name: RNNStep
doc: RNN 单步：`h' = φ (W h + U x)`。φ 为激活，W 为循环权重，U 为输入权重。
stmt: def RNNStep (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (h x : X) : X
proof: φ (W h + U x)

name: loopStepMap
doc: 隐状态映射（固定输入 x）：`h ↦ φ (W h + U x)`（RealLoop.iterate 的步函数）。
stmt: def loopStepMap (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (x : X) : X → X
proof: fun h => RNNStep φ W U h x

name: rnnState
doc: 轨迹：`rnnState φ W U h0 xs 0 = h0`，第 n+1 步用输入 `xs n`。
stmt:
def rnnState (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (h0 : X) (xs : ℕ → X) : ℕ → X
  | 0 => h0
  | n + 1 => RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs n) (xs n)

name: rnn_step_lipschitz
stmt:
lemma rnn_step_lipschitz (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (h g x : X) :
    ‖RNNStep φ W U h x - RNNStep φ W U g x‖ ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖h - g‖
proof:
by
  have hsub : (W h + U x) - (W g + U x) = W (h - g) := by
    rw [show (W h + U x) - (W g + U x) = W h - W g by abel, map_sub]
  calc
    ‖RNNStep φ W U h x - RNNStep φ W U g x‖
        = ‖φ (W h + U x) - φ (W g + U x)‖ := by rfl
    _ ≤ Lφ * ‖(W h + U x) - (W g + U x)‖ := hφ _ _
    _ = Lφ * ‖W (h - g)‖ := by rw [hsub]
    _ ≤ Lφ * (‖W‖ * ‖h - g‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (W.le_opNorm (h - g)) hLφ
    _ = (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖h - g‖ := by ring

name: rnn_step_input_lipschitz
stmt:
lemma rnn_step_input_lipschitz (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ Lu : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (_hLu : 0 ≤ Lu)
    (hU : ∀ x, ‖U x‖ ≤ Lu * ‖x‖) (h g x y : X) :
    ‖RNNStep φ W U h x - RNNStep φ W U g y‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖h - g‖ + (Lφ * Lu) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have hsub : (W h + U x) - (W g + U y) = W (h - g) + U (x - y) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub]
    abel
  have hUxy : ‖U (x - y)‖ ≤ Lu * ‖x - y‖ := hU (x - y)
  have hWxy : ‖W (h - g)‖ ≤ ‖W‖ * ‖h - g‖ := W.le_opNorm (h - g)
  calc
    ‖RNNStep φ W U h x - RNNStep φ W U g y‖
        = ‖φ (W h + U x) - φ (W g + U y)‖ := by rfl
    _ ≤ Lφ * ‖(W h + U x) - (W g + U y)‖ := hφ _ _
    _ = Lφ * ‖W (h - g) + U (x - y)‖ := by rw [hsub]
    _ ≤ Lφ * (‖W (h - g)‖ + ‖U (x - y)‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_add_le _ _) hLφ
    _ ≤ Lφ * (‖W‖ * ‖h - g‖ + Lu * ‖x - y‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hWxy hUxy) hLφ
    _ = (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖h - g‖ + (Lφ * Lu) * ‖x - y‖ := by ring

name: geom_sum_range_succ
stmt:
lemma geom_sum_range_succ (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), ρ ^ i) = 1 + ρ * (∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ ^ i)
proof:
by
  have hsum : (∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ ^ (i + 1)) = ∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ * ρ ^ i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.mul_sum, hsum]
  ring

name: geometric_error_decay
stmt:
lemma geometric_error_decay (ρ c E δ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (e : ℕ → ℝ)
    (he0 : e 0 ≤ E) (hstep : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ ρ * e n + c * δ) :
    ∀ n, e n ≤ ρ ^ n * E + (∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ ^ i) * (c * δ)
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using he0
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        e (n + 1) ≤ ρ * e n + c * δ := hstep n
        _ ≤ ρ * (ρ ^ n * E + (∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ ^ i) * (c * δ)) + c * δ :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hρ0) le_rfl
        _ = ρ ^ (n + 1) * E
              + (∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), ρ ^ i) * (c * δ) := by
              rw [geom_sum_range_succ ρ n, pow_succ]
              ring

name: rnn_hidden_contraction
stmt:
theorem rnn_hidden_contraction (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ)
    (h0 g0 : X) (xs : ℕ → X) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs n - rnnState φ W U g0 xs n‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ n * ‖h0 - g0‖
proof:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * ‖W‖ := mul_nonneg hLφ (norm_nonneg W)
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [rnnState]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hstep := rnn_step_lipschitz φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ
        (rnnState φ W U h0 xs n) (rnnState φ W U g0 xs n) (xs n)
      have hunfold : rnnState φ W U h0 xs (n + 1)
          = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs n) (xs n) := by simp [rnnState]
      have hunfold' : rnnState φ W U g0 xs (n + 1)
          = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U g0 xs n) (xs n) := by simp [rnnState]
      calc
        ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (n + 1) - rnnState φ W U g0 xs (n + 1)‖
            = ‖RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs n) (xs n)
                - RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U g0 xs n) (xs n)‖ := by rw [hunfold, hunfold']
        _ ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs n - rnnState φ W U g0 xs n‖ := hstep
        _ ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ((Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ n * ‖h0 - g0‖) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hρ0
        _ = (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ (n + 1) * ‖h0 - g0‖ := by ring

name: rnn_input_error_bound
stmt:
theorem rnn_input_error_bound (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ Lu δ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (hLu : 0 ≤ Lu)
    (hU : ∀ x, ‖U x‖ ≤ Lu * ‖x‖)
    (h0 g0 : X) (xs ys : ℕ → X) (n : ℕ)
    (hδ : ∀ k, ‖xs k - ys k‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs n - rnnState φ W U g0 ys n‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ n * ‖h0 - g0‖
        + (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ i) * ((Lφ * Lu) * δ)
proof:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * ‖W‖ := mul_nonneg hLφ (norm_nonneg W)
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * Lu := mul_nonneg hLφ hLu
  have hstep : ∀ k, ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1) - rnnState φ W U g0 ys (k + 1)‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs k - rnnState φ W U g0 ys k‖
        + (Lφ * Lu) * δ := by
    intro k
    have hunfold : rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1)
        = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (xs k) := by simp [rnnState]
    have hunfold' : rnnState φ W U g0 ys (k + 1)
        = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U g0 ys k) (ys k) := by simp [rnnState]
    have hk := rnn_step_input_lipschitz φ W U Lφ Lu hφ hLφ hLu hU
      (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (rnnState φ W U g0 ys k) (xs k) (ys k)
    have hk' : ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1) - rnnState φ W U g0 ys (k + 1)‖
        ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs k - rnnState φ W U g0 ys k‖
          + (Lφ * Lu) * ‖xs k - ys k‖ := by rw [hunfold, hunfold']; exact hk
    exact hk'.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hδ k) hc0))
  have hmain := geometric_error_decay (Lφ * ‖W‖) (Lφ * Lu) ‖h0 - g0‖ δ hρ0
    (fun k => ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs k - rnnState φ W U g0 ys k‖)
    (by simp [rnnState]) hstep
  exact hmain n

name: rnn_stability_bound
stmt:
theorem rnn_stability_bound (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ Lu δ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (hLu : 0 ≤ Lu)
    (hU : ∀ x, ‖U x‖ ≤ Lu * ‖x‖)
    (hρ1 : Lφ * ‖W‖ < 1)
    (h0 : X) (xs ys : ℕ → X) (n : ℕ)
    (hδ : ∀ k, ‖xs k - ys k‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs n - rnnState φ W U h0 ys n‖
      ≤ ((1 - (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ n) / (1 - Lφ * ‖W‖)) * ((Lφ * Lu) * δ)
proof:
by
  have hb := rnn_input_error_bound φ W U Lφ Lu δ hφ hLφ hLu hU h0 h0 xs ys n hδ
  have h1 : ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs n - rnnState φ W U h0 ys n‖
      ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ i) * ((Lφ * Lu) * δ) := by
    simpa using hb
  have hgeom : (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ i)
      = (1 - (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ n) / (1 - Lφ * ‖W‖) := by
    rw [geom_sum_eq (by linarith : Lφ * ‖W‖ ≠ 1) n]
    rw [div_eq_div_iff (by linarith : (Lφ * ‖W‖ - 1) ≠ 0) (by linarith : (1 - Lφ * ‖W‖) ≠ 0)]
    ring
  rw [hgeom] at h1
  exact h1

name: rnnState_eq_of_eq_prefix
stmt:
lemma rnnState_eq_of_eq_prefix (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (h0 g0 : X)
    (xs ys : ℕ → X) :
    ∀ k, h0 = g0 → (∀ j, j < k → xs j = ys j) →
      rnnState φ W U h0 xs k = rnnState φ W U g0 ys k
proof:
by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro heq _; simpa [rnnState] using heq
  | succ k ih =>
      intro heq hxs
      have hunfold : rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1)
          = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (xs k) := by simp [rnnState]
      have hunfold' : rnnState φ W U g0 ys (k + 1)
          = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U g0 ys k) (ys k) := by simp [rnnState]
      rw [hunfold, hunfold', ih heq (fun j hj => hxs j (by omega)), hxs k (by omega)]

name: rnn_forget_bound
stmt:
theorem rnn_forget_bound (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ Lu δ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (hLu : 0 ≤ Lu)
    (hU : ∀ x, ‖U x‖ ≤ Lu * ‖x‖)
    (h0 : X) (xs ys : ℕ → X) (k m : ℕ)
    (hk : ‖xs k - ys k‖ ≤ δ)
    (hxs : ∀ j, j ≠ k → xs j = ys j) :
    ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1 + m) - rnnState φ W U h0 ys (k + 1 + m)‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ m * ((Lφ * Lu) * δ)
proof:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * ‖W‖ := mul_nonneg hLφ (norm_nonneg W)
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * Lu := mul_nonneg hLφ hLu
  have hsame : rnnState φ W U h0 xs k = rnnState φ W U h0 ys k :=
    rnnState_eq_of_eq_prefix φ W U h0 h0 xs ys k rfl (fun j hj => hxs j (by omega))
                                 
  have hE : ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1) - rnnState φ W U h0 ys (k + 1)‖
      ≤ (Lφ * Lu) * δ := by
    have hunfold : rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1)
        = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (xs k) := by simp [rnnState]
    have hunfold' : rnnState φ W U h0 ys (k + 1)
        = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 ys k) (ys k) := by simp [rnnState]
    have hstep := rnn_step_input_lipschitz φ W U Lφ Lu hφ hLφ hLu hU
      (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (rnnState φ W U h0 ys k) (xs k) (ys k)
    rw [hunfold, hunfold']
    calc
      ‖RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (xs k)
          - RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 ys k) (ys k)‖
          ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs k - rnnState φ W U h0 ys k‖
              + (Lφ * Lu) * ‖xs k - ys k‖ := hstep
      _ = (Lφ * Lu) * ‖xs k - ys k‖ := by simp [hsame]
      _ ≤ (Lφ * Lu) * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk hc0
                         
  have hdecay : ∀ m, ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1 + m) - rnnState φ W U h0 ys (k + 1 + m)‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ m * ((Lφ * Lu) * δ) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simpa using hE
    | succ m ih =>
        have hidx : k + 1 + (m + 1) = k + 1 + m + 1 := by omega
        have h

name: loop_model_contraction
stmt:
theorem loop_model_contraction (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (x : X) :
    ∀ h g, ‖loopStepMap φ W U x h - loopStepMap φ W U x g‖ ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖h - g‖
proof:
by
  intro h g
  simpa [loopStepMap] using rnn_step_lipschitz φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ h g x

name: loop_fixed_point_unique
stmt:
theorem loop_fixed_point_unique (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ)
    (hρ1 : Lφ * ‖W‖ < 1) (x p q : X)
    (hp : loopStepMap φ W U x p = p) (hq : loopStepMap φ W U x q = q) : p = q
proof:
by
  have hlip := loop_model_contraction φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ x p q
  rw [hp, hq] at hlip
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - Lφ * ‖W‖ := by linarith
  have hle : (1 - Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖p - q‖ ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [hlip]
  have hd0 : ‖p - q‖ ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [hle, hpos]
  have hd : ‖p - q‖ = 0 := le_antisymm hd0 (norm_nonneg _)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hd)

                                                 
                                                
                                                          
                                         

section IterateLink

variable {Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y]

omit [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] in

name: iterate_fixed_point
doc: 辅助：`f p = p` ⟹ `iterate f n p = p`（不动点迭代仍不动）。
stmt:
lemma iterate_fixed_point (f : Y → Y) (p : Y) (hp : f p = p) :
    ∀ n, iterate f n p = p
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [iterate]
  | succ n ih =>
      show iterate f n (f p) = p
      rw [hp, ih]

omit [NormedSpace ℝ Y] in

name: iterate_lipschitz
doc: 辅助：Lipschitz 映射的迭代是 Lⁿ-Lipschitz（`iterate_step_swap`）。
stmt:
lemma iterate_lipschitz (f : Y → Y) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hf : ∀ a b, ‖f a - f b‖ ≤ L * ‖a - b‖) :
    ∀ n a b, ‖iterate f n a - iterate f n b‖ ≤ L ^ n * ‖a - b‖
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro a b; simp [iterate]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro a b
      have hswap : iterate f n (f a) = f (iterate f n a) := iterate_step_swap f n a
      have hswap' : iterate f n (f b) = f (iterate f n b) := iterate_step_swap f n b
      have hunfold : iterate f (n + 1) a = iterate f n (f a) := by simp [iterate]
      have hunfold' : iterate f (n + 1) b = iterate f n (f b) := by simp [iterate]
      rw [hunfold, hunfold', hswap, hswap']
      calc
        ‖f (iterate f n a) - f (iterate f n b)‖
            ≤ L * ‖iterate f n a - iterate f n b‖ := hf _ _
        _ ≤ L * (L ^ n * ‖a - b‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih a b) hL
        _ = L ^ (n + 1) * ‖a - b‖ := by ring

name: loop_converges_to_fixed_point
doc: 迭代对不动点的几何收敛率 `‖Tⁿ h₀ − p‖ ≤ ρⁿ·‖h₀ − p‖`（文件头定理链第 7 条）。
stmt:
theorem loop_converges_to_fixed_point (φ : Y → Y) (W U : Y →L[ℝ] Y) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (x : Y)
    (h0 p : Y) (hp : loopStepMap φ W U x p = p) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n h0 - p‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ n * ‖h0 - p‖
proof:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * ‖W‖ := mul_nonneg hLφ (norm_nonneg W)
  have hlip : ∀ a b, ‖loopStepMap φ W U x a - loopStepMap φ W U x b‖ ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖a - b‖ :=
    loop_model_contraction φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ x
  have hiter := iterate_lipschitz (loopStepMap φ W U x) (Lφ * ‖W‖) hρ0 hlip n h0 p
  have hfix : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n p = p := iterate_fixed_point _ p hp n
  rw [hfix] at hiter
  exact hiter

name: loop_iterate_convergence
doc: ρ < 1 ⟹ 两条迭代轨迹最终 ε-接近（接 `contraction_converges`；文件头定理链第 8 条）。
stmt:
theorem loop_iterate_convergence (φ : Y → Y) (W U : Y →L[ℝ] Y) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ)
    (hρ0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * ‖W‖) (hρ1 : Lφ * ‖W‖ < 1) (x h0 g0 : Y) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ n : ℕ, ‖iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n h0
        - iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n g0‖ < ε
proof:
by
  have hlip : ∀ a b,
      ‖loopStepMap φ W U x a - loopStepMap φ W U x b‖ ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖a - b‖ :=
    loop_model_contraction φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ x
  refine contraction_converges (Lφ * ‖W‖) hρ0 hρ1 ?_ ?_
  · intro n
    have hswap : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n (loopStepMap φ W U x h0)
        = loopStepMap φ W U x (iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n h0) :=
      iterate_step_swap _ n h0
    have hswap' : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n (loopStepMap φ W U x g0)
        = loopStepMap φ W U x (iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n g0) :=
      iterate_step_swap _ n g0
    have hunfold : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) (n + 1) h0
        = iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n (loopStepMap φ W U x h0) := by simp [iterate]
    have hunfold' : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) (n + 1) g0
        = iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n (loopStepMap φ W U x g0) := by simp [iterate]
    rw [hunfold, hunfold', hswap, hswap']
    exact hlip _ _
  · intro n
    exact norm_nonneg _

end IterateLink

end Lattice

name: frobeniusNorm
doc: Frobenius 范数：‖A‖_F = √(Σᵢ Σⱼ Aᵢⱼ²)（ℝ 上 Aᵢⱼ² = ‖Aᵢⱼ‖²）。
stmt: def frobeniusNorm (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) : ℝ
proof: Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin n, (A i j) ^ 2)

name: frobeniusNorm_nonneg
stmt: lemma frobeniusNorm_nonneg (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) : 0 ≤ frobeniusNorm A
proof:
by
  unfold frobeniusNorm
  exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: sum_sq_nonneg
doc: 平方和 Σᵢ Σⱼ Aᵢⱼ² ≥ 0（开方前提）。
stmt:
lemma sum_sq_nonneg {k l : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin l) ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin k, ∑ j : Fin l, (A i j) ^ 2
proof:
by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j hj => sq_nonneg _))

name: euclid_norm_sq_eq
doc: 欧氏范数平方 = 逐坐标平方和：‖x‖² = Σⱼ xⱼ²。
stmt:
lemma euclid_norm_sq_eq {k : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ j : Fin k, (x j) ^ 2
proof:
by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  · positivity

name: matvecE
doc: 矩阵乘欧氏向量（行点积）：(Ax)ᵢ = Σⱼ Aᵢⱼ xⱼ。
stmt:
def matvecE (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)
proof: fun i : Fin m => ∑ j : Fin n, A i j * x j

name: matvecE_add
stmt:
lemma matvecE_add (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    matvecE A (x + y) = matvecE A x + matvecE A y
proof:
by
  ext i
  unfold matvecE
  calc
    (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * (x j + y j)) = ∑ j : Fin n, (A i j * x j + A i j * y j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring
    _ = (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * x j) + (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * y j) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: matvecE_smul
stmt:
lemma matvecE_smul (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (c : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    matvecE A (c • x) = c • matvecE A x
proof:
by
  ext i
  unfold matvecE
  calc
    (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * (c * x j)) = ∑ j : Fin n, c * (A i j * x j) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring
    _ = c * ∑ j : Fin n, A i j * x j := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: matvecE_mul
doc: 矩阵乘法 = 线性映射复合：(A·B)x = A(Bx)（`mulVec_mulVec`）。
stmt:
lemma matvecE_mul (A : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin m) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    matvecE (A * B) x = matvecE A (matvecE B x)
proof:
by
  change Matrix.mulVec (A * B) x = Matrix.mulVec A (Matrix.mulVec B x)
  exact (Matrix.mulVec_mulVec (v := x) (M := A) (N := B)).symm

name: matvecE_single
doc: 单位向量作用：A·eⱼ = A 的第 j 列（eⱼ = `EuclideanSpace.single j 1`）。
stmt:
lemma matvecE_single (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    matvecE A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) = fun i : Fin m => A i j
proof:
by
  ext i
  unfold matvecE
  calc
    (∑ j_1 : Fin n, A i j_1 * EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) j_1) = A i j * 1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · simp
      · intro b hb hbj
        rw [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, if_neg hbj]
        simp
      · intro hj
        simp at hj
    _ = A i j := by ring

name: row_cs_bound
doc:
行 Cauchy-Schwarz：内积 ⟪Aᵢ·, x⟫ = Σⱼ Aᵢⱼ xⱼ 满足
(Σⱼ Aᵢⱼ xⱼ)² ≤ (Σⱼ Aᵢⱼ²)·(Σⱼ xⱼ²)。
stmt:
lemma row_cs_bound (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : Fin m) :
    (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * x j) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j : Fin n, (A i j) ^ 2) * (∑ j : Fin n, (x j) ^ 2)
proof:
by
  let u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := fun j : Fin n => A i j
  have hcs := abs_real_inner_le_norm u x
  have hsq : (inner u x) ^ 2 ≤ ‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (inner u x) ^ 2 = |(inner u x)| ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]
      _ ≤ (‖u‖ * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by
        have hb : 0 ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖x‖ := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
        exact sq_le_sq.mpr (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hb] using hcs)
      _ = ‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct] at hsq
  rw [euclid_norm_sq_eq, euclid_norm_sq_eq] at hsq
  simpa [Matrix.dotProduct, u] using hsq

name: frobeniusNorm_sq
stmt:
lemma frobeniusNorm_sq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (frobeniusNorm A) ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin n, (A i j) ^ 2
proof:
by
  unfold frobeniusNorm
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (sum_sq_nonneg A)]

name: frobenius_bound
doc: 逐点界：‖Ax‖ ≤ ‖A‖_F·‖x‖（行 CS 逐行 + 求和 + 开方）。
stmt:
lemma frobenius_bound (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ‖matvecE A x‖ ≤ frobeniusNorm A * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  have hsq : ‖matvecE A x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (frobeniusNorm A * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖matvecE A x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin m, (matvecE A x i) ^ 2 := by rw [euclid_norm_sq_eq]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin m, (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * x j) ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rfl
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, ((∑ j : Fin n, (A i j) ^ 2) * (∑ j : Fin n, (x j) ^ 2)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        exact row_cs_bound A x i
      _ = (∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin n, (A i j) ^ 2) * (∑ j : Fin n, (x j) ^ 2) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = (frobeniusNorm A) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← frobeniusNorm_sq]
        rw [← euclid_norm_sq_eq]
      _ = (frobeniusNorm A * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by ring
  have ha : 0 ≤ ‖matvecE A x‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hb : 0 ≤ frobeniusNorm A * ‖x‖ := mul_nonneg (frobeniusNorm_nonneg A) (norm_nonneg _)
  have habs : |‖matvecE A x‖| ≤ |frobeniusNorm A * ‖x‖| := (sq_le_sq.mp hsq)
  simpa [abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb] using habs

name: matvecELin
stmt:
def matvecELin (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) where
  toFun
proof:
matvecE A
  map_add' := matvecE_add A
  map_smul' := matvecE_smul A

name: matCLME
doc: 矩阵作为欧氏空间上的连续线性算子（以 ‖A‖_F 为显式界构造）。
stmt: def matCLME (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)
proof: (matvecELin A).mkContinuous (frobeniusNorm A) (frobenius_bound A)

name: matCLME_apply
stmt:
lemma matCLME_apply (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    matCLME A x = matvecE A x
proof:
by
  unfold matCLME
  rw [LinearMap.mkContinuous_apply]
  rfl

name: opNorm_le_frobenius
stmt: theorem opNorm_le_frobenius (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) : ‖matCLME A‖ ≤ frobeniusNorm A
proof:
by
  unfold matCLME
  exact LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le (matvecELin A) (frobeniusNorm_nonneg A) (frobenius_bound A)

name: matCLME_mul
stmt:
lemma matCLME_mul (A : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin m) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    matCLME (A * B) = matCLME A ∘L matCLME B
proof:
by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [matCLME_apply]
  rw [matCLME_apply]
  rw [matCLME_apply]
  exact matvecE_mul A B x

name: matrix_mul_norm_bound
stmt:
theorem matrix_mul_norm_bound (A : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin m) ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ‖matCLME (A * B)‖ ≤ ‖matCLME A‖ * ‖matCLME B‖
proof:
by
  rw [matCLME_mul]
  exact (matCLME A).opNorm_comp_le (matCLME B)

name: col_norm_sq
stmt:
lemma col_norm_sq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    ‖matvecE A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin m, (A i j) ^ 2
proof:
by
  rw [euclid_norm_sq_eq]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [matvecE_single]

name: col_norm_le_opNorm
stmt:
lemma col_norm_le_opNorm (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    ‖matvecE A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ≤ ‖matCLME A‖
proof:
by
  have h := (matCLME A).le_opNorm (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))
  rw [matCLME_apply] at h
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_single] at h
  simpa using h

name: frobenius_sq_eq_sum_col
doc: Frobenius 平方 = 各列范数平方之和。
stmt:
lemma frobenius_sq_eq_sum_col (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (frobeniusNorm A) ^ 2 = ∑ j : Fin n, ‖matvecE A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2
proof:
by
  rw [frobeniusNorm_sq]
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin n, (A i j) ^ 2) = ∑ j : Fin n, ∑ i : Fin m, (A i j) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin n, ‖matvecE A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [col_norm_sq]

name: frobenius_le_opNorm_sqrt
doc: 诚实反向界：‖A‖_F ≤ √n·‖A‖_op（n = 列数；标准形式为 √n，未强求 √(m·n)）。
stmt:
theorem frobenius_le_opNorm_sqrt (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    frobeniusNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖
proof:
by
  have hsq : (frobeniusNorm A) ^ 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (frobeniusNorm A) ^ 2 = ∑ j : Fin n, ‖matvecE A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 :=
        frobenius_sq_eq_sum_col A
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j hj
        have hle := col_norm_le_opNorm A j
        exact sq_le_sq.mpr (by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
          exact hle)
      _ = (Fintype.card (Fin n)) * ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
        simp
      _ = (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
        simp [Fintype.card_fin]
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖) ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_le n)
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hn]
  have hsq' : (frobeniusNorm A) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖) ^ 2 := by
    rwa [hsqrt]
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖ :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  have habs : |frobeniusNorm A| ≤ |Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖| := (sq_le_sq.mp hsq')
  simpa [abs_of_nonneg (frobeniusNorm_nonneg A), abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] using habs

name: matvecE_adjoint_eq
doc: 内积对偶：⟪Ax, y⟫ = ⟪x, Aᵀy⟫（转置是伴随；求和交换）。
stmt:
lemma matvecE_adjoint_eq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    (inner (matvecE A x) y : ℝ) = (inner x (matvecE Aᵀ y) : ℝ)
proof:
by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
  simp [Matrix.dotProduct, matvecE, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin m, (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * x j) * y i)
        = ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j : Fin n, (A i j * x j) * y i := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin n, ∑ i : Fin m, (A i j * x j) * y i := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin n, x j * (∑ i : Fin m, A i j * y i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          calc
            (∑ i : Fin m, (A i j * x j) * y i) = ∑ i : Fin m, x j * (A i j * y i) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro i hi
              ring
            _ = x j * (∑ i : Fin m, A i j * y i) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: basis_coord
doc: 单位基向量取坐标：vⱼ = ⟪eⱼ, v⟫（ℝ 上 conj 1 = 1）。
stmt:
lemma basis_coord (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (j : Fin n) :
    v j = inner (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) v
proof:
by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  simp

name: matCLME_adjoint
doc: 转置是伴随：matCLME Aᵀ = (matCLME A)†。
stmt:
lemma matCLME_adjoint (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    (matCLME A)† = matCLME Aᵀ
proof:
by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro y
  ext j
  calc
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (matCLME A) y) j
        = inner (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (matCLME A) y) := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
      simp
    _ = inner (matCLME A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) y := by
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (matCLME A) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) y
    _ = inner (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) (matCLME Aᵀ y) := by
      rw [matCLME_apply, matCLME_apply]
      exact matvecE_adjoint_eq A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) y
    _ = (matCLME Aᵀ y) j := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
      simp

name: norm_transpose_eq
doc: 转置保算子范数：‖Aᵀ‖_op = ‖A‖_op（伴随保范数）。
stmt:
theorem norm_transpose_eq (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ‖matCLME Aᵀ‖ = ‖matCLME A‖
proof:
by
  rw [← matCLME_adjoint A]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.norm_map (matCLME A))

end Lattice

name: argmax_of_monotone
stmt:
theorem argmax_of_monotone (s : ι → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Monotone g) (i : ι)
    (hi : IsArgMax s i) : IsArgMax (fun j => g (s j)) i
proof:
by
  intro j
  exact hg (hi j)

name: sigmoid_monotone
stmt: theorem sigmoid_monotone (x y : ℝ) (h : x ≤ y) : sigmoid x ≤ sigmoid y
proof:
by
  unfold sigmoid
                                        
  have hne : Real.exp (-y) ≤ Real.exp (-x) := by
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
                               
  have hd1 : 0 < 1 + Real.exp (-x) := by positivity
  have hd2 : 0 < 1 + Real.exp (-y) := by positivity
  have hden : 1 + Real.exp (-y) ≤ 1 + Real.exp (-x) := by linarith
                                  
  have hinv : (1 + Real.exp (-x))⁻¹ ≤ (1 + Real.exp (-y))⁻¹ :=
    (inv_le_inv₀ hd1 hd2).mpr hden
          
  calc
    1 / (1 + Real.exp (-x)) = (1 + Real.exp (-x))⁻¹ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
    _ ≤ (1 + Real.exp (-y))⁻¹ := hinv
    _ = 1 / (1 + Real.exp (-y)) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring

                         
                                     

omit [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] in

name: sigmoid_gate_preserves_order
stmt:
theorem sigmoid_gate_preserves_order (s : ι → ℝ) (i j : ι) (h : s j ≤ s i) :
    sigmoid (s j) ≤ sigmoid (s i)
proof: sigmoid_monotone (s j) (s i) h

name: moe_expert_selection
stmt:
theorem moe_expert_selection (s : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (hi : IsArgMax s i) :
    IsArgMax (fun j => sigmoid (s j)) i
proof:
by
  exact argmax_of_monotone s sigmoid (by
    intro a b h
    exact sigmoid_monotone a b h) i hi

name: softmax_gate_preserves_order
stmt:
theorem softmax_gate_preserves_order (s : ι → ℝ) (i j : ι) (h : s j ≤ s i) :
    softmax s j ≤ softmax s i
proof:
softmax_monotone s i j h

                   
                                                         
                            
                                                     

end Lattice

name: expertLoad
doc:
每专家负载：路由到专家 e 的 token 数。抽象为任意 Nat 值函数，
对应「分配矩阵按专家列计数」。
stmt: def expertLoad (iota : Type*)
proof: iota → Nat

name: droppedAt
doc: 专家 e 的溢出丢弃数 max 0 (load e - capacity e)。
stmt: def droppedAt (load capacity : iota → Nat) (e : iota) : Nat
proof: max 0 (load e - capacity e)

name: droppedCount
doc: 全模型丢弃 token 数：各专家溢出之和。
stmt: def droppedCount (load capacity : iota → Nat) : Nat
proof: ∑ e, droppedAt load capacity e

name: Balanced
doc: 均衡谓词：每个专家的负载都不超过容量（该专家无溢出）。
stmt: def Balanced (load capacity : iota → Nat) : Prop
proof: ∀ e, load e ≤ capacity e

name: droppedAt_eq_zero_iff
doc: 单专家丢弃为 0 <-> 该专家不超容。
stmt:
theorem droppedAt_eq_zero_iff (load capacity : iota → Nat) (e : iota) :
    droppedAt load capacity e = 0 ↔ load e ≤ capacity e
proof:
by
  unfold droppedAt
  omega

name: droppedCount_eq_zero_iff
doc: * **刻画**：droppedCount = 0 <-> Balanced。
stmt:
theorem droppedCount_eq_zero_iff (load capacity : iota → Nat) :
    droppedCount load capacity = 0 ↔ Balanced load capacity
proof:
by
  unfold droppedCount Balanced
  constructor
  · intro h e
    have h0 : droppedAt load capacity e = 0 := by
      have hz : ∀ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset iota), droppedAt load capacity x = 0 :=
        Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp h
      exact hz e (Finset.mem_univ e)
    exact (droppedAt_eq_zero_iff load capacity e).mp h0
  · intro h
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
    exact (droppedAt_eq_zero_iff load capacity e).mpr (h e)

name: balanced_no_drop
doc: **均衡 => 无丢弃**。
stmt:
theorem balanced_no_drop (load capacity : iota → Nat) (h : Balanced load capacity) :
    droppedCount load capacity = 0
proof: (droppedCount_eq_zero_iff load capacity).mpr h

name: imbalance_forces_drop
stmt:
theorem imbalance_forces_drop (load capacity : iota → Nat)
    (h : ∃ e, capacity e < load e) : 0 < droppedCount load capacity
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := h
  have hpos : 0 < droppedAt load capacity e := by
    unfold droppedAt
    omega
  have hle : droppedAt load capacity e ≤ droppedCount load capacity :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun e => droppedAt load capacity e)
      (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ e)
  omega

name: no_drop_forces_no_overflow
doc: 逆否形式。
stmt:
theorem no_drop_forces_no_overflow (load capacity : iota → Nat)
    (h : droppedCount load capacity = 0) : ¬ (∃ e, capacity e < load e)
proof:
by
  intro hc
  have := imbalance_forces_drop load capacity hc
  omega

name: drop_lower_bound
doc: * **下界**：Sum load - Sum cap <= droppedCount。
stmt:
theorem drop_lower_bound (load capacity : iota → Nat) :
    (∑ e, load e) - (∑ e, capacity e) ≤ droppedCount load capacity
proof:
by
  unfold droppedCount droppedAt
                                              
                                     
  have key : ∀ e : iota, load e - capacity e ≤ max 0 (load e - capacity e) := by
    intro e; omega
                                                         
  have hsub : (∑ e, (load e - capacity e)) ≤ ∑ e, max 0 (load e - capacity e) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun e _ => key e
                                                                     
  have hsplit : (∑ e, load e) - (∑ e, capacity e) ≤ ∑ e, (load e - capacity e) := by
    have : ∑ e, (load e - capacity e) + ∑ e, capacity e ≥ ∑ e, load e := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun e _ => by omega
    omega
  omega

name: drop_of_total_exceeds_capacity
doc: **总需求超总容量 => 必有丢弃**（鸽笼定量版）。
stmt:
theorem drop_of_total_exceeds_capacity (load capacity : iota → Nat)
    (h : (∑ e, capacity e) < ∑ e, load e) : 0 < droppedCount load capacity
proof:
by
  have hb := drop_lower_bound load capacity
  omega

name: uniform_drop_le_total
doc: 均一容量 c 下丢弃数 <= 总负载。
stmt:
theorem uniform_drop_le_total (load : iota → Nat) (c : Nat) :
    droppedCount load (fun _ => c) ≤ ∑ e, load e
proof:
by
  unfold droppedCount droppedAt
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun e _ => by omega

name: uniform_capacity_forces_drop
doc: * **均一容量下的可失败性**：c*|iota| < Sum load => 丢弃 > 0。
stmt:
theorem uniform_capacity_forces_drop (load : iota → Nat) (c : Nat) [Nonempty iota]
    (h : c * Fintype.card iota < ∑ e, load e) :
    0 < droppedCount load (fun _ => c)
proof:
by
  apply drop_of_total_exceeds_capacity
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  exact h

name: witness_imbalanced_drops
doc: 不均衡见证：2 专家，负载 (4,0)，容量 (2,2) => 丢弃 = 2。
stmt:
theorem witness_imbalanced_drops :
    droppedCount (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then 4 else 0) (fun _ : Fin 2 => 2) = 2
proof:
by
  norm_num [droppedCount, droppedAt, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: witness_balanced_no_drop
doc: 均衡见证：**同一负载** (4,0)，容量放宽为 (4,0) => 丢弃 = 0。
stmt:
theorem witness_balanced_no_drop :
    droppedCount (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then 4 else 0)
      (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then 4 else 0) = 0
proof:
by
  norm_num [droppedCount, droppedAt, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: witness_flip
doc: * **身份断言**：同一 load 在容量 A 下丢弃 > 0、在容量 B 下丢弃 = 0。
stmt:
theorem witness_flip :
    ∃ (load capacity capacity' : Fin 2 → Nat),
      droppedCount load capacity = 2 ∧ droppedCount load capacity' = 0
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then 4 else 0,
          fun _ : Fin 2 => 2, fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then 4 else 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact witness_imbalanced_drops
  · exact witness_balanced_no_drop

name: witness_core_fires
doc: 核心定理在**该实例上触发**的独立复核（非空洞假设）。
stmt:
theorem witness_core_fires :
    0 < droppedCount (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then 4 else 0) (fun _ : Fin 2 => 2)
proof:
by
  apply imbalance_forces_drop
  exact ⟨0, by decide⟩

name: witness_core_quiet
doc: 均衡侧核心定理的独立复核。
stmt:
theorem witness_core_quiet :
    droppedCount (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then 4 else 0)
      (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then 4 else 0) = 0
proof:
by
  apply balanced_no_drop
  intro e
  fin_cases e <;> decide

                                               

end Lattice

name: routeLoad
doc:
批 `T` 上、路由 `R` 下，专家 `e` 的**扇入**：批内选中 `e` 的 token 数。
这正是 `RealMoELoadBalance.expertLoad` 的**具体来源**。
stmt: def routeLoad (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota) (e : iota) : Nat
proof: (T.filter (fun t => e ∈ R t)).card

name: capacityRespecting
doc: 路由 `R` 在批 `T`、容量 `capacity` 下**不超容**。
stmt:
def capacityRespecting (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota) (capacity : iota -> Nat) :
    Prop
proof: Balanced (routeLoad T R) capacity

name: routeDropped
doc: 该批在路由 `R`、容量 `capacity` 下的**丢弃数**。
stmt: def routeDropped (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota) (capacity : iota -> Nat) : Nat
proof: droppedCount (routeLoad T R) capacity

name: routeLoad_drop_eq_zero_iff
doc: * **路由层无丢弃 <-> 每专家扇入不超容**。
stmt:
theorem routeLoad_drop_eq_zero_iff (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota)
    (capacity : iota -> Nat) :
    routeDropped T R capacity = 0 <-> capacityRespecting T R capacity
proof: droppedCount_eq_zero_iff (routeLoad T R) capacity

name: route_over_capacity_drops
doc: * **某专家扇入超容 => 该批必丢弃**（消费 `imbalance_forces_drop`）。
stmt:
theorem route_over_capacity_drops (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota)
    (capacity : iota -> Nat) (h : ∃ e, capacity e < routeLoad T R e) :
    0 < routeDropped T R capacity
proof: imbalance_forces_drop (routeLoad T R) capacity h

name: balanced_route_no_drop
doc: **全部不超容 => 零丢弃**（消费 `balanced_no_drop`）。
stmt:
theorem balanced_route_no_drop (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota)
    (capacity : iota -> Nat) (h : capacityRespecting T R capacity) :
    routeDropped T R capacity = 0
proof: balanced_no_drop (routeLoad T R) capacity h

name: routeLoad_sum_eq_card_mul
doc: 每个 token 恰好选 `k` 个专家时，**总扇入 = k * |T|**：双重计数恒等式。
stmt:
theorem routeLoad_sum_eq_card_mul (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota) (k : Nat)
    (hcard : ∀ t ∈ T, (R t).card = k) :
    (∑ e, routeLoad T R e) = k * T.card
proof:
by
  classical
  have hswap : (∑ e, routeLoad T R e) = ∑ t in T, (R t).card := by
    conv_lhs => arg 2; intro e; rw [routeLoad, Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
    rw [show (∑ e : iota, ∑ a ∈ T, (if e ∈ R a then 1 else 0))
          = ∑ e ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset iota), ∑ a ∈ T, (if e ∈ R a then 1 else 0) by simp]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_boole (fun e => e ∈ R t) Finset.univ]
    simp
  rw [hswap, Finset.sum_congr rfl hcard, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]

name: topk_route_capacity_exceeded
doc: * **top-k 路由 + 容量不足 => 必丢弃**。
stmt:
theorem topk_route_capacity_exceeded (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota)
    (capacity : iota -> Nat) (k : Nat) [Nonempty iota]
    (hcard : ∀ t ∈ T, (R t).card = k)
    (hover : (∑ e, capacity e) < k * T.card) :
    0 < routeDropped T R capacity
proof:
by
  apply drop_of_total_exceeds_capacity
  rw [routeLoad_sum_eq_card_mul T R k hcard]
  exact hover

name: ncRoute
doc: 具体路由：2 专家、1 个 token、选满两个专家。
stmt: private def ncRoute : Fin 1 -> Finset (Fin 2)
proof: fun _ => Finset.univ

name: nc_witness_over_capacity_drops
stmt:
theorem nc_witness_over_capacity_drops :
    0 < routeDropped (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)) ncRoute (fun _ : Fin 2 => 0)
proof:
by
  apply route_over_capacity_drops
  exact ⟨0, by decide⟩

name: nc_witness_fits_no_drop
stmt:
theorem nc_witness_fits_no_drop :
    routeDropped (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)) ncRoute (fun _ : Fin 2 => 1) = 0
proof:
by
  apply balanced_route_no_drop
  intro e
  fin_cases e <;> decide

name: nc_route_flip
doc: * **身份断言**：**同一路由** `ncRoute` 下结论翻转。
stmt:
theorem nc_route_flip :
    ∃ capacity capacity2 : Fin 2 -> Nat,
      routeDropped (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)) ncRoute capacity ≠ 0 ∧
      routeDropped (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)) ncRoute capacity2 = 0
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 1, ?_, nc_witness_fits_no_drop⟩
  intro h
  have hpos := nc_witness_over_capacity_drops
  omega

name: nc_k_exceeds_capacity_witness
doc: * **k 侧触发**：k=2、2 token、容量各 1 => `4 > 2` 成立 => 丢弃 > 0。
stmt:
theorem nc_k_exceeds_capacity_witness :
    0 < routeDropped (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))
      (fun _ : Fin 2 => (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))) (fun _ : Fin 2 => 1)
proof:
by
  apply topk_route_capacity_exceeded (k := 2) <;> decide

name: nc_k_fits_no_drop
doc: **k 侧不触发**：同一实例、容量各 2 => `4 > 4` 假 => 丢弃 = 0。
stmt:
theorem nc_k_fits_no_drop :
    routeDropped (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))
      (fun _ : Fin 2 => (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))) (fun _ : Fin 2 => 2) = 0
proof:
by
  apply balanced_route_no_drop
  intro e
  fin_cases e <;> decide

end Lattice

name: modReLU
stmt: def modReLU (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ
proof: if z = 0 then 0 else ((relu (Complex.abs z + b) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z / (Complex.abs z : ℂ))

name: modReLU_zero
stmt: @[simp] theorem modReLU_zero (b : ℝ) : modReLU b 0 = 0
proof:
by
  unfold modReLU
  simp

name: modReLU_phase_preserved
stmt:
theorem modReLU_phase_preserved (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    modReLU b z = ((relu (Complex.abs z + b) / Complex.abs z : ℝ) : ℂ) * z
proof:
by
  unfold modReLU
  rw [if_neg hz]
  rw [Complex.ofReal_div]
  ring

name: modReLU_gain_nonneg
stmt: lemma modReLU_gain_nonneg (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : 0 ≤ relu (Complex.abs z + b) / Complex.abs z
proof:
by
  exact div_nonneg (relu_nonneg (Complex.abs z + b)) (Complex.abs.nonneg z)

name: modReLU_nonneg_gain
stmt:
theorem modReLU_nonneg_gain (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s ∧ modReLU b z = (s : ℂ) * z
proof:
by
  refine ⟨relu (Complex.abs z + b) / Complex.abs z, modReLU_gain_nonneg b z, ?_⟩
  exact modReLU_phase_preserved b z hz

name: modReLU_magnitude
stmt:
theorem modReLU_magnitude (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    Complex.abs (modReLU b z) = relu (Complex.abs z + b)
proof:
by
  rw [modReLU_phase_preserved b z hz]
  rw [AbsoluteValue.map_mul]
  rw [Complex.abs_ofReal]
  rw [abs_div]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (relu_nonneg (Complex.abs z + b))]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (Complex.abs.nonneg z)]
  have hzabs : Complex.abs z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← Complex.norm_eq_abs z]
    exact fun h => hz (norm_eq_zero.mp h)
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ (relu (Complex.abs z + b)) hzabs]

name: relu_le_abs
stmt: lemma relu_le_abs (x : ℝ) : relu x ≤ |x|
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  exact max_le (le_abs_self x) (abs_nonneg x)

name: modReLU_bounded
stmt: theorem modReLU_bounded (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : Complex.abs (modReLU b z) ≤ Complex.abs z + |b|
proof:
by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst hz
    rw [modReLU_zero b]
    rw [← Complex.norm_eq_abs (0 : ℂ)]
    simp
  · rw [modReLU_magnitude b z hz]
    calc
      relu (Complex.abs z + b) ≤ |Complex.abs z + b| := relu_le_abs _
      _ ≤ |Complex.abs z| + |b| := abs_add _ _
      _ = Complex.abs z + |b| := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (Complex.abs.nonneg z)]

name: modReLU_magnitude_subgradient
stmt:
theorem modReLU_magnitude_subgradient (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < Complex.abs z + b) :
    Subgradient relu (Complex.abs z + b) 1
proof:
(relu_subgradient_positive (Complex.abs z + b) 1 hz).mpr rfl

end Lattice

name: relu_abs_sub_le
doc: `relu` 的 1-Lipschitz 性（`|relu a − relu b| ≤ |a − b|`，`max` 的 1-Lipschitz）。
stmt: theorem relu_abs_sub_le (a b : ℝ) : |relu a - relu b| ≤ |a - b|
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  exact abs_max_sub_max_le_abs a b 0

name: modReLU_one_half
doc: 具体值：`modReLU 1 (1/2) = 3/2`（实数意义下，`b = 1 > 0`）。
stmt:
theorem modReLU_one_half :
    modReLU 1 (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) = (((3 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)
proof:
by
  have hz : (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  rw [modReLU_phase_preserved 1 _ hz]
  have habs : Complex.abs ((((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Complex.abs_ofReal]
    norm_num
  have hr : relu (Complex.abs ((((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) + 1) = (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [habs]
    unfold relu
    norm_num
  rw [hr, habs]
  norm_num

name: modReLU_counterexample
stmt:
theorem modReLU_counterexample :
    Complex.abs (modReLU 1 0 - modReLU 1 (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = 3 / 2 ∧
    Complex.abs ((0 : ℂ) - (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = 1 / 2
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rw [modReLU_zero, zero_sub, modReLU_one_half]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.abs_ofReal]
    norm_num
  · rw [show (0 : ℂ) - (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) = (((-(1 / 2) : ℝ)) : ℂ) by norm_num]
    rw [Complex.abs_ofReal]
    norm_num

name: modReLU_not_one_lipschitz_for_pos_bias
doc: **原命题（全 `b` 的 1-Lipschitz）为假**（对 `b = 1` 即被上面的具体反例推翻）。
stmt:
theorem modReLU_not_one_lipschitz_for_pos_bias :
    ¬ (∀ (b : ℝ) (z w : ℂ),
        Complex.abs (modReLU b z - modReLU b w) ≤ Complex.abs (z - w))
proof:
by
  intro h
  have h1 := h 1 0 (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)
  rw [modReLU_counterexample.1, modReLU_counterexample.2] at h1
  norm_num at h1

name: modGain
doc:
门增益 `λ(z) = relu(|z| + b)/|z|`（`z = 0` 时分母为 0，但 `modReLU` 约定为 0，
本定义只在 `z ≠ 0` 时使用）。
stmt: def modGain (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℝ
proof: relu (Complex.abs z + b) / Complex.abs z

name: modReLU_eq_gain_mul
doc: 相位保持的增益形式（`z ≠ 0`）：`modReLU b z = ↑(modGain b z) · z`。
stmt:
theorem modReLU_eq_gain_mul (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    modReLU b z = ((modGain b z : ℝ) : ℂ) * z
proof:
by
  rw [modReLU_phase_preserved b z hz]
  rfl

name: relu_of_nonneg
doc: `relu x = x`（`x ≥ 0`）。
stmt: lemma relu_of_nonneg {x : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ x) : relu x = x
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  exact max_eq_left h

name: modReLU_lipschitz_of_nonpos
doc: **主定理：`b ≤ 0` 时 modReLU 是 1-Lipschitz**。证明见模块 docstring 的路线。
stmt:
theorem modReLU_lipschitz_of_nonpos (b : ℝ) (hb : b ≤ 0) (z w : ℂ) :
    Complex.abs (modReLU b z - modReLU b w) ≤ Complex.abs (z - w)
proof:
by
  set c : ℝ := -b with hc
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; linarith
  have htb : ∀ t : ℂ, Complex.abs t + b = Complex.abs t - c := by
    intro t
    rw [hc]
    ring
                                  
  have hrev : |Complex.abs z - Complex.abs w| ≤ Complex.abs (z - w) := by
    simpa only [← Complex.norm_eq_abs] using abs_norm_sub_norm_le z w
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst hz
    rw [modReLU_zero, zero_sub]
    rw [show Complex.abs (-(modReLU b w)) = Complex.abs (modReLU b w) from
      Complex.abs.map_neg (modReLU b w)]
    rw [show Complex.abs ((0 : ℂ) - w) = Complex.abs w from by
      rw [zero_sub, Complex.abs.map_neg]]
    by_cases hw : w = 0
    · subst hw
      rw [modReLU_zero]
    · rw [modReLU_magnitude b w hw, htb w]
      exact max_le (by linarith [hc0]) (Complex.abs.nonneg w)
  · by_cases hw : w = 0
    · subst hw
      rw [modReLU_zero]
      simp only [sub_zero]
      rw [modReLU_magnitude b z hz, htb z]
      exact max_le (by linarith [hc0]) (Complex.abs.nonneg z)
    ·                 
      have hrz : 0 < Complex.abs z := by
        rw [← Complex.norm_eq_abs]
        exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
      have hrw : 0 < Complex.abs w := by
        rw [← Complex.norm_eq_abs]
        exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hw
      rcases le_or_lt (Complex.abs z) c with hzc | hzc
      ·                           
        have hzneg : Complex.abs z - c ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hrelu : relu (Complex.abs z + b) = 0 := by
          rw [htb z]
          unfold relu

name: ScaleInvariantNorm
stmt: def ScaleInvariantNorm (n : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) : Prop
proof:
∀ x : ι → ℝ, ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → n (fun i => α * x i) = n x

                                
                                             

omit [Fintype ι] in

name: quotient_norm_scale_invariant
stmt:
theorem quotient_norm_scale_invariant (T : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hT : T (fun j => α * x j) = α * T x) :
    (fun i => α * x i / T (fun j => α * x j)) = fun i => x i / T x
proof:
by
  funext i
  rw [hT]
                                                     
  exact mul_div_mul_left (x i) (T x) (ne_of_gt hα)

name: layerNorm_in_family
stmt: theorem layerNorm_in_family : ScaleInvariantNorm (fun x : ι → ℝ => normalize x)
proof:
by
  intro x α hα
  exact normalize_scale_invariant x α hα

name: rmsNorm_in_family
stmt: theorem rmsNorm_in_family : ScaleInvariantNorm (fun x : ι → ℝ => rmsNorm x)
proof:
by
  intro x α hα
  exact rmsNorm_scale_invariant x α hα

name: rms_is_homogeneous
stmt:
theorem rms_is_homogeneous (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) :
    rms (fun i => α * x i) = α * rms x
proof: rms_scale x α hα

name: rmsNorm_scale_invariant_via_family
stmt:
theorem rmsNorm_scale_invariant_via_family (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    (fun i => α * x i / rms (fun j => α * x j)) = fun i => x i / rms x
proof:
by
                                
  exact quotient_norm_scale_invariant rms x α hα (rms_is_homogeneous x α (le_of_lt hα))

                            
                                                     
                                   

end Lattice

name: constOne
stmt: def constOne {n : ℕ} : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
proof: fun _ => 1

name: unit_normalize_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_lipschitz {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (x y : E) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ ≤ (2 / c) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have hx0 : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    linarith
  have hy0 : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    linarith
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
                                    
  have hnorm : |‖y‖ - ‖x‖| ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
    simpa [abs_sub_comm] using abs_norm_sub_norm_le x y
                                   
  have hrecip : |1 / ‖x‖ - 1 / ‖y‖| ≤ ‖x - y‖ / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) := by
    have hcalc : 1 / ‖x‖ - 1 / ‖y‖ = (‖y‖ - ‖x‖) / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) := by
      field_simp [hx0, hy0]
    rw [hcalc]
    have hdenpos : 0 < ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ := mul_pos hxpos (by linarith)
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hdenpos)]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnorm (le_of_lt hdenpos)
  calc
    ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖
        = ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖x‖) • y + ((1 / ‖x‖) • y - (1 / ‖y‖) • y)‖ := by
          congr 1
          abel
    _ ≤ ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖x‖) • y‖ + ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • y - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • (x - y)‖ + ‖((1 / ‖x‖) - (1 / ‖y‖)) • y‖ := by
          rw [smul_sub]
          rw [sub_smul]
    _ = (1 / ‖x‖) * ‖x - y‖ + |1 / ‖x‖ - 1 / ‖y‖| * ‖y‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul]
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by exact one_div_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hxpos))]
    _ ≤ (1 / ‖x‖) * ‖x - y‖ + (‖x - y‖ / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖)) * ‖y‖ := by
          exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrecip (norm_nonneg _)) _
    _ = (2 / ‖x‖) * ‖x - y‖ := by
          field_simp [hy0]
          ring
    _ ≤

name: rmsNorm_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem rmsNorm_lipschitz {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    ‖(Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x) - (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖y‖) • y)‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt n * 2 / c) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
                             
  have hdiff : (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x) - (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖y‖) • y)
      = (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y) := by
    rw [← smul_sub]
  rw [hdiff]
  calc
    ‖(Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y)‖
        = Real.sqrt n * ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg n)]
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt n * ((2 / c) * ‖x - y‖) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (unit_normalize_lipschitz x y c hc hx hy) (Real.sqrt_nonneg n)
    _ = (Real.sqrt n * 2 / c) * ‖x - y‖ := by ring

name: center_norm_le
stmt:
theorem center_norm_le {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ‖z - ((∑ i : Fin n, z i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ ≤ ‖z‖
proof:
by
  let c : ℝ := (∑ i : Fin n, z i) / n
  let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := z - c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
                                    
  have horth : inner w (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (0 : ℝ) := by
    unfold w
    have hz : inner z (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = ∑ i : Fin n, z i := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
      simp [Matrix.dotProduct, constOne]
    have h1n : inner (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
      simp [Matrix.dotProduct, constOne]
    have hc1 : inner (c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = c * n := by
      rw [inner_smul_left]
      rw [h1n]
      simp
    have hc : c * n = ∑ i : Fin n, z i := by
      unfold c
      by_cases hn : (n : ℝ) = 0
      · have hn0 : n = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
        subst n
        simp
      · field_simp [hn]
    calc
      inner (z - c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
          = inner z (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) - inner (c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by rw [inner_sub_left]
      _ = (∑ i : Fin n, z i) - c * n := by
            rw [hz, hc1]
      _ = 0 := by
            rw [hc]
            ring
                
  have hzdec : z = w + c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    unfold

name: center_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem center_lipschitz {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ‖(x - ((∑ i : Fin n, x i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      - (y - ((∑ i : Fin n, y i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))‖
      ≤ ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
                                                   
  have hlin : (x - ((∑ i : Fin n, x i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
        - (y - ((∑ i : Fin n, y i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      = (x - y) - ((∑ i : Fin n, (x - y) i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    ext j
    have hmean : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) / n - (∑ i : Fin n, y i) / n
        = (∑ i : Fin n, (x - y) i) / n := by
      have hsum : (∑ i : Fin n, (x - y) i) = (∑ i : Fin n, x i) - (∑ i : Fin n, y i) := by
        simpa [Pi.sub_apply] using (Finset.sum_sub_distrib : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) - (∑ i : Fin n, y i) = ∑ i : Fin n, x i - y i)
      rw [hsum, sub_div]
    simp [hmean]
    ring
  rw [hlin]
  exact center_norm_le (x - y)

                
                                                             
                                                  
                                          
                                                  
                     

end Lattice

name: lipschitz_constant_lower_bound
doc: 若 K 对点对 (a,b) 成立，则比值 ‖f a − f b‖ / ‖a − b‖ ≤ K。
stmt:
theorem lipschitz_constant_lower_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : E → E) (K : ℝ) (a b : E)
    (hK : ‖f a - f b‖ ≤ K * ‖a - b‖) (hd : 0 < ‖a - b‖) :
    ‖f a - f b‖ / ‖a - b‖ ≤ K
proof:
by
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hd]
  exact hK

name: unit_normalize_lipschitz_sharp
doc:
**单位化映射的紧 Lipschitz 界（实内积空间）**：
    ‖x/‖x‖ − y/‖y‖‖ ≤ (1/c)·‖x−y‖（‖x‖,‖y‖ ≥ c > 0）。
    改进 RealNormLipschitz 的 (2/c) 界；在 EuclideanSpace 上真正常数是 1/c。
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_lipschitz_sharp {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (x y : E) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ ≤ (1 / c) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc hx
  have hypos : 0 < ‖y‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc hy
  set u : E := (1 / ‖x‖) • x with hu
  set v : E := (1 / ‖y‖) • y with hv
  set α : ℝ := inner u v with hα
  have hcoefx : ‖(1 : ℝ) / ‖x‖‖ = (1 : ℝ) / ‖x‖ := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (one_div_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hxpos))]
  have hcoefy : ‖(1 : ℝ) / ‖y‖‖ = (1 : ℝ) / ‖y‖ := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (one_div_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hypos))]
  have hu_norm : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hu, norm_smul, hcoefx, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hxpos)]
  have hv_norm : ‖v‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hv, norm_smul, hcoefy, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hypos)]
  have hxsplit : ‖x‖ • u = x := by
    rw [hu, one_div]
    exact smul_inv_smul₀ (ne_of_gt hxpos) x
  have hysplit : ‖y‖ • v = y := by
    rw [hv, one_div]
    exact smul_inv_smul₀ (ne_of_gt hypos) y
  have hinner : inner x y = (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) * α := by
    calc
      inner x y = inner (‖x‖ • u) (‖y‖ • v) := by rw [hxsplit, hysplit]
      _ = (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) * α := by
            rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, hα]
            ring
  have hxy : ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) * α := by
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, hinner]
    ring
  have huv : ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = 2 - 2 * α := by
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, hu_norm, hv_norm, ← hα]
    ring
  have hα_le : α ≤ 1 := by
    have h := real_inner_le_norm u v
    rw [hu_norm, hv_norm] at h
    simp at h
    rwa [hα]
  have hrs : c ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ := b

name: unit_normalize_antipodal_real
doc: 取等点对上单位化映射的距离恰为 2：‖c/|c| − (−c)/|−c|‖ = 2。
stmt:
lemma unit_normalize_antipodal_real (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ‖(1 / ‖(c : ℝ)‖) • (c : ℝ) - (1 / ‖(-c : ℝ)‖) • (-c : ℝ)‖ = 2
proof:
by
  have hc' : ‖(c : ℝ)‖ = c := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
  have hnc : ‖(-c : ℝ)‖ = c := by rw [norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
  have e1 : (1 / c) • (c : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [smul_eq_mul, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc)]
  have e2 : (1 / c) • (-c : ℝ) = -1 := by
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_neg, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc)]
  rw [hc', hnc, e1, e2]
  norm_num

name: unit_normalize_sharp
doc: 常数 1/c **可达**（取等）：x = c、y = −c 时两侧同为 2。
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_sharp (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ‖(1 / ‖(c : ℝ)‖) • (c : ℝ) - (1 / ‖(-c : ℝ)‖) • (-c : ℝ)‖
      = (1 / c) * ‖(c : ℝ) - (-c : ℝ)‖
proof:
by
  rw [unit_normalize_antipodal_real c hc]
  have e3 : (c : ℝ) - (-c) = 2 * c := by ring
  rw [e3, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hc]

name: unit_normalize_constant_lower_bound
doc: 由 x = c、y = −c 的取等点，任何有效常数 K 都满足 K ≥ 1/c。
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_constant_lower_bound (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (K : ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ x y : ℝ, c ≤ ‖x‖ → c ≤ ‖y‖ →
      ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) :
    1 / c ≤ K
proof:
by
  have hx : c ≤ ‖(c : ℝ)‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
  have hy : c ≤ ‖(-c : ℝ)‖ := by rw [norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
  have h := hK c (-c) hx hy
  have heq2 : ‖(c : ℝ) - (-c : ℝ)‖ = 2 * c := by
    rw [show (c : ℝ) - (-c) = 2 * c by ring, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
  rw [unit_normalize_antipodal_real c hc, heq2] at h
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hc]
  nlinarith [h]

name: unit_normalize_two_div_not_attained
doc:
(2/c) 界在取等点对上是**严格**的：在 ℝ 上取 x = c、y = −c，则
    比值 2/‖x−y‖ = 1/c < 2/c，即 2 < (2/c)·(2c) = 4
    ⟹ RealNormLipschitz 的 2/c 界不是紧界。
    **边界**：本式仅在 ℝ 这一具体空间上证明 2/c 不取等；1/c 的普遍上界
    另由本节 `unit_normalize_lipschitz_sharp` 与 `unit_normalize_constant_lower_bound`
    给出（本文件对一般赋范空间只证下界，不主张 1/c 成立）。
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_two_div_not_attained (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ‖(1 / ‖(c : ℝ)‖) • (c : ℝ) - (1 / ‖(-c : ℝ)‖) • (-c : ℝ)‖
      < (2 / c) * ‖(c : ℝ) - (-c : ℝ)‖
proof:
by
  have heq2 : ‖(c : ℝ) - (-c : ℝ)‖ = 2 * c := by
    rw [show (c : ℝ) - (-c) = 2 * c by ring, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
  rw [unit_normalize_antipodal_real c hc, heq2]
  have hval2 : (2 / c) * (2 * c) = 4 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hc]; ring
  rw [hval2]
  norm_num

name: rmsNormE
doc:
RMSNorm 的向量映射形式（与 RealRMSNorm.rmsNorm 同构，
    在 EuclideanSpace 上 = √n · 单位化）。
stmt: def rmsNormE {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
proof: (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x)

name: rmsNormE_neg
doc: RMSNorm 换号：RMSNorm(−x) = −RMSNorm(x)。
stmt:
lemma rmsNormE_neg {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    rmsNormE (-x) = -rmsNormE x
proof:
by
  unfold rmsNormE
  rw [norm_neg, smul_neg, smul_neg]

name: norm_rmsNormE
doc: ‖x‖ = c 时 ‖RMSNorm(x)‖ = √n。
stmt:
lemma norm_rmsNormE {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c) : ‖rmsNormE x‖ = Real.sqrt n
proof:
by
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by rw [hx]; exact hc
  unfold rmsNormE
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg n)]
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (one_div_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hxpos)), hx, one_div,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc), mul_one]

name: rmsNormE_antipodal_norm
doc: 取等点对 (x, −x)：‖RMSNorm(x) − RMSNorm(−x)‖ = 2√n。
stmt:
lemma rmsNormE_antipodal_norm {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c) :
    ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE (-x)‖ = 2 * Real.sqrt n
proof:
by
  rw [rmsNormE_neg]
  have hsub : rmsNormE x - -rmsNormE x = (2 : ℝ) • rmsNormE x := by
    rw [sub_neg_eq_add, two_smul]
  rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_rmsNormE x c hc hx]
  norm_num

name: rmsNorm_constant_lower_bound
doc: 取等点对给出 RMSNorm 常数的下界：任何有效 K 满足 K ≥ √n/c。
stmt:
theorem rmsNorm_constant_lower_bound {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c K : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c)
    (hK : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) :
    Real.sqrt n / c ≤ K
proof:
by
  have h := hK (-x)
  have h2 : ‖x - (-x)‖ = 2 * c := by
    have hsub : x - (-x) = (2 : ℝ) • x := by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, two_smul]
    rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx]
    norm_num
  rw [rmsNormE_antipodal_norm x c hc hx, h2] at h
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hc]
  nlinarith [h]

name: rmsNorm_two_sqrt_not_attained
doc:
(2√n/c) 界在取等点对上是严格的（n > 0）：2√n < 4√n，
    故 RMSNorm 的 2√n/c 不是紧界（真常数 ≤ √n/c）。
stmt:
theorem rmsNorm_two_sqrt_not_attained {n : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : ‖x‖ = c) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ‖rmsNormE x - rmsNormE (-x)‖ < (2 * Real.sqrt n / c) * ‖x - (-x)‖
proof:
by
  have h2 : ‖x - (-x)‖ = 2 * c := by
    have hsub : x - (-x) = (2 : ℝ) • x := by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, two_smul]
    rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hx]
    norm_num
  rw [rmsNormE_antipodal_norm x c hc hx, h2]
  have hval : (2 * Real.sqrt n / c) * (2 * c) = 4 * Real.sqrt n := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hc]; ring
  rw [hval]
  have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  linarith

name: ctr
doc: 中心化（在 EuclideanSpace 上，坐标形式）。
stmt: def ctr {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
proof: fun i => z i - (∑ j : Fin n, z j) / (n : ℝ)

name: ctr_eq
doc: ctr 与 RealNormLipschitz 中的表达形式一致。
stmt:
lemma ctr_eq {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ctr z = z - ((∑ i : Fin n, z i) / (n : ℝ)) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
proof:
by
  funext i
  simp [ctr, constOne]

name: sum_ctr_eq_zero
doc: 中心化输出的坐标和为零（等价的零均值）。
stmt:
lemma sum_ctr_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, ctr z i = 0
proof:
by
  simp only [ctr]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hn : (n : ℝ) = 0
  · have hn0 : n = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
    subst hn0
    simp
  · field_simp [hn]

name: inner_ctr_constOne
doc: ctr 与常向量正交（正交投影的刻画）。
stmt:
lemma inner_ctr_constOne {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    inner (ctr z) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (0 : ℝ)
proof:
by
  have h1 : inner (ctr z) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = ∑ i : Fin n, ctr z i := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
    simp [Matrix.dotProduct, constOne]
  rw [h1, sum_ctr_eq_zero z]

name: ctr_fixes
doc: 零均值向量是 ctr 的不动点。
stmt:
lemma ctr_fixes {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (h : (∑ i : Fin n, z i) / (n : ℝ) = 0) : ctr z = z
proof:
by
  funext i
  simp [ctr, h]

name: ctr_idempotent
doc: ctr 幂等（投影的核心性质）。
stmt:
lemma ctr_idempotent {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ctr (ctr z) = ctr z
proof:
by
  funext i
  show ctr z i - (∑ j : Fin n, ctr z j) / (n : ℝ) = ctr z i
  rw [sum_ctr_eq_zero z, zero_div, sub_zero]

name: ctr_norm_le
doc: ctr 不增范数（正交投影的收缩性）。
stmt: lemma ctr_norm_le {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) : ‖ctr z‖ ≤ ‖z‖
proof:
by
  rw [ctr_eq]
  exact center_norm_le z

name: ctr_lipschitz
doc: ctr 是 1-Lipschitz。
stmt:
lemma ctr_lipschitz {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ‖ctr x - ctr y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  rw [ctr_eq x, ctr_eq y]
  exact center_lipschitz x y

name: center_map_is_projection
doc:
**中心化映射是正交投影**：幂等、正交于常向量、零均值超平面上恒等、
    1-Lipschitz 且不增范数。
stmt:
theorem center_map_is_projection (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ctr (ctr z) = ctr z) ∧
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      inner (ctr z) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (0 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      (∑ i : Fin n, z i) / (n : ℝ) = 0 → ctr z = z) ∧
    (∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖ctr z‖ ≤ ‖z‖) ∧
    (∀ x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ‖ctr x - ctr y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖)
proof:
⟨fun z => ctr_idempotent z,
   fun z => inner_ctr_constOne z,
   fun z h => ctr_fixes z h,
   fun z => ctr_norm_le z,
   fun x y => ctr_lipschitz x y⟩

name: center_lipschitz_sharp
doc:
1-常数是**紧的**：在零均值超平面上 ctr 是恒等，故任意两个超平面向量
    使 ‖ctr x − ctr y‖ = 1·‖x − y‖ 取等。
stmt:
theorem center_lipschitz_sharp {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) / (n : ℝ) = 0)
    (hy : (∑ i : Fin n, y i) / (n : ℝ) = 0) :
    ‖ctr x - ctr y‖ = 1 * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  rw [ctr_fixes x hx, ctr_fixes y hy, one_mul]

name: center_lipschitz_constant_optimal
doc: 中心化 Lipschitz 常数的下界：超平面上任意两个不同点给出 K ≥ 1。
stmt:
theorem center_lipschitz_constant_optimal {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hx : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) / (n : ℝ) = 0)
    (hy : (∑ i : Fin n, y i) / (n : ℝ) = 0) (K : ℝ)
    (hK : ‖ctr x - ctr y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    1 ≤ K
proof:
by
  have hd : 0 < ‖x - y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxy)
  have heq : ‖ctr x - ctr y‖ = ‖x - y‖ := by
    rw [ctr_fixes x hx, ctr_fixes y hy]
  rw [heq] at hK
  have hdiv : ‖x - y‖ / ‖x - y‖ ≤ K := (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr hK
  rwa [div_self (ne_of_gt hd)] at hdiv

end Lattice

name: safeNormalize
doc: 安全归一化：`x ↦ (‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ • x`（分母加稳定化常数 ε，零输入有定义）。
stmt: def safeNormalize (ε : ℝ) (x : E) : E

name: safe_normalize_zero
doc: 零输入：`safeNormalize ε 0 = 0`（不再出现 0/0）。
stmt: lemma safe_normalize_zero (ε : ℝ) : safeNormalize ε (0 : E) = 0
proof:
by
  unfold safeNormalize
  simp

omit [NormedSpace ℝ E] in

name: safe_normalize_denom_ge
doc: 分母下界：`ε ≤ ‖x‖ + ε`（稳定性的来源）。
stmt: lemma safe_normalize_denom_ge (ε : ℝ) (x : E) : ε ≤ ‖x‖ + ε
proof:
by
  linarith [norm_nonneg x]

name: safe_normalize_denom_pos
stmt: lemma safe_normalize_denom_pos (ε : ℝ) (x : E) (hε : 0 < ε) : 0 < ‖x‖ + ε
proof: lt_of_lt_of_le hε (safe_normalize_denom_ge ε x)

name: safe_normalize_norm
doc: `0 < ε` ⟹ `‖safeNormalize ε x‖ = ‖x‖ / (‖x‖ + ε)`。
stmt:
theorem safe_normalize_norm (ε : ℝ) (x : E) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ‖safeNormalize ε x‖ = ‖x‖ / (‖x‖ + ε)
proof:
by
  unfold safeNormalize
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hd : 0 < ‖x‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_pos ε x hε
  rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hd), inv_mul_eq_div]

name: safe_normalize_bound
doc: `0 < ε` ⟹ `‖safeNormalize ε x‖ ≤ 1`（输出落在单位球内）。
stmt: theorem safe_normalize_bound (ε : ℝ) (x : E) (hε : 0 < ε) : ‖safeNormalize ε x‖ ≤ 1
proof:
by
  rw [safe_normalize_norm ε x hε, div_le_one (safe_normalize_denom_pos ε x hε)]
  linarith [norm_nonneg x]

name: safe_normalize_sub_decomp
doc:
**差的分解**：`f x − f y = a⁻¹•(x − y) + (a⁻¹ − b⁻¹)•y`，`a = ‖x‖+ε`、`b = ‖y‖+ε`。
（把它拆成"平行分量 + 径向修正"两项，分别可控。）
stmt:
lemma safe_normalize_sub_decomp (ε : ℝ) (x y : E) :
    safeNormalize ε x - safeNormalize ε y
      = (‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ • (x - y) + ((‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ - (‖y‖ + ε)⁻¹) • y
proof:
by
  unfold safeNormalize
  rw [smul_sub, sub_smul]
  abel

name: inv_sub_inv_eq
doc: 倒数差的代数式：`a⁻¹ − b⁻¹ = (b − a)/(a·b)`（a, b ≠ 0）。
stmt:
lemma inv_sub_inv_eq {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a⁻¹ - b⁻¹ = (b - a) / (a * b)
proof:
by
  field_simp

name: safe_normalize_radial_bound
stmt:
lemma safe_normalize_radial_bound (ε : ℝ) (x y : E) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    |(‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ - (‖y‖ + ε)⁻¹| ≤ ‖x - y‖ / ε ^ 2
proof:
by
  have ha : 0 < ‖x‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_pos ε x hε
  have hb : 0 < ‖y‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_pos ε y hε
  have hprod : ε ^ 2 ≤ (‖x‖ + ε) * (‖y‖ + ε) := by
    have hxa : ε ≤ ‖x‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_ge ε x
    have hyb : ε ≤ ‖y‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_ge ε y
    calc ε ^ 2 = ε * ε := by ring
      _ ≤ (‖x‖ + ε) * (‖y‖ + ε) := mul_le_mul hxa hyb hε.le ha.le
  have hnum : |(‖y‖ + ε) - (‖x‖ + ε)| = |‖y‖ - ‖x‖| := by ring_nf
  have hnorm : |‖y‖ - ‖x‖| ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact abs_norm_sub_norm_le x y
  rw [inv_sub_inv_eq (ne_of_gt ha) (ne_of_gt hb), abs_div, abs_of_pos (mul_pos ha hb), hnum]
  calc |‖y‖ - ‖x‖| / ((‖x‖ + ε) * (‖y‖ + ε))
      ≤ ‖x - y‖ / ((‖x‖ + ε) * (‖y‖ + ε)) := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnorm (mul_pos ha hb).le
    _ ≤ ‖x - y‖ / ε ^ 2 := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (norm_nonneg _) (pow_pos hε 2) hprod

name: safe_normalize_lipschitz_on
doc:
**球内 Lipschitz 界**：`‖x‖ ≤ R`、`‖y‖ ≤ R`、`0 ≤ R`、`0 < ε` ⟹
`‖safeNormalize ε x − safeNormalize ε y‖ ≤ ((R + ε)/ε²)·‖x − y‖`。
stmt:
theorem safe_normalize_lipschitz_on (ε R : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (_hR : 0 ≤ R) (x y : E)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ R) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ R) :
    ‖safeNormalize ε x - safeNormalize ε y‖ ≤ ((R + ε) / ε ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have ha : 0 < ‖x‖ + ε := safe_normalize_denom_pos ε x hε
  have hterm1 : ‖(‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ • (x - y)‖ ≤ ε⁻¹ * ‖x - y‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha)]
    have hle : (‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ ≤ ε⁻¹ := (inv_le_inv₀ ha hε).mpr (safe_normalize_denom_ge ε x)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (norm_nonneg _)
  have hterm2 : ‖((‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ - (‖y‖ + ε)⁻¹) • y‖ ≤ (‖x - y‖ / ε ^ 2) * R := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul (safe_normalize_radial_bound ε x y hε) hy (norm_nonneg y)
      (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (pow_pos hε 2).le)
  calc ‖safeNormalize ε x - safeNormalize ε y‖
      = ‖(‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ • (x - y) + ((‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ - (‖y‖ + ε)⁻¹) • y‖ := by
          rw [safe_normalize_sub_decomp]
    _ ≤ ‖(‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ • (x - y)‖ + ‖((‖x‖ + ε)⁻¹ - (‖y‖ + ε)⁻¹) • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ε⁻¹ * ‖x - y‖ + (‖x - y‖ / ε ^ 2) * R := add_le_add hterm1 hterm2
    _ = ((R + ε) / ε ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖ := by
          field_simp
          ring

name: variance_floor_nonneg
doc: 方差非负 + ε > 0 ⟹ 方差加 ε 后严格正（`sqrt(var + ε)` 有定义且非零）。
stmt: lemma variance_floor_nonneg (ε v : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hv : 0 ≤ v) : 0 < v + ε
proof:
by
  linarith

end Lattice

name: NormSqLoss
stmt: def NormSqLoss (A : E →L[ℝ] F) (b : F) (x : E) : ℝ
proof:
‖A x - b‖ ^ 2

                     
                               

omit [CompleteSpace F] in

name: norm_sq_line_deriv
stmt:
lemma norm_sq_line_deriv (u w : F) :
    deriv (fun t : ℝ => ‖u + t • w‖ ^ 2) 0 = 2 * inner u w
proof:
by
                                            
  have hline : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => u + t • w) w 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const w).const_add u
  have hquad : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ‖u + t • w‖ ^ 2) (2 * inner u w) 0 := by
    simpa using hline.norm_sq
  exact hquad.deriv

                    

omit [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] in

name: loss_differentiable
stmt: lemma loss_differentiable (A : E →L[ℝ] F) (b : F) : ∀ x : E, DifferentiableAt ℝ (NormSqLoss A b) x
proof:

stmt: lemma re_neg_I_mul (z : 𝕜) : RCLike.re (-(RCLike.I : 𝕜) * z) = RCLike.im z
proof:
by
  calc
    RCLike.re (-(RCLike.I : 𝕜) * z) = RCLike.re (-((RCLike.I : 𝕜) * z)) := by rw [neg_mul]
    _ = -RCLike.re ((RCLike.I : 𝕜) * z) := by simp
    _ = -(RCLike.re (RCLike.I : 𝕜) * RCLike.re z - RCLike.im (RCLike.I : 𝕜) * RCLike.im z) := by
      rw [RCLike.mul_re]
    _ = RCLike.im (RCLike.I : 𝕜) * RCLike.im z := by simp [RCLike.I_re]
    _ = RCLike.im z := by
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact RCLike.I_im z

（在「`c` 为精确均值」假设下，见 §四 `avgSmooth_deviation_shrink`）—— **不是** `1 − 1/N`。
