end Lattice

name: ssmState
doc:
SSM（线性时不变）隐状态递推：`h_t = A h_{t-1} + B x_t`
（`RealLoopModel.rnnState` 在恒等激活下的特化）。
stmt: def ssmState (A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) : ℕ → E
proof: rnnState (fun x : E => x) A B h0 xs

name: ssmOutput
doc: SSM 输出：`y_t = C h_t`。
stmt: def ssmOutput (C A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) (t : ℕ) : E
proof: C (ssmState A B h0 xs t)

name: ssmState_zero
stmt:
@[simp] theorem ssmState_zero (A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) :
    ssmState A B h0 xs 0 = h0
proof: rfl

name: ssmState_succ
stmt:
@[simp] theorem ssmState_succ (A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) (n : ℕ) :
    ssmState A B h0 xs (n + 1) = A (ssmState A B h0 xs n) + B (xs n)
proof:
by
  simp [ssmState, rnnState, RNNStep]

name: ssm_pow_succ_apply
stmt:
lemma ssm_pow_succ_apply (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (k : ℕ) (y : E) :
    A ((A ^ k) y) = (A ^ (k + 1)) y
proof:
by
  rw [pow_succ']
  rfl

name: ssm_norm_pow_le
doc: `‖A^n‖ ≤ ‖A‖^n`（算子范数次可乘；`n = 0` 时用 `‖id‖ ≤ 1`）。
stmt: lemma ssm_norm_pow_le (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (n : ℕ) : ‖A ^ n‖ ≤ ‖A‖ ^ n
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
  · subst h
    simpa using (ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := E))
  · exact norm_pow_le' A h

name: ssmState_explicit
stmt:
theorem ssmState_explicit (A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) (t : ℕ) :
    ssmState A B h0 xs t
      = (A ^ t) h0 + ∑ s in Finset.range t, (A ^ (t - 1 - s)) (B (xs s))
proof:
by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [ssmState, rnnState]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hA0 : A ((A ^ n) h0) = (A ^ (n + 1)) h0 := ssm_pow_succ_apply A n h0
    have hAsum : A (∑ s in Finset.range n, (A ^ (n - 1 - s)) (B (xs s)))
        = ∑ s in Finset.range n, (A ^ (n - s)) (B (xs s)) := by
      rw [map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s hs
      have hslt : s < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hs
      have hidx : n - 1 - s + 1 = n - s := by omega
      rw [ssm_pow_succ_apply A (n - 1 - s) (B (xs s)), hidx]
    have hsum_eq : (∑ s in Finset.range n, (A ^ (n - s)) (B (xs s)))
        = ∑ s in Finset.range n, (A ^ (n + 1 - 1 - s)) (B (xs s)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s hs
      have hslt : s < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hs
      have hidx : n + 1 - 1 - s = n - s := by omega
      rw [hidx]
    rw [ssmState_succ, ih, map_add, hA0, hAsum, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have hzero : n + 1 - 1 - n = 0 := by omega
    rw [hzero, pow_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply, hsum_eq]
    abel

name: ssm_contraction
stmt:
theorem ssm_contraction (A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 g0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖ssmState A B h0 xs n - ssmState A B g0 xs n‖ ≤ ‖A‖ ^ n * ‖h0 - g0‖
proof:
by
  have hφ : ∀ a b : E, ‖(fun x : E => x) a - (fun x : E => x) b‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖ := by
    intro a b
    simp
  have h := rnn_hidden_contraction (fun x : E => x) A B 1 hφ (by norm_num) h0 g0 xs n
  simpa [ssmState] using h

name: ssm_contraction_rho
doc: 显式收缩率版本：`‖A‖ ≤ ρ` ⟹ `‖h_n − g_n‖ ≤ ρⁿ·‖h₀ − g₀‖`。
stmt:
theorem ssm_contraction_rho (A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 g0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ)
    (_hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ ρ) :
    ‖ssmState A B h0 xs n - ssmState A B g0 xs n‖ ≤ ρ ^ n * ‖h0 - g0‖
proof:
le_trans (ssm_contraction A B h0 g0 xs n)
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg A) hA n) (norm_nonneg _))

name: ssm_stability_bound
stmt:
theorem ssm_stability_bound (A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (δ : ℝ) (hA1 : ‖A‖ < 1)
    (h0 : E) (xs ys : ℕ → E) (n : ℕ) (hδ : ∀ k, ‖xs k - ys k‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖ssmState A B h0 xs n - ssmState A B h0 ys n‖
      ≤ ((1 - ‖A‖ ^ n) / (1 - ‖A‖)) * (‖B‖ * δ)
proof:
by
  have hφ : ∀ a b : E, ‖(fun x : E => x) a - (fun x : E => x) b‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) * ‖a - b‖ := by
    intro a b
    simp
  have hU : ∀ x : E, ‖B x‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * ‖x‖ := fun x => ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm B x
  have h := rnn_stability_bound (fun x : E => x) A B 1 ‖B‖ δ hφ (by norm_num)
    (norm_nonneg B) hU (by simpa using hA1) h0 xs ys n hδ
  simpa [ssmState] using h

name: ssm_pow_add
stmt:
theorem ssm_pow_add (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (m n : ℕ) :
    (A ^ (m + n) : E →L[ℝ] E) = A ^ m * A ^ n
proof: pow_add A m n

name: ssm_state_compose
stmt:
theorem ssm_state_compose (A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ t : ℕ, ssmState A B (ssmState A B h0 xs n) (fun k => xs (n + k)) t
      = ssmState A B h0 xs (n + t)
proof:
by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [ssmState, rnnState]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [ssmState_succ, ih]
    have hstep : n + (t + 1) = (n + t) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hstep, ssmState_succ]

name: ssm_output_bound
stmt:
theorem ssm_output_bound (C A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) (M : ℝ) (t : ℕ)
    (hM : ‖ssmState A B h0 xs t‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖ssmOutput C A B h0 xs t‖ ≤ ‖C‖ * M
proof:
by
  unfold ssmOutput
  calc
    ‖C (ssmState A B h0 xs t)‖ ≤ ‖C‖ * ‖ssmState A B h0 xs t‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm C _
    _ ≤ ‖C‖ * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM (norm_nonneg C)

name: ssm_state_growth_bound
stmt:
theorem ssm_state_growth_bound (A B : E →L[ℝ] E) (h0 : E) (xs : ℕ → E) (M0 Mx : ℝ)
    (hM0 : ‖h0‖ ≤ M0) (hMx : ∀ s, ‖xs s‖ ≤ Mx) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖ssmState A B h0 xs t‖
      ≤ ‖A‖ ^ t * M0 + ∑ s in Finset.range t, ‖A‖ ^ (t - 1 - s) * (‖B‖ * Mx)
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ s ∈ Finset.range t,
      ‖(A ^ (t - 1 - s)) (B (xs s))‖ ≤ ‖A‖ ^ (t - 1 - s) * (‖B‖ * Mx) := by
    intro s _
    calc
      ‖(A ^ (t - 1 - s)) (B (xs s))‖ ≤ ‖A ^ (t - 1 - s)‖ * ‖B (xs s)‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (A ^ (t - 1 - s)) (B (xs s))
      _ ≤ ‖A‖ ^ (t - 1 - s) * (‖B‖ * Mx) := by
        apply mul_le_mul
        · exact ssm_norm_pow_le A (t - 1 - s)
        · calc
            ‖B (xs s)‖ ≤ ‖B‖ * ‖xs s‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm B (xs s)
            _ ≤ ‖B‖ * Mx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hMx s) (norm_nonneg B)
        · exact norm_nonneg _
        · positivity
  rw [ssmState_explicit]
  calc
    ‖(A ^ t) h0 + ∑ s in Finset.range t, (A ^ (t - 1 - s)) (B (xs s))‖
        ≤ ‖(A ^ t) h0‖ + ‖∑ s in Finset.range t, (A ^ (t - 1 - s)) (B (xs s))‖ :=
          norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ ^ t * M0 + ∑ s in Finset.range t, ‖A‖ ^ (t - 1 - s) * (‖B‖ * Mx) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · calc
          ‖(A ^ t) h0‖ ≤ ‖A ^ t‖ * ‖h0‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (A ^ t) h0
          _ ≤ ‖A‖ ^ t * M0 :=
            mul_le_mul (ssm_norm_pow_le A t) hM0 (norm_nonneg h0) (by positivity)
      · calc
          ‖∑ s in Finset.range t, (A ^ (t - 1 - s)) (B (xs s))‖
              ≤ ∑ s in Finset.range t, ‖(A ^ (t - 1 - s)) (B (xs s))‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ s in Finset.range t, ‖A‖ ^ (t - 1 - s) * (‖B‖ * Mx) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum hterm

end Lattice

name: zohGain
doc:
**ZOH 输入增益（级数定义）**：`Φ(A,Δ) = ∑ₙ Δ^{n+1}/(n+1)! • Aⁿ`。

**与积分的等价性（标注）**：教科书定义为 Bochner 积分 `∫₀^Δ exp(s•A) ds`；
对 `exp(s•A) = ∑ₙ (n!)⁻¹ sⁿ • Aⁿ` 逐项积分 `∫₀^Δ sⁿ ds = Δ^{n+1}/(n+1)` 即得本定义。
**「级数 = 积分」这一步本文件未证**（需要区间积分与 `tsum` 交换），故此处以级数**定义**。

**为什么用级数而不是积分**：这样 `A * Φ = Φ * A = exp(Δ•A) − 1` 变成**纯代数**操作
（`Algebra.mul_smul_assoc` + `pow_succ'`），完全绕开非交换环上的测度论。
stmt: def zohGain (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) : 𝔸
proof: ∑' n : ℕ, ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n

name: zohGain_scalar_le
doc:
**标量主控界**：`|Δ|^{n+1}‖A‖ⁿ/(n+1)! ≤ |Δ|·(|Δ|‖A‖)ⁿ/n!`。
由 `1/(n+1)! ≤ 1/n!`（`Nat.factorial_le`）与 `‖Aⁿ‖ ≤ ‖A‖ⁿ`（`norm_pow_le`）得到；
它使 `Φ` 的级数被标量指数级数 `∑ (|Δ|‖A‖)ⁿ/n! = e^{|Δ|‖A‖}` 主控。
stmt:
lemma zohGain_scalar_le (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * |Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A‖ ^ n
      ≤ |Delta| * ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ n)
proof:
by
  have hfac : ((n.factorial : ℝ)) ≤ ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le (by omega)
  have hfacpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((n.factorial : ℝ)) := by positivity
  have hpos2 : (0 : ℝ) < ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hinv : (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ (((n.factorial : ℝ)))⁻¹ :=
    (inv_le_inv₀ hpos2 hfacpos).mpr hfac
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ |Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A‖ ^ n :=
    mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _) (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
  calc (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * |Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A‖ ^ n
      = (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * (|Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A‖ ^ n) := by ring
    _ ≤ (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A‖ ^ n) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hinv hnn
    _ = |Delta| * ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ n) := by
        rw [mul_pow]
        field_simp
        ring

name: zohGain_summable
doc:
**`zohGain` 的级数可和**（**核心可和性引理**）。

标注：mathlib 的 `Summable.norm` 要求 `FiniteDimensional ℝ 𝔸`（见 STYLE 坑表），对一般
完备赋范环不可用，故走 `Summable.of_nonneg_of_le` + `Summable.of_norm`
（与 `RealSSMDiscretization.ssmDisc_exp_truncation_bound` 同一套路）。
stmt:
lemma zohGain_summable (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n)
proof:
by
  have hbase : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ n) := by
    have h := NormedSpace.expSeries_summable' (𝕂 := ℝ) (|Delta| * ‖A‖)
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h
  have hmaj : Summable
      (fun n : ℕ => |Delta| * ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ n)) :=
    hbase.mul_left |Delta|
  refine Summable.of_norm ?_
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_) hmaj
  have hpow : |Delta ^ (n + 1)| = |Delta| ^ (n + 1) := abs_pow Delta (n + 1)
  have hstep : ‖((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n‖
      = (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * |Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A ^ n‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)), hpow]
  rw [hstep]
  calc (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * |Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A ^ n‖
      ≤ (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * |Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A‖ ^ n := by
        have h1 : ‖A ^ n‖ ≤ ‖A‖ ^ n := norm_pow_le A n
        have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * |Delta| ^ (n + 1) :=
          mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h2
    _ ≤ |Delta| * ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ n) :=
        zohGain_scalar_le A Delta n

name: zohGain_norm_le
doc:
**ZOH 增益的范数界**：`‖Φ(A,Δ)‖ ≤ |Δ| · e^{|Δ|‖A‖}`。

由主控级数 `∑ₙ |Δ|(|Δ|‖A‖)ⁿ/n! = |Δ| e^{|Δ|‖A‖}` 得到。这是把 `Φ` 接进
`RealSelectiveSSM` 稳定界（前提 `‖B_t‖ ≤ M`）的**接口**：
取 `M = |Δ| e^{|Δ|‖A‖} ‖B‖ sup‖u‖`。
stmt:
theorem zohGain_norm_le (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    ‖zohGain A Delta‖ ≤ |Delta| * Real.exp (|Delta| * ‖A‖)
proof:
by
  have hbase : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ n) := by
    have h := NormedSpace.expSeries_summable' (𝕂 := ℝ) (|Delta| * ‖A‖)
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h
  have hmaj : Summable
      (fun n : ℕ => |Delta| * ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ n)) :=
    hbase.mul_left |Delta|
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ‖((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n‖
        ≤ |Delta| * ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ n) := by
    intro n
    have hpow : |Delta ^ (n + 1)| = |Delta| ^ (n + 1) := abs_pow Delta (n + 1)
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)), hpow]
    calc (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * |Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A ^ n‖
        ≤ (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * |Delta| ^ (n + 1) * ‖A‖ ^ n := by
          have h1 : ‖A ^ n‖ ≤ ‖A‖ ^ n := norm_pow_le A n
          have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * |Delta| ^ (n + 1) :=
            mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h2
      _ ≤ |Delta| * ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ n) :=
          zohGain_scalar_le A Delta n
  have hnorm : Summable
      (fun n : ℕ => ‖((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _) hterm hmaj
  calc ‖zohGain A Delta‖
      ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, ‖((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n‖ :=

name: exp_smul_sub_one_eq_tsum
doc:
**`exp` 剥掉线性项**：`exp(Δ•A) − 1 = ∑ₙ (Δ^{n+1}/(n+1)!) • A^{n+1}`。

证明：`exp(Δ•A) = ∑ₙ (n!)⁻¹ • (Δ•A)ⁿ`（`exp_eq_tsum`），用
`sum_add_tsum_nat_add 1` 拆出 `n=0` 项 `1`，再用 `smul_pow`/`smul_smul`
把 `(n!)⁻¹ • (Δ•A)^{n+1}` 重整为 `(Δ^{n+1}/(n+1)!) • A^{n+1}`。
stmt:
lemma exp_smul_sub_one_eq_tsum (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - 1
      = ∑' n : ℕ, ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ (n + 1)
proof:
by
  have hf : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (Delta • A) ^ n) :=
    NormedSpace.expSeries_summable' (Delta • A)
  have hexp : NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A)
      = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (Delta • A) ^ n := by
    simpa using congrFun (NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum (𝕂 := ℝ) (𝔸 := 𝔸)) (Delta • A)
  have hsplit := sum_add_tsum_nat_add (G := 𝔸) 1 hf
  have hhead : (∑ i ∈ range 1, (((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (Delta • A) ^ i) = 1 := by simp
  have htail : NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - 1
      = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ • (Delta • A) ^ (n + 1) := by
    rw [hexp, ← hsplit, hhead]
    abel
  rw [htail]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  rw [smul_pow, smul_smul]

name: mul_zohGain
doc:
**`A` 左乘 ZOH 增益**：`A * Φ(A,Δ) = ∑ₙ (Δ^{n+1}/(n+1)!) • A^{n+1}`。

用 `Summable.tsum_mul_left` 提出 `A`，再逐项 `Algebra.mul_smul_comm` + `pow_succ'`。
**注意**：`pow_succ'` 给出 `A * A^n = A^{n+1}`，正是所需的**左乘**方向
（`pow_succ` 给的是 `A^n * A`，方向相反）。
stmt:
lemma mul_zohGain (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    A * zohGain A Delta
      = ∑' n : ℕ, ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ (n + 1)
proof:
by
  have hs := zohGain_summable A Delta
  have h1 : (∑' n : ℕ, A * ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n)
      = A * ∑' n : ℕ, ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n :=
    Summable.tsum_mul_left A hs
  rw [zohGain, ← h1]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [Algebra.mul_smul_comm ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) A (A ^ n),
    (pow_succ' A n).symm]

name: zohGain_mul
stmt:
lemma zohGain_mul (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    zohGain A Delta * A
      = ∑' n : ℕ, ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ (n + 1)
proof:
by
  have hs := zohGain_summable A Delta
  have h1 : (∑' n : ℕ, ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n * A)
      = (∑' n : ℕ, ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) • A ^ n) * A :=
    Summable.tsum_mul_right A hs
  rw [zohGain, ← h1]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc ((((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * Delta ^ (n + 1)) (A ^ n) A,
    (pow_succ A n).symm]

name: zoh_bridge_mul
doc: **ZOH 桥接（核心，左乘）**：`A * Φ(A,Δ) = exp(Δ•A) − 1`。
stmt:
theorem zoh_bridge_mul (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    A * zohGain A Delta = NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - 1
proof:
by
  rw [mul_zohGain, ← exp_smul_sub_one_eq_tsum]

name: zoh_bridge_mul_comm
doc: **ZOH 桥接（核心，右乘）**：`Φ(A,Δ) * A = exp(Δ•A) − 1`。
stmt:
theorem zoh_bridge_mul_comm (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    zohGain A Delta * A = NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - 1
proof:
by
  rw [zohGain_mul, ← exp_smul_sub_one_eq_tsum]

name: zohGain_commute
doc:
**`A` 与 ZOH 增益交换**：`A * Φ(A,Δ) = Φ(A,Δ) * A`。

左右两条桥接恒等式都等于 `exp(Δ•A) − 1`；这是**非交换**设定下积分定义所满足的
「可交换性」在级数定义上的精确对应。
stmt:
theorem zohGain_commute (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    A * zohGain A Delta = zohGain A Delta * A
proof:
by
  rw [zoh_bridge_mul, zoh_bridge_mul_comm]

name: exp_smul_commute
doc:
**`A` 与 `exp(s•A)` 交换**：`A * exp(s•A) = exp(s•A) * A`。

由 `exp_eq_tsum` + `Summable.tsum_mul_left`/`tsum_mul_right` 逐项得到：两边都等于
`∑ₙ (sⁿ/n!) • A^{n+1}`。这是「连续半群的生成元与半群交换」——
`zoh_bridge_mul` 之外通往「连续解满足 ODE」的第二个关键零件。
stmt:
theorem exp_smul_commute (A : 𝔸) (s : ℝ) :
    A * NormedSpace.exp ℝ (s • A) = NormedSpace.exp ℝ (s • A) * A
proof:
by
  have hf : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n) :=
    NormedSpace.expSeries_summable' (s • A)
  have hexp : NormedSpace.exp ℝ (s • A)
      = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n := by
    simpa using congrFun (NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum (𝕂 := ℝ) (𝔸 := 𝔸)) (s • A)
  have hl : A * (∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n)
      = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * s ^ n) • A ^ (n + 1) := by
    rw [(Summable.tsum_mul_left A hf).symm]
    refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Algebra.mul_smul_comm (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) A ((s • A) ^ n), smul_pow]
    rw [Algebra.mul_smul_comm (s ^ n) A (A ^ n), (pow_succ' A n).symm]
    exact smul_smul ((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ (s ^ n) (A ^ (n + 1))
  have hr : (∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n) * A
      = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * s ^ n) • A ^ (n + 1) := by
    rw [(Summable.tsum_mul_right A hf).symm]
    refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) ((s • A) ^ n) A, smul_pow]
    rw [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc (s ^ n) (A ^ n) A, (pow_succ A n).symm]
    exact smul_smul ((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ (s ^ n) (A ^ (n + 1))
  rw [hexp, hl, hr]

name: zohStepGen
doc:
**ZOH 一步（连续→离散）**：从 `h` 出发、输入在整步内保持为常数 `u`，
经过步长 `Δ` 后的状态

    `zohStepGen A B u Δ h = exp(Δ•A) h + Φ(A,Δ) • (B u)`。

`zohStepGen_zero_input` 给出 `u = 0` 时退化为 `RealSSMDiscretization.zohStep A Δ * h`
（即 `Ā h`）；`zoh_recurrence_eq_selState` 给出它与 `RealSelectiveSSM.selState` 的对接。
stmt: def zohStepGen (A B u : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) (hgen : 𝔸) : 𝔸
proof: NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) * hgen + zohGain A Delta * (B * u)

name: zohStepGen_zero_input
doc:
**ZOH 一步与 `RealSSMDiscretization.zohStep` 的对接（零输入退化）**：
`u = 0` 时 `zohStepGen A B 0 Δ h = zohStep A Δ * h`。

即 `RealSSMDiscretization` 的 `zohStep A Δ := exp ℝ (Δ • A)` 正是本文件 ZOH 一步的
**齐次部分**；本文件补上的是**非齐次（输入）部分** `Φ(A,Δ) • (B u)`。
stmt:
theorem zohStepGen_zero_input (A B : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) (hgen : 𝔸) :
    zohStepGen A B 0 Delta hgen = zohStep A Delta * hgen
proof:
by
  simp [zohStepGen, zohStep]

name: zoh_recurrence_eq_selState
doc:
**ZOH 递推 与 `selState` 的精确对接（核心）**：取
`Ā := exp(Δ•A)`（时不变）、`B̄_t := Φ(A,Δ) • (B u_t)`，
则 ZOH 离散轨迹**逐项等于** `RealSelectiveSSM.selState (fun _ => Ā) B̄`。

这是 A4.3 的「对接」：`RealSelectiveSSM` 的全部结果（闭式解 `selState_explicit`、
稳定界 `selState_norm_bound_contracting`、LTI 退化 `sel_is_LTI_special`）
**自动适用**于 ZOH 离散化的连续系统。
stmt:
theorem zoh_recurrence_eq_selState (A B : 𝔸) (u : ℕ → 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    selState (fun _ => NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A))
        (fun k => zohGain A Delta * (B * u k)) (t + 1)
      = NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A)
          * selState (fun _ => NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A))
              (fun k => zohGain A Delta * (B * u k)) t
        + zohGain A Delta * (B * u t)
proof: selState_succ _ _ t

name: zoh_state_explicit
doc:
**ZOH 离散轨迹的闭式解（核心推论）**：把 `RealSelectiveSSM.selState_explicit`
套到 ZOH 系数上，得到

    `h_t = ∑_{k<t} Ā^{t−1−k} * (Φ(A,Δ) • (B u_k))`，   `Ā = exp(Δ•A)`。

**下标递减**（`Ā^{t−1−k}`，最左是最大指数）——与 CORRECTIONS B18 一致；
此处因 `Ā` 与 `B̄_k` 都是环元素、且 `Ā` 是**同一个**元素，故可与
`Finset.prod` 型的 `selProd` 互转（`selProd_const`）。
stmt:
theorem zoh_state_explicit (A B : 𝔸) (u : ℕ → 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    selState (fun _ => NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A))
        (fun k => zohGain A Delta * (B * u k)) t
      = ∑ k in range t,
          (NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A)) ^ (t - 1 - k) * (zohGain A Delta * (B * u k))
proof: sel_is_LTI_special _ _ t

name: zoh_state_norm_bound
doc:
**ZOH 离散轨迹的一致稳定界（核心推论）**：若 `‖exp(Δ•A)‖ ≤ ρ < 1` 且
`‖Φ(A,Δ)(B u_k)‖ ≤ M`，则 `‖h_t‖ ≤ M/(1−ρ)`，**与 `t` 无关**。

由 `RealSelectiveSSM.selState_norm_bound_contracting` 直接实例化；
`zohGain_norm_le` 给出把 `M` 用连续参数表示的接口：
`M ≤ |Δ| e^{|Δ|‖A‖} ‖B‖ sup_k ‖u_k‖`。
stmt:
theorem zoh_state_norm_bound (A B : 𝔸) (u : ℕ → 𝔸) (Delta ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hA : ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A)‖ ≤ ρ)
    (hB : ∀ k, ‖zohGain A Delta * (B * u k)‖ ≤ M) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState (fun _ => NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A))
        (fun k => zohGain A Delta * (B * u k)) t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)
proof: selState_norm_bound_contracting _ _ ρ M hρ0 hρ1 (fun _ => hA) hB hM t

name: selStateGated
doc:
**门控递推（输入依赖的选择性 SSM）**：`A_t = g t` 由输入序列 `g` **给出**
（`A_t = σ(W x_t)` 是其特例：取 `g t := σ (W * x t)`）。

本定义把「输入依赖」形式化为：`A_t` 是**另一个序列** `g`，与 `x` 的关系由调用者
以函数形式提供。这样 `RealSelectiveSSM` 的全部代数结果可用，同时把「依赖关系」
作为一个**显式参数**（而非隐藏在类型里）——这是可验证性的关键设计。
stmt: def selStateGated (g B : ℕ → 𝔸) : ℕ → 𝔸
proof: selState g B

name: selStateGated_explicit
doc: **输入依赖的闭式解**：`h_t = ∑_{k<t} selProd g (k+1) t * B_k`。
stmt:
theorem selStateGated_explicit (g B : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) :
    selStateGated g B t = ∑ k in range t, selProd g (k + 1) t * B k
proof: selState_explicit g B t

name: selStateGated_norm_bound
doc:
**输入依赖的稳定界（核心，A4.1）**：若门控一致有界 `∀t, ‖g t‖ ≤ ρ < 1`
且输入项 `∀k, ‖B_k‖ ≤ M`，则 `‖h_t‖ ≤ M/(1−ρ)` —— **与 `t` 无关**。

即：**输入依赖本身不破坏稳定性**；稳定性只取决于门控的**一致范数界** `ρ < 1`。
这正解释了 Mamba 为何把门控写成 `exp(Δ_t A)` 且 `A < 0`：
`Δ_t = softplus(W x_t) > 0` 使 `‖exp(Δ_t A)‖ = e^{Δ_t A} < 1` **对任意输入**成立，
从而 `ρ = sup_t e^{Δ_t A} < 1` 由 `Δ_t` 的**一致下界**保证。
stmt:
theorem selStateGated_norm_bound (g B : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    (hg : ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ≤ ρ) (hB : ∀ k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selStateGated g B t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)
proof: selState_norm_bound_contracting g B ρ M hρ0 hρ1 hg hB hM t

name: selState_gate_perturbation_step
doc:
**门控扰动的一步传播（A4.1 核心引理）**：设两条门控递推 `h_{t+1} = g_t h_t + B_t` 与
`h'_{t+1} = g'_t h'_t + B_t`（**同一输入序列** `B`）从同一初值出发，则

    `h_{t+1} − h'_{t+1} = g_t (h_t − h'_t) + (g_t − g'_t) h'_t`,

于是 `‖h_{t+1} − h'_{t+1}‖ ≤ ‖g_t‖·‖h_t − h'_t‖ + ‖g_t − g'_t‖·‖h'_t‖`。

这是**输入依赖敏感性**的递归骨架：门控的扰动 `g_t − g'_t` 通过被扰动轨迹的状态
`h'_t` 放大。**完整的多步界（Gronwall 型）未做**（见文件头「诚实边界」）。
stmt:
theorem selState_gate_perturbation_step (g g' B : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) :
    selState g B (t + 1) - selState g' B (t + 1)
      = g t * (selState g B t - selState g' B t)
        + (g t - g' t) * selState g' B t
proof:
by
  rw [selState_succ, selState_succ]
  noncomm_ring

name: selState_gate_perturbation_norm_le
stmt:
theorem selState_gate_perturbation_norm_le (g g' B : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState g B (t + 1) - selState g' B (t + 1)‖
      ≤ ‖g t‖ * ‖selState g B t - selState g' B t‖
        + ‖g t - g' t‖ * ‖selState g' B t‖
proof:
by
  rw [selState_gate_perturbation_step]
  refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_mul_le _ _))

name: sel_spectral_norm_criterion
doc:
**范数判据（充分条件之一，最易验证）**：`∀t, ‖A_t‖ ≤ ρ < 1` ⟹ 状态一致有界。
这就是 `selState_norm_bound_contracting` 的**前提形式**；A4.2 要的正是
「`ρ < 1` 的显式充分条件」，本定理把它固定为**范数条件**。
stmt:
theorem sel_spectral_norm_criterion (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    (hA : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ) (hB : ∀ k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState A B t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)
proof: selState_norm_bound_contracting A B ρ M hρ0 hρ1 hA hB hM t

name: sel_spectral_eigen_criterion
doc:
**命名修订（历史沿革）**：本定理原名/原注释声称的是「特征值判据（抽象形式，充分条件
之二）」，即「`A_t` 的**每个特征值** `μ` 满足 `‖μ‖ ≤ ρ < 1` **且** `A_t` 是**正规元**
（`A A⋆ = A⋆ A`，`[StarRing]`）⟹ `‖A_t‖ = ρ(A_t) ≤ ρ`，从而回到范数判据」。该陈述
**已被否证为与本定理签名不符**：实际的假设 `hspec` 就是**范数界** `∀i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ`，
签名中既无特征值条件也无正规性条件。

据此，本定理的准确身份是 `sel_spectral_norm_criterion` 的**同义重述**（逐字同构的
范数判据，仅实例参数多一个 `[StarRing 𝔸]`），本文件中的 `[StarRing 𝔸]` 在证明体内
**未被使用**。

已否证/未做的部分（保留备查，不得据此认为已证）：
- 「特征值 + 正规元 ⟹ `‖A‖ ≤ ρ`」的桥（Gelfand / 谱半径公式 `‖A‖ = ρ(A)`）**未做**；
- `[StarRing]` 的实际调用**未做**。
一般的「特征值模 < 1」（非正规）**不**蕴含 `‖A‖ < 1`（反例：`[[1, K], [0, 1]]`
特征值全为 1，但 `‖·‖_∞ = 1 + K`）——该反例说明的是上述**未做的桥**不能省略正规性
假设，与本定理（范数判据重述）本身无关。
stmt:
theorem sel_spectral_eigen_criterion [StarRing 𝔸] (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hspec : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ) (hB : ∀ k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState A B t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)
proof: selState_norm_bound_contracting A B ρ M hρ0 hρ1 hspec hB hM t

name: sel_LTI_zoh_spectral_criterion
doc:
**LTI 的 ZOH 谱判据（A4.2 × A4.3 交叉）**：若连续生成元满足
`‖exp(s•A)‖ ≤ ρ < 1`（`Δ_t ≡ s` 时即 `‖Ā‖ ≤ ρ`），则 LTI 状态一致有界。

这是 Mamba 稳定性的**连续侧**充分条件：`A` 的所有特征值实部 < 0（耗散）
⟹ 存在 `s` 使 `‖exp(s A)‖ < 1`（半群指数衰减）。本文件把「实部 < 0 ⟹ 存在这样的
`s`」作为**未做的接口**留出（需要 `Matrix` 谱与 `exp` 的桥接）。
stmt:
theorem sel_LTI_zoh_spectral_criterion (a : 𝔸) (B : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ ρ) (hB : ∀ k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState (fun _ => a) B t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)
proof:
selState_norm_bound_contracting (fun _ => a) B ρ M hρ0 hρ1 (fun _ => ha) hB hM t

end Lattice

name: zohStep
doc: ZOH（零阶保持）精确一步算子 `Ā = NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Δ • A)`（矩阵/算子指数）。
stmt: def zohStep (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) : 𝔸
proof: NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A)

name: eulerStep
doc: 前向欧拉一步算子 `Ē = 1 + Δ • A`（`NormedSpace.exp` 级数的 1 阶截断）。
stmt: def eulerStep (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) : 𝔸
proof: 1 + Delta • A

name: ssmDisc_fact_shift_inv_le
stmt:
lemma ssmDisc_fact_shift_inv_le (i : ℕ) :
    (((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ (1 / 2) * (((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹)
proof:
by
  have hnat : 2 * i.factorial ≤ (i + 2).factorial := by
    calc 2 * i.factorial ≤ (i + 2) * i.factorial := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
      _ ≤ (i + 2) * (i + 1).factorial := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.factorial_le (by omega))
      _ = (i + 2).factorial := by
            rw [show (i + 2).factorial = (i + 2) * (i + 1).factorial from
              Nat.factorial_succ (i + 1)]
  have hleR : (2 : ℝ) * (i.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((i + 2).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hposa : (0 : ℝ) < ((i + 2).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hposb : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) * (i.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hinv : (((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) * (i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ :=
    (inv_le_inv₀ hposa hposb).mpr hleR
  have hkey : (((2 : ℝ) * (i.factorial : ℝ)))⁻¹ = (1 / 2) * (((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) := by
    rw [mul_inv]; norm_num
  rwa [hkey] at hinv

name: ssmDisc_summable_fact_mul_pow
doc:
**标量可和性**：`∑ₙ tⁿ/n!` 的项 `tⁿ/n! = (n!⁻¹)·tⁿ` 可和
（`NormedSpace.expSeries_summable'` 在 `𝔸 = ℝ` 上）。
stmt:
lemma ssmDisc_summable_fact_mul_pow (t : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * t ^ n)
proof:
by
  have h := NormedSpace.expSeries_summable' (𝕂 := ℝ) t
  simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h

name: ssmDisc_tsum_fact_mul_pow
doc:
**标量指数级数**：`∑ₙ (n!⁻¹)·tⁿ = Real.exp t`
（`Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ` 与 `NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum`）。
stmt:
lemma ssmDisc_tsum_fact_mul_pow (t : ℝ) :
    ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * t ^ n = Real.exp t
proof:
by
  rw [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ]
  rw [NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum]
  simp [smul_eq_mul]

name: ssmDisc_fact_tail_term_le
doc:
**标量尾项逐项比较**：`t^(i+2)/(i+2)! ≤ (t²/2)·(t^i/i!)`（`t ≥ 0`）。
由 `ssmDisc_fact_shift_inv_le` 乘以非负量 `t²·t^i` 得到。
stmt:
lemma ssmDisc_fact_tail_term_le (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (i : ℕ) :
    (((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * t ^ (i + 2)
      ≤ (t ^ 2 / 2) * ((((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * t ^ i)
proof:
by
  have hle := ssmDisc_fact_shift_inv_le i
  have ht2 : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 := sq_nonneg t
  have hti : 0 ≤ t ^ i := pow_nonneg ht i
  calc (((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * t ^ (i + 2)
      = (((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * (t ^ 2 * t ^ i) := by rw [pow_add]; ring
    _ ≤ ((1 / 2) * (((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹)) * (t ^ 2 * t ^ i) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (mul_nonneg ht2 hti)
    _ = (t ^ 2 / 2) * ((((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * t ^ i) := by ring

name: ssmDisc_tail_fact_bound
doc:
**标量尾部界**（**核心标量引理**）：`t ≥ 0` 时
`∑ᵢ t^(i+2)/(i+2)! ≤ (t²/2)·e^t`。
逐项比较 + `tsum_le_tsum` + `tsum_mul_left` + `ssmDisc_tsum_fact_mul_pow`。
stmt:
lemma ssmDisc_tail_fact_bound (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∑' i : ℕ, (((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * t ^ (i + 2) ≤ t ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp t
proof:
by
  have hg : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * t ^ n) :=
    ssmDisc_summable_fact_mul_pow t
  have hg2 : Summable (fun i : ℕ => (((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * t ^ (i + 2)) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 2).mpr hg
  have hg3 : Summable
      (fun i : ℕ => (t ^ 2 / 2) * ((((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * t ^ i)) :=
    hg.mul_left (t ^ 2 / 2)
  calc ∑' i : ℕ, (((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * t ^ (i + 2)
      ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, (t ^ 2 / 2) * ((((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * t ^ i) :=
        tsum_le_tsum (fun i => ssmDisc_fact_tail_term_le t ht i) hg2 hg3
    _ = (t ^ 2 / 2) * ∑' i : ℕ, ((((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * t ^ i) := tsum_mul_left
    _ = (t ^ 2 / 2) * Real.exp t := by rw [ssmDisc_tsum_fact_mul_pow]

                              

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in

name: ssmDisc_exp_truncation_bound
doc:
**核心定理：指数级数截断误差**。对任意 `x : 𝔸`，
`‖exp x − (1 + x)‖ ≤ ‖x‖²/2 · e^{‖x‖}`。

证明：`exp x = ∑ₙ (n!⁻¹)•xⁿ`；用 `sum_add_tsum_nat_add 2` 拆成前两项 `1 + x` 与尾巴
`∑ᵢ (i+2)!⁻¹ • x^(i+2)`；范数用 `norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm` 与 `tsum_le_tsum` 逐项放缩到
标量尾和，最后用 `ssmDisc_tail_fact_bound` 收尾。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_exp_truncation_bound (x : 𝔸) :
    ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ x - (1 + x)‖ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp ‖x‖
proof:
by
  have hf : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • x ^ n) :=
    NormedSpace.expSeries_summable' x
  have hexp : NormedSpace.exp ℝ x = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • x ^ n := by
    rw [NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum]

name: ssmDisc_zoh_euler_gap
doc:
**ZOH 与欧拉一步算子的差**：`‖zohStep A Δ − eulerStep A Δ‖ ≤ (|Δ|‖A‖)²/2 · e^{|Δ|‖A‖}`。
即 `ssmDisc_exp_truncation_bound` 作用于 `Δ • A`，并用 `‖Δ • A‖ = |Δ|·‖A‖`。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_zoh_euler_gap (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    ‖zohStep A Delta - eulerStep A Delta‖
      ≤ (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp (|Delta| * ‖A‖)
proof:
by
  have h := ssmDisc_exp_truncation_bound (Delta • A)
  have hnorm : ‖Delta • A‖ = |Delta| * ‖A‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  simpa [zohStep, eulerStep, hnorm, smul_eq_mul] using h

name: zohStep_pow_eq
doc:
**ZOH 幂的指数形式**：`(zohStep A Δ)ⁿ = exp ((n : ℝ) • (Δ • A))`
（`NormedSpace.exp_nsmul`）。
stmt:
theorem zohStep_pow_eq (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    zohStep A Delta ^ n = NormedSpace.exp ℝ ((n : ℝ) • (Delta • A))
proof:
by
  rw [zohStep, ← NormedSpace.exp_nsmul n (Delta • A), Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

name: ssmDisc_zoh_pow_eq_zohStep
doc:
**N 步 ZOH 等于单步 `nΔ`**：`(zohStep A Δ)ⁿ = zohStep A (n·Δ)`（`smul_smul`）。
这是 ZOH 精确性的核心：`n` 次 `Δ` 步与 1 次 `nΔ` 步完全一致。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_zoh_pow_eq_zohStep (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    zohStep A Delta ^ n = zohStep A ((n : ℝ) * Delta)
proof:
by
  rw [zohStep_pow_eq, zohStep, smul_smul]

name: ssmDisc_pow_sub_pow_norm_le
doc:
**一般 N 步累积误差引理**（**核心**）。设 `0 ≤ C`、`‖S‖ ≤ C`、`‖T‖ ≤ C`，则对任意
`x : 𝔸` 与 `n : ℕ`：
`‖Sⁿ x − Tⁿ x‖ ≤ n · Cⁿ⁻¹ · ‖S − T‖ · ‖x‖`。

对 `n` 归纳；归纳步用分解
`S^(n+1) x − T^(n+1) x = S (Sⁿ x − Tⁿ x) + (S − T) (Tⁿ x)`
与实数配平 `n·Cⁿ⁻¹·C + Cⁿ = (n+1)·Cⁿ`（`n = 0` 时左端首项为 `0`）。
注意对一般赋范环，`Sⁿ x` 就是乘法 `S^n * x`。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_pow_sub_pow_norm_le (S T : 𝔸) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hS : ‖S‖ ≤ C) (hT : ‖T‖ ≤ C) (x : 𝔸) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖S ^ n * x - T ^ n * x‖ ≤ n * C ^ (n - 1) * ‖S - T‖ * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      have hpow : S ^ (k + 1) * x - T ^ (k + 1) * x
          = S * (S ^ k * x - T ^ k * x) + (S - T) * (T ^ k * x) := by
        rw [pow_succ', pow_succ']
        noncomm_ring
      rw [hpow]
      have h1 : ‖S * (S ^ k * x - T ^ k * x)‖ ≤ C * (k * C ^ (k - 1) * ‖S - T‖ * ‖x‖) := by
        calc ‖S * (S ^ k * x - T ^ k * x)‖ ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖S ^ k * x - T ^ k * x‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
          _ ≤ C * (k * C ^ (k - 1) * ‖S - T‖ * ‖x‖) :=
              mul_le_mul hS ih (norm_nonneg _) hC
      have hTk : ‖T ^ k * x‖ ≤ C ^ k * ‖x‖ := by
        calc ‖T ^ k * x‖ ≤ ‖T ^ k‖ * ‖x‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
          _ ≤ C ^ k * ‖x‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (le_trans (norm_pow_le T k)
                  (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg T) hT k)) (norm_nonneg x)
      have h2 : ‖(S - T) * (T ^ k * x)‖ ≤ ‖S - T‖ * (C ^ k * ‖x‖) := by
        calc ‖(S - T) * (T ^ k * x)‖ ≤ ‖S - T‖ * ‖T ^ k * x‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖S - T‖ * (C ^ k * ‖x‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTk (norm_nonneg _)
      refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      refine (add_le_add h1 h2).trans ?_
      have hck : (k : ℝ) * C ^ (k - 1) * C = (k : ℝ) * C ^ k := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
        · subst hk; simp
        · have hstep : C ^ (k - 1) * C = C ^ k := by
            rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
          rw [show (k : ℝ) * C ^ (k - 1) * C = (k : ℝ) * (C ^ (k - 1) * C) by ring, hstep]

name: ssmDisc_nstep_error
doc:
**N 步累积误差界**（**核心结论**）。设 `0 ≤ C`、`‖eulerStep A Δ‖ ≤ C`、`‖zohStep A Δ‖ ≤ C`，
则对任意 `x : 𝔸`：
`‖(eulerStep A Δ)ⁿ x − (zohStep A Δ)ⁿ x‖
   ≤ n · Cⁿ⁻¹ · ((|Δ|‖A‖)²/2 · e^{|Δ|‖A‖}) · ‖x‖`。
由 `ssmDisc_pow_sub_pow_norm_le`（取 `S = eulerStep`、`T = zohStep`）与
`ssmDisc_zoh_euler_gap` 组合。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_nstep_error (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (he : ‖eulerStep A Delta‖ ≤ C) (hz : ‖zohStep A Delta‖ ≤ C) (x : 𝔸) :
    ‖eulerStep A Delta ^ n * x - zohStep A Delta ^ n * x‖
      ≤ (n : ℝ) * C ^ (n - 1)
          * ((|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp (|Delta| * ‖A‖)) * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  have h := ssmDisc_pow_sub_pow_norm_le (eulerStep A Delta) (zohStep A Delta) C hC he hz x n
  have hd : ‖eulerStep A Delta - zohStep A Delta‖
      ≤ (|Delta| * ‖A‖) ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp (|Delta| * ‖A‖) := by
    rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact ssmDisc_zoh_euler_gap A Delta
  refine h.trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (norm_nonneg x)
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (pow_nonneg hC _))

name: ssmDisc_norm_exp_le
doc:
**指数算子的范数界**：`‖exp x‖ ≤ e^{‖x‖}`（tsum 的三角不等式 + 标量指数级数）。

标注：`NormedSpace.exp` 的首参是**显式**的标量域 `𝕂`，故此处必须写 `NormedSpace.exp ℝ x`；
否则在目标类型未定时 `x : 𝔸` 会被错误地当作 `𝕂` 实参（实测 `application type mismatch`）。
stmt: theorem ssmDisc_norm_exp_le (x : 𝔸) : ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ x‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖x‖
proof:
by
  have hexp : NormedSpace.exp ℝ x = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • x ^ n := by
    rw [show NormedSpace.exp ℝ x
        = (fun y : 𝔸 => ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • y ^ n) x from by
      rw [NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum (𝕂 := ℝ) (𝔸 := 𝔸)]]
  have hf : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • x ^ n) :=
    NormedSpace.expSeries_summable' x
  have hfn : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖(((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • x ^ n‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _)
      (fun n => by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_pow_le x n) (by positivity))
      (ssmDisc_summable_fact_mul_pow ‖x‖)
  have hsc : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * ‖x‖ ^ n) :=
    ssmDisc_summable_fact_mul_pow ‖x‖
  calc ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ x‖
      = ‖∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • x ^ n‖ := by rw [hexp]
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, ‖(((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • x ^ n‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hfn
    _ ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) * ‖x‖ ^ n := tsum_le_tsum (fun n => ?_) hfn hsc
    _ = Real.exp ‖x‖ := ssmDisc_tsum_fact_mul_pow ‖x‖
  · rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_pow_le x n) (by positivity)

name: cnLeft
doc: **CN 左算子** `I − ΔA/2`（隐式部分）。

doc: **CN 右算子** `I + ΔA/2`（显式部分）。

name: ssmDisc_exp_sub_one_sub_self
doc:
**`exp` 剥掉前两项**：`exp x − 1 − x = ∑ᵢ ((i+2)!)⁻¹ • x^{i+2}`。

用 `sum_add_tsum_nat_add 2` 把指数级数拆成 `1 + x` 与 `n ≥ 2` 的尾巴。

theorem ssmDisc_exp_sub_one_sub_self (x : 𝔸) :

proof:

    NormedSpace.expSeries_summable' x
  have hexp : NormedSpace.exp ℝ x = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • x ^ n := by
    rw [NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum (𝕂 := ℝ) (𝔸 := 𝔸)]
  have hsplit := sum_add_tsum_nat_add (G := 𝔸) 2 hf
  have hhead : (∑ i ∈ range 2, (((i.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • x ^ i) = 1 + x := by
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
      Finset.sum_range_zero]
    simp
  rw [hexp, ← hsplit, hhead]

theorem ssmDisc_exp_sub_one_sub_self_bound (x : 𝔸) :
    ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ x - 1 - x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp ‖x‖

      ‖(((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ • x ^ (i + 2)‖

    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_pow_le x (i + 2)) (by positivity)
  have hf2n : Summable (fun i : ℕ => ‖(((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ • x ^ (i + 2)‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => norm_nonneg _) hterm
      ((summable_nat_add_iff 2).mpr (ssmDisc_summable_fact_mul_pow ‖x‖))
  have hsc : Summable (fun i : ℕ => (((i + 2).factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * ‖x‖ ^ (i + 2)) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 2).mpr (ssmDisc_summable_fact_mul_pow ‖x‖)

name: ssmDisc_exp_commute
doc:
**`A` 与 `exp(s•A)` 交换（核心代数引理）**：`A * exp(s•A) = exp(s•A) * A`。

两边都等于 `∑ₙ ((n!⁻¹)sⁿ) • A^{n+1}`（左乘 `Algebra.mul_smul_comm` + `pow_succ'`，
右乘 `Algebra.smul_mul_assoc` + `pow_succ`）。**非交换环上此引理不平凡**，
是把 `A` 从 `exp` 右侧搬到左侧的必要条件。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_exp_commute (A : 𝔸) (s : ℝ) :
    A * NormedSpace.exp ℝ (s • A) = NormedSpace.exp ℝ (s • A) * A
proof:
by
  have hf : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n) :=
    NormedSpace.expSeries_summable' (s • A)
  have hexp : NormedSpace.exp ℝ (s • A)
      = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n := by
    rw [NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum (𝕂 := ℝ) (𝔸 := 𝔸)]
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, A * ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n)
      = (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * s ^ n) • A ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    rw [Algebra.mul_smul_comm (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) A ((s • A) ^ n), smul_pow]
    rw [Algebra.mul_smul_comm (s ^ n) A (A ^ n), (pow_succ' A n).symm]
    exact smul_smul ((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ (s ^ n) (A ^ (n + 1))
  have key2 : ∀ n : ℕ, ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n) * A
      = (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * s ^ n) • A ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    rw [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) ((s • A) ^ n) A, smul_pow]
    rw [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc (s ^ n) (A ^ n) A, (pow_succ A n).symm]
    exact smul_smul ((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ (s ^ n) (A ^ (n + 1))
  calc A * NormedSpace.exp ℝ (s • A)
      = A * ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n := by rw [hexp]
    _ = ∑' n : ℕ, A * ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n) :=
        (Summable.tsum_mul_left A hf).symm
    _ = ∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹ * s ^ n) • A ^ (n + 1) := tsum_congr key
    _ = ∑' n : ℕ, ((((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n) * A := (tsum_congr key2).symm
    _ = (∑' n : ℕ, (((n.factorial : ℝ))⁻¹) • (s • A) ^ n) * A :=
        Summable.tsum_mul_right A hf
    _ = NormedSpace.

name: ssmDisc_cn_defect_norm_le
doc:
**CN 缺陷的显式界（核心，A4.4）**：记 `x = Δ•A`，

    `‖(I − ΔA/2)·exp(ΔA) − (I + ΔA/2)‖
        ≤ (‖x‖²/2·e^{‖x‖} + ‖x‖) + (|Δ|/2)·(‖A‖·e^{‖x‖} + ‖A‖)
          + (|Δ|/2)·(‖A‖·e^{‖x‖} + ‖A‖)`。

**证明策略（诚实标注 —— 这是一处有意的降级）**：
把 `cnLeft A Δ * exp(Δ•A) − cnRight A Δ` 展开成

    `(exp(Δ•A) − 1) − (Δ/2)•(exp(Δ•A)·A) − (Δ/2)•A`

（用 `ssmDisc_exp_commute` 把 `A` 搬到 `exp` 右侧），再作三角不等式分三块：
`‖exp x − 1‖ ≤ ‖x‖²/2·e^{‖x‖} + ‖x‖`（`ssmDisc_exp_truncation_bound` + 三角不等式）、
`‖(Δ/2)•(exp x·A)‖ ≤ (|Δ|/2)·(‖A‖·e^{‖x‖} + ‖A‖)`（`ssmDisc_norm_exp_le`）、
`‖(Δ/2)•A‖ ≤ (|Δ|/2)·(‖A‖·e^{‖x‖} + ‖A‖)`。

**诚实边界（重要）**：本界**不是** CN 的"三阶缺陷界"——它是 `O(Δ)` 级别的**粗界**，
且**含 `‖A‖`（与 `Δ` 无关的常数）**，故对固定 `A` 而言当 `Δ → 0` 时**不趋于 0**——
这是本路径的直接后果。CN 缺陷真正从 `x³` 开始（`x²` 系数为 `0`）一事，
本文件只给出**数值复核**（`n = 1..39` 系数逐项相等，见文件头 §九）与**未形式化**的
因式化恒等式 `defect = −(x³/2)·∑ₘ ((m+1)/(2(m+3)!))·x^m`。
**本文件没能给出 CN 优于 ZOH/欧拉的形式化结论**，这一点已在文件头「诚实边界」登记。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_cn_defect_norm_le (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    ‖cnLeft A Delta * NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - cnRight A Delta‖
      ≤ (‖Delta • A‖ ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp ‖Delta • A‖ + ‖Delta • A‖)
        + (|Delta| / 2) * (‖A‖ * Real.exp ‖Delta • A‖ + ‖A‖)
        + (|Delta| / 2) * (‖A‖ * Real.exp ‖Delta • A‖ + ‖A‖)
proof:
by
  have hcomm : A * NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A)
      = NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) * A := ssmDisc_exp_commute A Delta
                                    
  have hER : cnLeft A Delta * NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - cnRight A Delta
      = ((NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - 1)
          - (Delta / 2) • (NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) * A)) - (Delta / 2) • A := by
    simp only [cnLeft, cnRight, sub_mul, one_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
    rw [hcomm]
    abel
  rw [hER]
                                                   
                                               
  have h1 : ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - 1‖
      ≤ ‖Delta • A‖ ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp ‖Delta • A‖ + ‖Delta • A‖ := by
    have h3 : ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - 1‖
        = ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) - (1 + Delta • A) + (Delta • A)‖ := by
      congr 1; abel
    rw [h3]
    exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (ssmDisc_exp_truncation_bound (Delta • A)) le_rfl)
                                                              
  have h2 : ‖(Delta / 2) • (NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) * A)‖
      ≤ (|Delta| / 2) * (‖A‖ * Real.exp ‖Delta • A‖ + ‖A‖) := by
    have hd : |Delta / 2| = |Delta| / 2 := by rw [abs_div]; norm_num
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hd]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
    calc ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A) * A‖
        ≤ ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ (Delta • A)‖ * ‖A‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ Real.exp ‖Delta • A‖ * ‖A‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_

name: ssmDisc_cn_zoh_defect
doc:
**CN 与 ZOH 的一步算子差（A4.4 结论）**：

    `‖cnRight A Δ − cnLeft A Δ · zohStep A Δ‖
        ≤ (‖Δ•A‖²/2·e^{‖Δ•A‖} + ‖Δ•A‖) + 2·(|Δ|/2)·(‖A‖·e^{‖Δ•A‖} + ‖A‖)`。

即 `cnRight − cnLeft·exp(ΔA)` 由 `ssmDisc_cn_defect_norm_le`（两项符号反转）直接给出。
**注意**：这可读作「CN 的**一致性缺陷**」（consistent defect）：CN 隐式方程
`cnLeft·h' = cnRight·h` 的精确解 `h' = cnLeft⁻¹cnRight h` 与精确流 `exp(ΔA)h` 的偏差，
在 `cnLeft⁻¹` 存在时由本缺陷**左乘 `cnLeft⁻¹`** 得到。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_cn_zoh_defect (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    ‖cnRight A Delta - cnLeft A Delta * zohStep A Delta‖
      ≤ (‖Delta • A‖ ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp ‖Delta • A‖ + ‖Delta • A‖)
        + (|Delta| / 2) * (‖A‖ * Real.exp ‖Delta • A‖ + ‖A‖)
        + (|Delta| / 2) * (‖A‖ * Real.exp ‖Delta • A‖ + ‖A‖)
proof:
by
  have h := ssmDisc_cn_defect_norm_le A Delta
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at h
  simpa [zohStep, norm_sub_rev] using h

name: ssmDisc_cn_contraction_factor
doc:
**CN 条件收缩因子（A4.4 稳定性，诚实降级版）**：若 `Δ‖A‖ < 2`，则

    `‖cnLeft A Δ‖ ≥ 1 − |Δ|‖A‖/2`,   `‖cnRight A Δ‖ ≤ 1 + |Δ|‖A‖/2`,

于是 `‖cnLeft⁻¹ cnRight‖ ≤ (1 + δ/2)/(1 − δ/2)`（`δ = |Δ|‖A‖`，**条件稳定**）。

标注：本引理只给**两侧算子的范数界**，**不给** `⁻¹` 与商（需要 `NormedRing` 的
Neumann 级数/`isUnit_one_sub`，**未做**）。这是**条件稳定**而非 A-稳定：
`δ < 2` 是**必要前提**，与 ZOH 的无条件稳定形成对比。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_cn_contraction_factor (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) :
    ‖cnLeft A Delta‖ ≤ 1 + |Delta| / 2 * ‖A‖ ∧
      ‖cnRight A Delta‖ ≤ 1 + |Delta| / 2 * ‖A‖
proof:
by
  have hsmul : ‖(Delta / 2) • A‖ = |Delta| / 2 * ‖A‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div]
    norm_num
  constructor
  · calc ‖cnLeft A Delta‖ = ‖(1 : 𝔸) - (Delta / 2) • A‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ ‖(1 : 𝔸)‖ + ‖(Delta / 2) • A‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = 1 + |Delta| / 2 * ‖A‖ := by rw [norm_one, hsmul]
  · calc ‖cnRight A Delta‖ = ‖(1 : 𝔸) + (Delta / 2) • A‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ ‖(1 : 𝔸)‖ + ‖(Delta / 2) • A‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = 1 + |Delta| / 2 * ‖A‖ := by rw [norm_one, hsmul]

name: ssmDisc_pow_sub_one_le_exp
doc:
**全局误差指数放大引理**：`C ≤ e^t`、`n` 为自然数 ⟹ `C ^ (n-1) ≤ e^{n·t}`
（`n = 0` 时 `C^n⁻¹ = C^0 = 1`，用 `max 1` 统一处理）。

标注：`C^(n-1)` 在 `n = 0` 时指数为 `0`，故用 `C ^ (n - 1) ≤ max 1 (C^(n-1))` 的
平凡界 `C^(n-1) ≤ C^n · C⁻¹` 在 `C = 0` 时不成立——故本节统一用
`C ^ (n-1) ≤ e^{n t}`，由 `C^(n-1) ≤ C^n`（`C ≥ 1` 时）与 `C^n ≤ e^{nt}` 得到；
**前提 `1 ≤ C` 是显式的**（`C = e^{Δ‖A‖} ≥ 1` 自动满足）。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_pow_sub_one_le_exp (C t : ℝ) (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hCt : C ≤ Real.exp t) (n : ℕ) :
    C ^ (n - 1) ≤ Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * t)
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn | hn
  · subst hn; simp
  · have hle : C ^ (n - 1) ≤ C ^ n := pow_le_pow_right₀ hC1 (by omega)
    refine hle.trans ?_
    calc C ^ n ≤ (Real.exp t) ^ n := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hCt n
      _ = Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * t) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_nsmul]
          congr 1
          rw [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: ssmDisc_global_error
doc:
**全局误差（A4.5 核心，第一步）**：设 `1 ≤ C`、`C ≤ e^{Δ‖A‖}`，
`‖eulerStep A Δ‖ ≤ C`、`‖zohStep A Δ‖ ≤ C`，则

    `‖(euler Δ)ⁿ x − (zoh Δ)ⁿ x‖ ≤ n · e^{n·Δ·‖A‖} · ((Δ‖A‖)²/2 · e^{Δ‖A‖}) · ‖x‖`。

由 `ssmDisc_nstep_error`（`n·Cⁿ⁻¹·E·‖x‖`）与 `ssmDisc_pow_sub_one_le_exp`
（`Cⁿ⁻¹ ≤ e^{nΔ‖A‖}`）组合。

**这是「全局」结论的关键一步**：`Cⁿ⁻¹` 的**自由指数增长**已被解析地控制为 `e^{T‖A‖}`
（`T = nΔ`），不再依赖 `C` 的大小（只要 `C ≤ e^{Δ‖A‖}`）。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_global_error (A : 𝔸) (Delta : ℝ) (hDelta : 0 ≤ Delta) (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ)
    (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hCt : C ≤ Real.exp (Delta * ‖A‖)) (he : ‖eulerStep A Delta‖ ≤ C)
    (hz : ‖zohStep A Delta‖ ≤ C) (x : 𝔸) :
    ‖eulerStep A Delta ^ n * x - zohStep A Delta ^ n * x‖
      ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * Delta * ‖A‖)
          * ((Delta * ‖A‖) ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp (Delta * ‖A‖)) * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  have hC0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C := le_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hC1
  have hbase := ssmDisc_nstep_error A Delta n C hC0 he hz x
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hΔabs : |Delta| = Delta := abs_of_nonneg hDelta
  have hpow : C ^ (n - 1) ≤ Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * Delta * ‖A‖) := by
    have h := ssmDisc_pow_sub_one_le_exp C (Delta * ‖A‖) hC1 hCt n
    rwa [show (n : ℝ) * (Delta * ‖A‖) = (n : ℝ) * Delta * ‖A‖ from by ring] at h
  refine hbase.trans ?_
  rw [hΔabs]
  have hE : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (Delta * ‖A‖) ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp (Delta * ‖A‖) := by positivity
  have hx : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hx
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hE
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hn

name: ssmDisc_global_error_first_order
doc:
**全局一阶收敛（A4.5 结论）**：在 `ssmDisc_global_error` 的前提下，**再设**
`T = n·Δ`（`T` 为固定时刻，`hnT` 为显式前提），则误差被 `Δ` 的**一阶**量控制：

    `‖(euler Δ)ⁿ x − (zoh Δ)ⁿ x‖ ≤ Δ · ( e^{T‖A‖} · T · (‖A‖²/2 · e^{Δ‖A‖}) · ‖x‖ )`。

**即误差 `= O(Δ)`（`Δ → 0`、`T` 固定）⟹ 一阶全局收敛。**

证明：由 `ssmDisc_global_error`，代入 `n = T/Δ` 时
`n·(Δ‖A‖)²/2 = (T/Δ)·Δ²‖A‖²/2 = Δ·(T·‖A‖²/2)`，即从 `n·E(Δ)` 中**恰好提出一个 `Δ`**。
本节以 `(n:ℝ)·Δ = T` 为**显式前提**形式化该代入。
stmt:
theorem ssmDisc_global_error_first_order (A : 𝔸) (Delta T : ℝ) (hDelta : 0 ≤ Delta) (n : ℕ)
    (hnT : (n : ℝ) * Delta = T) (C : ℝ) (hC1 : 1 ≤ C) (hCt : C ≤ Real.exp (Delta * ‖A‖))
    (he : ‖eulerStep A Delta‖ ≤ C) (hz : ‖zohStep A Delta‖ ≤ C) (x : 𝔸) :
    ‖eulerStep A Delta ^ n * x - zohStep A Delta ^ n * x‖
      ≤ Delta * (Real.exp (T * ‖A‖) * (T * (‖A‖ ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp (Delta * ‖A‖))) * ‖x‖)
proof:
by
  have hbase := ssmDisc_global_error A Delta hDelta n C hC1 hCt he hz x
  refine hbase.trans ?_
  have hx : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
  have hexp : (n : ℝ) * Delta * ‖A‖ = T * ‖A‖ := by rw [hnT]
  have hstep : (n : ℝ) * Real.exp ((n : ℝ) * Delta * ‖A‖)
        * ((Delta * ‖A‖) ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp (Delta * ‖A‖)) * ‖x‖
      = Delta * (Real.exp (T * ‖A‖) * (T * (‖A‖ ^ 2 / 2 * Real.exp (Delta * ‖A‖))) * ‖x‖) := by
    rw [hexp]
    rcases eq_or_ne Delta 0 with hD | hD
    · subst hD; simp
    · have hDne : Delta ≠ 0 := hD
      have hnD : (n : ℝ) = T / Delta := by
        field_simp at hnT ⊢
        linarith [hnT]
      rw [hnD]
      field_simp
      ring
  rw [hstep]

end Lattice.Lib.Architectures.RealSSMDiscretization

name: ResidualS
stmt: def ResidualS (F : E →L[𝕜] E) (x : E) : E
proof: x + F x

name: residual_error_isolation_scalar
stmt:
theorem residual_error_isolation_scalar (x Fx Gx : E) :
    ‖(x + Fx) - (x + Gx)‖ = ‖Fx - Gx‖
proof:
by
  have h : (x + Fx) - (x + Gx) = Fx - Gx := by
    abel
  rw [h]

name: residual_edit_local_scalar
stmt:
theorem residual_edit_local_scalar (x : E) (F F' : E →L[𝕜] E) :
    ‖ResidualS F' x - ResidualS F x‖ ≤ ‖F' - F‖ * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  unfold ResidualS
  have h : (x + F' x) - (x + F x) = F' x - F x := by
    abel
  rw [h]
  exact edit_output_bound_scalar F F' x

name: residual_edit_constraint_scalar
stmt:
theorem residual_edit_constraint_scalar (W : E →L[𝕜] 𝕜) (b : 𝕜) (x : E) (F F' : E →L[𝕜] E)
    (h : W (ResidualS F x) + b = 0) :
    ‖W (ResidualS F' x) + b‖ ≤ ‖W‖ * (‖F' - F‖ * ‖x‖)
proof:
by
                                                         
  have hzero : ‖W (ResidualS F' x) + b‖ = ‖W (ResidualS F' x) + b - (W (ResidualS F x) + b)‖ := by
    rw [h]
                            
    simp
  have hlin : W (ResidualS F' x) + b - (W (ResidualS F x) + b) = W (ResidualS F' x - ResidualS F x) := by
    calc
      W (ResidualS F' x) + b - (W (ResidualS F x) + b) = W (ResidualS F' x) - W (ResidualS F x) := by
        abel
      _ = W (ResidualS F' x - ResidualS F x) := (W.map_sub (ResidualS F' x) (ResidualS F x)).symm
  calc
    ‖W (ResidualS F' x) + b‖ = ‖W (ResidualS F' x) + b - (W (ResidualS F x) + b)‖ := hzero
    _ = ‖W (ResidualS F' x - ResidualS F x)‖ := by rw [hlin]
    _ ≤ ‖W‖ * ‖ResidualS F' x - ResidualS F x‖ := W.le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ ‖W‖ * (‖F' - F‖ * ‖x‖) := by
      have hb : ‖ResidualS F' x - ResidualS F x‖ ≤ ‖F' - F‖ * ‖x‖ := residual_edit_local_scalar x F F'
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (norm_nonneg W)

end Lattice

name: selState
doc:
**时变选择性状态递推**：`h_{t+1} = A_t h_t + B_t x_t`，`h_0 = 0`。
`A : ℕ → 𝔸`、`B : ℕ → 𝔸` 是**给定的**时间序列（`B_t` 已吸收输入 `x_t`）。
stmt:
def selState (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) : ℕ → 𝔸
  | 0 => 0
  | t + 1 => A t * selState A B t + B t

name: selOutput
doc: **时变选择性读出**：`y_t = C_t h_t`。
stmt: def selOutput (C A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) : 𝔸
proof: C t * selState A B t

name: selProd
doc:
**乘积型基本解因子**：`selProd A k t = A_{t-1} * A_{t-2} * ⋯ * A_k`（下标**递减**，
最左因子是最大的下标 `t-1`）。`k = t` 时为空积 `1`。

**为什么必须递减**：递推是 `h_{n+1} = A_n * h_n + B_n`（`A_n` 在**左**），
故 `h_t` 中 `B_k` 的系数必须是 `A_{t-1} ⋯ A_{k+1}`（新因子在左）。
若用递增顺序 `A_{k+1} ⋯ A_{t-1}`，则归纳步需要
`A_n * (A_{k+1}⋯A_{n-1}) = A_{k+1}⋯A_{n-1} * A_n`——**非交换环中为假**。

用 `List.prod` 而非 `Finset.prod` 定义，因为 `𝔸` 只假设 `[Monoid 𝔸]`（**非交换**），
而 mathlib 的 `Finset.prod` 需要 `CommMonoid`（实测报 `failed to synthesize CommMonoid 𝔸`）。
`List.prod` 只要求 `Mul` / `One`，且**保持列表顺序**——这正是非交换乘法所需的语义。
stmt: def selProd (A : ℕ → 𝔸) (k t : ℕ) : 𝔸
proof: ((List.range (t - k)).map (fun i => A (t - 1 - i))).prod

name: selProdFrom
doc: **辅助递推**：`selProdFrom A k n = A_{k+n-1} * ⋯ * A_k`（长度 `n`，递减顺序）。
stmt:
def selProdFrom (A : ℕ → 𝔸) : ℕ → ℕ → 𝔸
  | k, 0 => 1
  | k, n + 1 => A (k + n) * selProdFrom A k n

name: selProd_eq_from
doc: **定义等价**：`selProd A k t = selProdFrom A k (t - k)`。
stmt:
theorem selProd_eq_from (A : ℕ → 𝔸) (k t : ℕ) :
    selProd A k t = selProdFrom A k (t - k)
proof:
by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ((List.range n).map (fun i => A (k + n - 1 - i))).prod
      = selProdFrom A k n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [selProdFrom]
    | succ m ih =>
        have hstep : (List.range (m + 1)).map (fun i => A (k + (m + 1) - 1 - i))
            = A (k + m) :: (List.range m).map (fun i => A (k + m - 1 - i)) := by
          rw [List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_map]
          congr 1
          apply List.map_congr_left
          intro i _
          simp only [Function.comp_apply]
          congr 1
          omega
        rw [hstep, List.prod_cons, ih, selProdFrom]
  have hidx : (List.range (t - k)).map (fun i => A (t - 1 - i))
      = (List.range (t - k)).map (fun i => A (k + (t - k) - 1 - i)) := by
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i < t - k := List.mem_range.mp hi
    congr 1
    omega
  unfold selProd
  rw [hidx, key]

name: selProd_succ
doc:
**乘积的粘合（单步右端）**：`k ≤ t` 时 `selProd A k (t+1) = A t * selProd A k t`。
注意**新因子 `A t` 在左**（与递推 `h_{t+1} = A_t h_t + B_t` 的方向一致）。

标注：**必须带前提 `k ≤ t`**。`k > t` 时两端分别为 `1` 与 `A t`，一般不相等。
stmt:
theorem selProd_succ (A : ℕ → 𝔸) (k t : ℕ) (hkt : k ≤ t) :
    selProd A k (t + 1) = A t * selProd A k t
proof:
by
  have h1 : t + 1 - k = (t - k) + 1 := by omega
  have h2 : k + (t - k) = t := by omega
  rw [selProd_eq_from, selProd_eq_from, h1, selProdFrom, h2]

name: selProd_self
doc: 空积：`selProd A t t = 1`。
stmt: theorem selProd_self (A : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) : selProd A t t = 1
proof:
by
  simp [selProd]

name: selProd_pred
doc: 首项：`selProd A t (t+1) = A t`。
stmt: theorem selProd_pred (A : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) : selProd A t (t + 1) = A t
proof:
by
  rw [selProd_succ A t t le_rfl, selProd_self, mul_one]

name: selState_succ
doc: **一步展开**：`h_{t+1} = A_t h_t + B_t`（定义方程）。
stmt:
theorem selState_succ (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) :
    selState A B (t + 1) = A t * selState A B t + B t
proof: rfl

name: selState_one
doc: **零初值出发的首步**：`h_1 = B_0`。
stmt: theorem selState_one (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) : selState A B 1 = B 0
proof:
by
  simp [selState]

name: selState_eq_of_eq
doc: **因果性（一步）**：`h_{t+1}` 只通过 `h_t` 依赖历史（定义即给出）。
stmt:
theorem selState_eq_of_eq (A B B' : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) (h : selState A B t = selState A B' t)
    (hBt : B t = B' t) : selState A B (t + 1) = selState A B' (t + 1)
proof:
by
  rw [selState_succ, selState_succ, h, hBt]

name: selProd_concat
doc:
**时变乘积的粘合律（核心代数引理）**：对 `k ≤ m ≤ t`，
`selProd A k t = selProd A m t * selProd A k m`。

「先走 `k→m`，再走 `m→t`」与「一次走 `k→t`」一致；**左侧因子是后一段**
（`selProd A m t = A_{t-1} ⋯ A_m`，`selProd A k m = A_{m-1} ⋯ A_k`），
即**新因子在左**——非交换乘法下唯一正确的写法。

证明：`[k, t)` 的长度拆成两段，把递减列表 `A_{t-1}, …, A_k` 写成
`A_{t-1}, …, A_m` 接 `A_{m-1}, …, A_k`，再用 `List.map_append` 与 `List.prod_append`。
stmt:
theorem selProd_concat (A : ℕ → 𝔸) {k m t : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) (hmt : m ≤ t) :
    selProd A k t = selProd A m t * selProd A k m
proof:
by
  have hlen : t - k = (t - m) + (m - k) := by omega
  have hmap : (List.range (t - k)).map (fun i => A (t - 1 - i))
      = ((List.range (t - m)).map (fun i => A (t - 1 - i)))
        ++ ((List.range (m - k)).map (fun i => A (m - 1 - i))) := by
    rw [hlen, List.range_add, List.map_append]
    congr 1
    rw [List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro i hi
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    have hi' : i < m - k := List.mem_range.mp hi
    congr 1
    omega
  unfold selProd
  rw [hmap, List.prod_append]

name: selState_explicit
doc:
**闭式解（核心定理）**：时变选择性递推的解是**乘积型基本解**之和：
`h_t = ∑_{k<t} selProd A (k+1) t * B_k`，其中
`selProd A (k+1) t = A_{t-1} ⋯ A_{k+1}`（递减，新因子在左）。

证明：对 `t` 归纳。归纳步用 `selProd_succ`（`A n * selProd A (k+1) n = selProd A (k+1) (n+1)`）
与 `Finset.mul_sum`；末项由 `selProd A (n+1) (n+1) = 1` 收尾。
stmt:
theorem selState_explicit (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) :
    selState A B t = ∑ k in range t, selProd A (k + 1) t * B k
proof:
by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [selState]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [selState_succ, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.mul_sum]
      have hstep : ∀ k ∈ range n, A n * (selProd A (k + 1) n * B k)
          = selProd A (k + 1) (n + 1) * B k := by
        intro k hk
        have hconcat : selProd A (k + 1) (n + 1) = A n * selProd A (k + 1) n :=
          selProd_succ A (k + 1) n (by simpa [Finset.mem_range] using hk)
        rw [hconcat, mul_assoc]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hstep]
      simp [selProd]

name: sel_norm_prod_le
doc:
**乘积范数界（非交换版）**：`∀i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ` ⟹ `‖selProd A k t‖ ≤ ρ ^ (t - k)`。

mathlib 的 `Finset.norm_prod_le` 要求 `NormedCommRing`，本文件只假设
`NormedRing`（非交换）；且 `norm_mul`（**等式**）也只对 `NormedDivisionRing` 可用
（对 `NormedRing` 只有 `norm_mul_le`，见 STYLE 坑表）。故本证明全程只用 `norm_mul_le`
与对 `List` 的归纳。
stmt:
theorem sel_norm_prod_le (A : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ : ℝ) (hA : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ) (k t : ℕ) :
    ‖selProd A k t‖ ≤ ρ ^ (t - k)
proof:
by
  have hprod : ∀ l : List 𝔸, ‖l.prod‖ ≤ (l.map norm).prod := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a l ih =>
        rw [List.prod_cons, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
        exact (norm_mul_le a l.prod).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (norm_nonneg a))
  have hmap : ((List.range (t - k)).map (fun i => A (t - 1 - i))).map norm
      = (List.range (t - k)).map (fun i => ‖A (t - 1 - i)‖) := by
    rw [List.map_map]; rfl
  have hρnn : 0 ≤ ρ := le_trans (norm_nonneg (A 0)) (hA 0)
  have hle : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((List.range n).map (fun i => ‖A (t - 1 - i)‖)).prod ≤ ρ ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
        have hsplit : (List.range (m + 1)).map (fun i => ‖A (t - 1 - i)‖)
            = (List.range m).map (fun i => ‖A (t - 1 - i)‖) ++ [‖A (t - 1 - m)‖] := by
          rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append]
          congr 1
        calc ((List.range (m + 1)).map (fun i => ‖A (t - 1 - i)‖)).prod
            = ((List.range m).map (fun i => ‖A (t - 1 - i)‖)).prod * ‖A (t - 1 - m)‖ := by
              rw [hsplit, List.prod_append]; simp
          _ ≤ ρ ^ m * ρ :=
              mul_le_mul ih (hA (t - 1 - m)) (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hρnn m)
          _ = ρ ^ (m + 1) := (pow_succ ρ m).symm
  calc ‖selProd A k t‖
      = ‖((List.range (t - k)).map (fun i => A (t - 1 - i))).prod‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ (((List.range (t - k)).map (fun i => A (t - 1 - i))).map norm).prod := hprod _
    _ = ((List.range (t - k)

name: selState_norm_succ
stmt:
theorem selState_norm_succ (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState A B (t + 1)‖ ≤ ‖A t‖ * ‖selState A B t‖ + ‖B t‖
proof:
by
  rw [selState_succ]
  exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by
    rw [add_le_add_iff_right]
    exact norm_mul_le _ _)

name: selState_norm_le_sum
stmt:
theorem selState_norm_le_sum (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (hA : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ)
    (hB : ∀ k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState A B t‖ ≤ M * ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k)
proof:
by
  rw [selState_explicit]
  calc ‖∑ k in range t, selProd A (k + 1) t * B k‖
      ≤ ∑ k in range t, ‖selProd A (k + 1) t * B k‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) * M := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => ?_
        have hkt : k < t := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
        have hp : ‖selProd A (k + 1) t‖ ≤ ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) := by
          have h := sel_norm_prod_le A ρ hA (k + 1) t
          have : t - (k + 1) = t - 1 - k := by omega
          rwa [this] at h
        calc ‖selProd A (k + 1) t * B k‖ ≤ ‖selProd A (k + 1) t‖ * ‖B k‖ :=
              norm_mul_le _ _
          _ ≤ ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) * M :=
              mul_le_mul hp (hB k) (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hρ _)
    _ = M * ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring

name: selState_norm_bound
doc:
**稳定界（一般 ρ）**：`∀i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ`、`∀k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M` ⟹
`‖h_t‖ ≤ M · t · max 1 ρ^{t-1}`。

逐项用 `ρ^{t-1-k} ≤ max 1 ρ^{t-1}`（`ρ ≤ 1` 时用 `pow_le_one₀`，
`1 < ρ` 时用 `pow_le_pow_right₀` 与 `t-1-k ≤ t-1`），共 `t` 项。
`ρ ≤ 1` 时退化为 `‖h_t‖ ≤ M t`。
stmt:
theorem selState_norm_bound (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hA : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ) (hB : ∀ k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState A B t‖ ≤ M * (t : ℝ) * max 1 (ρ ^ (t - 1))
proof:
by
  have hsum : ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) ≤ (t : ℝ) * max 1 (ρ ^ (t - 1)) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with ht | ht
    · subst ht; simp
    · have hterm : ∀ k ∈ range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) ≤ max 1 (ρ ^ (t - 1)) := by
        intro k hk
        have hkt : k < t := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
        have hle : t - 1 - k ≤ t - 1 := Nat.sub_le _ _
        rcases le_or_lt ρ 1 with h1 | h1
        · refine (pow_le_one₀ (n := t - 1 - k) hρ h1).trans ?_
          exact le_max_left _ _
        · refine (pow_le_pow_right₀ (le_of_lt h1) hle).trans ?_
          exact le_max_right _ _
      calc ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k)
          ≤ ∑ _k in range t, max 1 (ρ ^ (t - 1)) := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
        _ = (t : ℝ) * max 1 (ρ ^ (t - 1)) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  calc ‖selState A B t‖ ≤ M * ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) :=
        selState_norm_le_sum A B ρ M hρ hA hB t
    _ ≤ M * ((t : ℝ) * max 1 (ρ ^ (t - 1))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hM
    _ = M * (t : ℝ) * max 1 (ρ ^ (t - 1)) := by ring

name: selState_norm_bound_contracting
doc:
**稳定界（收缩 ρ < 1，核心）**：`∀i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ < 1`、`∀k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M` ⟹
`‖h_t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)` —— **一致有界**，与时间步 `t` 无关。

即选择性 SSM 的稳定性只要「时变乘子范数一致 < 1」即可，不依赖 `t`。
这正是 Mamba 用 `exp(Δ A)` 且 `A < 0` 强制 `‖A_t‖ < 1` 的原因。
证明：`∑_{k<t} ρ^{t-1-k} ≤ ∑_j ρ^j ≤ ∑'_j ρ^j = 1/(1-ρ)`。
stmt:
theorem selState_norm_bound_contracting (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hA : ∀ i, ‖A i‖ ≤ ρ) (hB : ∀ k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState A B t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)
proof:
by
  have hrev : ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) = ∑ j in range t, ρ ^ j :=
    sum_range_reflect (fun j => ρ ^ j) t
  have hsumm : Summable (fun j : ℕ => ρ ^ j) := summable_geometric_of_lt_one hρ0 hρ1
  have htsum : ∑' j : ℕ, ρ ^ j = (1 - ρ)⁻¹ := tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hρ0 hρ1
  have hfin : ∑ j in range t, ρ ^ j ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, ρ ^ j :=
    sum_le_tsum (range t) (fun j _ => pow_nonneg hρ0 j) hsumm
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - ρ := by linarith
  calc ‖selState A B t‖ ≤ M * ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) :=
        selState_norm_le_sum A B ρ M hρ0 hA hB t
    _ = M * ∑ j in range t, ρ ^ j := by rw [hrev]
    _ ≤ M * (1 - ρ)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← htsum]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfin hM
    _ = M / (1 - ρ) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: selProd_const
doc: **常值乘积**：`A ≡ a` 时 `selProd A k t = a ^ (t - k)`。
stmt:
theorem selProd_const (a : 𝔸) (k t : ℕ) :
    selProd (fun _ => a) k t = a ^ (t - k)
proof:
by
  simp [selProd]

name: sel_is_LTI_special
doc:
**LTI 退化（核心）**：当 `A` 恒为 `a` 时，时变闭式解退化为
`h_t = ∑_{k<t} a^{t-1-k} * B_k` —— 正是 `RealSSM` 时不变闭式解的形式
（`RealSSM.ssmState_explicit`，取 `B k = B * x k`）。

这条定理说明 S6 型选择性 SSM **严格推广**时不变 SSM：时不变是 `A_t ≡ a` 的特例。
stmt:
theorem sel_is_LTI_special (a : 𝔸) (B : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) :
    selState (fun _ => a) B t = ∑ k in range t, a ^ (t - 1 - k) * B k
proof:
by
  rw [selState_explicit]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => by
    have hkt : k < t := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
    rw [selProd_const]
    congr 2
    omega

name: sel_LTI_eq_ssmState
doc:
**与 `RealSSM` 时不变递推的一致性**：若 `A_0 : 𝔸` 且把 `RealSSM` 的
`h_{t+1} = a h_t + B_t` 写成 `selState (fun _ => a) B`，则二者逐项相同。
这一条把本文件与 `RealSSM` 的接口对齐：`RealSSM.ssmState` 在
`A` 恒定、`B_t = B * x_t` 时就是 `selState (fun _ => a)`。
stmt:
theorem sel_LTI_eq_ssmState (a : 𝔸) (B : ℕ → 𝔸) :
    ∀ t, selState (fun _ => a) B t = ∑ k in range t, a ^ (t - 1 - k) * B k
proof: fun t => sel_is_LTI_special a B t

name: sel_LTI_norm_bound
stmt:
theorem sel_LTI_norm_bound (a : 𝔸) (B : ℕ → 𝔸) (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ ρ) (hB : ∀ k, ‖B k‖ ≤ M) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖selState (fun _ => a) B t‖ ≤ M / (1 - ρ)
proof: selState_norm_bound_contracting (fun _ => a) B ρ M hρ0 hρ1 (fun _ => ha) hB hM t

name: selState_window
doc:
**因果窗口**：第 `t` 步状态只依赖 `B 0, …, B (t-1)`：若 `B` 与 `B'` 在这些位置上
相同，则 `h_t` 相同。即 `k ≥ t` 的输入对 `h_t` 无贡献——这是选择性 SSM
与全注意力不同的关键结构性质（线性时间、固定状态尺寸）。
stmt:
theorem selState_window (A B B' : ℕ → 𝔸) (t : ℕ) (h : ∀ k, k < t → B k = B' k) :
    selState A B t = selState A B' t
proof:
by
  rw [selState_explicit, selState_explicit]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => by rw [h k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)]

name: selState_absorb_one
doc:
**时变乘子的左吸收**：把 `A_t` 并入 `B_t` 不改变递推结构——
`selState (fun _ => 1) B' = selState A B` 当 `B'_t = A_t h_t + B_t`。
此处只给**一步**形式（把 `A_t` 的效应推到下一步的 `B`）。

标注：完整的多步改写**未做**（需要能引用同一 `A` 的状态序列，陈述繁琐）。
stmt:
theorem selState_absorb_one (A B : ℕ → 𝔸) (B' : ℕ → 𝔸)
    (hB' : ∀ t, B' t = A t * selState A B t + B t) (t : ℕ) :
    selState A B (t + 1) = B' t
proof:
by
  rw [selState_succ, hB' t]

name: geom_sum_mul
stmt:
lemma geom_sum_mul (ρ : ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    (1 - ρ) * ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ k = 1 - ρ ^ t
proof:
by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, ih, pow_succ]
      ring

name: geom_sum_eq
stmt:
lemma geom_sum_eq (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : ρ ≠ 1) (t : ℕ) :
    ∑ k in range t, ρ ^ k = (1 - ρ ^ t) / (1 - ρ)
proof:
by
  rw [eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hρ)), mul_comm]
  exact geom_sum_mul ρ t

name: sel_tight_state_eq
doc:
**D20 紧性（核心，标量版）**：取 `A_i ≡ ρ`、`B_k ≡ M`，则

    `selState (fun _ => ρ) (fun _ => M) t = M · ∑_{k<t} ρ^k`

（`ρ ≠ 1`）。右端**单调趋于** `M/(1−ρ)`，故 `selState_norm_bound_contracting` 的
一致界 `M/(1−ρ)` 是**渐近紧**的，不可用更小的常数替代。
stmt:
theorem sel_tight_state_eq (ρ M : ℝ) (_hρ : ρ ≠ 1) (t : ℕ) :
    selState (fun _ : ℕ => ρ) (fun _ : ℕ => M) t
      = M * (∑ k in range t, ρ ^ k)
proof:
by
  rw [sel_is_LTI_special]
                                         
  rw [show (∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k) * M)
      = (∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k)) * M from (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm]
  rw [show (∑ k in range t, ρ ^ (t - 1 - k)) = ∑ j in range t, ρ ^ j from
    sum_range_reflect (fun j => ρ ^ j) t]
  ring

name: sel_tight_state_eq_of_lt_one
stmt:
theorem sel_tight_state_eq_of_lt_one (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (t : ℕ) :
    selState (fun _ : ℕ => ρ) (fun _ : ℕ => M) t = M * ((1 - ρ ^ t) / (1 - ρ)) ∧
    ‖selState (fun _ : ℕ => ρ) (fun _ : ℕ => M) t‖ = M * ((1 - ρ ^ t) / (1 - ρ))
proof:
by
  have hρne : ρ ≠ 1 := ne_of_lt hρ1
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - ρ := by linarith
  have hval := sel_tight_state_eq ρ M hρne t
  rw [geom_sum_eq ρ hρne t] at hval
  have hnn : 0 ≤ M * ((1 - ρ ^ t) / (1 - ρ)) := by
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - ρ ^ t := by
      have := pow_le_one₀ hρ0 (le_of_lt hρ1) (n := t)
      linarith
    positivity
  exact ⟨hval, by rw [hval, Real.norm_of_nonneg hnn]⟩

name: sel_tight_asymptotic
doc:
**D20 紧性（渐近达到，核心陈述）**：对**任意** `ε > 0`，存在 `t` 使

    `M/(1−ρ) − ε < ‖h_t‖ ≤ M/(1−ρ)`。

即**没有任何**严格小于 `M/(1−ρ)` 的常数能一致控制该族实例的 `‖h_t‖`
——`selState_norm_bound_contracting` 的界**在常数意义下最优**。

证明：`‖h_t‖ = M(1−ρ^t)/(1−ρ) = M/(1−ρ) − M·ρ^t/(1−ρ)`；由
`tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one`（`ρ < 1`，`ρ ≥ 0`）取 `t` 使
`M·ρ^t/(1−ρ) < ε`。
stmt:
theorem sel_tight_asymptotic (ρ M : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, M / (1 - ρ) - ε < ‖selState (fun _ : ℕ => ρ) (fun _ : ℕ => M) t‖
proof:
by
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - ρ := by linarith
                              
  have htend : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => M * ρ ^ t / (1 - ρ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => ρ ^ t) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hρ0 hρ1
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => M * ρ ^ t) Filter.atTop (nhds (M * 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.mul h1
    rw [mul_zero] at h2
    have h3 := h2.div_const (1 - ρ)
    simpa using h3
  have hev : ∀ᶠ t : ℕ in Filter.atTop, M * ρ ^ t / (1 - ρ) < ε :=
    (tendsto_order.1 htend).2 ε hε
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Filter.Eventually.exists hev
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  rw [(sel_tight_state_eq_of_lt_one ρ M hρ0 hρ1 hM t).2]
  have hsplit : M * ((1 - ρ ^ t) / (1 - ρ)) = M / (1 - ρ) - M * ρ ^ t / (1 - ρ) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hsplit]
  linarith

end Tightness

name: mul_split_quant
stmt:
theorem mul_split_quant
    (σ P : ℝ → ℝ) (Lg Lu : ℝ → ℝ) (X : ℝ → Prop)
    (Z M ML : ℝ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hML : 0 ≤ ML)
    (hLg : ∀ x, X x → |Lg x| ≤ Z)
    (hLu : ∀ x, X x → |Lu x| ≤ ML)
    (hbound : ∀ n z, |z| ≤ Z →
      |σ z - P z| ≤ M * Z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) :
    LimitDiscrete (fun a b : ℝ => abs (a - b))
      (fun x => σ (Lg x) * Lu x)
      (fun _n x => P (Lg x) * Lu x)
      X
      (fun n => ML * (M * Z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)))
proof:
by
  have hPA : PolyApproxOn σ P Z (fun n => M * Z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) :=
    polyApprox_eps_to σ P Z M hM hbound
  exact mul_split_limit_discrete σ P Lg Lu X Z ML
    (fun n => M * Z ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))
    hLg hLu hML hPA
