    IsArgMax s i
proof: topk_one_is_argmax s (routeSelectOne s) (routeSelectOne_spec s) hi

name: routed_output_bound
stmt:
theorem routed_output_bound (S : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, i ∈ S → 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i in S, w i = 1)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖routeOutput S w v‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  simpa [routeOutput] using topk_output_bound S w v M hw0 hsum hV

name: routeOutput_hard
stmt:
theorem routeOutput_hard (i : ι) (v : ι → F) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : w i = 1) (hrest : ∀ j, j ≠ i → w j = 0) :
    routeOutput ({i} : Finset ι) w v = v i
proof:
by
  simpa [routeOutput] using top1_output_is_hard i v w hw hrest

name: dynamic_route_error
stmt:
theorem dynamic_route_error (S S' : Finset ι) (w w' : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, i ∈ S → 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i in S, w i = 1)
    (hw0' : ∀ i, i ∈ S' → 0 ≤ w' i) (hsum' : ∑ i in S', w' i = 1)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖routeOutput S w v - routeOutput S' w' v‖ ≤ 2 * M
proof:
by
  have h1 := routed_output_bound S w v M hw0 hsum hV
  have h2 := routed_output_bound S' w' v M hw0' hsum' hV
  calc
    ‖routeOutput S w v - routeOutput S' w' v‖
        ≤ ‖routeOutput S w v‖ + ‖routeOutput S' w' v‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ M + M := add_le_add h1 h2
    _ = 2 * M := by ring

name: argmax_stable
stmt:
theorem argmax_stable (s s' : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (γ ε : ℝ)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s j + γ ≤ s i)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hεγ : 2 * ε ≤ γ) :
    IsArgMax s' i
proof:
by
  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst hji
    exact le_rfl
  · have h1 : s' j ≤ s j + ε := by
      have h := hpert j
      rw [abs_le] at h
      linarith [h.2]
    have h2 : s i - ε ≤ s' i := by
      have h := hpert i
      rw [abs_le] at h
      linarith [h.1]
    have h3 := hgap j hji
    linarith

name: topk_route_stable
stmt:
theorem topk_route_stable (s s' : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) (γ ε : ℝ)
    (hS : IsTopK s S k)
    (hgap : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → s j + γ ≤ s i)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hεγ : 2 * ε ≤ γ) :
    IsTopK s' S k
proof:
by
  refine ⟨hS.1, ?_⟩
  intro i hi j hj
  have h1 : s' j ≤ s j + ε := by
    have h := hpert j
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.2]
  have h2 : s i - ε ≤ s' i := by
    have h := hpert i
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  have h3 := hgap i hi j hj
  linarith

name: topk_route_stable_unique
stmt:
theorem topk_route_stable_unique (s s' : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (γ ε : ℝ)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s j + γ ≤ s i)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hεγ : 2 * ε < γ) :
    ∀ j : ι, IsArgMax s' j → j = i
proof:
by
  apply argmax_unique s' i
  intro j hji
  have h1 : s' j ≤ s j + ε := by
    have h := hpert j
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.2]
  have h2 : s i - ε ≤ s' i := by
    have h := hpert i
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  have h3 := hgap j hji
  linarith

name: route_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem route_lipschitz (s s' : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hS : IsTopK s S k)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hchange : ¬ IsTopK s' S k) :
    ∃ i ∈ S, ∃ j, j ∉ S ∧ s i - s j < 2 * ε
proof:
by
  by_contra hcon
  have hcon' : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → 2 * ε ≤ s i - s j := by
    intro i hi j hj
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    exact hcon ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hlt⟩
  apply hchange
  refine topk_route_stable s s' S k (2 * ε) ε hS ?_ hpert le_rfl
  intro i hi j hj
  have h := hcon' i hi j hj
  linarith

name: gqa_weights_nonneg
stmt:

name: grouped_output_bound
stmt:
theorem grouped_output_bound (Q : Fin H → E →L[ℝ] E) (Kv : Fin K → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (V : Fin K → ι → F) (g : Fin H → Fin K) (d : ℝ) (xq : E) (x : ι → E)

name: mqa_is_gqa_extreme
stmt:
theorem mqa_is_gqa_extreme (Q : Fin H → E →L[ℝ] E) (Kv : Fin 1 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (V : Fin 1 → ι → F) (g : Fin H → Fin 1) (d : ℝ) (xq : E) (x : ι → E)

name: softmax_monotone
stmt:
theorem softmax_monotone (s : ι → ℝ) (i j : ι) (h : s j ≤ s i) :
    softmax s j ≤ softmax s i
proof:
by
  unfold softmax
                                         
  have he : Real.exp (s j) ≤ Real.exp (s i) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h
  have hS : 0 < ∑ k, Real.exp (s k) := softmax_denom_pos s

name: headOutput
doc: 单头输出：权重 `w` 对 value `V` 的凸组合 `Σ_i w i • V i`。
stmt: def headOutput {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (V : ι → F) : F
proof: ∑ i, w i • V i

name: mergeHeads
doc: 多头合并：把 `k` 个头的输出 `h` 按合并权重 `α` 组合成一个头。
stmt: def mergeHeads {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) : F
proof: ∑ i, α i • h i

name: mergeHeadsOver
doc: 限制在头集合 `S` 上的合并（剪枝/稀疏合并）。
stmt: def mergeHeadsOver {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : Finset ι) (α : ι → ℝ) (h : ι → F) : F
proof: ∑ i in S, α i • h i

name: dropHead
doc: 剪头权重：把第 `j` 头的权重置 0。
stmt: def dropHead {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (j : Fin k) : Fin k → ℝ
proof: fun i => if i = j then 0 else α i

name: head_output_bound
stmt:
theorem head_output_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (V : ι → F)
    (M : ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i, w i = 1) (hV : ∀ i, ‖V i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖headOutput w V‖ ≤ M
proof: convComb_norm_bound w V M hw hsum hV

name: merge_output_bound
stmt:
theorem merge_output_bound {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hsum : ∑ i, α i = 1) (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeads
  calc
    ‖∑ i, α i • h i‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖α i • h i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i, α i * ‖h i‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hα i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, α i * M := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hα i)
    _ = M * (∑ i, α i) := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, mul_comm]
    _ = M := by rw [hsum, mul_one]

name: merge_output_bound_subprob
doc: 次概率权重（`Σ α ≤ 1`）的合并输出界：剪枝只减质量、不放大输出。
stmt:
theorem merge_output_bound_subprob {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hα1 : ∑ i, α i ≤ 1) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeads
  calc
    ‖∑ i, α i • h i‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖α i • h i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i, α i * ‖h i‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hα i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, α i * M := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hα i)
    _ = (∑ i, α i) * M := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ 1 * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα1 hM0
    _ = M := one_mul M

name: mergeHeads_sub_smul_sum
doc: 合并减权的分解：`mergeHeads α h − (Σα) • h0 = Σ α i • (h i − h0)`。
stmt:
lemma mergeHeads_sub_smul_sum {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F) :
    mergeHeads α h - (∑ i, α i) • h0 = ∑ i, α i • (h i - h0)
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeads
  rw [Finset.sum_smul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (smul_sub (α i) (h i) h0).symm

name: head_redundancy_bound_subprob
doc:
次概率版冗余界：`‖mergeHeads α h − (Σα)•h0‖ ≤ (Σα)·ε`（`α ≥ 0`、
`∀i, ‖h i − h0‖ ≤ ε`）。
stmt:
theorem head_redundancy_bound_subprob {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F)
    (ε : ℝ) (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hε : ∀ i, ‖h i - h0‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h - (∑ i, α i) • h0‖ ≤ (∑ i, α i) * ε
proof:
by
  rw [mergeHeads_sub_smul_sum]
  calc
    ‖∑ i, α i • (h i - h0)‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖α i • (h i - h0)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i, α i * ‖h i - h0‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hα i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, α i * ε := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hε i) (hα i)
    _ = (∑ i, α i) * ε := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]

name: head_redundancy_bound
doc:
**核心**：`α` 是概率分布（`Σα = 1`）且所有头与 `h0` 相差 ≤ ε ⟹
合并结果与 `h0` 的误差 ≤ ε（冗余头的合并不放大误差）。
stmt:
theorem head_redundancy_bound {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F) (ε : ℝ)
    (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hsum : ∑ i, α i = 1) (hε : ∀ i, ‖h i - h0‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h - h0‖ ≤ ε
proof:
by
  have hmain := head_redundancy_bound_subprob α h h0 ε hα hε
  rwa [hsum, one_smul, one_mul] at hmain

name: head_pairwise_redundancy_bound
doc: 两两相近（都以第 `j` 头为参考）⟹ 合并到 `h j` 的误差 ≤ ε。
stmt:
theorem head_pairwise_redundancy_bound {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (j : Fin k)
    (ε : ℝ) (hα : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i) (hsum : ∑ i, α i = 1) (hε : ∀ i, ‖h i - h j‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖mergeHeads α h - h j‖ ≤ ε
proof: head_redundancy_bound α h (h j) ε hα hsum hε

name: merge_exact_when_identical
doc: 所有头恒等（都等于 `h0`）⟹ `mergeHeads α h = (Σα) • h0`。
stmt:
theorem merge_exact_when_identical {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F)
    (hid : ∀ i, h i = h0) : mergeHeads α h = (∑ i, α i) • h0
proof:
by
  calc
    mergeHeads α h = ∑ i, α i • h0 := by
      unfold mergeHeads
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hid i]
    _ = (∑ i, α i) • h0 := Finset.sum_smul.symm

name: merge_lossless_when_identical
doc: 所有头恒等且 `Σα = 1` ⟹ 合并**无损**：`mergeHeads α h = h0`。
stmt:
theorem merge_lossless_when_identical {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (h : Fin k → F) (h0 : F)
    (hid : ∀ i, h i = h0) (hsum : ∑ i, α i = 1) : mergeHeads α h = h0
proof:
by
  rw [merge_exact_when_identical α h h0 hid, hsum, one_smul]

name: pruned_head_mass_loss
doc: 丢头的权重和损失恰为 `α j`。
stmt:
theorem pruned_head_mass_loss {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (j : Fin k) :
    ∑ i, dropHead α j i = (∑ i, α i) - α j
proof:
by
  have hpoint : ∀ i : Fin k, dropHead α j i = α i - (if i = j then α i else 0) := by
    intro i
    unfold dropHead
    by_cases h : i = j
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  calc
    ∑ i, dropHead α j i = ∑ i, (α i - (if i = j then α i else 0)) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hpoint i
    _ = (∑ i, α i) - ∑ i, (if i = j then α i else 0) := Finset.sum_sub_distrib
    _ = (∑ i, α i) - α j := by rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ j)]

name: mergeHeads_sub_drop
doc: 丢头后的合并与完整合并之差恰为 `−α_j • h_j`。
stmt:
lemma mergeHeads_sub_drop {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (j : Fin k) (h : Fin k → F) :
    mergeHeads (dropHead α j) h - mergeHeads α h = -(α j) • h j
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeads dropHead
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [hb]
  · intro hj
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj

name: pruned_head_bound
doc: **剪头误差界**：丢掉第 `j` 头造成的输出差 ≤ `α_j · M`（该头权重 × 输出上界）。
stmt:
theorem pruned_head_bound {k : ℕ} (α : Fin k → ℝ) (j : Fin k) (h : Fin k → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hαj : 0 ≤ α j) (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖mergeHeads (dropHead α j) h - mergeHeads α h‖ ≤ α j * M
proof:
by
  rw [mergeHeads_sub_drop, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hαj]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM j) hαj

name: mergeHeadsOver_eq_mergeHeads
stmt:
theorem mergeHeadsOver_eq_mergeHeads {k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin k)) (α : Fin k → ℝ)
    (h : Fin k → F) : mergeHeadsOver S α h = ∑ i in S, α i • h i
proof: rfl

name: pruned_head_output_bound
doc:
头剪枝（只保留 `S` 内的头、权重在 `S` 上和为 1）的输出界：
直接复用 `RealTopK.topk_output_bound`。
stmt:
theorem pruned_head_output_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (S : Finset ι) (α : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hα : ∀ i, i ∈ S → 0 ≤ α i) (hsum : ∑ i in S, α i = 1)
    (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) : ‖mergeHeadsOver S α h‖ ≤ M
proof: topk_output_bound S α h M hα hsum hM

name: pruned_head_output_bound_subprob
doc: 头剪枝的次概率版：`Σ_{i∈S} α i ≤ 1` 时输出仍 ≤ M（`M ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
theorem pruned_head_output_bound_subprob {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (S : Finset ι) (α : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hα : ∀ i, i ∈ S → 0 ≤ α i) (hα1 : ∑ i in S, α i ≤ 1)
    (hM0 : 0 ≤ M) (hM : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ≤ M) : ‖mergeHeadsOver S α h‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold mergeHeadsOver
  calc
    ‖∑ i in S, α i • h i‖ ≤ ∑ i in S, ‖α i • h i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i in S, α i * ‖h i‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hα i hi)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i in S, α i * M :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hα i hi)
    _ = (∑ i in S, α i) * M := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ 1 * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα1 hM0
    _ = M := one_mul M

end Lattice

name: headMass
doc: **头的质量**：`headMass μ T = ∑_{i∈T} μ i`（保留头的重要性质量之和）。
stmt: def headMass (mu : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i in T, mu i

name: prunedMass
doc: **剪枝丢弃质量**：`prunedMass μ T = ∑_{i∉T} μ i`。
stmt: def prunedMass (mu : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i

name: prunedOutput
doc: **剪枝输出**：`prunedOutput μ o T = ∑_{i∈T} μ i • o i`（只保留 `T` 中头的输出和）。
stmt: def prunedOutput (mu : ι → ℝ) (o : ι → F) (T : Finset ι) : F
proof: ∑ i in T, mu i • o i

name: headMass_le_topSum
doc:
**核心最优性（exchange argument）**：设 `S` 是质量最大的 `m` 个头
（`∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∉ S, μ j ≤ μ i`），则**任意**同基数的头集 `T`
满足 `headMass μ T ≤ headMass μ S`。

即「保留最大的 `m` 个头」在**所有**等预算方案中最优。证明直接是
`topK_sum_max`：令 `U = T \ S`、`V = S \ T`，两边基数相等；
取 `U` 中质量最大者 `i0`，逐项 `μ i ≤ μ i0 ≤ μ j`（`i ∈ U, j ∈ V`），
两段各 `|U| = |V|` 项配对即得 `∑_U μ ≤ ∑_V μ`，再由
`∑_T = ∑_{T∩S} + ∑_U`、`∑_S = ∑_{T∩S} + ∑_V` 收尾。
stmt:
theorem headMass_le_topSum (mu : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    headMass mu T ≤ headMass mu S
proof: topK_sum_max mu hcard htop

name: headMass_add_prunedMass
doc: **质量守恒**：`headMass μ T + prunedMass μ T = ∑ i, μ i`。
stmt:
theorem headMass_add_prunedMass (mu : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) :
    headMass mu T + prunedMass mu T = ∑ i, mu i
proof:
by
  have h := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := mu) (Finset.subset_univ T)
  unfold headMass prunedMass
  simp only [Finset.sdiff_eq_filter] at h ⊢
  linarith

name: prunedMass_le_of_topSum
doc:
**丢弃质量最小（等价形式）**：取最大的 `m` 个时，被剪掉的质量
`prunedMass μ S ≤ prunedMass μ T` 对任意同基数 `T` 成立。

由质量守恒（保留 + 丢弃 = 总量，见 `headMass_add_prunedMass`）与
`headMass_le_topSum` 得到。
stmt:
theorem prunedMass_le_of_topSum (mu : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    prunedMass mu S ≤ prunedMass mu T
proof:
by
  have hS := headMass_add_prunedMass mu S
  have hT := headMass_add_prunedMass mu T
  have hle := headMass_le_topSum mu hcard htop
  linarith

name: greedy_is_optimal
doc:
**贪心最优性**：若 `S` 是最大的 `m` 个且 `T` 是任意同基数集，
则 `headMass μ S` 是**可达上确界**——即不存在比 `S` 更好的等预算方案。
stmt:
theorem greedy_is_optimal (mu : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    headMass mu T ≤ headMass mu S ∧ prunedMass mu S ≤ prunedMass mu T
proof: ⟨headMass_le_topSum mu hcard htop, prunedMass_le_of_topSum mu hcard htop⟩

name: uniform_head_case
doc:
**均匀头特例**：所有头质量相同时，**任意**两个同基数头集的保留质量相等——
即最优解**不唯一**（等质量任意选）。
stmt:
theorem uniform_head_case (c : ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card) :
    headMass (fun _ => c) T = headMass (fun _ => c) S
proof:
by
  unfold headMass
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.sum_const, hcard]

name: head_pruning_bound
doc:
**头剪枝误差界（核心）**：设 `∀i, ‖o i‖ ≤ M` 且质量非负，则
`‖prunedOutput μ o T − ∑ i, μ i • o i‖ ≤ M · prunedMass μ T`。

即**误差由被剪掉的质量控制**。差的精确分解为 `−∑_{i∉T} μ i • o i`。
stmt:
theorem head_pruning_bound (mu : ι → ℝ) (o : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, ‖o i‖ ≤ M)
    (hmu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ mu i) (T : Finset ι) :
    ‖prunedOutput mu o T - ∑ i, mu i • o i‖ ≤ M * prunedMass mu T
proof:
by
  have hfull : ∑ i : ι, mu i • o i
      = ∑ i in T, mu i • o i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i • o i := by
    have h := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := fun i => mu i • o i) (Finset.subset_univ T)
    rw [Finset.sdiff_eq_filter] at h ⊢
    simp only [Finset.sum_filter] at h ⊢
    rw [← h]
    abel
  have hdec : prunedOutput mu o T - ∑ i, mu i • o i
      = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(mu i)) • o i := by
    have hneg : -(∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i • o i)
        = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(mu i)) • o i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [neg_smul]
    rw [show prunedOutput mu o T - ∑ i, mu i • o i
        = -(∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i • o i) by
      rw [hfull]; unfold prunedOutput; abel]
    exact hneg
  rw [hdec]
  calc ‖∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(mu i)) • o i‖
      ≤ ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, ‖(-(mu i)) • o i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i * ‖o i‖ := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (hmu i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, mu i * M := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hmu i)
    _ = M * prunedMass mu T := by
        unfold prunedMass
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: head_pruning_optimal_bound
doc:
**最优误差界**：取质量最大的 `m` 个头时，误差界 `M · prunedMass μ S`
**不大于**任何同基数方案的误差界。
stmt:
theorem head_pruning_optimal_bound (mu : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    M * prunedMass mu S ≤ M * prunedMass mu T
proof: mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (prunedMass_le_of_topSum mu hcard htop) hM0

name: headMass_mono_budget
doc: **预算扩大不劣**：`S ⊆ S'`、质量非负 ⟹ `headMass μ S ≤ headMass μ S'`。
stmt:
theorem headMass_mono_budget (mu : ι → ℝ) (hmu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ mu i) {S S' : Finset ι}
    (hsub : S ⊆ S') : headMass mu S ≤ headMass mu S'
proof: Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun i _ _ => hmu i

name: retain_all_exact
doc: **满载精确性**：`T = univ`（保留全部头）时输出等于全输出，误差为 **0**。
stmt:
theorem retain_all_exact (mu : ι → ℝ) (o : ι → F) :
    prunedOutput mu o Finset.univ = ∑ i, mu i • o i
proof: rfl

name: prunedMass_univ
doc: **满载剪枝质量为零**：`prunedMass μ univ = 0`。
stmt: theorem prunedMass_univ (mu : ι → ℝ) : prunedMass mu (Finset.univ : Finset ι) = 0
proof:
by
  unfold prunedMass
  simp

name: retain_all_error_zero
doc: **满载误差为零**。
stmt:
theorem retain_all_error_zero (mu : ι → ℝ) (o : ι → F) :
    ‖prunedOutput mu o Finset.univ - ∑ i, mu i • o i‖ = 0
proof:
by
  rw [retain_all_exact, sub_self, norm_zero]

name: layer_wise_independent
doc:
**跨层独立最优（可加情形）**：设两层各有质量评分 `μ₁`、`μ₂`，
数据位于直积类型 `ι₁ × ι₂`，层内质量**加性**（`μ (i,j) = μ₁ i + μ₂ j`）。
若预算是 `(m₁, m₂)`（每层各保留 `m` 个），则**逐层**取 top-`m` 是全局最优。

本文件证明**加性分离**的关键等式：对任意 `T₁ × T₂`，
`headMass (μ₁ + μ₂) (T₁ ×ˢ T₂) = |T₂| · headMass μ₁ T₁ + |T₁| · headMass μ₂ T₂`
—— 即跨层质量是「层内质量 × 另一层基数」的线性组合，
故**逐层**最大化即全局最大化（两层的最优选择互不耦合）。

标注：这是「可加性 ⟹ 逐层最优 = 全局最优」的**充分**条件；
层间耦合（残差流）情形**未做**（见诚实边界）。
stmt:
theorem layer_wise_independent {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
    [DecidableEq ι₁] [DecidableEq ι₂] (mu₁ : ι₁ → ℝ) (mu₂ : ι₂ → ℝ)
    (T₁ : Finset ι₁) (T₂ : Finset ι₂) :
    headMass (fun p : ι₁ × ι₂ => mu₁ p.1 + mu₂ p.2) (T₁ ×ˢ T₂)
      = (T₂.card : ℝ) * headMass mu₁ T₁ + (T₁.card : ℝ) * headMass mu₂ T₂
proof:
by
  unfold headMass
  rw [Finset.sum_product]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  ·                                                   
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const]
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  ·                                                   
    simp only [Finset.sum_const]
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: coupledLoss
doc:
**残差流耦合下的跨层联合损失**：`D₁ + D₂ + c·D₁·D₂`。

`c = 0` 退化为可加（§五 的 `layer_wise_independent` 适用区间）；
`c ≠ 0` 时两层的取舍**不**可分离。
stmt: def coupledLoss (c D1 D2 : ℝ) : ℝ

name: coupledLoss_zero_coupling
doc:
**可加退化（衔接 §五）**：`c = 0` 时耦合损失就是两层丢弃质量之和
——即 `layer_wise_independent` 的加性假设在这个模型里就是 `c = 0`。
stmt:
theorem coupledLoss_zero_coupling (D1 D2 : ℝ) :
    coupledLoss 0 D1 D2 = D1 + D2
proof:
by
  unfold coupledLoss; ring

name: layerwise_optimal_not_global
doc:
**逐层最优 ≠ 全局最优（核心反例，精确有理数）**：取 `c = -3`，
两层各有两个可选头、其丢弃质量分别为 `1/10` 与 `9/10`。

- **逐层最优**：两层都选「丢弃质量最小」的方案 `(D₁, D₂) = (1/10, 1/10)`，
  给 `coupledLoss = 17/100`；
- **全局最优**：两层都选「丢弃质量最大」的方案 `(9/10, 9/10)`，
  给 `coupledLoss = -63/100 < 17/100`。

故**逐层最小化丢弃质量得到的解不是全局最优解**——残差流的（强）抵消耦合
（`c = -3`）使「故意多丢一点」反而显著降低总损失。

这说明 `RealHeadPruningOptimal` 的逐层最优性（`headMass_le_topSum`）
**不能**直接升为跨层最优性，除非层间耦合可加（§五）。
反例的全部数字都是有理数，可由内核 `norm_num` 直接验证。
stmt:
theorem layerwise_optimal_not_global :
    coupledLoss (-3) (1/10) (1/10) = 17/100 ∧
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) = -63/100 ∧
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) < coupledLoss (-3) (1/10) (1/10)
proof: ⟨by norm_num [coupledLoss], by norm_num [coupledLoss], by norm_num [coupledLoss]⟩

name: layerwise_optimal_is_global_worst
doc:
**反例的完整 2×2 表**：`(9/10, 9/10)` **严格优于**其余三个组合
——即全局最优不仅是「不等于逐层最优」，而是**恰好取在逐层最劣的方向上**。

这是比 `layerwise_optimal_not_global` 更强的陈述：反例不是边界平局，
而是**严格反转**（逐层最优是全局最劣）。
stmt:
theorem layerwise_optimal_is_global_worst :
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) < coupledLoss (-3) (1/10) (1/10) ∧
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) < coupledLoss (-3) (1/10) (9/10) ∧
    coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (9/10) < coupledLoss (-3) (9/10) (1/10)
proof: ⟨by norm_num [coupledLoss], by norm_num [coupledLoss], by norm_num [coupledLoss]⟩

name: coupledLoss_strictAnti_on_negative
doc:
**非加性失效的阈值（核心，联合最优条件）**：交叉项使联合损失关于
**单层**丢弃质量**非单调**——`∂/∂D₁ (D₁ + D₂ + c D₁ D₂) = 1 + c·D₂`，
故当 `D₂ > -1/c`（`c < 0`）时**增大** `D₁` 反而**降低**总损失。

形式化：`c < 0` 且 `1 + c·D₂ < 0` 时，`D₁ ↦ coupledLoss c D₁ D₂` **严格递减**。
这就是「逐层最优 ≠ 全局最优」的**充要机制**：只要存在一层使
`1 + c·D_other < 0`，该层的「越小越好」直觉就失效。

**联合最优条件**（本模型下）：`c ≥ 0` 时，
`1 + c·D₂ ≥ 1 > 0`、`1 + c·D₁ ≥ 1 > 0`，两方向都单调递增，
故**逐层最小化丢弃质量 = 全局最优**（可加分离在 `c ≥ 0` 时仍然有效，
尽管损失函数本身非加性）。`c < 0` 时分离可能失效（见上两条反例）。
stmt:
theorem coupledLoss_strictAnti_on_negative (c D1 D1' D2 : ℝ)
    (h : 1 + c * D2 < 0) (hlt : D1 < D1') :
    coupledLoss c D1' D2 < coupledLoss c D1 D2
proof:
by
  unfold coupledLoss
  have : (D1' - D1) * (1 + c * D2) < 0 :=
    mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) h
  nlinarith

name: layerwise_optimal_of_nonneg_coupling
doc:
**`c ≥ 0` 时逐层最优仍是全局最优（联合最优的充分条件，核心）**：
残差耦合非负（放大型）时，联合损失关于每一层的丢弃质量**单调不减**
（`1 + c·D₂ ≥ 1 > 0`，需 `D₂ ≥ 0`），
故「两层都取各自最小丢弃质量」是全局最优——**可加分离在放大耦合下依然成立**。

这给出精确的分界：**耦合的符号**决定逐层最优是否全局最优
（`c ≥ 0`：是；`c < 0`：未必，见 `layerwise_optimal_not_global`）。
stmt:
theorem layerwise_optimal_of_nonneg_coupling (c D1 D1' D2 : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hD2 : 0 ≤ D2) (hlt : D1 ≤ D1') :
    coupledLoss c D1 D2 ≤ coupledLoss c D1' D2
proof:
by
  unfold coupledLoss
  have h1 : 0 ≤ 1 + c * D2 := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: retrainedMass
doc:
**重训练补偿后的有效质量**：保留头 `i` 的有效质量按补偿率 `ρ` 缩放。
`ρ = 0` 退化为未补偿（原始 `μ i`）。
stmt: def retrainedMass (rho : ℝ) (mu : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i in T, (1 - rho) * mu i

name: retrainedMass_eq_smul
doc: **补偿是线性的**：`retrainedMass ρ μ T = (1-ρ) · headMass μ T`。
stmt:
theorem retrainedMass_eq_smul (rho : ℝ) (mu : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) :
    retrainedMass rho mu T = (1 - rho) * headMass mu T
proof:
by
  unfold retrainedMass headMass
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: retrained_headMass_le_topSum
doc:
**补偿不改变最优头的选择（核心）**：`ρ < 1` 时，
「原始质量最大的 `m` 个头」**仍然**是补偿后质量最大的 `m` 个
——即**对角重训练不改变剪枝决策**，只等比缩小误差界。

这是简化模型的**关键结论**：既然补偿对每个保留头施加**同一**因子 `(1-ρ)`，
排序不变，故 §二 的最优性（`headMass_le_topSum`）**原样转移**到补偿后的设定。
（真实重训练是非对角的，会改变排序——该情形**未做**。）
stmt:
theorem retrained_headMass_le_topSum (rho : ℝ) (mu : ι → ℝ) (hrho : rho < 1)
    {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → mu j ≤ mu i) :
    retrainedMass rho mu T ≤ retrainedMass rho mu S
proof:
by
  rw [retrainedMass_eq_smul, retrainedMass_eq_smul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (headMass_le_topSum mu hcard htop) (by linarith)

name: retraining_improves_bound
doc:
**补偿缩小误差界（定量）**：补偿率越大（`ρ₁ ≤ ρ₂`），
同一保留集的**有效丢弃质量**越小，故误差界越紧。

形式化：质量非负时 `(1-ρ₂)·prunedMass ≤ (1-ρ₁)·prunedMass`
——**重训练单调地改进误差界**（不需要 `ρ₂ ≤ 1` 的额外假设）。
stmt:
theorem retraining_improves_bound (mu : ι → ℝ) (hmu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ mu i) (T : Finset ι)
    {rho1 rho2 : ℝ} (h12 : rho1 ≤ rho2) :
    (1 - rho2) * prunedMass mu T ≤ (1 - rho1) * prunedMass mu T
proof:
by
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ ?_
  · linarith
  · unfold prunedMass
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hmu i

end Lattice.Lib.Attention.RealHeadPruningOptimal

name: blockRotate
doc: 分块旋转：对第 i 个 2D 块用角度 `θ i` 做 `rotateR`。
stmt: def blockRotate {d : ℕ} (θ : Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin d → Point2R) : Fin d → Point2R
proof: fun i => rotateR (θ i) (u i)

name: blockDot
doc: 分块内积：各块 2D 内积之和 `Σ_i ⟨u_i, v_i⟩`（把 d 维向量的内积写成 2D 块内积之和）。
stmt: def blockDot {d : ℕ} (u v : Fin d → Point2R) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i, rdot (u i) (v i)

name: blockNormSq
doc: 分块平方范数 `‖u‖² = Σ_i ⟨u_i, u_i⟩`。
stmt: def blockNormSq {d : ℕ} (u : Fin d → Point2R) : ℝ
proof: blockDot u u

name: blockNorm
doc: 分块范数 `‖u‖ = sqrt(‖u‖²)`。
stmt: def blockNorm {d : ℕ} (u : Fin d → Point2R) : ℝ
proof: Real.sqrt (blockNormSq u)

name: block_rotate_preserves_dot
stmt:
theorem block_rotate_preserves_dot {d : ℕ} (θ : Fin d → ℝ) (u v : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockDot (blockRotate θ u) (blockRotate θ v) = blockDot u v
proof:
by
  unfold blockDot
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro i _
  exact rotate_preserves_dot (θ i) (u i) (v i)

name: block_rotate_compose
stmt:
theorem block_rotate_compose {d : ℕ} (a b : Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockRotate a (blockRotate b u) = blockRotate (fun i => a i + b i) u
proof:
by
  funext i
  exact rotate_compose (a i) (b i) (u i)

name: block_rope_relative_preserves_dot
stmt:
theorem block_rope_relative_preserves_dot {d : ℕ} (m p : ℝ) (θ : Fin d → ℝ)
    (q k : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockDot (blockRotate (fun i => m * θ i) q) (blockRotate (fun i => p * θ i) k) =
      blockDot q (blockRotate (fun i => (p - m) * θ i) k)
proof:
by
  unfold blockDot
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro i _
  exact rope_relative_preserves_dot m p (θ i) (q i) (k i)

name: block_rotate_preserves_normSq
stmt:
theorem block_rotate_preserves_normSq {d : ℕ} (θ : Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockNormSq (blockRotate θ u) = blockNormSq u
proof: block_rotate_preserves_dot θ u u

name: block_rotate_preserves_norm
doc: 分块旋转保（平方范数的）范数 `‖BlockRotate(θ)u‖ = ‖u‖`。
stmt:
theorem block_rotate_preserves_norm {d : ℕ} (θ : Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockNorm (blockRotate θ u) = blockNorm u
proof:
by
  unfold blockNorm
  rw [block_rotate_preserves_normSq]

name: block_rope_isometry
stmt:
theorem block_rope_isometry {d : ℕ} (m p : ℝ) (θ : Fin d → ℝ) (u : Fin d → Point2R) :
    blockNormSq (blockRotate (fun i => (p - m) * θ i) u) = blockNormSq u
proof:
block_rotate_preserves_normSq (fun i => (p - m) * θ i) u

end Lattice

name: retainedMass
doc: **保留质量**：`retainedMass w T = ∑_{i∈T} w i`（保留的注意力权重和）。
stmt: def retainedMass (w : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i in T, w i

name: droppedMass
doc: **丢弃质量**：`droppedMass w T = ∑_{i∉T} w i = 总质量 − 保留质量`。
stmt: def droppedMass (w : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i

name: budgetOutput
doc:
**预算输出**：`output T = ∑_{i∈T} w i • v i`（只用保留集的加权和）。

这是 `RealDynamicRoute.routeOutput` 在同一场景下的实例（`w` 为注意力权重）。
stmt: def budgetOutput (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (T : Finset ι) : F
proof: ∑ i in T, w i • v i

name: retainedMass_le_topSum
doc:
**核心最优性（交换论证）**：设 `S` 是权重最大的 `m` 项
（`∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∉ S, w j ≤ w i`），则**任意**与 `S` 同基数的保留集 `T`
满足 `retainedMass w T ≤ retainedMass w S`。

即「保留最大的 `m` 个」在**所有**等预算方案中最优。证明直接是
`topK_sum_max`（交换论证：取 `T \ S` 中权重最大者 `i0`，
逐项配对 `w i ≤ w i0 ≤ w j`）。
stmt:
theorem retainedMass_le_topSum (w : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → w j ≤ w i) :
    retainedMass w T ≤ retainedMass w S
proof: topK_sum_max w hcard htop

name: retainedMass_add_droppedMass
doc:
**质量守恒**：`retainedMass w T + droppedMass w T = ∑ i, w i`。

保留与丢弃恰好划分全集（与 `RealBlockSparseExact` 的
`maskCount_add_compl_eq_total` 在实数求和上的对应形式）。

**注意：R3 更正（悬空引用）**：`RealBlockSparseExact` **不在本文件的 import 闭包内**
（本文件只 `import Mathlib` / `RealKVCache` / `RealTopKExistence`），
故上述只是**跨模块的文字类比**，本文件**未** import 该模块、**未**使用其任何引理；
本定理的证明**完全自足**（只用 `Finset.sum_sdiff` / `Finset.sum_filter`）。
stmt:
theorem retainedMass_add_droppedMass (w : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) :
    retainedMass w T + droppedMass w T = ∑ i, w i
proof:
by
  have h := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := w) (Finset.subset_univ T)
  unfold retainedMass droppedMass
  simp only [Finset.sdiff_eq_filter] at h ⊢
  linarith

name: droppedMass_nonneg
doc: **丢弃质量非负**：权重非负时 `0 ≤ droppedMass w T`。
stmt:
theorem droppedMass_nonneg (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (T : Finset ι) :
    0 ≤ droppedMass w T
proof: Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hw i

name: droppedMass_eq_zero_iff
doc: **丢弃质量为 0 的刻画**：权重非负时 `droppedMass w T = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∉ T, w i = 0`。
stmt:
theorem droppedMass_eq_zero_iff (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (T : Finset ι) :
    droppedMass w T = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∉ T, w i = 0
proof:
by
  unfold droppedMass
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => hw i)]
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    exact h i (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩)
  · intro h i hi
    exact h i (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hi).2

name: budgetError_bound
doc:
**预算误差界（核心）**：设 `∀i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M` 且全集的权重和为 `Wtot`，
则用保留集 `T` 近似的误差满足
`‖budgetOutput w v T − ∑ i, w i • v i‖ ≤ M · droppedMass w T`。

即**误差由丢弃质量控制**——把注意力质量集中在少数条目上就足够精确。
证明：差等于 `∑_{i∉T} w i • v i`，逐项用 `‖w i • v i‖ = w i · ‖v i‖ ≤ w i · M`
（权重非负），再由三角不等式提出。

标注：这里的差**恰好**是丢弃部分的加权和（精确分解，非估计）。
stmt:
theorem budgetError_bound (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (T : Finset ι) :
    ‖budgetOutput w v T - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ ≤ M * droppedMass w T
proof:
by
                                           
  have hfull : ∑ i : ι, w i • v i
      = ∑ i in T, w i • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i • v i := by
    have h := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := fun i => w i • v i) (Finset.subset_univ T)
    rw [Finset.sdiff_eq_filter] at h ⊢
    simp only [Finset.sum_filter] at h ⊢
    rw [← h]
    abel
  have hdec : budgetOutput w v T - ∑ i, w i • v i
      = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(w i)) • v i := by
    have hneg : -(∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i • v i)
        = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(w i)) • v i := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [neg_smul]
    rw [show budgetOutput w v T - ∑ i, w i • v i
        = -(∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i • v i) by
      rw [hfull]; unfold budgetOutput; abel]
    exact hneg
  rw [hdec]
  calc ‖∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, (-(w i)) • v i‖
      ≤ ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, ‖(-(w i)) • v i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i * ‖v i‖ := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (hw i)]
    _ ≤ ∑ i in Finset.univ \ T, w i * M := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM i) (hw i)
    _ = M * droppedMass w T := by
        unfold droppedMass
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: droppedMass_le_of_topSum
doc:
**最优误差界**：若 `S` 是最大的 `m` 项、`T` 是任意同基数的保留集，
则 `droppedMass w S ≤ droppedMass w T`，从而**最优方案的误差界最小**。

由质量守恒（保留 + 丢弃 = 总量）与 `retainedMass_le_topSum` 得到。
stmt:
theorem droppedMass_le_of_topSum (w : ι → ℝ) {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → w j ≤ w i) :
    droppedMass w S ≤ droppedMass w T
proof:
by
  have hS := retainedMass_add_droppedMass w S
  have hT := retainedMass_add_droppedMass w T
  have hle := retainedMass_le_topSum w hcard htop
  linarith

name: optimal_error_bound
doc:
**最优误差界（组合形式）**：`S` 为最大的 `m` 项时，
任何同基数 `T` 的误差界 `M · droppedMass w T` 都**不小于** `M · droppedMass w S`。

**v15 更正（删除装饰性形参 `v`）**：原陈述带形参 `v : ι → F`，但证明体从不使用它
（Lean 未报 `unused variable` 是因为 `v` 出现于**陈述**中的…事实上它**不出现在结论里**；
经逐行核对，`v` 对本命题完全无贡献）。已**删除**——命题强度**不变**。
（下游无调用方按位置传参，见全库 grep。）
stmt:
theorem optimal_error_bound (w : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    {S T : Finset ι} (hcard : S.card = T.card)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → w j ≤ w i) :
    M * droppedMass w S ≤ M * droppedMass w T
proof: mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (droppedMass_le_of_topSum w hcard htop) hM0

name: retainedMass_mono_budget
doc:
**预算越大越好（保留质量单调）**：若 `S ⊆ S'` 且权重非负，
则 `retainedMass w S ≤ retainedMass w S'`。
stmt:
theorem retainedMass_mono_budget (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) {S S' : Finset ι}
    (hsub : S ⊆ S') : retainedMass w S ≤ retainedMass w S'
proof: Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun i _ _ => hw i

name: full_budget_exact
doc:
**满载精确性**：`T = univ` 时丢弃质量为 `0`，误差为 `0`
——回收 `RealKVCache` 的「无预算限制 ⟹ 精确」结论。

**v15 更正**：原陈述带形参 `v : ι → F`，但证明体是 `rfl`（对 `univ` 取和即原式），
与 `v` 的具体取值无关——`v` 是**签名对齐用**的装饰性形参，已改名为 `_v` 以显式标注
（结论里的 `v` 仍是被全称绑定的自由变量，命题不变）。
stmt:
theorem full_budget_exact (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) :
    budgetOutput w v Finset.univ = ∑ i, w i • v i
proof:
by
  unfold budgetOutput
  rfl

name: droppedMass_univ
doc: **满载丢弃质量为零**：`droppedMass w univ = 0`。
stmt: theorem droppedMass_univ (w : ι → ℝ) : droppedMass w (Finset.univ : Finset ι) = 0
proof:
by
  unfold droppedMass
  simp

name: full_budget_error_zero
doc:
**满载误差为零**：`T = univ` 时 `budgetError_bound` 的左端为 `0`。

**v15 更正**：原陈述带形参 `v : ι → F` 且**结论含 `v`**（`‖budgetOutput w v univ −
∑ i, w i • v i‖ = 0`）。Lean **未**把 `v` 报为 `unused`（它出现在结论中），
故 `v` **保留**——它是**全称量化**的实参（对**每个** `v` 误差都为 `0`，
这正是「满载 ⟹ 精确」的内容）。证明用 `full_budget_exact w v` 消去 `budgetOutput`
再由 `sub_self` 得 `0`。
stmt:
theorem full_budget_error_zero (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) :
    ‖budgetOutput w v Finset.univ - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = 0
proof:
by
  rw [full_budget_exact, sub_self, norm_zero]

name: budget_error_sharp_zero
doc:
**`m = 0` 的紧性见证（退化）**：空保留集 `T = ∅` 的丢弃质量等于**全部**质量，
故误差界 `M · ∑ i, w i` 可达（取所有 `v i` 同向、`‖v i‖ = M`）。

标注：这是**退化**（`m = 0`，即完全不缓存）的紧性；
一般 `m` 下误差界的**锐性（下界）未做**（见诚实边界）。

**v15 更正（删除装饰性前提）**：原陈述带形参 `v`、假设 `hM`（`∀i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M`）
与 `hw`（权重非负），但 Lean 报 **`unused variable 'hM'` 与 `'hw'`**
（`v` 亦被整个丢弃）——结论只是 `droppedMass w ∅ = ∑ i, w i`
（**定义级别的恒等式**，由 `Finset.univ \ ∅ = univ` 即得），**不需要任何假设**。
原陈述因此**虚构了前提**（与「锐性」相关的三条假设其实属 §六 的对抗向量论证，
不属于本恒等式）。已**删除**三者，命题变为**无条件**形式——更诚实且**严格更强**。
stmt:
theorem budget_error_sharp_zero (w : ι → ℝ) :
    droppedMass w (∅ : Finset ι) = ∑ i, w i
proof:
by
  unfold droppedMass
  simp

name: budget_error_zero_budget
doc: **`m = 0` 时误差界即总质量界**：`‖0 − ∑ i, w i • v i‖ ≤ M · ∑ i, w i`。
stmt:
theorem budget_error_zero_budget (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) :
    ‖budgetOutput w v (∅ : Finset ι) - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ ≤ M * ∑ i, w i
proof:
by
  have h := budgetError_bound w v M hM hw (∅ : Finset ι)
  rwa [budget_error_sharp_zero w] at h

name: adversarialVec
doc:
**对抗向量（标量模型）**：`v i := −M`。

它把每一项的加权贡献都拉到**同一方向**，使 `budgetError_bound` 的三角不等式取等。
stmt: def adversarialVec (M : ℝ) : ι → ℝ
proof: fun _ => -M

name: norm_adversarialVec
doc: **对抗向量的范数恰为 `M`**（`M ≥ 0`）——即它落在假设类 `‖v i‖ ≤ M` 的**边界**上。
stmt:
theorem norm_adversarialVec (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (i : ι) :
    ‖adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i‖ = M
proof:
by
  rw [adversarialVec, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hM]

name: smul_adversarialVec
doc: **加权贡献恒为 `−(M * w i)`**：`w i • v i = −(M * w i)`（标量模型）。
stmt:
theorem smul_adversarialVec (w : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (i : ι) :
    w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i = -(M * w i)
proof:
by
  rw [adversarialVec, smul_neg, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: sharpness_witness_uniform
doc:
**锐性见证（上界侧，核心）**：`w ≥ 0`、`M ≥ 0` 时，对抗向量 `v := −M` 使

    `‖budgetOutput w v S − ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = M · droppedMass w S`

——即 `budgetError_bound` 的**左端取到右端**（不等号变等号）。

**意义**：这条定理把 `budgetError_bound` 的**单向**上界升级为**双向**：
界在该实例上**恰被达到**，故 `M · droppedMass` 是**最优常数形式**，不可能改进
（若换成 `M' < M`，本实例即为反例，见 §七 `not_optConstant_lt`）。
stmt:
theorem sharpness_witness_uniform (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (S : Finset ι) :
    ‖budgetOutput w (adversarialVec (ι := ι) M) S
        - ∑ i, w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i‖ = M * droppedMass w S
proof:
by
  have hpart : budgetOutput w (adversarialVec (ι := ι) M) S = -(M * ∑ i in S, w i) := by
    unfold budgetOutput
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => smul_adversarialVec w M i), Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
      Finset.mul_sum]
  have hfull : ∑ i, w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i = -(M * ∑ i, w i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => smul_adversarialVec w M i), Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
      Finset.mul_sum]
  have htot : (∑ i, w i) = (∑ i in S, w i) + droppedMass w S := by
    have h := retainedMass_add_droppedMass w S
    unfold retainedMass at h
    linarith
  have hdropped : 0 ≤ droppedMass w S := droppedMass_nonneg w hw S
  have hdiff : budgetOutput w (adversarialVec (ι := ι) M) S
      - ∑ i, w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i = M * droppedMass w S := by
    rw [hpart, hfull]
    rw [show -(M * (∑ i in S, w i)) - -(M * ∑ i, w i)
        = M * ((∑ i, w i) - ∑ i in S, w i) from by ring]
    rw [htot]
    ring
  rw [hdiff, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM hdropped)]

name: OptConstant
doc:
**最优常数谓词**：`OptConstant w M S c` 表示「对**任意** `∀i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M` 的 `v`，
`M`-类内的误差界 `c · droppedMass w S` 都成立」。

**标注（本轮实测的实例推断坑）**：使用 `OptConstant` 时**必须**显式传 `(F := F)`
（或让上下文中出现一个类型为 `F` 的项），否则 `F` 是**不可推断的隐式参数**，
Lean 报极具误导的 `typeclass instance problem is stuck: NormedSpace ℝ ?m`。
stmt: def OptConstant (w : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (c : ℝ) : Prop
proof:
∀ v : ι → F, (∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) →
    ‖budgetOutput w v S - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ ≤ c * droppedMass w S

name: optConstant_self
doc:
**界本身是最优常数的候选**：`OptConstant w M S M`——直接就是
`budgetError_bound`（在 `w ≥ 0` 下）。

**v15 更正（删除装饰性前提）**：本定理原带形参 `v₀ : ι → F` 与假设
`hMv : ∀ i, ‖v₀ i‖ ≤ M`，但**证明体从不使用二者**（Lean 报
`unused variable 'hMv'`；`v₀` 亦被整个丢弃）——而 `OptConstant` 对**任意**
满足 `∀i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M` 的 `v` 都断言界成立，故这两个前提是**纯装饰**：
对任意 `v₀`（含不满足 `hMv` 者）命题强度完全相同。已**删除**，命题变为
**更诚实且严格更强**的形式（无需为调用方提供见证向量）。
`v` 是 `OptConstant` **内部**全称量化的变量，由 `fun v hv => …` 立即绑定。

**v15 更正之二（`hM : 0 ≤ M`）**：Lean 亦报 `unused variable 'hM'`——
`budgetError_bound` 的界对**任意实 `M`** 成立（其证明用 `mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left`
时以 `hw` 逐项放缩，`M` 的符号不进入），故 `hM` 同为装饰性前提，已**删除**。
stmt:
theorem optConstant_self (w : ι → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (S : Finset ι) :
    OptConstant (F := F) w M S M
proof: fun v hv => budgetError_bound w v M hv hw S

name: optConstant_eq_of_witness
doc:
**由取等见证导出「最优常数恰为 `M`」（充要）**：若存在一条满足
`∀i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M` 的实例使不等号**取等**，且**丢弃质量非零**
（`droppedMass w S ≠ 0`），则

    `OptConstant w M S c ↔ M ≤ c`。

左边 ⟹ 右边：取等实例上 `M · droppedMass w S = ‖error‖ ≤ c · droppedMass w S`，
故 `M ≤ c`（`droppedMass > 0` 时约去）。
右边 ⟹ 左边：`c · droppedMass ≥ M · droppedMass`，故 `budgetError_bound` 提升为 `c` 版。

**`droppedMass ≠ 0` 前提是本质的（诚实标注）**：`droppedMass = 0`（满载缓存）时
误差恒为 `0`，界 `c · 0 = 0` 对**任意** `c`（含负数）都成立，
此时「最优常数」**退化**——`c ≥ M` **不**从界面推出。故本定理显式要求非退化。

**这是本文件最重要的双向结果**：它把「误差界」从单向上界升级为
「**`M` 是最优常数，改进不可能**」。

**v15 更正（删除多余假设 `hM`）**：原陈述带 `hM : 0 ≤ M`，但 Lean 报
`unused variable 'hM'`——证明的两个方向都只用 `droppedMass_nonneg` 给出的
`0 ≤ droppedMass w S`（约去正因子与 `linarith` 均不需要 `M` 的非负性），
`hM` 是**纯装饰前提**，已**删除**（命题强度不变，但少一个虚构前提）。
stmt:
theorem optConstant_eq_of_witness (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ)
    {S : Finset ι} (hS : droppedMass w S ≠ 0)
    (v : ι → F) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M)
    (heq : ‖budgetOutput w v S - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = M * droppedMass w S) (c : ℝ) :
    OptConstant (F := F) w M S c ↔ M ≤ c
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hopt
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ droppedMass w S := droppedMass_nonneg w hw S
    have hdpos : 0 < droppedMass w S := lt_of_le_of_ne hd0 (Ne.symm hS)
    have h := hopt v hv
    rw [heq] at h
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h hdpos
  · intro hc v' hv'
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ droppedMass w S := droppedMass_nonneg w hw S
    have h1 := budgetError_bound w v' M hv' hw S
    have h2 : M * droppedMass w S ≤ c * droppedMass w S :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hd0
    linarith

name: optConstant_lower_bound
doc:
**下界方向**：若存在取等见证（且丢弃质量非零），则任何有效的最优常数 `c` 必须 `≥ M`
——即 `M · droppedMass w S` 是**信息类内不可改进**的误差保证。

**v15 更正**：删除**从未被证明使用**的 `hM : 0 ≤ M`（Lean 报 `unused variable 'hM'`）。
stmt:
theorem optConstant_lower_bound (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ)
    {S : Finset ι} (hS : droppedMass w S ≠ 0) (v : ι → F) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M)
    (heq : ‖budgetOutput w v S - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = M * droppedMass w S)
    {c : ℝ} (hopt : OptConstant (F := F) w M S c) : M ≤ c
proof: (optConstant_eq_of_witness w hw M hS v hv heq c).mp hopt

name: not_optConstant_lt
doc:
**改进不可能（反例形式，最直白的下界陈述）**：若存在取等见证且
`droppedMass w S ≠ 0`，则**任何** `c < M` 都不是有效的 M-类误差常数
——即把 `M` 换成更小的常数必然出现反例。

前提 `droppedMass ≠ 0` 是本质的：丢弃质量为 0（满载缓存）时误差恒为 0，
任何常数（含负数）都是有效上界，这时「最优常数」退化（**标注**）。

**v15 更正**：删除**从未被证明使用**的 `hM : 0 ≤ M`（Lean 报 `unused variable 'hM'`）。
stmt:
theorem not_optConstant_lt (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ)
    {S : Finset ι} (hS : droppedMass w S ≠ 0) (v : ι → F) (hv : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M)
    (heq : ‖budgetOutput w v S - ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = M * droppedMass w S)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : c < M) : ¬ OptConstant (F := F) w M S c
proof:
by
  intro hopt
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ droppedMass w S := droppedMass_nonneg w hw S
  have hdpos : 0 < droppedMass w S := lt_of_le_of_ne hd0 (Ne.symm hS)
  have hle := hopt v hv
  rw [heq] at hle
  have hmul : c * droppedMass w S < M * droppedMass w S :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc hdpos
  linarith

name: sharpness_witness_const_weights
doc:
**`m = 1` 的锐性见证（通用基数，非退化）**：取**任意** `ι`、**任意**保留集 `S`、
权重恒为 `1`、`M = 1`。则

    `‖budgetOutput w v S − ∑ i, w i • v i‖ = 1 · droppedMass w S`。

其中 `v := adversarialVec 1`（恒为 `−1`）满足 `‖v i‖ = 1`（落在假设类边界）。

**这是「只保留部分项」情形的完整非退化锐性见证**：
`droppedMass w S = |ι| − |S|`（只要 `S ≠ univ` 即 `> 0`），界两端**均为正**。
特别地 `|ι| = 2`、`S = {单点}` 即 `m = 1`、`n = 2` 的最小实例（`droppedMass = 1`）。
stmt:
theorem sharpness_witness_const_weights (S : Finset ι) :
    ‖budgetOutput (fun _ : ι => (1 : ℝ)) (adversarialVec (ι := ι) 1) S
        - ∑ i : ι, (1 : ℝ) • adversarialVec (ι := ι) 1 i‖
      = 1 * droppedMass (fun _ : ι => (1 : ℝ)) S
proof:
sharpness_witness_uniform (fun _ : ι => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ => zero_le_one) 1
    zero_le_one S

name: sharpness_witness_two_nonzero
doc:
**`m = 1`、`n = 2` 的最小非退化实例**：`ι = Fin 2`、权重恒为 `1`、`M = 1`、
保留集 `S = {0}`，则 `droppedMass = 1` 且误差恰为 `1`。

**标注**：这里的对抗向量由 §六 的构造 `adversarialVec` 给出（不是手写的
`if` 表达式），因此**自动**落在 `budgetError_bound` 的假设类内；显式的
`droppedMass = 1` 与 `‖v 0‖ = 1` 另行机器验证。
stmt:
theorem sharpness_witness_two_nonzero :
    droppedMass (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ)) {(0 : Fin 2)} = 1
      ∧ ‖adversarialVec (ι := Fin 2) 1 (0 : Fin 2)‖ = 1
      ∧ ‖budgetOutput (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ)) (adversarialVec (ι := Fin 2) 1) {(0 : Fin 2)}
          - ∑ i : Fin 2, (1 : ℝ) • adversarialVec (ι := Fin 2) 1 i‖ = 1 * 1
proof:
by
  have hd : droppedMass (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ)) {(0 : Fin 2)} = 1 := by
    unfold droppedMass
    rw [show (Finset.univ \ ({(0 : Fin 2)} : Finset (Fin 2))) = {(1 : Fin 2)} from by decide]
    simp
  have hn : ‖adversarialVec (ι := Fin 2) 1 (0 : Fin 2)‖ = 1 :=
    norm_adversarialVec 1 zero_le_one (0 : Fin 2)
  have hw := sharpness_witness_const_weights (ι := Fin 2) {(0 : Fin 2)}
  rw [hd] at hw
  exact ⟨hd, hn, hw⟩

name: sharpness_witness_empty
doc:
**`m = 0` 的锐性见证（升级版）**：`S = ∅` 时对任意 `N`，误差
`= M · ∑ i, w i`——即 §五 的退化见证其实是 §六 一般构造的特例
（`droppedMass w ∅ = ∑ i, w i`）。
stmt:
theorem sharpness_witness_empty (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    ‖budgetOutput w (adversarialVec (ι := ι) M) (∅ : Finset ι)
        - ∑ i, w i • adversarialVec (ι := ι) M i‖ = M * ∑ i, w i
proof:
by
  rw [sharpness_witness_uniform w hw M hM (∅ : Finset ι)]
  congr 1
  unfold droppedMass
  simp

             
                                              
                                              
                                
                                              
                                         
                                                            
                                           
                                      
                                          
                                                 

end Lattice

name: cacheLength
doc: 处理到位置 `i`（含）时，已缓存的 token 数 = `i.val + 1`。
stmt: def cacheLength {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : ℕ
proof: i.val + 1

name: cache_size_eq_processed
doc: 缓存长度的定义式展开（已处理 token 数）。
stmt: theorem cache_size_eq_processed {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : cacheLength i = i.val + 1
proof: rfl

name: prefixScores
doc:
前缀截断分数：把位置 `i` 之后的未来分数置零——模拟缓存中尚未写入的
未来槽位（未来取值任意，不影响计算结果，见 `cache_independent_of_future`）。
stmt: def prefixScores {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : Fin n → ℝ
proof: fun j => if j ≤ i then s j else 0

name: prefixScores_of_le
doc: 前缀截断保持前缀上的取值：`j ≤ i ⟹ prefixScores s i j = s j`。
stmt:
@[simp] lemma prefixScores_of_le {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (h : j ≤ i) :
    prefixScores s i j = s j
proof:
by
  unfold prefixScores
  rw [if_pos h]

name: prefixScores_of_not_le
doc: 前缀截断丢弃后缀：`¬ j ≤ i ⟹ prefixScores s i j = 0`。
stmt:
@[simp] lemma prefixScores_of_not_le {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (h : ¬ j ≤ i) :
    prefixScores s i j = 0
proof:
by
  unfold prefixScores
  rw [if_neg h]

name: causalRowOutput
doc: 全量因果注意力的第 `i` 行输出：`Σ_j w_j • V_j`，`w = causalSoftmax s i`。
stmt: def causalRowOutput {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) : F
proof: convComb (causalSoftmax s i) V

name: cacheRowOutput
doc:
增量（KV 缓存）行输出：只用前缀截断分数（缓存前 `i` 个 key/value）重算
第 `i` 行，与全量计算的差由 `cache_row_output_eq_full` 断言为零。
stmt: def cacheRowOutput {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) : F
proof: convComb (causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i) V

name: causalFullOutput
doc: 全量因果注意力的整条序列输出（逐行）。
stmt: def causalFullOutput {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) : Fin n → F
proof: fun i => causalRowOutput s V i

name: causalCacheOutput
doc: 增量（KV 缓存）推理的整条序列输出（逐行用缓存前缀计算）。
stmt: def causalCacheOutput {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) : Fin n → F
proof: fun i => cacheRowOutput s V i

name: cache_independent_of_future
stmt:
theorem cache_independent_of_future {n : ℕ} (s s' : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    (h : ∀ j, j ≤ i → s j = s' j) :
    causalSoftmax s i = causalSoftmax s' i
proof:
by
  funext j
  unfold causalSoftmax causalDenom
  have hden : (∑ k, (if k ≤ i then Real.exp (s k) else 0))
      = ∑ k, (if k ≤ i then Real.exp (s' k) else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    by_cases hki : k ≤ i
    · rw [if_pos hki, if_pos hki, h k hki]
    · rw [if_neg hki, if_neg hki]
  rw [hden]
  by_cases hji : j ≤ i
  · rw [if_pos hji, if_pos hji, h j hji]
  · rw [if_neg hji, if_neg hji]

name: cache_append_eq_full
stmt:
theorem cache_append_eq_full {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i = causalSoftmax s i
proof:
by
  symm
  apply cache_independent_of_future
  intro j hj
  rw [prefixScores_of_le s i j hj]

name: cache_row_output_eq_full
stmt:
theorem cache_row_output_eq_full {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) :
    cacheRowOutput s V i = causalRowOutput s V i
proof:
by
  unfold cacheRowOutput causalRowOutput
  rw [cache_append_eq_full]

name: cache_output_eq_full
stmt:
theorem cache_output_eq_full {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) :
    causalCacheOutput s V = causalFullOutput s V
proof:
by
  funext i
  exact cache_row_output_eq_full s V i

name: cache_append_preserves_earlier_rows
stmt:
theorem cache_append_preserves_earlier_rows {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (k i : Fin n)
    (hk : k ≤ i) :
    causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) k = causalSoftmax (prefixScores s k) k
proof:
by
  apply cache_independent_of_future
  intro j hj
  rw [prefixScores_of_le s i j (le_trans hj hk), prefixScores_of_le s k j hj]

name: cache_append_preserves_earlier_outputs
doc: 定理五'（输出级）：追加 token 不改变已缓存位置 `k` 的输出行。
stmt:
theorem cache_append_preserves_earlier_outputs {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F)
    (k i : Fin n) (hk : k ≤ i) :
    convComb (causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) k) V
      = convComb (causalSoftmax (prefixScores s k) k) V
proof:
by
  rw [cache_append_preserves_earlier_rows s k i hk]

name: cache_weights_supported_on_prefix
stmt:
theorem cache_weights_supported_on_prefix {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n)
    (h : ¬ j ≤ i) : causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j = 0
proof: causalSoftmax_eq_zero_of_gt (prefixScores s i) i j h

name: cache_row_output_supported_on_prefix
doc:
定理六'：缓存行输出只需前缀 `j ≤ i` 上的 value
（`Σ_{j ∈ univ} = Σ_{j ∈ Iic i}`，因后缀权重为 0）。
stmt:
theorem cache_row_output_supported_on_prefix {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F)
    (i : Fin n) :
    cacheRowOutput s V i
      = ∑ j in Finset.Iic i, causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j • V j
proof:
by
  unfold cacheRowOutput convComb
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
  intro x _ hxnot
  have hxi : ¬ x ≤ i := fun h => hxnot (Finset.mem_Iic.mpr h)
  rw [cache_weights_supported_on_prefix s i x hxi, zero_smul]

name: cache_memory_bound
stmt:
theorem cache_memory_bound {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin n => causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j ≠ 0)).card
      ≤ cacheLength i
proof:
by
  have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin n => causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j ≠ 0)
      ⊆ Finset.Iic i := by
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    rw [Finset.mem_Iic]
    by_contra hji
    exact hj.2 (cache_weights_supported_on_prefix s i j hji)
  calc
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin n => causalSoftmax (prefixScores s i) i j ≠ 0)).card
        ≤ (Finset.Iic i).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = i.val + 1 := Fin.card_Iic i
    _ = cacheLength i := rfl

name: cache_output_bound
stmt:
theorem cache_output_bound {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (V : Fin n → F) (i : Fin n) (M : ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ j, ‖V j‖ ≤ M) : ‖cacheRowOutput s V i‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold cacheRowOutput
  exact causal_attention_output_bound (prefixScores s i) i V M hV

end Lattice

name: featScore
doc:
特征映射 `φ` 下的核分数：`φ(q)·φ(k) = Σ_i φ(q_i)·φ(k_i)`。
这是线性注意力的「打分」，把 query/key 的交互写成逐维特征内积（可分核）。
stmt: def featScore {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q k : Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i : Fin d, φ (q i) * φ (k i)

name: linAttnDenom
doc: 线性注意力的分母：`Σ_j featScore φ q (K j)`（与标准 softmax 的分母同构）。
stmt: def linAttnDenom {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ j : ι, featScore φ q (K j)

name: linAttnWeights
doc:
线性注意力权重：`w_j = featScore φ q (K j) / Σ_l featScore φ q (K l)`。
归一化后是 query 行的概率分布（见 `linear_attn_weights_pmf`）。
stmt: def linAttnWeights {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) : ι → ℝ
proof: fun j => featScore φ q (K j) / linAttnDenom φ q K

name: linearAttentionOutput
doc: 线性注意力输出（归一化版）：`Σ_j w_j • V_j`。
stmt:
def linearAttentionOutput {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ)
    (V : ι → F) : F
proof: ∑ j : ι, linAttnWeights φ q K j • V j

name: linearAttentionNum
doc:
线性注意力分子（**未归一化**）：`Σ_j featScore φ q (K j) • V_j`。
结合律重排（`linear_attn_associativity`）作用在这个量上。
stmt:
def linearAttentionNum {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ)
    (V : ι → F) : F
proof: ∑ j : ι, featScore φ q (K j) • V j

name: linAttnState
doc:
线性注意力的**状态**：`Σ_j φ(k_j)_i • V_j`（第 `i` 个特征维的聚合）。
与 query 无关，可对所有 query 复用——`O(n·d)` 预计算的载体。
stmt: def linAttnState {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (V : ι → F) (i : Fin d) : F
proof: ∑ j : ι, φ (K j i) • V j

name: featScore_nonneg
doc: `featScore` 非负（`φ ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
lemma featScore_nonneg {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x) (q k : Fin d → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ featScore φ q k
proof:
by
  unfold featScore
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hφ _) (hφ _)

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: linAttnDenom_nonneg
doc: 分母非负（`φ ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
lemma linAttnDenom_nonneg {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) : 0 ≤ linAttnDenom φ q K
proof:
by
  unfold linAttnDenom
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => featScore_nonneg φ hφ q (K j)

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: linAttnDenom_pos
doc: 分母为正：只要存在某个位置核分数为正（`φ ≥ 0` 下即该位置有非零特征）。
stmt:
lemma linAttnDenom_pos {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (hne : ∃ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j)) :
    0 < linAttnDenom φ q K
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hne
  unfold linAttnDenom
  exact Finset.sum_pos'
    (fun l _ => featScore_nonneg φ hφ q (K l))
    ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hj⟩

                       

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: linear_attn_weights_nonneg
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_weights_nonneg {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (j : ι) : 0 ≤ linAttnWeights φ q K j
proof:
by
  unfold linAttnWeights
  exact div_nonneg (featScore_nonneg φ hφ q (K j)) (linAttnDenom_nonneg φ hφ q K)

                                   

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: linear_attn_weights_sum_one
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_weights_sum_one {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (hne : ∃ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j)) :
    ∑ j, linAttnWeights φ q K j = 1
proof:
by
  have hD : linAttnDenom φ q K ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (linAttnDenom_pos φ hφ q K hne)
  unfold linAttnWeights
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self hD

name: linear_attn_weights_pmf
doc: 归一化后线性注意力权重构成概率分布（非负 + 和为 1）。
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_weights_pmf {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (hne : ∃ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j)) :
    (∀ j, 0 ≤ linAttnWeights φ q K j) ∧ (∑ j, linAttnWeights φ q K j = 1)
proof:
⟨fun j => linear_attn_weights_nonneg φ hφ q K j,
   linear_attn_weights_sum_one φ hφ q K hne⟩

name: linear_attn_output_bound
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_output_bound {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (hne : ∃ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j))
    (V : ι → F) (M : ℝ) (hV : ∀ j, ‖V j‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖linearAttentionOutput φ q K V‖ ≤ M
proof:
convComb_norm_bound (linAttnWeights φ q K) V M
    (linear_attn_weights_nonneg φ hφ q K)
    (linear_attn_weights_sum_one φ hφ q K hne) hV

                                          
                                                         

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: linear_attn_is_softmax
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_is_softmax {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ j, 0 < featScore φ q (K j)) :
    linAttnWeights φ q K = softmax (fun j => Real.log (featScore φ q (K j)))
proof:
by
  funext j
  unfold linAttnWeights linAttnDenom softmax
  rw [Real.exp_log (hpos j)]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => (Real.exp_log (hpos l)).symm

                                                  
                                                                                   

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: softmax_vs_linear
stmt:
theorem softmax_vs_linear (q : Fin 1 → ℝ) (K : ι → Fin 1 → ℝ) :
    linAttnWeights Real.exp q K = softmax (fun j => q 0 + K j 0)
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ (k : Fin 1 → ℝ),
      (∑ i : Fin 1, Real.exp (q i) * Real.exp (k i)) = Real.exp (q 0 + k 0) := by
    intro k
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one, ← Real.exp_add]
  funext j
  unfold linAttnWeights linAttnDenom featScore softmax
  rw [hterm (K j)]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => hterm (K l)

                                            
                                                                         
                                                          
                                                

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: linear_attn_associativity
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_associativity {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ)
    (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (V : ι → F) :
    linearAttentionNum φ q K V = ∑ i : Fin d, φ (q i) • linAttnState φ K V i
proof:
by
  unfold linearAttentionNum linAttnState featScore
  simp only [Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => mul_smul _ _ _

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: linear_attn_state_form
doc: 状态复用形式（定理六的改写）：输出分子 = `Σ_i φ(q_i) • state_i`。
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_state_form {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ)
    (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (V : ι → F) :
    linearAttentionNum φ q K V = ∑ i : Fin d, φ (q i) • linAttnState φ K V i
proof:
linear_attn_associativity φ q K V

                                    

omit [Nonempty ι] in

name: linearAttentionOutput_eq_inv_smul_num
stmt:
theorem linearAttentionOutput_eq_inv_smul_num {d : ℕ} (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (q : Fin d → ℝ)
    (K : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (V : ι → F) :
    linearAttentionOutput φ q K V = (linAttnDenom φ q K)⁻¹ • linearAttentionNum φ q K V
proof:
by
  unfold linearAttentionOutput linearAttentionNum linAttnWeights
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul]

name: denseAttentionOps
doc: 显式注意力分数矩阵的规模（`n²` 次标量乘法）。
stmt: def denseAttentionOps (n : ℕ) : ℕ
proof: n * n

name: linearAttentionOps
doc: 线性注意力核化形式的规模（`n·d` 次标量乘法）。
stmt: def linearAttentionOps (n d : ℕ) : ℕ
proof: n * d

name: linear_attn_complexity
doc: `d ≤ n` 时核化形式的计数量不超过显式形式。
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_complexity {n d : ℕ} (h : d ≤ n) :
    linearAttentionOps n d ≤ denseAttentionOps n
proof:
by
  unfold linearAttentionOps denseAttentionOps
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left n h

name: linear_attn_complexity_strict
doc: 严格版本：`d < n` 且 `n > 0` 时严格更少（真正的 `O(n)` vs `O(n²)` 节省）。
stmt:
theorem linear_attn_complexity_strict {n d : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (h : d < n) :
    linearAttentionOps n d < denseAttentionOps n
proof:
by
  unfold linearAttentionOps denseAttentionOps
  exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hn

end Lattice

name: mlaLatent
doc: 下投影（down-projection）：`x ↦ W_DKV x`，把 token 嵌入压到 latent 空间 `L`。
stmt: def mlaLatent (WDKV : E →L[ℝ] L) (x : E) : L
proof: WDKV x

name: mlaKey
doc: 键侧上投影（up-projection）：latent `c ↦ W_UK c`。
stmt: def mlaKey (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (c : L) : E
proof: WUK c

name: mlaValue
doc: 值侧上投影：latent `c ↦ W_UV c`。
stmt: def mlaValue (WUV : L →L[ℝ] F) (c : L) : F
proof: WUV c

name: mlaScoreNaive
doc:
MLA 分数（naive 形式）：查询 `q` 与 latent `c` 的「上投影后再内积」。
`mlaScoreNaive W_UK q c = ⟨q, W_UK c⟩`。
stmt: def mlaScoreNaive (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (q : E) (c : L) : ℝ
proof: inner (𝕜 := ℝ) q (WUK c)

name: mlaScoreAbsorbed
doc:
MLA 分数（**吸收**形式）：把 `W_UK` 吸收进查询侧，得算子 `W_UK† ∘ W_Q`。
`mlaScoreAbsorbed W_UK q c = ⟨W_UK† q, c⟩`。
stmt: def mlaScoreAbsorbed (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (q : E) (c : L) : ℝ
proof: inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK q) c

name: mla_absorb_key
doc:
**吸收律**：naive 分数 = 吸收分数。
`⟨q, W_UK c⟩ = ⟨W_UK† q, c⟩`——伴随的内积刻画（`adjoint_inner_left`）。
这是 MLA 推理优化的**全部代数内容**：不必物化 `k = W_UK c`。
stmt:
theorem mla_absorb_key (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (q : E) (c : L) :
    mlaScoreNaive WUK q c = mlaScoreAbsorbed WUK q c
proof:
by
  unfold mlaScoreNaive mlaScoreAbsorbed
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left WUK c q).symm

name: mla_absorb_query
doc:
**点态吸收律**：把查询投影 `W_Q` 一并代入，
`⟨W_Q x, W_UK c⟩ = ⟨(W_UK† ∘ W_Q) x, c⟩`。
左边是 MHA 式的「先上投影、再内积」；右边是 MLA 式的**预合成算子**。
stmt:
theorem mla_absorb_query (WQ : E →L[ℝ] E) (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) (c : L) :
    inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (WQ x) (WUK c) =
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK).comp WQ x) c
proof:
by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left WUK c (WQ x)).symm

name: mla_absorb_all_tokens
doc:
**全 token 吸收律**：对 token 集 `ι` 上逐点成立的吸收，整体成立。
说明吸收是**逐 token 可交换**的，与序列长度无关——这正是推理时能全程不物化 `k` 的理由。
stmt:
theorem mla_absorb_all_tokens {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (q : E) (c : ι → L) :
    (∑ t, mlaScoreNaive WUK q (c t)) = ∑ t, mlaScoreAbsorbed WUK q (c t)
proof:
by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  exact mla_absorb_key WUK q (c t)

name: mlaCachePerToken
doc: 每 token 的 **MLA 缓存元素数** = latent 维 `d_c`。
stmt: def mlaCachePerToken (d_c : ℕ) : ℕ
proof: d_c

name: fullCachePerToken
doc: 每 token 的 **全秩 MHA 缓存元素数** = `2 * H * d_h`（键 + 值，H 头，每头 d_h 维）。
stmt: def fullCachePerToken (H d_h : ℕ) : ℕ
proof: 2 * H * d_h

name: mla_cache_le_full_cache
doc: **缓存不增**：`d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h` 时 MLA 的每 token 缓存不超过全秩 MHA。
stmt:
theorem mla_cache_le_full_cache (d_c H d_h : ℕ)
    (h : d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h) :
    mlaCachePerToken d_c ≤ fullCachePerToken H d_h
proof:
by
  unfold mlaCachePerToken fullCachePerToken
  exact h

name: mla_cache_strict
doc: **严格压缩**：`d_c < 2 * H * d_h` 时 MLA 缓存**严格更小**（真压缩，非等于）。
stmt:
theorem mla_cache_strict (d_c H d_h : ℕ)
    (h : d_c < 2 * H * d_h) :
    mlaCachePerToken d_c < fullCachePerToken H d_h
proof:
by
  unfold mlaCachePerToken fullCachePerToken
  exact h

name: mla_cache_le_full_cache_seq
doc:
**序列级缓存界**：长度 `n` 的序列上，MLA 缓存总量 `n * d_c` 不超过全秩总量
`n * (2 * H * d_h)`（`d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h`）。
stmt:
theorem mla_cache_le_full_cache_seq (n d_c H d_h : ℕ)
    (h : d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h) :
    n * mlaCachePerToken d_c ≤ n * fullCachePerToken H d_h
proof:
by
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (mla_cache_le_full_cache d_c H d_h h)

name: mla_compression_ratio_ge_one
doc:
**压缩率下界**：若全秩缓存 `≥ 1` 且 MLA 缓存 `≤ d_c`，则
压缩比 `(2*H*d_h) / d_c ≥ 1`。这条把「省内存」变成一个可计算的比较。
stmt:
theorem mla_compression_ratio_ge_one (d_c H d_h : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d_c)
    (h : d_c ≤ 2 * H * d_h) :
    1 ≤ fullCachePerToken H d_h / d_c
proof:
by
  unfold fullCachePerToken
  exact Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hd |>.mpr (by rw [one_mul]; exact h)

name: absorb_requires_image
doc:
**吸收可实施性**：若键确实由 latent 上投影得到（`k = W_UK c`），
则 `⟨q, k⟩ = ⟨W_UK† q, c⟩`。这是吸收律在「键有来源」前提下的重述。
stmt:
theorem absorb_requires_image (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (q : E) (c : L) :
    inner (𝕜 := ℝ) q (WUK c) =
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK q) c
proof: mla_absorb_key WUK q c

name: mla_absorb_exists_operator
doc:
**吸收律的 operator 形式**：存在算子 `A : E →L[ℝ] L`（显式 `W_UK†`）使
`∀ q c, ⟨q, W_UK c⟩ = ⟨A q, c⟩`。把「重结合」陈述为**存在性**，
从而与负对照（不存在这样的 `A`）形成同一命题的正反两面。
stmt:
theorem mla_absorb_exists_operator (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∃ A : E →L[ℝ] L, ∀ (q : E) (c : L),
      inner (𝕜 := ℝ) q (WUK c) = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (A q) c
proof: ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK, fun q c => mla_absorb_key WUK q c⟩

name: nc_absorbed_not_identically_zero
doc:
NC-1（**吸收分数依赖上投影，非恒零**）：取 `W_UK = id`、`q = c = 1`，
吸收分数为 `1 ≠ 0`。若 `mlaScoreAbsorbed` 恒为 0，本定理不可证，
则 `mla_absorb_key` 退化为 `0 = 0` 的空话。
stmt:
theorem nc_absorbed_not_identically_zero :
    mlaScoreAbsorbed (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) (1 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0
proof:
by
  unfold mlaScoreAbsorbed
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_id]
  simp [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]

name: nc_absorption_impossible_for_free_key
doc:
NC-2（**吸收不是对任意键成立**）：在 ℝ 上，不存在算子 `A` 能把
**独立于 `c`** 的键写成 `⟨A q, c⟩`（对一切 `c` 成立）。
取 `q = 1`、键 `k = 1`：`c = 0` 迫使 `1 = 0`，矛盾。
这是「键必须落在上投影的像里」的具体见证。
stmt:
theorem nc_absorption_impossible_for_free_key :
    ¬ ∃ A : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ c : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (A (1 : ℝ)) c
proof:
by
  rintro ⟨A, hA⟩
  have h0 : (1 : ℝ) = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (A (1 : ℝ)) 0 := hA 0
  simp only [inner_zero_right] at h0
  norm_num at h0

name: nc_cache_strict_needs_hypothesis
doc:
NC-3（**严格压缩的前提可失败**）：不带维度假设时，严格不等式**不成立**。
取 `d_c = 4, H = 1, d_h = 1`：`4 < 2` 为假。这把 `mla_cache_strict` 的
假设从「装饰」降为**真实前提**（若删去假设仍可证，该定理是空的）。
stmt:
theorem nc_cache_strict_needs_hypothesis :
    ¬ (mlaCachePerToken 4 < fullCachePerToken 1 1)
proof:
by
  unfold mlaCachePerToken fullCachePerToken
  norm_num

end Lattice

name: mlaAbsorbedMap
doc:
MLA 推理时预合成的**吸收算子**：`x ↦ W_UK† (W_Q x)`。
物化它之后，每个 token 只需一次与 latent 的内积，无需物化 `k = W_UK c`。
stmt: def mlaAbsorbedMap (WQ : E →L[ℝ] E) (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) : E →L[ℝ] L
proof: (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK).comp WQ

name: mla_absorbed_opNorm_le
doc:
**吸收的算子范数代价**：`‖W_UK† ∘ W_Q‖ ≤ ‖W_UK‖ * ‖W_Q‖`。
（伴随等距 `‖W_UK†‖ = ‖W_UK‖` 与复合的次乘性。）
这是 MLA 特有的定量界：吸收不是免费的，其代价由两个投影的范数之积控制。
stmt:
theorem mla_absorbed_opNorm_le (WQ : E →L[ℝ] E) (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) :
    ‖mlaAbsorbedMap WQ WUK‖ ≤ ‖WUK‖ * ‖WQ‖
proof:
by
  unfold mlaAbsorbedMap
  calc ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK).comp WQ‖
      ≤ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint WUK‖ * ‖WQ‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
    _ = ‖WUK‖ * ‖WQ‖ := by rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.norm_map]

name: mla_score_eq_absorbedMap
doc:
**吸收打分 = 预合成算子打分**：把 `mla_absorb_query` 重述为算子形式，
说明「吸收」在陈述层面就是一次算子应用。
stmt:
theorem mla_score_eq_absorbedMap (WQ : E →L[ℝ] E) (WUK : L →L[ℝ] E) (x : E) (c : L) :
    inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (WQ x) (WUK c) = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (mlaAbsorbedMap WQ WUK x) c
proof:
by
  unfold mlaAbsorbedMap
  exact mla_absorb_query WQ WUK x c

name: mla_score_eq_plain_inner
doc:
**恒等退化 ⟹ 普通内积打分**：`W_UK = id`（不压缩）时，
MLA 的吸收打分退化为普通内积打分 `⟨q, c⟩`——
即 MLA 是标准注意力打分的**真扩展**（在恒等上投影处与原打分重合）。
stmt:
theorem mla_score_eq_plain_inner (q c : E) :
    mlaScoreAbsorbed (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) q c = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) q c
proof:
by
  unfold mlaScoreAbsorbed
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_id]
  simp [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]

                                                                   
                          
                                             
                                                                     
omit [CompleteSpace E] in

name: mla_score_eq_gqa_logits_id
stmt:
theorem mla_score_eq_gqa_logits_id {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (Q : Fin 1 → E →L[ℝ] E) (g : Fin 1 → Fin 1)
    (xq : E) (x : ι → E) (i : Fin 1) (j : ι) :
    gqaLogits Q (fun _ : Fin 1 => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) g 1 xq x i j
      = inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (Q i xq) (x j)
proof:
by
  unfold gqaLogits
  simp [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, Real.sqrt_one]

end Lattice

name: maskedDenom
doc: 一般掩码分母：`Σ_k (if mask i k then exp(s_k) else 0)`（`if` 形式避免 −∞）。
stmt:
def maskedDenom {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : ℝ
proof: ∑ k : Fin n, (if mask i k then Real.exp (s k) else 0)

name: maskedSoftmax
doc:
一般掩码 softmax：`w_j = (if mask i j then exp(s_j) else 0) / Σ_k (if mask i k then exp(s_k) else 0)`。
任意掩码模式（全 / 因果 / 滑动窗口 / 前缀）共用此定义。
stmt:
def maskedSoftmax {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : Fin n → ℝ
proof: fun j => (if mask i j then Real.exp (s j) else 0) / maskedDenom mask s i

name: maskedDenom_nonneg
stmt:
lemma maskedDenom_nonneg {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ maskedDenom mask s i
proof:
by
  unfold maskedDenom
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro k _
  by_cases h : mask i k
  · simp [h]
    exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (s k))
  · simp [h]

name: maskedDenom_pos
stmt:
lemma maskedDenom_pos {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (hne : ∃ j, mask i j) : 0 < maskedDenom mask s i
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hne
  unfold maskedDenom
  exact Finset.sum_pos'
    (fun k _ => by
      by_cases h : mask i k
      · simp [h]
        exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (s k))
      · simp [h])
    ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, by simp [hj, Real.exp_pos (s j)]⟩

name: maskedSoftmax_nonneg
stmt:
theorem maskedSoftmax_nonneg {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (j : Fin n) : 0 ≤ maskedSoftmax mask s i j
proof:
by
  unfold maskedSoftmax
  exact div_nonneg
    (by
      by_cases h : mask i j
      · simp [h]
        exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (s j))
      · simp [h])
    (maskedDenom_nonneg mask s i)

name: maskedSoftmax_sum_one
stmt:
theorem maskedSoftmax_sum_one {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (hne : ∃ j, mask i j) :
    ∑ j, maskedSoftmax mask s i j = 1
proof:
by
  unfold maskedSoftmax maskedDenom
  have hD : (∑ k : Fin n, (if mask i k then Real.exp (s k) else 0)) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (maskedDenom_pos mask s i hne)
  calc
    ∑ j, (if mask i j then Real.exp (s j) else 0) /
          (∑ k : Fin n, (if mask i k then Real.exp (s k) else 0))
        = (∑ j, (if mask i j then Real.exp (s j) else 0)) /
          (∑ k : Fin n, (if mask i k then Real.exp (s k) else 0)) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    _ = 1 := by
          exact div_self hD

name: masked_attention_output_bound
stmt:
theorem masked_attention_output_bound {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (hne : ∃ j, mask i j)
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (V : Fin n → F) (M : ℝ) (hV : ∀ j, ‖V j‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖convComb (maskedSoftmax mask s i) V‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨hne.choose⟩
  exact convComb_norm_bound (maskedSoftmax mask s i) V M
    (fun j => maskedSoftmax_nonneg mask s i j)
    (maskedSoftmax_sum_one mask s i hne) hV

name: maskedSoftmax_pos_of_mask
stmt:
theorem maskedSoftmax_pos_of_mask {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (hne : ∃ k, mask i k) (hij : mask i j) :
    0 < maskedSoftmax mask s i j
proof:
by
  unfold maskedSoftmax
  rw [if_pos hij]
  exact div_pos (Real.exp_pos (s j)) (maskedDenom_pos mask s i hne)

name: maskedSoftmax_eq_zero_of_not_mask
stmt:
theorem maskedSoftmax_eq_zero_of_not_mask {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop)
    [DecidableRel mask] (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (hij : ¬ mask i j) :
    maskedSoftmax mask s i j = 0
proof:
by
  unfold maskedSoftmax
  simp [hij]

name: full_mask_eq_softmax
stmt:
theorem full_mask_eq_softmax {n : ℕ} (s : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    maskedSoftmax (fun _ _ : Fin (n + 1) => True) s i = softmax s
proof:
by
  funext j
  simp [maskedSoftmax, maskedDenom, softmax]

name: causal_mask_eq_causalSoftmax
stmt:
theorem causal_mask_eq_causalSoftmax {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    maskedSoftmax (fun _ j : Fin n => j ≤ i) s i = causalSoftmax s i
proof:
by
  funext j
  simp [maskedSoftmax, maskedDenom, causalSoftmax, causalDenom]

name: slidingMask
doc: 滑动窗口掩码：`j` 在 `i` 的窗口内（`j ≤ i` 且 `i − j ≤ w`）。
stmt: abbrev slidingMask {n : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) : Prop

name: instDecidableRelSlidingMask
stmt: instance instDecidableRelSlidingMask {n : ℕ} (w : ℕ) : DecidableRel (slidingMask (n := n) w)
proof: fun i j => inferInstanceAs (Decidable ((j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) ∧ (i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ) ≤ w))

name: slidingMask_refl
doc: 对角线满足滑动窗口掩码（`i − i = 0 ≤ w`）⟹ 每行非空。
stmt: theorem slidingMask_refl {n : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : slidingMask w i i
proof:
by
  constructor
  · exact le_rfl
  · rw [Nat.sub_self]
    exact Nat.zero_le w

name: sliding_window_row_random
doc: 滑动窗口掩码的注意力权重行随机（合法性）。
stmt:
theorem sliding_window_row_random {n : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ j, maskedSoftmax (slidingMask w) s i j = 1
proof: maskedSoftmax_sum_one (slidingMask w) s i ⟨i, slidingMask_refl w i⟩

name: sliding_window_nonneg
doc: 滑动窗口掩码的注意力权重非负（合法性）。
stmt:
theorem sliding_window_nonneg {n : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ maskedSoftmax (slidingMask w) s i j
proof: maskedSoftmax_nonneg (slidingMask w) s i j

name: sliding_window_output_bound
doc: 滑动窗口掩码的注意力输出界（残差稳定性对稀疏注意力同样成立）。
stmt:
theorem sliding_window_output_bound {n : ℕ} (w : ℕ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (V : Fin n → F) (M : ℝ) (hV : ∀ j, ‖V j‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖convComb (maskedSoftmax (slidingMask w) s i) V‖ ≤ M
proof: masked_attention_output_bound (slidingMask w) s i ⟨i, slidingMask_refl w i⟩ V M hV

name: masked_row_nonempty_of_refl
stmt:
theorem masked_row_nonempty_of_refl {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (hrefl : ∀ i, mask i i) (i : Fin n) : ∃ j, mask i j
proof: ⟨i, hrefl i⟩

name: refl_mask_output_bound
stmt:
theorem refl_mask_output_bound {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]
    (hrefl : ∀ i, mask i i) (s : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n)
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (V : Fin n → F) (M : ℝ) (hV : ∀ j, ‖V j‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖convComb (maskedSoftmax mask s i) V‖ ≤ M
proof: masked_attention_output_bound mask s i (masked_row_nonempty_of_refl mask hrefl i) V M hV

name: refl_mask_sum_one
doc: 自反掩码的行随机性。
stmt:
theorem refl_mask_sum_one {n : ℕ} (mask : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel mask]

name: causalDenom_lower
stmt:
lemma causalDenom_lower {k : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (x : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ j : Fin k, -M ≤ x j) (i : Fin k) :
    Real.exp (-M) ≤ causalDenom x i
proof:
by
  calc
    Real.exp (-M) ≤ Real.exp (x i) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hx i)
    _ ≤ causalDenom x i := by
          unfold causalDenom
          have hnonneg : ∀ j : Fin k, 0 ≤ (if j ≤ i then Real.exp (x j) else 0) := by
            intro j
            by_cases h : j ≤ i
            · simp [h]
              exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (x j))
            · simp [h]
          have hle : Real.exp (x i) ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, (if j ≤ i then Real.exp (x j) else 0) := by
            simpa using
              (Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
                (f := fun j : Fin k => if j ≤ i then Real.exp (x j) else 0)
                (fun j hj => hnonneg j) (Finset.mem_univ i))
          exact hle

name: causalDenom_diff_bound
stmt:
lemma causalDenom_diff_bound {k : ℕ} (M : ℝ) (x y : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ j : Fin k, x j ≤ M) (hy : ∀ j : Fin k, y j ≤ M) (i : Fin k) :
    |causalDenom x i - causalDenom y i| ≤ k * Real.exp M * LinfNorm (x - y)
proof:
by
  unfold causalDenom
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  calc
    |∑ j : Fin k, ((if j ≤ i then Real.exp (x j) else 0) - (if j ≤ i then Real.exp (y j) else 0))|
        ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, |(if j ≤ i then Real.exp (x j) else 0) - (if j ≤ i then Real.exp (y j) else 0)| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (fun j : Fin k => (if j ≤ i then Real.exp (x j) else 0) - (if j ≤ i then Real.exp (y j) else 0)) Finset.univ
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, |Real.exp (x j) - Real.exp (y j)| := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j hj
          by_cases hji : j ≤ i <;> simp [hji]
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, Real.exp M * |x j - y j| := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j hj
          exact exp_lipschitz_on M (x j) (y j) (hx j) (hy j)
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin k, Real.exp M * LinfNorm (x - y) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j hj
          have hz : |x j - y j| = |(x - y) j| := by rfl
          rw [hz]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_csSup (bddAbove_abs (x - y)) (by exact ⟨j, rfl⟩)) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos M))
    _ = k * (Real.exp M * LinfNorm (x - y)) := by simp [Finset.sum_const]
    _ = k * Real.exp M * LinfNorm (x - y) := by ring

theorem causal_attention_lipschitz_numeric {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] (S : E →L[ℝ] (Fin k → ℝ))
    (V : Fin k → E →L[ℝ] E) (M B : ℝ)

      ‖(∑ j : Fin k, causalSoftmax (S x) q j • (V j x)) - (∑ j : Fin k, causalSoftmax (S y) q j • (V j y))‖
        ≤ M * (1 + B * ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (4 * (‖S‖ * B)) * ‖S‖)) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  intro x y hBx hBy
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by
    rcases (Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (NeZero.pos k)) with ⟨i₀⟩
    linarith [hM i₀, norm_nonneg (V i₀)]
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (norm_nonneg x) hBx
                                                  
  let M' : ℝ := ‖S‖ * B
  have hM' : 0 ≤ M' := by
    dsimp [M']
    exact mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg S) hB0
                                                                   
  have hscore : ∀ (z : E), ‖z‖ ≤ B → ∀ i : Fin k, |(S z) i| ≤ M' := by
    intro z hz i
    dsimp [M']
    calc
      |(S z) i| ≤ ‖S z‖ := by
            rw [← linfNorm_eq_norm (S z)]
            exact le_csSup (bddAbove_abs (S z)) (by exact ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      _ ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖z‖ := S.le_opNorm z
      _ ≤ ‖S‖ * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz (norm_nonneg S)
                                                                              
  have hwlip : ∀ (u v : E), ‖u‖ ≤ B → ‖v‖ ≤ B →
      (∑ i : Fin k, |causalSoftmax (S u) q i - causalSoftmax (S v) q i|)
      ≤ ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (4 * M') * ‖S‖) * ‖u - v‖ := by
    intro u v hu hv
    have h1 := causal_weight_l1_diff_bound (k := k) M' hM' (S u) (S v)
      (fun i => abs_le.mp (hscore u hu i)) (fun i => abs_le.mp (hscore v hv i)) q
    have h2 := score_lin_lipschitz S u v
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin k, |causalSoftmax (S u) q i - causalSoftmax (S v) q i|)
          ≤ ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (4 * M') * LinfNorm (S u - S v)) := h1
      _ ≤ ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (4 * M') * ‖S

  have hin : ‖(x + A x + W x) - (y + A y + W y)‖ ≤ (1 + La + ‖W‖) * ‖x - y‖ := by
