name: impl_via_alignment
stmt:
theorem impl_via_alignment (out₁ out₂ k : ℝ) (h : out₂ = k * out₁) :
    out₁ = 0 → out₂ = 0
proof:
by
  intro h₁
  rw [h, h₁]
  ring

name: impl_iff_via_alignment
stmt:
theorem impl_iff_via_alignment (out₁ out₂ k : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (h : out₂ = k * out₁) :
    out₁ = 0 ↔ out₂ = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · exact impl_via_alignment out₁ out₂ k h
  · intro h₂
                                          
    have : k * out₁ = 0 := by rw [← h, h₂]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hk

name: constraint_implication_via_alignment
stmt:
theorem constraint_implication_via_alignment (c₁ c₂ : RealConstraint) (k : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x : ℝ, RealNeuronOut (convertReal c₂) x = k * RealNeuronOut (convertReal c₁) x) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, RealConstraintSat c₁ x → RealConstraintSat c₂ x
proof:
by
  intro x hsat
                                        
  have hout₁ : RealNeuronOut (convertReal c₁) x = 0 := (convertReal_preserves c₁ x).mp hsat
  have hout₂ : RealNeuronOut (convertReal c₂) x = 0 :=
    impl_via_alignment (RealNeuronOut (convertReal c₁) x) (RealNeuronOut (convertReal c₂) x) k
      (h x) hout₁
  exact (convertReal_preserves c₂ x).mpr hout₂

name: not_andC_zero_iff
stmt: theorem not_andC_zero_iff (a b : ℝ) : ¬(real_andC a b = 0) ↔ a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hnot
                                       
    rw [not_or] at hnot
    have hz : real_andC a b = 0 :=
      (real_andC_eq_zero_iff a b).mpr ⟨(not_not.mp hnot.1), (not_not.mp hnot.2)⟩
    exact h hz
  · intro h hz
                                                                  
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact h ((real_andC_eq_zero_iff a b).mp hz).1
    · exact h ((real_andC_eq_zero_iff a b).mp hz).2

name: not_orC_zero_iff
stmt: theorem not_orC_zero_iff (a b : ℝ) : ¬(real_orC a b = 0) ↔ a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro ha
      exact h ((real_orC_eq_zero_iff a b).mpr (Or.inl ha))
    · intro hb
      exact h ((real_orC_eq_zero_iff a b).mpr (Or.inr hb))
  · intro h hz
                                   
    rcases (real_orC_eq_zero_iff a b).mp hz with ha | hb
    · exact h.1 ha
    · exact h.2 hb

name: implication_penalty
stmt:
theorem implication_penalty (out₁ out₂ : ℝ) :
    out₁ = 0 → (relu (out₂ ^ 2) = 0 ↔ out₂ = 0)
proof:
by
  intro h₁
                                                       
  have hrelu : relu (out₂ ^ 2) = 0 ↔ out₂ ^ 2 ≤ 0 := relu_eq_zero_iff (out₂ ^ 2)
  have hsq : out₂ ^ 2 ≤ 0 ↔ out₂ = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro hle
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ out₂ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg out₂
      have hz : out₂ ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm hle hnonneg
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hz
    · intro h
      simp [h]
  rw [hrelu, hsq]

end Lattice

name: margin_implication_penalty
stmt:
theorem margin_implication_penalty (out₁ out₂ : ℝ) (h₁ : out₁ = 0) (h₂ : 0 < out₂) :
    0 < relu (out₂ - out₁)
proof:
by
  have hpos : 0 < out₂ - out₁ := by
    rw [h₁]
    linarith
  have hrelu : relu (out₂ - out₁) = out₂ - out₁ := by
    unfold relu
    exact max_eq_left (le_of_lt hpos)
  rw [hrelu]
  exact hpos

name: margin_implication_satisfied
stmt:
theorem margin_implication_satisfied (out₁ out₂ : ℝ) (h : out₂ ≤ out₁) :
    relu (out₂ - out₁) = 0
proof:
by
  exact (relu_eq_zero_iff (out₂ - out₁)).mpr (by linarith)

name: implication_transitive
stmt:
theorem implication_transitive (a b c : ℝ)
    (h₁ : relu (b - a) = 0) (h₂ : relu (c - b) = 0) :
    relu (c - a) = 0
proof:
by
  have hba : b ≤ a := sub_nonpos.mp ((relu_eq_zero_iff (b - a)).mp h₁)
  have hcb : c ≤ b := sub_nonpos.mp ((relu_eq_zero_iff (c - b)).mp h₂)
  exact (relu_eq_zero_iff (c - a)).mpr (by linarith)

name: relu_lipschitz
stmt: theorem relu_lipschitz (x y : ℝ) : |relu x - relu y| ≤ |x - y|
proof:
by
                                      
                                                                     
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  constructor
  ·                             
    unfold relu
    have hx : x ≤ y + |x - y| := by linarith [le_abs_self (x - y)]
    have h0 : 0 ≤ |x - y| := abs_nonneg (x - y)
    have hle : max x 0 ≤ max y 0 + |x - y| := by
      exact max_le (le_trans hx (add_le_add_right (le_max_left y 0) _))
        (le_trans (le_max_right y 0) (le_add_of_nonneg_right h0))
    linarith
  ·                             
    unfold relu
    have hy : y ≤ x + |x - y| := by linarith [le_abs_self (y - x), abs_sub_comm x y]
    have h0 : 0 ≤ |x - y| := abs_nonneg (x - y)
    have hle : max y 0 ≤ max x 0 + |x - y| := by
      exact max_le (le_trans hy (add_le_add_right (le_max_left x 0) _))
        (le_trans (le_max_right x 0) (le_add_of_nonneg_right h0))
    linarith

name: implication_sum_zero_iff
stmt:
theorem implication_sum_zero_iff (ps : List (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (ps.map (fun p => relu (p.2 - p.1))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 ↔
      ∀ p ∈ ps, relu (p.2 - p.1) = 0
proof:
by
                                             
  have hmap : ps.map (fun p => relu (p.2 - p.1)) =
      (ps.map (fun p => (p.2, p.1))).map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2)) := by
    simpa [List.map_map]
  have hswap : (ps.map (fun p => relu (p.2 - p.1))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0
      = SumRelu (ps.map (fun p => (p.2, p.1))) := by
    unfold SumRelu
    rw [hmap]
  rw [hswap]
                                                          
  rw [sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each]
  constructor
  · intro h p hp
                                                       
    simpa using h (p.2, p.1) (List.mem_map.2 ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
  · intro h q hq
                                                                
    rcases (List.mem_map.mp hq) with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    simpa using h p hp

                
                                            
                                    
                              
                                                 
                                                 

end Lattice

name: klDensity
doc:
**密度形式 KL 散度**：`KL(f‖g) = ∫ f·log(f/g) dμ`（`μ` 为基准测度）。
约定 `Real.log 0 = 0`，故 `f = 0` 处被积项为 0。
stmt: noncomputable def klDensity {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (f g : α → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x / g x) ∂μ

name: differentialEntropy
doc:
**微分熵**：`H(f) = −∫ f·log f dμ`。约定 `Real.log 0 = 0`（`f = 0` 处
被积项 `f·log f = 0`，与离散熵的 0 log 0 = 0 约定一致）。
stmt:
noncomputable def differentialEntropy {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (f : α → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: - ∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x) ∂μ

name: crossEntropyMeasure
doc:
**连续交叉熵**：`CE(f,g) = −∫ f·log g dμ`（RealCrossEntropy 的 `crossEntropy`
在测度空间上的对应物）。
stmt:
noncomputable def crossEntropyMeasure {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    (f g : α → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: - ∫ x, f x * Real.log (g x) ∂μ

name: sub_le_mul_log_div
doc:
**逐点 Gibbs 下界**：`0 ≤ f x`、`0 < g x` ⟹ `f x − g x ≤ f x·log(f x/g x)`。
证明：`f x = 0` 时右边为 0、左边 `−g x < 0`；`f x > 0` 时令 `a = f x/g x > 0`，
由 `log t ≤ t − 1`（`t = a⁻¹`）与 `log_inv` 得 `1 − a⁻¹ ≤ log a`，两边乘
`f x > 0`，并用 `f x·(f x/g x)⁻¹ = g x` 化简左边。
stmt:
theorem sub_le_mul_log_div {f g : ℝ} (hf : 0 ≤ f) (hg : 0 < g) :
    f - g ≤ f * Real.log (f / g)
proof:
by
  by_cases hf0 : f = 0
  ·                                
    rw [hf0]
    simp only [zero_mul, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero]
    linarith
  · have hfpos : 0 < f := lt_of_le_of_ne hf (Ne.symm hf0)
    have ha : 0 < f / g := div_pos hfpos hg
                                                                     
    have hlog : (1 : ℝ) - (f / g)⁻¹ ≤ Real.log (f / g) := by
      have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha)
      rw [Real.log_inv] at h
      linarith
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hfpos.le
    have hkey : f * (1 - (f / g)⁻¹) = f - g := by
      rw [inv_div]
      field_simp
    rw [hkey] at hmul
    exact hmul

name: klDensity_nonneg
doc:
**Gibbs 不等式（密度形式，核心）**：`f ≥ 0`、`g > 0`、`f`、`g` 与
`f·log(f/g)` 可积、且 `∫f = ∫g` ⟹ `KL(f‖g) ≥ 0`。
证明：逐点 `sub_le_mul_log_div` + `integral_mono`，再用 `integral_sub` 与
`∫f = ∫g` 把下界化归为 0。
stmt:
theorem klDensity_nonneg {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} {f g : α → ℝ}
    (hf_nn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg_pos : ∀ x, 0 < g x)
    (hf_int : Integrable f μ) (hg_int : Integrable g μ)
    (hkl_int : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x / g x)) μ)
    (h_eq : ∫ x, f x ∂μ = ∫ x, g x ∂μ) :
    0 ≤ klDensity μ f g
proof:
by
  have hfg : Integrable (fun x => f x - g x) μ := hf_int.sub hg_int
  have hpoint : (fun x => f x - g x) ≤ fun x => f x * Real.log (f x / g x) :=
    fun x => sub_le_mul_log_div (hf_nn x) (hg_pos x)
  have hmono : (∫ x, (f x - g x) ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x / g x) ∂μ :=
    integral_mono hfg hkl_int hpoint
  have hzero : (∫ x, (f x - g x) ∂μ) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub hf_int hg_int, h_eq, sub_self]
  calc (0 : ℝ) = ∫ x, (f x - g x) ∂μ := hzero.symm
    _ ≤ ∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x / g x) ∂μ := hmono
    _ = klDensity μ f g := rfl

name: klDensity_eq_sub_entropies
doc:
**KL 的熵分解**：f、g 严格正且 `f·log f`、`f·log g` 可积 ⟹
`KL(f‖g) = ∫f·log f − ∫f·log g`（`Real.log_div` 逐点拆积 + `integral_sub`）。
stmt:
theorem klDensity_eq_sub_entropies {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {f g : α → ℝ} (hf_pos : ∀ x, 0 < f x) (hg_pos : ∀ x, 0 < g x)
    (h1 : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) μ)
    (h2 : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (g x)) μ) :
    klDensity μ f g
      = (∫ x, f x * Real.log (f x) ∂μ) - ∫ x, f x * Real.log (g x) ∂μ
proof:
by
  have hpoint : (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x / g x))
      = fun x => f x * Real.log (f x) - f x * Real.log (g x) := by
    funext x
    rw [Real.log_div (hf_pos x).ne' (hg_pos x).ne']
    ring
  rw [klDensity, hpoint, integral_sub h1 h2]

name: klDensity_eq_ce_sub_entropy_measure
doc: **定义桥（KL = CE − H，测度版）**：`KL(f‖g) = crossEntropyMeasure − differentialEntropy`。
stmt:
theorem klDensity_eq_ce_sub_entropy_measure {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {f g : α → ℝ} (hf_pos : ∀ x, 0 < f x) (hg_pos : ∀ x, 0 < g x)
    (h1 : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) μ)
    (h2 : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (g x)) μ) :
    klDensity μ f g = crossEntropyMeasure μ f g - differentialEntropy μ f
proof:
by
  rw [klDensity_eq_sub_entropies hf_pos hg_pos h1 h2, crossEntropyMeasure, differentialEntropy]
  ring

name: differentialEntropy_le_crossEntropyMeasure
doc:
**熵 ≤ 交叉熵（连续版）**：在 `klDensity_nonneg` 的假设下，
`H(f) ≤ CE(f,g)`（RealCrossEntropy 的 `ce_ge_entropy` 在测度空间上的对应物）。
由 Gibbs 非负性与定义桥 `KL = CE − H` 直接得到。
stmt:
theorem differentialEntropy_le_crossEntropyMeasure {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {μ : Measure α} {f g : α → ℝ}
    (hf_nn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg_pos : ∀ x, 0 < g x)
    (hf_int : Integrable f μ) (hg_int : Integrable g μ)
    (h1 : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x)) μ)
    (h2 : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (g x)) μ)
    (hkl_int : Integrable (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x / g x)) μ)
    (h_eq : ∫ x, f x ∂μ = ∫ x, g x ∂μ) :
    differentialEntropy μ f ≤ crossEntropyMeasure μ f g
proof:
by
  have hnn := klDensity_nonneg hf_nn hg_pos hf_int hg_int hkl_int h_eq
                                
  have hpoint : (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x / g x))
      = fun x => f x * Real.log (f x) - f x * Real.log (g x) := by
    funext x
    by_cases hfx : f x = 0
    · rw [hfx]
      simp [Real.log_zero]
    · rw [Real.log_div hfx (hg_pos x).ne']
      ring
  have hbridge : klDensity μ f g = crossEntropyMeasure μ f g - differentialEntropy μ f := by
    rw [klDensity, hpoint, integral_sub h1 h2, crossEntropyMeasure, differentialEntropy]
    ring
  linarith [hnn, hbridge]

name: klDensity_self
doc:
`KL(f‖f) = 0`（逐点被积项为零：`f = 0` 时 `0·log 0 = 0`，
`f ≠ 0` 时 `log(f/f) = log 1 = 0`）。
stmt:
theorem klDensity_self {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) :
    klDensity μ f f = 0
proof:
by
  have hzero : (fun x => f x * Real.log (f x / f x)) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
    funext x
    by_cases h : f x = 0
    · rw [h]
      simp [Real.log_zero]
    · rw [div_self h, Real.log_one, mul_zero]
  rw [klDensity, hzero]
  simp

name: klDensity_eq_zero_of_eq
stmt:
theorem klDensity_eq_zero_of_eq {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : f = g) : klDensity μ f g = 0
proof:
by
  subst h
  exact klDensity_self μ f

name: klMeasure
doc:
**Radon–Nikodym 形式 KL 散度**：`KL(μ‖ν) = ∫ log(dν/dμ) dμ`。
`Measure.rnDeriv` 取值于 `ℝ≥0∞`，故先 `.toReal` 实数化再取 `Real.log`
（`Real.log 0 = 0` 处理 `dν/dμ = 0` 的纤维）。
stmt: noncomputable def klMeasure {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ ν : Measure α) : ℝ
proof: ∫ x, Real.log ((ν.rnDeriv μ x).toReal) ∂μ

name: klMeasure_self
doc:
**自 KL 为零**：`[SigmaFinite μ]` ⟹ `KL(μ‖μ) = 0`。
证明：`Measure.rnDeriv_self` 给出 `μ.rnDeriv μ =ᵐ[μ] 1`，逐点
`log 1 = 0`，被积函数 a.e. 为零，`integral_congr_ae` + `integral_zero`。
stmt:
theorem klMeasure_self {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) [SigmaFinite μ] :
    klMeasure μ μ = 0
proof:
by
  have h : (fun x => Real.log ((μ.rnDeriv μ x).toReal)) =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [Measure.rnDeriv_self μ] with x hx
    rw [hx]
    simp
  rw [klMeasure, integral_congr_ae h]
  simp

name: klMeasure_eq_zero_of_eq
doc: `μ = ν ⟹ KL(μ‖ν) = 0`（由 `klMeasure_self` 转移）。
stmt:
theorem klMeasure_eq_zero_of_eq {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ ν : Measure α}
    [SigmaFinite μ] (h : μ = ν) : klMeasure μ ν = 0
proof:
by
  subst h
  exact klMeasure_self μ

end Lattice

name: onehot
doc: one-hot 标签向量：onehot y a = 1（a = y），否则 0。
stmt: def onehot {k : ℕ} (y : Fin k) : Fin k → ℝ
proof: fun a => if a = y then 1 else 0

name: crossEntropy
doc: 交叉熵 CE(p,q) = -Σ_a p a · log(q a)（q 需在 log 定义域内，即 0 < q a）。
stmt: noncomputable def crossEntropy {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: -∑ a, p a * Real.log (q a)

name: entropy
doc: 熵 H(p) = CE(p,p) = -Σ p·log p。
stmt: noncomputable def entropy {k : ℕ} (p : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: crossEntropy p p

name: softmax_pos
stmt: lemma softmax_pos {k : ℕ} (z : Fin k → ℝ) : ∀ i, 0 < softmax z i
proof:
by
  intro i
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨i⟩
  unfold softmax
  exact div_pos (Real.exp_pos (z i)) (softmax_denom_pos z)

name: ce_sum_neg
stmt: lemma ce_sum_neg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : crossEntropy p q = ∑ a, p a * (-Real.log (q a))
proof:
by
  calc
    crossEntropy p q = -∑ a, p a * Real.log (q a) := rfl
    _ = ∑ a, -(p a * Real.log (q a)) := by rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    _ = ∑ a, p a * (-Real.log (q a)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      rw [mul_neg]

name: ce_nonneg
stmt:
theorem ce_nonneg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) : 0 ≤ crossEntropy p q
proof:
by
                          
  have hq1 : ∀ a, q a ≤ 1 := by
    intro a
    have hle : q a ≤ ∑ b, q b :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun b hb => le_of_lt (hq0 b)) (Finset.mem_univ a)
    rwa [hqsum] at hle
                                   
  have hneg : ∀ a, 1 - q a ≤ -Real.log (q a) := by
    intro a
    have hlog : Real.log (q a) ≤ q a - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (hq0 a)
    linarith
                          
  have hpq : ∑ a, p a * q a ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      ∑ a, p a * q a ≤ ∑ a, p a * 1 := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro a ha
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hq1 a) (hp0 a)
      _ = ∑ a, p a := by simp
      _ = 1 := hpsum
                                 
  have hsum1 : ∑ a, p a * (1 - q a) = 1 - ∑ a, p a * q a := by
    calc
      ∑ a, p a * (1 - q a) = ∑ a, (p a - p a * q a) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro a ha
            ring
      _ = (∑ a, p a) - ∑ a, p a * q a := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      _ = 1 - ∑ a, p a * q a := by rw [hpsum]
                                       
  have hstep : ∑ a, p a * (1 - q a) ≤ ∑ a, p a * (-Real.log (q a)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro a ha
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hneg a) (hp0 a)
  calc
    0 ≤ ∑ a, p a * (1 - q a) := by
          rw [hsum1]
          linarith [hpq]
    _ ≤ ∑ a, p a * (-Real.log (q a)) := hstep
    _ = crossEntropy p q := (ce_sum_neg p q).symm

name: entropy_nonneg
stmt:
theorem entropy_nonneg (p : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1) :
    0 ≤ entropy p
proof:
by
  unfold entropy
  exact ce_nonneg p p (fun a => le_of_lt (hp0 a)) hpsum hp0 hpsum

name: ce_onehot_eq_neg_log
stmt:
theorem ce_onehot_eq_neg_log (y : Fin k) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (_hq : 0 < q y) :
    crossEntropy (onehot y) q = -Real.log (q y)
proof:
by
  have hsum : ∑ a, onehot y a * Real.log (q a) = Real.log (q y) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single y (by
      intro b hb hby
      simp [onehot, hby]) (by
      intro hy
      exact False.elim (hy (Finset.mem_univ y)))]
    simp [onehot]
  calc
    crossEntropy (onehot y) q = -∑ a, onehot y a * Real.log (q a) := rfl
    _ = -Real.log (q y) := by rw [hsum]

name: ce_eq_zero_iff_support
stmt:
theorem ce_eq_zero_iff_support (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    crossEntropy p q = 0 ↔ ∀ a, p a = 0 ∨ q a = 1
proof:
by
                  
  have hq1 : ∀ a, q a ≤ 1 := by
    intro a
    have hle : q a ≤ ∑ b, q b :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun b hb => le_of_lt (hq0 b)) (Finset.mem_univ a)
    rwa [hqsum] at hle
                            
  have hterm0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a * (-Real.log (q a)) := by
    intro a
    apply mul_nonneg (hp0 a)
    have hlogle : Real.log (q a) ≤ 0 := by
      have hle : Real.log (q a) ≤ Real.log (1 : ℝ) :=
        Real.log_le_log (hq0 a) (hq1 a)
      rwa [Real.log_one] at hle
    linarith
  constructor
  · intro hce
    have hsum0 : ∑ a, p a * (-Real.log (q a)) = 0 := by
      rw [← ce_sum_neg p q, hce]
    have hz : ∀ a, p a * (-Real.log (q a)) = 0 := by
      have hall := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun a _ => hterm0 a)).mp hsum0
      intro a
      exact hall a (Finset.mem_univ a)
    intro a
    have hmul := mul_eq_zero.mp (hz a)
    rcases hmul with hpa | hlogz
    · exact Or.inl hpa
    · right
      have hlog : Real.log (q a) = 0 := by linarith
      rcases (Real.log_eq_zero.mp hlog) with hz | h1 | hn
      · exfalso
        linarith [hq0 a]
      · exact h1
      · exfalso
        linarith [hq0 a]
  · intro hsupp
    have hall : ∀ a, p a * (-Real.log (q a)) = 0 := by
      intro a
      rcases hsupp a with hpa | hqa
      · rw [hpa]
        simp
      · have hlog : Real.log (q a) = 0 := by rw [hqa, Real.log_one]
        simp [hlog]
    rw [ce_sum_neg p q]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro a ha
    exact hall a

name: ce_eq_zero_of_onehot
stmt:
theorem ce_eq_zero_of_onehot (y : Fin k) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (hq : 0 < q y) :
    crossEntropy (onehot y) q = 0 ↔ q y = 1
proof:
by
  rw [ce_onehot_eq_neg_log y q hq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hlog : Real.log (q y) = 0 := by linarith
    rcases (Real.log_eq_zero.mp hlog) with hz | h1 | hn
    · exfalso
      linarith [hq]
    · exact h1
    · exfalso
      linarith [hq]
  · intro hq1
    rw [hq1, Real.log_one]
    simp

name: ce_onehot_softmax_eq_neg_log
stmt:
theorem ce_onehot_softmax_eq_neg_log (s : Fin k → ℝ) (y : Fin k) :
    crossEntropy (onehot y) (softmax s) = -Real.log (softmax s y)
proof:
by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨y⟩
  exact ce_onehot_eq_neg_log y (softmax s) (softmax_pos s y)

name: ce_ge_entropy
stmt:
theorem ce_ge_entropy (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    entropy p ≤ crossEntropy p q
proof:
by
                                                 
  have hdecomp : crossEntropy p q - crossEntropy p p
      = ∑ a, p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a)) := by
    rw [ce_sum_neg p q, ce_sum_neg p p]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    ring
                                            
  have hterm : ∀ a, p a - q a ≤ p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a)) := by
    intro a
    have hlogsep : 1 - q a / p a ≤ Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a) := by
      have hpos : 0 < q a / p a := div_pos (hq0 a) (hp0 a)
      have hlogle : Real.log (q a / p a) ≤ q a / p a - 1 :=
        Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hpos
      have hsep : Real.log (q a) - Real.log (p a) = Real.log (q a / p a) := by
        rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hq0 a)) (ne_of_gt (hp0 a))]
      linarith
    have hmul : p a * (1 - q a / p a) ≤ p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogsep (le_of_lt (hp0 a))
    have heq : p a * (1 - q a / p a) = p a - q a := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp0 a)]
    rwa [heq] at hmul
                             
  have hsumdiff : ∑ a, (p a - q a) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hpsum, hqsum]
    simp
  have hle : crossEntropy p p ≤ crossEntropy p q := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ crossEntropy p q - crossEntropy p p := by
      rw [hdecomp]
      have hsumle : ∑ a, (p a - q a) ≤ ∑ a, p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro a ha
        exact hterm a

name: fderiv_apply_direction_fin
proof:
by
  have hg : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => s + t • v) v 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add s
  have hf' : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f s) (s + (0 : ℝ) • v) := by
    have hs : s + (0 : ℝ) • v = s := by simp
    rw [hs]
    exact hf.hasFDerivAt
  exact (hf'.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hg).deriv.symm

name: softmax_ce_differentiableAt
stmt:
lemma softmax_ce_differentiableAt {k : ℕ} (s : Fin k → ℝ) (y : Fin k) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => -Real.log (softmax z y)) s
proof:
by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨y⟩
                                                                 
  have hnum : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => Real.exp (z y)) s := by
    have hproj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => z y) s := by
      simpa using (differentiableAt_apply (y : Fin k) s)
    exact hproj.exp
  have hden : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => ∑ j : Fin k, Real.exp (z j)) s := by
    have hfd : ∀ j : Fin k, HasFDerivAt (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => Real.exp (z j))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => Real.exp (z j)) s) s := by
      intro j
      have hproj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => z j) s := by
        simpa using (differentiableAt_apply (j : Fin k) s)
      exact (hproj.exp).hasFDerivAt
    exact (HasFDerivAt.sum (by intro j hj; exact hfd j)).differentiableAt
  have hsm : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => softmax z y) s := by
    have hne : (∑ j : Fin k, Real.exp (s j)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (softmax_denom_pos s)
                                                       
                                                   
    have hinv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => (∑ j : Fin k, Real.exp (z j))⁻¹) s :=
      hden.inv hne
    have hprod : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => Real.exp (z y) * (∑ j : Fin k, Real.exp (z j))⁻¹) s :=
      hnum.mul hinv
    simpa [softmax] using hprod

name: softmax_ce_fderiv_apply
stmt:
theorem softmax_ce_fderiv_apply (s v : Fin k → ℝ) (y : Fin k) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => -Real.log (softmax z y)) s v
      = (∑ j, softmax s j * v j) - v y
proof:
by
  have hbridge : fderiv ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => -Real.log (softmax z y)) s v
      = deriv (fun t : ℝ => -Real.log (softmax (s + t • v) y)) 0 :=
    fderiv_apply_direction_fin (softmax_ce_differentiableAt s y)
  rw [hbridge]

name: softmax_ce_fderiv_eq_dot
stmt:
theorem softmax_ce_fderiv_eq_dot (s v : Fin k → ℝ) (y : Fin k) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : Fin k → ℝ => -Real.log (softmax z y)) s v
      = ∑ j, (softmax s j - (if j = y then 1 else 0)) * v j
proof:
by
  rw [softmax_ce_fderiv_apply s v y]
                                                        
  have hstep1 : ∑ j, (softmax s j - (if j = y then 1 else 0)) * v j
      = ∑ j, (softmax s j * v j - (if j = y then 1 else 0) * v j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    ring
  have hstep2 : ∑ j, (softmax s j * v j - (if j = y then 1 else 0) * v j)
      = (∑ j, softmax s j * v j) - ∑ j, (if j = y then 1 else 0) * v j := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hone : ∑ j, (if j = y then 1 else 0) * v j = v y := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single y (by
      intro b hb hby
      simp [hby]) (by
      intro hy
      exact False.elim (hy (Finset.mem_univ y)))]
    simp
  calc
    (∑ j, softmax s j * v j) - v y
        = (∑ j, softmax s j * v j) - ∑ j, (if j = y then 1 else 0) * v j := by rw [hone]
    _ = ∑ j, (softmax s j * v j - (if j = y then 1 else 0) * v j) := hstep2.symm
    _ = ∑ j, (softmax s j - (if j = y then 1 else 0)) * v j := hstep1.symm

name: channelComp
doc: 信道复合：(K∘L)_{ac} = Σ_b K_{ab}·L_{bc}。
stmt:
noncomputable def channelComp (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ) :
    Fin k → Fin m → ℝ
proof: fun a c => ∑ b, K a b * L b c

name: channelComp_row_sum
doc: 复合信道的行和仍为 1。
stmt:
lemma channelComp_row_sum (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) (hLr : ∀ b, ∑ c, L b c = 1) :
    ∀ a, ∑ c, channelComp K L a c = 1
proof:
by
  intro a
  simp only [channelComp]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have h : ∀ b, ∑ c, K a b * L b c = K a b := by
    intro b
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hLr b, mul_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => h b), hKr a]

name: channelComp_pos
doc: 复合信道仍严格正。
stmt:
lemma channelComp_pos [Nonempty (Fin l)] (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hL : ∀ b c, 0 < L b c) :
    ∀ a c, 0 < channelComp K L a c
proof:
by
  intro a c
  simp only [channelComp]
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun b _ => mul_pos (hK a b) (hL b c)) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: channelPush_comp
doc: 信道推前的函子性：(p·K)·L = p·(K∘L)。
stmt:
lemma channelPush_comp (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ) (p : Fin k → ℝ) :
    channelPush (channelComp K L) p = channelPush L (channelPush K p)
proof:
by
  funext c
  have hL : ∑ a, p a * (∑ b, K a b * L b c)
      = ∑ b, ∑ a, p a * (K a b * L b c) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => by rw [Finset.mul_sum]), Finset.sum_comm]
  have hR : ∑ b, (∑ a, p a * K a b) * L b c
      = ∑ b, ∑ a, (p a * K a b) * L b c :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by rw [Finset.sum_mul])
  simp only [channelPush, channelComp]
  rw [hL, hR]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  ring

name: channelPush_pos
stmt:
lemma channelPush_pos [Nonempty (Fin k)] (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (b : Fin l) : 0 < channelPush K p b
proof:
by
  simp only [channelPush]
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun a _ => mul_pos (hp a) (hK a b)) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: channelPush_sum
stmt:
lemma channelPush_sum (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1) :
    ∑ b, channelPush K p b = 1
proof:
by
  simp only [channelPush]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have h : ∀ a, ∑ b, p a * K a b = p a := by
    intro a
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hKr a, mul_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => h a), hps]

name: dp_chain
stmt:
theorem dp_chain (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (L : Fin l → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1)
    (hL : ∀ b c, 0 < L b c) (hLr : ∀ b, ∑ c, L b c = 1) :
    kl (channelPush (channelComp K L) p) (channelPush (channelComp K L) q) ≤ kl p q
proof:
by
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hps
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk⟩⟩
  rw [channelPush_comp K L p, channelPush_comp K L q]
  have hpK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K p b := fun b => channelPush_pos K p hp hK b
  have hpKs : ∑ b, channelPush K p b = 1 := channelPush_sum K p hKr hps
  have hqK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K q b := fun b => channelPush_pos K q hq hK b
  have hqKs : ∑ b, channelPush K q b = 1 := channelPush_sum K q hKr hqs
  calc kl (channelPush L (channelPush K p)) (channelPush L (channelPush K q))
      ≤ kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) :=
        dp_inequality (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) L hpK hpKs hqK hqKs hL hLr
    _ ≤ kl p q := dp_inequality p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr

name: channelPush_zero_col
doc: 若第 b 列整列为零，则推前分布的第 b 分量为零。
stmt:
lemma channelPush_zero_col (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p : Fin k → ℝ) (b : Fin l)
    (h : ∀ a, K a b = 0) : channelPush K p b = 0
proof:
by
  simp only [channelPush]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => by rw [h a, mul_zero])

name: dp_zero_column_term
doc: 零列的 KL 项为零：推前分布两侧在该分量都为零。
stmt:
lemma dp_zero_column_term (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (b : Fin l)
    (h : ∀ a, K a b = 0) :
    channelPush K p b = 0 ∧ channelPush K q b = 0 ∧
      channelPush K p b * Real.log (channelPush K p b / channelPush K q b) = 0
proof:
by
  have hp := channelPush_zero_col K p b h
  have hq := channelPush_zero_col K q b h
  refine ⟨hp, hq, ?_⟩
  rw [hp, zero_div, Real.log_zero, mul_zero]

name: ratioConstant
doc:
比值在信道的每个纤维上常值：
   对任意 b 与任意两个 K_{·b} > 0 的输入 a、a'，有 p_a/q_a = p_{a'}/q_{a'}。
stmt: def ratioConstant (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∀ b a a', 0 < K a b → 0 < K a' b → p a / q a = p a' / q a'

name: ratioFactorized
doc: 等价表述：存在 c : Fin l → ℝ，使 K_{ab} > 0 时 p_a/q_a = c_b（「因子化」）。
stmt: def ratioFactorized (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∃ c : Fin l → ℝ, ∀ a b, 0 < K a b → p a / q a = c b

name: ratioConstant_iff_ratioFactorized
doc: 两种表述等价（K 严格正、Fin k 非空时；否则空纤维赋予任意常数）。
stmt:
lemma ratioConstant_iff_ratioFactorized [Nonempty (Fin k)] (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) :
    ratioConstant K p q ↔ ratioFactorized K p q
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hrc
    refine ⟨fun b => p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)), ?_⟩
    intro a b _
    exact hrc b a (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) (hK a b) (hK _ b)
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩ b a a' ha ha'
    rw [hc a b ha, hc a' b ha']

name: dp_eq_of_ratio_constant
doc:
**DPI 等号刻画的（后向）方向**：比值在纤维上常值 ⟹ KL 不变。
证明：由常值性 (pK)_b = c_b·(qK)_b（c_b = p_{a₀}/q_{a₀}），故
(pK)_b/(qK)_b = c_b 与 b 无关地等于一个固定常数 c；
KL(pK‖qK) = Σ_b (pK)_b·log c = log c·Σ_b (pK)_b = log c，
KL(p‖q) = Σ_a p_a·log(p_a/q_a) = log c·Σ_a p_a = log c。两者相等。
stmt:
theorem dp_eq_of_ratio_constant (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1)
    (hrc : ratioConstant K p q) :
    kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) = kl p q
proof:
by
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hps
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk⟩⟩
  have hl : l ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    have h := hKr (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k))
    simp at h
  obtain ⟨b0⟩ : Nonempty (Fin l) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hl⟩⟩
         
  have hc : ∀ a, p a / q a = p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) :=
    fun a => hrc b0 a (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) (hK a b0) (hK _ b0)
                      
  have hratio : ∀ b, channelPush K p b
      = (p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k))) * channelPush K q b := by
    intro b
    simp only [channelPush]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    have h1 : p a
        = (p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k))) * q a :=
      calc p a = (p a / q a) * q a := (div_mul_cancel₀ (p a) (ne_of_gt (hq a))).symm
        _ = (p (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k)) / q (Classical.arbitrary (Fin k))) * q a := by
              rw [hc a]
    rw [h1]
    ring
  have hqK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K q b := fun b => channelPush_pos K q hq hK b
  have hpK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K p b := fun b => channelPush_pos K p hp hK b
  have hpKs : ∑ b, channelPush K p b = 1 := channelPush_sum K p hKr hps
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) hpK hqK, kl_as_sum_log_ratio p q hp hq]
  have hL : ∑ b, channelPush K p b * Real.log (channelPush K p b / channelPush K q b)
      = Real.log

name: dpGap
doc: DPI 的下降量（gap）：KL(p‖q) − KL(pK‖qK) ≥ 0。
stmt: noncomputable def dpGap (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: kl p q - kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q)

name: dp_gap_nonneg
stmt:
theorem dp_gap_nonneg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) :
    0 ≤ dpGap K p q
proof:
by
  have h := dp_inequality p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr
  unfold dpGap
  linarith

name: dp_strict_of_collapse
doc:
**DPI 的严格下降实例**：单输出信道（l = 1，K ≡ 1）把任意分布探塌为同一点分布，
    故 KL(pK‖qK) = 0；只要 p ≠ q，就有 KL(p‖q) > 0，于是 KL 严格下降。

这是「DPI 一般不是等号」的清晰证据，也是等号刻画正向方向的一个反例锚点。
stmt:
theorem dp_strict_of_collapse {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    kl (channelPush (fun (_ : Fin k) (_ : Fin 1) => (1 : ℝ)) p)
        (channelPush (fun (_ : Fin k) (_ : Fin 1) => (1 : ℝ)) q) < kl p q
proof:
by
  have hcolp : channelPush (fun (_ : Fin k) (_ : Fin 1) => (1 : ℝ)) p = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
    funext b
    simp only [channelPush, mul_one]
    exact hps
  have hcolq : channelPush (fun (_ : Fin k) (_ : Fin 1) => (1 : ℝ)) q = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
    funext b
    simp only [channelPush, mul_one]
    exact hqs
  rw [hcolp, hcolq,
    kl_eq_zero_of_eq (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ)) rfl]
  have hpos := kl_pos_of_ne p q hp hps hq hqs hpq
  linarith

end Lattice

name: logsum_eq_imp_ratio_one
doc:
**log-sum 函数的等号情形（核心工具）**。

设 `z, z' : ι → ℝ` 严格正，且 log-sum 不等式取等：
`(Σz)·log((Σz)/(Σz')) = Σ z·log(z/z')`。则对每个 i 有 `z_i·(Σz') = z'_i·(Σz)`，
即 `A_i := z_i·(Σz')/(z'_i·(Σz)) = 1`。

证明：令 `m = Σz`、`r = Σz'`、`A_i = z_i·r/(z'_i·m) > 0`。由 `RealDataProcessing.logsum_le`
证明内部的恒等式
  `Σ z_i·log A_i = (Σ z_i·log(z_i/z'_i)) − m·log(m/r)`，
取等给出 `Σ z_i·log A_i = 0`。另一方面
  `(A_i = 1) ⟺ log A_i = 1 − A_i⁻¹`（`RealEqualityCharacterization.log_eq_one_sub_inv_iff`），
且每项 `z_i·(1 − A_i⁻¹) ≤ z_i·log A_i`、`Σ z_i·(1 − A_i⁻¹) = 0`，
故差 `Σ (z_i·log A_i − z_i·(1 − A_i⁻¹)) = 0` 而非负逐项，每项为零；
`z_i > 0` 时 `log A_i = 1 − A_i⁻¹`，于是 `A_i = 1`。
stmt:
lemma logsum_eq_imp_ratio_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (z z' : ι → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 < z i) (hz' : ∀ i, 0 < z' i)
    (heq : (∑ i, z i) * Real.log ((∑ i, z i) / (∑ i, z' i))
      = ∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)) :
    ∀ i, z i * (∑ i, z' i) = z' i * (∑ i, z i)
proof:
by
  have hmpos : 0 < ∑ i, z i :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hrpos : 0 < ∑ i, z' i :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz' i) Finset.univ_nonempty

  set r : ℝ := ∑ i, z' i with hr

    fun i => div_pos (mul_pos (hz i) hrpos) (mul_pos (hz' i) hmpos)
  have hlogA : ∀ i, Real.log (A i)
      = (Real.log (z i) - Real.log (z' i)) + (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : A i = (z i / z' i) * (r / m) := by
      rw [hA]
      exact (div_mul_div_comm (z i) (z' i) r m).symm
    rw [h1, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos (hz i) (hz' i)))
        (ne_of_gt (div_pos hrpos hmpos)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hz i)) (ne_of_gt (hz' i)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hrpos) (ne_of_gt hmpos)]

      = (∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)) + m * (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    have hterm : ∀ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
        = z i * Real.log (z i / z' i) + z i * (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
      intro i
      rw [hlogA i, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hz i)) (ne_of_gt (hz' i))]
      ring
    calc ∑ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
        = ∑ i, (z i * Real.log (z i / z' i) + z i * (Real.log r - Real.log m)) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i)
      _ = (∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)) + ∑ i, z i * (Real.log r - Real.log m) :=
          Finset.sum_add_distrib
      _ = (∑ i

name: dp_eq_imp_eq
doc:
**DPI 等号刻画的（正向）方向**，强化形式：严格正信道、严格正概率向量下
`KL(pK‖qK) = KL(p‖q) ⟹ p = q`。

证明路线见文件头说明：逐通道 log-sum 取等（`logsum_eq_imp_ratio_one`）给出
`p_a·r_b = q_a·m_b`，对 b 求和并用 `Σ_b r_b = Σ_b m_b = 1` 收缩得 `p_a = q_a`。
stmt:
theorem dp_eq_imp_eq (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1)
    (heq : kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) = kl p q) :
    p = q
proof:
by
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hps
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk⟩⟩
                
  have hgap_b : ∀ b, 0 ≤ (∑ a, (p a * K a b) * Real.log ((p a * K a b) / (q a * K a b)))

name: dp_eq_imp_ratio_constant
doc:
**DPI 等号刻画的（正向）方向**：严格正信道下 KL 不变 ⟹
`RealDPIComplete.ratioConstant K p q`（比值 `p_a/q_a` 在每个信道的纤维上常值）。

由强化定理 `dp_eq_imp_eq`（得 `p = q`）平凡推出。
stmt:
theorem dp_eq_imp_ratio_constant (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1)
    (heq : kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) = kl p q) :
    ratioConstant K p q
proof:
by
  have hpq : p = q := dp_eq_imp_eq p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr heq
  intro b a a' _ _
  rw [hpq]
  rw [div_self (ne_of_gt (hq a)), div_self (ne_of_gt (hq a'))]

name: dp_eq_iff_ratio_constant
doc:
**DPI 等号刻画的完整 iff**（正向 + 后向）：严格正信道、严格正概率向量下
`KL(pK‖qK) = KL(p‖q) ⟺ ratioConstant K p q`。

正向是 `dp_eq_imp_ratio_constant`，后向是 `RealDPIComplete.dp_eq_of_ratio_constant`。
stmt:
theorem dp_eq_iff_ratio_constant (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKr : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) :
    kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) = kl p q ↔ ratioConstant K p q
proof:
⟨dp_eq_imp_ratio_constant p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr,
   dp_eq_of_ratio_constant p q K hp hps hq hqs hK hKr⟩

end Lattice

name: logsum_le
stmt:
lemma logsum_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (z z' : ι → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ i, 0 < z i) (hz' : ∀ i, 0 < z' i) :
    (∑ i, z i) * Real.log ((∑ i, z i) / (∑ i, z' i))
      ≤ ∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)
proof:
by
  have hmpos : 0 < ∑ i, z i :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hrpos : 0 < ∑ i, z' i :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hz' i) Finset.univ_nonempty

  set r : ℝ := ∑ i, z' i with hr

  have hApos : ∀ i, 0 < A i :=
    fun i => div_pos (mul_pos (hz i) hrpos) (mul_pos (hz' i) hmpos)
  have hlogA : ∀ i, Real.log (A i)
      = (Real.log (z i) - Real.log (z' i)) + (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : A i = (z i / z' i) * (r / m) := by
      rw [hA]
      exact (div_mul_div_comm (z i) (z' i) r m).symm
    rw [h1, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos (hz i) (hz' i))) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hrpos hmpos)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hz i)) (ne_of_gt (hz' i)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hrpos) (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
  have hsplit : ∑ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
      = (∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)) + m * (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    have hterm : ∀ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
        = z i * Real.log (z i / z' i) + z i * (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
      intro i
      rw [hlogA i, Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hz i)) (ne_of_gt (hz' i))]
      ring
    calc ∑ i, z i * Real.log (A i)
        = ∑ i, (z i * Real.log (z i / z' i) + z i * (Real.log r - Real.log m)) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i)
      _ = (∑ i, z i * Real.log (z i / z' i)) + ∑ i, z i * (Real.log r - Real.log m) :=
          Finset.sum_add_distrib
      _ = (∑ i, z i *

name: dp_inequality
stmt:
theorem dp_inequality (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqs : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKrow : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) :
    kl (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) ≤ kl p q
proof:
by
  have hexp : ∃ a, p a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ a, p a = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => h a)
    rw [hps] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  have hexq : ∃ a, q a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ a, q a = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => h a)
    rw [hqs] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hps
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk⟩⟩
  have hpK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K p b := by
    obtain ⟨a0, ha0⟩ := hexp
    intro b
    have h : 0 < ∑ a, p a * K a b :=
      Finset.sum_pos (fun a _ => mul_pos (hp a) (hK a b)) ⟨a0, Finset.mem_univ a0⟩
    simpa [channelPush] using h
  have hqK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K q b := by
    obtain ⟨a0, ha0⟩ := hexq
    intro b
    have h : 0 < ∑ a, q a * K a b :=
      Finset.sum_pos (fun a _ => mul_pos (hq a) (hK a b)) ⟨a0, Finset.mem_univ a0⟩
    simpa [channelPush] using h
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) hpK hqK,
    kl_as_sum_log_ratio p q hp hq]
  calc ∑ b, channelPush K p b * Real.log (channelPush K p b / channelPush K q b)
      = ∑ b, (∑ a, p a * K a b)
          * Real.log ((∑ a, p a * K a b) / (∑ a, q a * K a b)) := by
        simp only [channelPush]
    _ ≤ ∑ b, ∑ a, (p a * K a b) * Real.log ((p a * K a b) / (q a * K a b)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro b _
        exact logsum_le (fun a => p a * K a b) (fun a => q a * K a b)
          (fun a => mul_pos (hp a) (hK a b

name: tv_eq_sum_abs
stmt:
lemma tv_eq_sum_abs (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) :
    tv p q = ∑ a, |q a - p a|
proof:
by
  unfold tv fDivergence
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  have h2 : p a * (q a / p a - 1) = q a - p a := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp a)]
  calc p a * |q a / p a - 1| = |p a * (q a / p a - 1)| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (hp a)]
    _ = |q a - p a| := by rw [h2]

name: tv_data_processing
stmt:
theorem tv_data_processing (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (K : Fin k → Fin l → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hps : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hK : ∀ a b, 0 < K a b) (hKrow : ∀ a, ∑ b, K a b = 1) :
    tv (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) ≤ tv p q
proof:
by
  have hexp : ∃ a, p a ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ a, p a = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => h a)
    rw [hps] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  obtain ⟨a0, ha0⟩ := hexp
  have hpK : ∀ b, 0 < channelPush K p b := by
    intro b
    have h : 0 < ∑ a, p a * K a b :=
      Finset.sum_pos (fun a _ => mul_pos (hp a) (hK a b)) ⟨a0, Finset.mem_univ a0⟩
    simpa [channelPush] using h
  rw [tv_eq_sum_abs (channelPush K p) (channelPush K q) hpK, tv_eq_sum_abs p q hp]
  calc ∑ b, |channelPush K q b - channelPush K p b|
      = ∑ b, |∑ a, (q a - p a) * K a b| := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro b _
        congr 1
        simp only [channelPush]
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        ring
    _ ≤ ∑ b, ∑ a, |q a - p a| * K a b := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro b _
        calc |∑ a, (q a - p a) * K a b| ≤ ∑ a, |(q a - p a) * K a b| := by
              simpa using (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (s := Finset.univ)
                (f := fun a => (q a - p a) * K a b))
          _ ≤ ∑ a, |q a - p a| * K a b := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro a _
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (hK a b))]
    _ = ∑ a, |q a - p a| := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hKrow a, mul_one]

end Lattice

name: sum_partition
stmt:
lemma sum_partition (f : ι → F) (S : Finset ι) :
    ∑ i, f i = ∑ i in S, f i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, f i
proof:
by
                              
  have hunion : (Finset.univ : Finset ι) = S ∪ (Finset.univ \ S) := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ S
    · simp [hi]
    · simp [hi]
  calc
    ∑ i, f i = ∑ i in S ∪ (Finset.univ \ S), f i := by rw [← hunion]
    _ = ∑ i in S, f i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, f i := by
      exact Finset.sum_union disjoint_sdiff_self_right

name: renorm_diff
stmt:
lemma renorm_diff (pᵢ Z : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ pᵢ) (hZ : 0 < Z) (hZle : Z ≤ 1) :
    |pᵢ - pᵢ / Z| = pᵢ * (1 - Z) / Z
proof:
by
                                       
  have hneg : pᵢ - pᵢ / Z = -(pᵢ * (1 - Z) / Z) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hZ]
    ring
  rw [hneg, abs_neg]
                                             
  have hge : 0 ≤ pᵢ * (1 - Z) / Z := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ 1 - Z := by linarith
    have hprod : 0 ≤ pᵢ * (1 - Z) := mul_nonneg hp h1
    exact div_nonneg hprod (le_of_lt hZ)
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hge]

name: dropped_mass_bound
stmt:
theorem dropped_mass_bound (p : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (S : Finset ι) (Z M : ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hsum : ∑ i, p i = 1)
    (hZ : Z = ∑ i in S, p i) (hZ0 : 0 < Z) (hZ1 : Z ≤ 1)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖fullAttn p v - sparseAttn p v S Z‖ ≤ 2 * M * (1 - Z)
proof:
by
          
  have hdiff : fullAttn p v - sparseAttn p v S Z =
      ∑ i in S, (p i - p i / Z) • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i := by
    unfold fullAttn sparseAttn
                                                                   
    calc
      (∑ i, p i • v i) - (∑ i in S, (p i / Z) • v i)
          = (∑ i in S, p i • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i) - (∑ i in S, (p i / Z) • v i) := by
                          
            rw [← sum_partition (fun i => p i • v i) S]
        _ = (∑ i in S, p i • v i - ∑ i in S, (p i / Z) • v i) + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i := by
                                               
            abel
        _ = ∑ i in S, (p i - p i / Z) • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i := by
                                                            
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            apply congrArg (fun x => x + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i)
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            rw [← sub_smul]
  rw [hdiff]
            
  calc
    ‖∑ i in S, (p i - p i / Z) • v i + ∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i‖
        ≤ ‖∑ i in S, (p i - p i / Z) • v i‖ + ‖∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i • v i‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ i in S, ‖(p i - p i / Z) • v i‖) + (∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, ‖p i • v i‖) := by
      exact add_le_add (norm_sum_le _ _) (norm_sum_le _ _)
    _ ≤ (∑ i in S, p i * (1 - Z) / Z * M) + (∑ i in Finset.univ \ S, p i * M) := by

name: elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl
stmt:
theorem elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) (hq : ∀ z, 0 < q z) (hqs : ∑ z, q z = 1) :
    elbo p q = Real.log (∑ z, p z) - kl q (posterior p)
proof:
by
  have hSpos : 0 < ∑ z, p z := Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hp i) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hSne : (∑ z, p z) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hSpos
  have hpost_pos : ∀ z, 0 < posterior p z := posterior_pos p hp
  have hpost_sum : ∑ z, posterior p z = 1 := posterior_sum p hp
               
  have hkl := kl_as_sum_log_ratio q (posterior p) hq hpost_pos
                                                
  have hratio : ∀ z, Real.log (q z / posterior p z)
      = Real.log (q z) - Real.log (p z) + Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
    intro z
    have h1 : q z / posterior p z = (q z * (∑ z, p z)) / p z := by
      unfold posterior
      field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp z), hSne]
    rw [h1, Real.log_div (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (hq z)) hSne) (ne_of_gt (hp z)),
      Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (hq z)) hSne]
    ring
             
  have hsum : ∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z / posterior p z)
      = (∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z)) - (∑ z, q z * Real.log (p z))
        + (∑ z, q z) * Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
    have hterm : ∀ z, q z * Real.log (q z / posterior p z)
        = (q z * Real.log (q z) - q z * Real.log (p z))
          + q z * Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
      intro z
      rw [hratio z]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => hterm z), Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]
  have helbo : elbo p q
      = (∑ z, q z * Real.log (p z)) - (∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z)) := by
    unfold elbo
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro z _
    ring
  r

stmt:

name: elbo_tight_iff
stmt:
theorem elbo_tight_iff [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) (hq : ∀ z, 0 < q z) (hqs : ∑ z, q z = 1) :
    elbo p q = Real.log (∑ z, p z) ↔ q = posterior p
proof:
by
  have hpost_pos : ∀ z, 0 < posterior p z := posterior_pos p hp
  have hpost_sum : ∑ z, posterior p z = 1 := posterior_sum p hp
  have hz := kl_zero_iff_eq q (posterior p) hq hqs hpost_pos hpost_sum
  have hpost_eq : elbo p (posterior p) = Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
    rw [elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl p (posterior p) hp hpost_pos hpost_sum,
      kl_eq_zero_of_eq (posterior p) (posterior p) rfl]
    ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply hz.mp
    linarith [elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl p q hp hq hqs]
  · intro h

name: em_posterior_optimal
stmt:
theorem em_posterior_optimal [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ z, 0 < p z) (hq : ∀ z, 0 < q z) (hqs : ∑ z, q z = 1) :
    elbo p q ≤ elbo p (posterior p) ∧ (elbo p q = elbo p (posterior p) ↔ q = posterior p)
proof:
by
  have hpost_pos : ∀ z, 0 < posterior p z := posterior_pos p hp
  have hpost_sum : ∑ z, posterior p z = 1 := posterior_sum p hp
  have h1 : elbo p q ≤ Real.log (∑ z, p z) := elbo_le_log_marginal p q hp hq hqs
  have h2 : elbo p (posterior p) = Real.log (∑ z, p z) := by
    rw [elbo_eq_log_marginal_sub_kl p (posterior p) hp hpost_pos hpost_sum,
      kl_eq_zero_of_eq (posterior p) (posterior p) rfl]
    ring
  constructor
  · rw [h2]; exact h1
  · rw [h2]
    exact elbo_tight_iff p q hp hq hqs

name: elbo_eq_sum_log_p_add_entropy
stmt:
theorem elbo_eq_sum_log_p_add_entropy (p q : Fin k → ℝ) :
    elbo p q = (∑ z, q z * Real.log (p z)) + entropy q
proof:
by
  have h1 : entropy q = -∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z) := rfl
  have h2 : ∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z) = -entropy q := by
    rw [h1]; ring
  have h3 : elbo p q
      = (∑ z, q z * Real.log (p z)) - (∑ z, q z * Real.log (q z)) := by
    unfold elbo
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro z _
    ring
  rw [h3, h2]
  ring

end Lattice

name: mix
doc: 混合分布：r_a = lam·p_a + (1−lam)·q_a（p、q 的凸组合）。
stmt: def mix {k : ℕ} (lam : ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : Fin k → ℝ
proof: fun a => lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a

name: mix_is_pmf
stmt:
theorem mix_is_pmf {k : ℕ} (lam : ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    (∀ a, 0 ≤ mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro a
    unfold mix
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hlam0 (hp0 a)) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlam1) (hq0 a))
  · unfold mix
    calc
      (∑ a, (lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a))
          = (∑ a, lam * p a) + ∑ a, (1 - lam) * q a := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ = lam * (∑ a, p a) + (1 - lam) * (∑ a, q a) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = lam * 1 + (1 - lam) * 1 := by rw [hpsum, hqsum]
      _ = 1 := by ring

name: mix_pos
stmt:
lemma mix_pos {k : ℕ} (lam : ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) : ∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a
proof:
by
  intro a
  unfold mix
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlam0 with hlamz | hlamgt
  ·                 
    subst lam
    simpa using (hq0 a)
  ·                            
    have h1 : 0 < lam * p a := mul_pos hlamgt (hp0 a)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (1 - lam) * q a := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlam1) (le_of_lt (hq0 a))
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (le_add_of_nonneg_right h2)

name: mix_pmf_strict
stmt:
lemma mix_pmf_strict {k : ℕ} (lam : ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    (∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1
proof:
by
  constructor
  · exact mix_pos lam p q hlam0 hlam1 hp0 hq0
  · exact (mix_is_pmf lam p q hlam0 hlam1 (fun a => le_of_lt (hp0 a)) hpsum
      (fun a => le_of_lt (hq0 a)) hqsum).2

name: entropy_mix_identity
stmt:
theorem entropy_mix_identity {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) :
    entropy (mix lam p q)
      = lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q
          + lam * kl p (mix lam p q) + (1 - lam) * kl q (mix lam p q)
proof:
by
  let r : Fin k → ℝ := mix lam p q
                                                                                                   
  have hsimple : lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q + lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r
      = lam * crossEntropy p r + (1 - lam) * crossEntropy q r := by
    unfold kl
    ring
                                         
  have hmain : entropy r = lam * crossEntropy p r + (1 - lam) * crossEntropy q r := by
                                  
    have hra : ∀ a, r a = lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a := by
      intro a
      rfl
                                                                      
    have hsum : (∑ a, r a * Real.log (r a))
        = lam * (∑ a, p a * Real.log (r a))
            + (1 - lam) * (∑ a, q a * Real.log (r a)) := by
      calc
        (∑ a, r a * Real.log (r a))
            = ∑ a, (lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a) * Real.log (r a) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro a ha
              rw [hra a]
        _ = ∑ a, (lam * (p a * Real.log (r a))
              + (1 - lam) * (q a * Real.log (r a))) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro a ha
              ring
        _ = (∑ a, lam * (p a * Real.log (r a)))
            + ∑ a, (1 - lam) * (q a * Real.log (r a)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = lam * (∑ a, p a * Real.log (r a))
            + (1 - lam) * (∑ a, q a * Real.log (r a)) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]

name: entropy_concave
stmt:
theorem entropy_concave {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (lam : ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q ≤ entropy (mix lam p q)
proof:
by
  let r : Fin k → ℝ := mix lam p q
  have hpmf : (∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1 :=
    mix_pmf_strict lam p q hlam0 hlam1 hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum
  have hr0 : ∀ a, 0 < r a := by
    intro a
    exact (hpmf.1) a
  have hrs : ∑ a, r a = 1 := hpmf.2
  have hklp : 0 ≤ kl p r := kl_nonneg p r hp0 hpsum hr0 hrs
  have hklq : 0 ≤ kl q r := kl_nonneg q r hq0 hqsum hr0 hrs
  have hident := entropy_mix_identity p q lam
  have hident' : entropy r =
      lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q + lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r := by
    simpa [r] using hident
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r := by
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hlam0 hklp) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlam1) hklq)
  rw [hident']
  linarith

name: kl_pos_of_ne
stmt:
lemma kl_pos_of_ne {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) (hpq : p ≠ q) : 0 < kl p q
proof:
by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ kl p q := kl_nonneg p q hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum
  have hneq : kl p q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact hpq ((kl_zero_iff_eq p q hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum).mp hz)
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hnonneg (Ne.symm hneq)

name: entropy_concavity_strict
stmt:
theorem entropy_concavity_strict {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (lam : ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hlam0 : 0 < lam) (hlam1 : lam < 1) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q < entropy (mix lam p q)
proof:
by
  let r : Fin k → ℝ := mix lam p q
  have hpmf : (∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1 :=
    mix_pmf_strict lam p q (le_of_lt hlam0) (le_of_lt hlam1) hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum
  have hr0 : ∀ a, 0 < r a := by
    intro a
    exact (hpmf.1) a
  have hrs : ∑ a, r a = 1 := hpmf.2
                                                                      
  have hpne_r : p ≠ r := by
    intro hpr
    apply hpq
    funext a
    have hpa : p a = r a := congrFun hpr a
    have hra : r a = lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a := by rfl
    have hmain : p a = lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a := by rwa [hra] at hpa
    have hmul : (1 - lam) * p a = (1 - lam) * q a := by
      calc
        (1 - lam) * p a = p a - lam * p a := by ring
        _ = (lam * p a + (1 - lam) * q a) - lam * p a := by
              nth_rewrite 1 [hmain]
              rfl
        _ = (1 - lam) * q a := by ring
    have hsub : (1 - lam) * (p a - q a) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_sub, hmul, sub_self]
    rcases (mul_eq_zero.mp hsub) with h1 | hdiff
    · exfalso
      exact (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm (ne_of_lt hlam1))) h1
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff
  have hklp_pos : 0 < kl p r := kl_pos_of_ne p r hp0 hpsum hr0 hrs hpne_r
  have hklq_nonneg : 0 ≤ kl q r := kl_nonneg q r hq0 hqsum hr0 hrs
  have hident := entropy_mix_identity p q lam
  have hident' : entropy r =
      lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q + lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r := by
    simpa [r] using hident
  have hgt : 0 < lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r :

name: entropy_concavity_eq_iff
stmt:
theorem entropy_concavity_eq_iff {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (lam : ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    entropy (mix lam p q) = lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q
      ↔ lam = 0 ∨ lam = 1 ∨ p = q
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_cases h0 : lam = 0
    · exact Or.inl h0
    · right
      by_cases h1 : lam = 1
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · right
                      
        have hlamgt : 0 < lam := lt_of_le_of_ne hlam0 (by intro hz; exact h0 hz.symm)
        have hlamlt : lam < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hlam1 h1
        let r : Fin k → ℝ := mix lam p q
        have hpmf : (∀ a, 0 < mix lam p q a) ∧ ∑ a, mix lam p q a = 1 :=
          mix_pmf_strict lam p q (le_of_lt hlamgt) (le_of_lt hlamlt) hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum
        have hr0 : ∀ a, 0 < r a := by
          intro a
          exact (hpmf.1) a
        have hrs : ∑ a, r a = 1 := hpmf.2
        have hident := entropy_mix_identity p q lam
        have hident' : entropy r =
            lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q + lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r := by
          simpa [r] using hident
        have h : entropy r = lam * entropy p + (1 - lam) * entropy q := by
          simpa [r] using heq
                                                 
        have hdiff : lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r = 0 := by
          rw [hident'] at h
          linarith
        have hklp0 : 0 ≤ kl p r := kl_nonneg p r hp0 hpsum hr0 hrs
        have hklq0 : 0 ≤ kl q r := kl_nonneg q r hq0 hqsum hr0 hrs
                           
        have hterm1 : lam * kl p r = 0 := by
          have hle1 : lam * kl p r ≤ lam * kl p r + (1 - lam) * kl q r :=
            le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hlamlt)) hklq0

name: fDivergence
doc: f-散度：D_f(p‖q) = Σ_a p_a·f(q_a / p_a)。
stmt: noncomputable def fDivergence (f : ℝ → ℝ) (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, p a * f (q a / p a)

name: mul_div_self
stmt: lemma mul_div_self (a b : ℝ) (hb : b ≠ 0) : b * (a / b) = a
proof:
by
  rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hb]

name: fdiv_nonneg_of_convex
stmt:
theorem fdiv_nonneg_of_convex {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f) (hf1 : f 1 = 0)
    (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ q a)
    (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    0 ≤ fDivergence f p q
proof:
by
  have hxmem : ∀ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)), q a / p a ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro a _
    exact div_nonneg (hq0 a) (le_of_lt (hp0 a))
  have hjen : f (∑ a, p a • (q a / p a)) ≤ ∑ a, p a • f (q a / p a) :=
    hconv.map_sum_le (t := Finset.univ) (w := fun a => p a) (p := fun a => q a / p a)
      (fun a _ => le_of_lt (hp0 a)) hpsum hxmem
  have hleft : ∑ a, p a • (q a / p a) = 1 := by
    have h1 : ∀ a : Fin k, p a • (q a / p a) = q a := by
      intro a
      rw [smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_div_self (q a) (p a) (ne_of_gt (hp0 a))
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => h1 a)]
    exact hqsum
  have hright : ∑ a, p a • f (q a / p a) = fDivergence f p q := by
    unfold fDivergence
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    0 = f 1 := hf1.symm
    _ = f (∑ a, p a • (q a / p a)) := by rw [hleft]
    _ ≤ ∑ a, p a • f (q a / p a) := hjen
    _ = fDivergence f p q := hright

name: chiSq
doc: χ² 散度：D(p‖q) = Σ_a p_a·(q_a/p_a − 1)²。
stmt: noncomputable def chiSq (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: fDivergence (fun t => (t - 1) ^ 2) p q

name: chiSq_nonneg
doc:
χ² 散度非负：逐项 p_a ≥ 0 与平方 ≥ 0 直接得（也由 `fdiv_nonneg_of_convex` 得，
此处给出不依赖凸性引理名的直接证明）。
stmt: theorem chiSq_nonneg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) : 0 ≤ chiSq p q
proof:
by
  unfold chiSq fDivergence
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => mul_nonneg (hp0 a) (sq_nonneg _))

name: tv
doc: 全变差型散度：D(p‖q) = Σ_a p_a·|q_a/p_a − 1|。
stmt: noncomputable def tv (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: fDivergence (fun t => |t - 1|) p q

name: tv_nonneg
doc: 全变差非负：逐项非负直接得。
stmt: theorem tv_nonneg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) : 0 ≤ tv p q
proof:
by
  unfold tv fDivergence
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => mul_nonneg (hp0 a) (abs_nonneg _))

name: kl_as_fdiv
stmt:
theorem kl_as_fdiv (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) :
    fDivergence (fun t => t * Real.log t) q p = kl p q
proof:
by
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio p q hp0 hq0]
  unfold fDivergence
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  calc
    q a * ((p a / q a) * Real.log (p a / q a))
        = (q a * (p a / q a)) * Real.log (p a / q a) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = p a * Real.log (p a / q a) := by
          rw [mul_div_self (p a) (q a) (ne_of_gt (hq0 a))]

name: kl_fdiv_nonneg
doc: KL 实例的 f-散度非负（由 `kl_nonneg` 直接转写）。
stmt:
theorem kl_fdiv_nonneg (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    0 ≤ fDivergence (fun t => t * Real.log t) q p
proof:
by
  rw [kl_as_fdiv p q hp0 hq0]
  exact kl_nonneg p q hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum

end Lattice

name: score
doc: score 函数：score_p,θ(a) = ∂_θ log p_θ(a)。
stmt: noncomputable def score (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin k) : ℝ
proof: deriv (fun t => Real.log (p t a)) θ

name: fisherInfo
doc: Fisher 信息（一维参数）：F(θ) = Σ_a p_θ(a)·score_p,θ(a)²。
stmt: noncomputable def fisherInfo (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2

name: fisher_nonneg
stmt:
theorem fisher_nonneg (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hp : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p θ a) :
    0 ≤ fisherInfo p θ
proof:
by
  unfold fisherInfo
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => mul_nonneg (hp a) (sq_nonneg _))

name: score_log_derivative
stmt:
theorem score_log_derivative (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (a : Fin k) (hpos : 0 < p θ a)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => p t a) θ) :
    deriv (fun t => p t a) θ = p θ a * score p θ a
proof: log_derivative_identity (fun t => p t a) θ hpos hd

name: fisher_score_mean_zero
stmt:
theorem fisher_score_mean_zero (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hsum : ∀ t, ∑ a, p t a = 1)
    (hpos : ∀ a, 0 < p θ a)
    (hd : ∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => p t a) θ) :
    ∑ a, p θ a * score p θ a = 0
proof:
by
  have hconst : (fun t : ℝ => ∑ a, p t a) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
    funext t
    exact hsum t
  have hderiv0 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∑ a, p t a) θ = 0 := by
    rw [hconst]
    simp
  have hsumderiv : deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∑ a, p t a) θ
      = ∑ a, deriv (fun t : ℝ => p t a) θ :=
    deriv_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun a (t : ℝ) => p t a)
      (by intro a _; exact hd a)
  have hper : ∀ a, deriv (fun t : ℝ => p t a) θ = p θ a * score p θ a :=
    fun a => score_log_derivative p θ a (hpos a) (hd a)
  rw [hsumderiv] at hderiv0
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hper a)] at hderiv0
  exact hderiv0

name: fisher_equals_second_derivative
stmt:
theorem fisher_equals_second_derivative (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ a, 0 < p θ a)
    (hsecond : ∀ a, deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => Real.log (p s a)) t) θ
        = deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ / p θ a - (score p θ a) ^ 2)
    (hsum_second : ∑ a, deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ = 0) :
    fisherInfo p θ
      = -∑ a, p θ a * deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => Real.log (p s a)) t) θ
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ a, p θ a * deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => Real.log (p s a)) t) θ
      = deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ - p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2 := by
    intro a
    rw [hsecond a]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (hp a)]
  have hS3 : ∑ a, p θ a * deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => Real.log (p s a)) t) θ
      = ∑ a, (deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ
          - p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hterm a)
  have hsplit : ∑ a, (deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ
        - p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2)
      = ∑ a, deriv (fun t => deriv (fun s => p s a) t) θ
        - ∑ a, p θ a * (score p θ a) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib
  unfold fisherInfo
  linarith [hS3, hsplit, hsum_second]

name: naturalGradient
doc: 自然梯度（一维）：F⁻¹·g。
stmt: noncomputable def naturalGradient (F g : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: g / F

name: quad_complete_square
doc: 配方法（二次型的完全平方）。
stmt:
lemma quad_complete_square (F g v : ℝ) (hF : F ≠ 0) :
    g * v - (F / 2) * v ^ 2 = g ^ 2 / (2 * F) - (F / 2) * (v - g / F) ^ 2
proof:
by
  field_simp [hF]
  ring

name: quad_at_naturalGradient
doc: 自然梯度处的二次型值。
stmt:
lemma quad_at_naturalGradient (F g : ℝ) (hF : F ≠ 0) :
    g * (naturalGradient F g) - (F / 2) * (naturalGradient F g) ^ 2 = g ^ 2 / (2 * F)
proof:
by
  unfold naturalGradient
  field_simp [hF]
  ring

name: natural_gradient_maximizes_quadratic
doc:
自然梯度是 Fisher 度量下二次型的最速下降方向：
F > 0 时 v* = g/F 最大化 v ↦ g·v − (F/2)·v²。
g = −∇J 时「最大化 g·v − (F/2)v²」即「最小化 ∇J·v + (F/2)v²」，
即 Fisher 度量 ‖v‖²_F = F·v² 下的最速下降。
stmt:
theorem natural_gradient_maximizes_quadratic (F g : ℝ) (hF : 0 < F) :
    ∀ v : ℝ,
      g * v - (F / 2) * v ^ 2
        ≤ g * (naturalGradient F g) - (F / 2) * (naturalGradient F g) ^ 2
proof:
by
  intro v
  have hFne : F ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hF
  rw [quad_complete_square F g v hFne, quad_at_naturalGradient F g hFne]
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (F / 2) * (v - g / F) ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (le_of_lt hF) (by norm_num)) (sq_nonneg _)
  linarith

name: natural_gradient_maximizes_quadratic_iff
doc: 最速下降刻画的等号情形：二次型取到最大值 ⟺ v 恰是自然梯度 v* = g/F。
stmt:
theorem natural_gradient_maximizes_quadratic_iff (F g : ℝ) (hF : 0 < F) (v : ℝ) :
    (g * v - (F / 2) * v ^ 2
        = g * (naturalGradient F g) - (F / 2) * (naturalGradient F g) ^ 2)
      ↔ v = naturalGradient F g
proof:
by
  have hFne : F ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hF
  have hF2 : (F / 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [quad_complete_square F g v hFne, quad_at_naturalGradient F g hFne]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hmul : (F / 2) * (v - g / F) ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have hsq : (v - g / F) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with h1 | h2
      · exact absurd h1 hF2
      · exact h2
    have hv : v - g / F = 0 := pow_eq_zero hsq
    unfold naturalGradient
    linarith
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    unfold naturalGradient
    ring

name: fisher_cramer_rao
stmt:
theorem fisher_cramer_rao (p : ℝ → Fin k → ℝ) (T : Fin k → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)

      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
