name: kl
doc: KL 散度（相对熵）：KL(p‖q) = CE(p,q) − H(p) = Σ_a p_a·log(p_a/q_a)。
stmt: noncomputable def kl {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: crossEntropy p q - entropy p

name: kl_eq_ce_sub_entropy
doc: 定义桥：KL(p‖q) = CE(p,q) − H(p)（按定义即证）。
stmt:
theorem kl_eq_ce_sub_entropy {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) :
    kl p q = crossEntropy p q - entropy p
proof: rfl

name: kl_as_sum_log_sub_log
stmt:
lemma kl_as_sum_log_sub_log {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) :
    kl p q = ∑ a, p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a))
proof:
by
  unfold kl entropy
  rw [ce_sum_neg p q, ce_sum_neg p p]
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  ring

name: kl_as_sum_log_ratio
stmt:
theorem kl_as_sum_log_ratio {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) : kl p q = ∑ a, p a * Real.log (p a / q a)
proof:
by
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_sub_log p q]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hp0 a)) (ne_of_gt (hq0 a))]

name: kl_nonneg
stmt:
theorem kl_nonneg {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) : 0 ≤ kl p q
proof:
by
  unfold kl
  have hge : entropy p ≤ crossEntropy p q := ce_ge_entropy p q hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum
  linarith

name: kl_term_ge
stmt:
lemma kl_term_ge {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) :
    ∀ a, p a - q a ≤ p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a))
proof: fun a => gibbs_ineq (hp0 a) (hq0 a)

name: kl_zero_iff_support
stmt:
theorem kl_zero_iff_support {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    kl p q = 0 ↔ ∀ a, p a = 0 ∨ q a = p a
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ a, p a - q a ≤ p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a)) :=
    kl_term_ge p q hp0 hq0
  have hsumdiff : ∑ a, (p a - q a) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hpsum, hqsum]
    simp
  have hdiff0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a)) - (p a - q a) := by
    intro a
    linarith [hterm a]
  constructor
  · intro hkl
    have hsum0 : ∑ a, (p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a)) - (p a - q a)) = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← kl_as_sum_log_sub_log p q, hkl, hsumdiff]
      ring
    have hz : ∀ a, p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a)) - (p a - q a) = 0 := by
      have hall := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun a _ => hdiff0 a)).mp hsum0
      intro a
      exact hall a (Finset.mem_univ a)
    intro a
    by_cases hpa : p a = 0
    · exact Or.inl hpa
    · right
      have hpa' : 0 < p a := lt_of_le_of_ne (hp0 a) (Ne.symm hpa)
      have heqterm : p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a)) = p a - q a := by linarith [hz a]
      have hlogeq : Real.log (p a / q a) = 1 - (p a / q a)⁻¹ := by
        have hd : Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a) = (p a - q a) / p a := by
          calc
            Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a) = (p a * (Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a))) / p a := by
              field_simp [ne_of_gt hpa']
            _ = (p a - q a) / p a := by rw [heqterm]
        have hd2 : (p a - q a) / p a = 1 - q a / p a := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hpa']
        have h1 : Real.log (p a) - Real.log (q a) = 1 - q a / p a := by

name: kl_zero_iff_eq
stmt:
theorem kl_zero_iff_eq {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a)
    (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1) (hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < q a) (hqsum : ∑ a, q a = 1) :
    kl p q = 0 ↔ p = q
proof:
by
  have hsupp : kl p q = 0 ↔ ∀ a, p a = 0 ∨ q a = p a :=
    kl_zero_iff_support p q (fun a => le_of_lt (hp0 a)) hpsum hq0 hqsum
  constructor
  · intro hkl
    have h : ∀ a, p a = 0 ∨ q a = p a := hsupp.mp hkl
    funext a
    rcases h a with hpa | hqa
    · exfalso
      linarith [hp0 a]
    · exact hqa.symm
  · intro hpq
    rw [hpq]
    unfold kl entropy
    ring

name: kl_eq_zero_of_eq
stmt: theorem kl_eq_zero_of_eq {k : ℕ} (p q : Fin k → ℝ) (hpq : p = q) : kl p q = 0
proof:
by
  rw [hpq]
  unfold kl entropy
  ring

name: kl_onehot
stmt:
theorem kl_onehot {k : ℕ} (y : Fin k) (q : Fin k → ℝ) (hq : 0 < q y) :
    kl (onehot y) q = -Real.log (q y)
proof:
by
  unfold kl entropy
  rw [ce_onehot_eq_neg_log y q hq]
  have hq1 : 0 < onehot y y := by simp [onehot]
  rw [ce_onehot_eq_neg_log y (onehot y) hq1]
  simp [onehot, Real.log_one]

name: kl_softmax_pmf
stmt:
theorem kl_softmax_pmf {k : ℕ} [Nonempty (Fin k)] (p s : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 < p a) (hpsum : ∑ a, p a = 1) : 0 ≤ kl p (softmax s)
proof:
by
  have hq0 : ∀ a, 0 < softmax s a := softmax_pos s
  have hqsum : ∑ a, softmax s a = 1 := softmax_sum_one s
  exact kl_nonneg p (softmax s) hp0 hpsum hq0 hqsum

end Lattice

name: klJoint
doc: **联合 KL 散度**（有限支撑）：`KL(p‖q) = Σ_{a,b} p_ab·log(p_ab / q_ab)`。
stmt: noncomputable def klJoint (p q : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (p a b / q a b)

name: klJointMarginal
doc: **边缘（行）KL 散度**：`KL(p_X‖q_X) = Σ_a mr_a·log(mr_a / mr'_a)`。
stmt: noncomputable def klJointMarginal (p q : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ a, marginalRow p a * Real.log (marginalRow p a / marginalRow q a)

name: klConditional
doc: **条件 KL 散度**：`KL(p(y|a)‖q(y|a)) = Σ_b (p_ab/mr_a)·log((p_ab/mr_a)/(q_ab/mr'_a))`。
stmt: noncomputable def klConditional (p q : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (a : Fin m) : ℝ
proof:
∑ b, (p a b / marginalRow p a)
    * Real.log ((p a b / marginalRow p a) / (q a b / marginalRow q a))

name: log_ratio_decomposition
doc:
**逐点 log 恒等式**：`log(p_b/q_b) = log((p_b/r)/(q_b/r')) + log(r/r')`。
由乘法恒等式 `((p/r)/(q/r'))·(r/r') = p/q` 与 `Real.log_mul` 逆用得到。
stmt:
lemma log_ratio_decomposition {pb qb r r' : ℝ} (hp : pb ≠ 0) (hq : qb ≠ 0)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hr' : r' ≠ 0) :
    Real.log (pb / qb)
      = Real.log ((pb / r) / (qb / r')) + Real.log (r / r')
proof:
by
  have h1 : (pb / r) / (qb / r') ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (div_ne_zero hp hr) (div_ne_zero hq hr')
  have h2 : r / r' ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hr hr'
  have hprod : (pb / r) / (qb / r') * (r / r') = pb / qb := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [← hprod, Real.log_mul h1 h2]

name: sum_row_kl_decomposition
doc:
**单纤维分解**：固定 `a`，
`Σ_b p_ab·log(p_ab/q_ab) = mr_a·KL(p(y|a)‖q(y|a)) + mr_a·log(mr_a/mr'_a)`。
stmt:
lemma sum_row_kl_decomposition (p q : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 < p a b)
    (hq0 : ∀ a b, 0 < q a b) (hrp : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow p a)
    (hrq : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow q a) (a : Fin m) :
    ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (p a b / q a b)
      = marginalRow p a * klConditional p q a
        + marginalRow p a * Real.log (marginalRow p a / marginalRow q a)
proof:
by
  have hrp' : (marginalRow p a) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hrp a)
  have hrq' : (marginalRow q a) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hrq a)
  have hpoint : ∀ b : Fin n, p a b * Real.log (p a b / q a b)
      = p a b * Real.log ((p a b / marginalRow p a) / (q a b / marginalRow q a))
        + p a b * Real.log (marginalRow p a / marginalRow q a) := by
    intro b
    rw [log_ratio_decomposition (ne_of_gt (hp0 a b)) (ne_of_gt (hq0 a b)) hrp' hrq']
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => hpoint b), Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  ·                                                             
    unfold klConditional
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    field_simp
  ·                                      
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    rfl

name: kl_chain_rule
doc:
**KL 的链式法则（核心）**：有限支撑下
`KL(p(x,y)‖q(x,y)) = KL(p(x)‖q(x)) + Σ_a p(x=a)·KL(p(y|x=a)‖q(y|x=a))`。
stmt:
theorem kl_chain_rule (p q : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 < p a b)
    (hq0 : ∀ a b, 0 < q a b) (hrp : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow p a)
    (hrq : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow q a) :
    klJoint p q = klJointMarginal p q
      + ∑ a, marginalRow p a * klConditional p q a
proof:
by
  unfold klJoint klJointMarginal
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ =>
    sum_row_kl_decomposition p q hp0 hq0 hrp hrq a)]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

name: klJoint_nonneg
doc:
**联合 KL 非负**（Gibbs 不等式）：`p ≥ 0`、`q > 0`、`ΣΣ p = 1`、`ΣΣ q = 1`
⟹ `0 ≤ KL(p‖q)`。证明：逐项 `sub_le_mul_log_div` 求和 + `ΣΣ(p−q) = 1 − 1 = 0`。
stmt:
theorem klJoint_nonneg (p q : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ p a b)
    (hq0 : ∀ a b, 0 < q a b) (hpsum : ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b = 1)
    (hqsum : ∑ a, ∑ b, q a b = 1) :
    0 ≤ klJoint p q
proof:
by
  have hpoint : ∀ a b, p a b - q a b ≤ p a b * Real.log (p a b / q a b) :=
    fun a b => sub_le_mul_log_div (hp0 a b) (hq0 a b)
  have hdiff : ∑ a, ∑ b, (p a b - q a b) = 0 := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hpsum, hqsum]
    ring
  calc (0 : ℝ) = ∑ a, ∑ b, (p a b - q a b) := hdiff.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (p a b / q a b) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _ => hpoint a b))
    _ = klJoint p q := rfl

name: mutualInformation_eq_klJoint_prodDist
doc:
**互信息 = 联合与边缘乘积之间的 KL**：`MI(p) = KL(p‖p_X⊗p_Y)`
（`RealMutualInformation.mutualInformation` 的 log(p)−log(q) 形式与
`klJoint` 的 log(p/q) 形式经 `Real.log_div` 对齐）。
stmt:
theorem mutualInformation_eq_klJoint_prodDist (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a b, 0 < p a b) (hr : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow p a)
    (hc : ∀ b, 0 < marginalCol p b) :
    mutualInformation p = klJoint p (prodDist p)
proof:
by
  unfold mutualInformation klJoint
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hp0 a b)) (ne_of_gt (prodDist_pos p a b (hr a) (hc b)))]

name: jointEntropy
doc: **联合熵**：`H(X,Y) = −Σ_{a,b} p_ab·log p_ab`。
stmt: noncomputable def jointEntropy (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: -∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (p a b)

name: marginalEntropyRow
doc: **行边缘熵**：`H(X) = −Σ_a mr_a·log mr_a`。
stmt: noncomputable def marginalEntropyRow (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: -∑ a, marginalRow p a * Real.log (marginalRow p a)

name: marginalEntropyCol
doc: **列边缘熵**：`H(Y) = −Σ_b mc_b·log mc_b`。
stmt: noncomputable def marginalEntropyCol (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: -∑ b, marginalCol p b * Real.log (marginalCol p b)

name: sum_sum_mul_log_marginalRow
doc: 行内提出常数：`Σ_a Σ_b p_ab·log(mr_a) = Σ_a mr_a·log(mr_a)`。
stmt:
lemma sum_sum_mul_log_marginalRow (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (marginalRow p a))
      = ∑ a, marginalRow p a * Real.log (marginalRow p a)
proof:
by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  rfl

name: sum_sum_mul_log_marginalCol
doc: 列内提出常数（换序后）：`Σ_a Σ_b p_ab·log(mc_b) = Σ_b mc_b·log(mc_b)`。
stmt:
lemma sum_sum_mul_log_marginalCol (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (marginalCol p b))
      = ∑ b, marginalCol p b * Real.log (marginalCol p b)
proof:
by
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  unfold marginalCol
  rfl

name: mutualInformation_eq_entropy_decomposition
doc:
**MI 的熵分解**（**补齐 `RealMutualInformation` 明确标注未做的部分**）：
`MI(p) = H(X) + H(Y) − H(X,Y)`。
证明：把 `log(mr_a·mc_b)` 拆成 `log mr_a + log mc_b`（`Real.log_mul`），
分配后分别用行/列提出常数引理提出 `mr_a`、`mc_b`。
stmt:
theorem mutualInformation_eq_entropy_decomposition (p : Fin m → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ a, 0 < marginalRow p a)
    (hc : ∀ b, 0 < marginalCol p b) :
    mutualInformation p = marginalEntropyRow p + marginalEntropyCol p - jointEntropy p
proof:
by
  have hlog : ∀ a b, Real.log (prodDist p a b)
      = Real.log (marginalRow p a) + Real.log (marginalCol p b) := by
    intro a b
    unfold prodDist
    rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (hr a)) (ne_of_gt (hc b))]
  have hsplit : (∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * (Real.log (p a b)
        - (Real.log (marginalRow p a) + Real.log (marginalCol p b))))
      = (∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (p a b))
        - (∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (marginalRow p a))
        - (∑ a, ∑ b, p a b * Real.log (marginalCol p b)) := by
    simp_rw [mul_sub, mul_add]
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    ring
  unfold mutualInformation
  simp_rw [hlog]
  rw [hsplit, sum_sum_mul_log_marginalRow, sum_sum_mul_log_marginalCol]
  unfold marginalEntropyRow marginalEntropyCol jointEntropy
  ring

end Lattice

name: mixDist
doc: 两个分布的凸混合（逐分量）。
stmt: noncomputable def mixDist (lam : ℝ) (q1 q2 : Fin k → ℝ) : Fin k → ℝ
proof: fun a => lam * q1 a + (1 - lam) * q2 a

name: mixDist_pos
doc: 混合保严格正（q₁, q₂ > 0、λ ∈ [0,1]）。
stmt:
lemma mixDist_pos (q1 q2 : Fin k → ℝ) (h1 : ∀ a, 0 < q1 a) (h2 : ∀ a, 0 < q2 a)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) (a : Fin k) : 0 < mixDist lam q1 q2 a
proof:
by
  unfold mixDist
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlam0 with h0 | h0
  · rw [← h0]
    rw [zero_mul, zero_add, sub_zero, one_mul]
    exact h2 a
  · have hmul : 0 < lam * q1 a := mul_pos h0 (h1 a)
    have hle : 0 ≤ (1 - lam) * q2 a := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt (h2 a))
    linarith

name: log_concave_two
stmt:
lemma log_concave_two {x y lam : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    lam * Real.log x + (1 - lam) * Real.log y ≤ Real.log (lam * x + (1 - lam) * y)
proof: log_concave_pair hx hy hlam0 hlam1

name: ce_convex_in_q
stmt:
theorem ce_convex_in_q (p q1 q2 : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hq1 : ∀ a, 0 < q1 a) (hq2 : ∀ a, 0 < q2 a) {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    crossEntropy p (mixDist lam q1 q2)
      ≤ lam * crossEntropy p q1 + (1 - lam) * crossEntropy p q2
proof:
by
  rw [ce_sum_neg p (mixDist lam q1 q2), ce_sum_neg p q1, ce_sum_neg p q2]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  have hmix : 0 < mixDist lam q1 q2 a := mixDist_pos q1 q2 hq1 hq2 hlam0 hlam1 a
  have hlog : Real.log (mixDist lam q1 q2 a) ≥ lam * Real.log (q1 a) + (1 - lam) * Real.log (q2 a) :=
    log_concave_two (hq1 a) (hq2 a) hlam0 hlam1
  have hneg : -Real.log (mixDist lam q1 q2 a)
      ≤ lam * (-Real.log (q1 a)) + (1 - lam) * (-Real.log (q2 a)) := by linarith
  calc
    p a * (-Real.log (mixDist lam q1 q2 a))
        ≤ p a * (lam * (-Real.log (q1 a)) + (1 - lam) * (-Real.log (q2 a))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hneg (hp0 a)
    _ = lam * (p a * (-Real.log (q1 a))) + (1 - lam) * (p a * (-Real.log (q2 a))) := by ring

name: kl_convex_in_q
stmt:
theorem kl_convex_in_q (p q1 q2 : Fin k → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a)
    (hq1 : ∀ a, 0 < q1 a) (hq2 : ∀ a, 0 < q2 a) {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    kl p (mixDist lam q1 q2) ≤ lam * kl p q1 + (1 - lam) * kl p q2
proof:
by
  have h := ce_convex_in_q p q1 q2 hp0 hq1 hq2 hlam0 hlam1
  have hsum1 : lam + (1 - lam) = 1 := by ring
  unfold kl
  linarith [h, hsum1]

name: mul_log_convex_two
stmt:
lemma mul_log_convex_two {x y q lam : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    (lam * x + (1 - lam) * y) * Real.log ((lam * x + (1 - lam) * y) / q)
      ≤ lam * (x * Real.log (x / q)) + (1 - lam) * (y * Real.log (y / q))
proof: mul_log_convex_pair hx hy hq hlam0 hlam1

name: kl_convex_in_p
stmt:
theorem kl_convex_in_p (p1 p2 q : Fin k → ℝ) (hp1 : ∀ a, 0 < p1 a) (hp2 : ∀ a, 0 < p2 a)
    (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a) {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    kl (mixDist lam p1 p2) q ≤ lam * kl p1 q + (1 - lam) * kl p2 q
proof:
by
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_sub_log (mixDist lam p1 p2) q, kl_as_sum_log_sub_log p1 q,
    kl_as_sum_log_sub_log p2 q]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  have h1 := mul_log_convex_two (hp1 a) (hp2 a) (hq a) hlam0 hlam1
  have hmixpos : 0 < lam * p1 a + (1 - lam) * p2 a :=
    mixDist_pos p1 p2 hp1 hp2 hlam0 hlam1 a
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hp1 a)) (ne_of_gt (hq a)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hp2 a)) (ne_of_gt (hq a)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hmixpos) (ne_of_gt (hq a))] at h1
  simpa only [mixDist] using h1

end Lattice

name: logsum_finset
stmt:
lemma logsum_finset {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w x s : ι → ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hws : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (hs : ∀ i, 0 < s i) :
    (∑ i, w i * x i) * Real.log ((∑ i, w i * x i) / (∑ i, w i * s i))
      ≤ ∑ i, w i * (x i * Real.log (x i / s i))
proof:
by
  have hex : ∃ i, w i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ i, w i = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => h i)
    rw [hws] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0⟩ := hex
  have hwi0 : 0 < w i0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hw0 i0) (Ne.symm hi0)
  have hmpos : 0 < ∑ i, w i * x i :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hwi0 (hx i0))
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (le_of_lt (hx i)))
        (Finset.mem_univ i0))
  have hrpos : 0 < ∑ i, w i * s i :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hwi0 (hs i0))
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (le_of_lt (hs i)))
        (Finset.mem_univ i0))
  set m : ℝ := ∑ i, w i * x i with hm
  set r : ℝ := ∑ i, w i * s i with hr
  set A : ι → ℝ := fun i => x i * r / (s i * m) with hA
  have hApos : ∀ i, 0 < A i :=
    fun i => div_pos (mul_pos (hx i) hrpos) (mul_pos (hs i) hmpos)
  have hlogA : ∀ i, Real.log (A i)
      = (Real.log (x i) - Real.log (s i)) + (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : A i = (x i / s i) * (r / m) := by
      rw [hA]
      exact (div_mul_div_comm (x i) (s i) r m).symm
    rw [h1, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (div_pos (hx i) (hs i))) (ne_of_gt (div_pos hrpos hmpos)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt (hx i)) (ne_of_gt (hs i)),
      Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hrpos) (ne_of_gt hmpos)]
  have hsplit : ∑ i, w i * (x i * Real.log (A i))
      = (∑ i, w i * (x i * Real.log (x i / s i))) + m * (Real.log r - Real.log m) := by
    have hterm : ∀ i, w i * (x i * Real.log (A i))

name: logsum_two
doc:
两点 log-sum 不等式（逐项形式）：
m = lam·x + (1−lam)·y、r = lam·s + (1−lam)·t ⟹
m·log(m/r) ≤ lam·x·log(x/s) + (1−lam)·y·log(y/t)（x, y, s, t > 0、lam ∈ [0,1]）。
【实现】`logsum_finset` 在 `Fin 2` 上取权重 `(lam, 1−lam)`、点 `(x, y)`、`(s, t)`。
stmt:
lemma logsum_two {x y s t lam : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    (lam * x + (1 - lam) * y) * Real.log ((lam * x + (1 - lam) * y) / (lam * s + (1 - lam) * t))
      ≤ lam * (x * Real.log (x / s)) + (1 - lam) * (y * Real.log (y / t))
proof:
by
  have h := logsum_finset (w := ![lam, 1 - lam]) (x := ![x, y]) (s := ![s, t])
    (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> (simp; linarith [hlam0, hlam1]))
    (by simp [Fin.sum_univ_two])
    (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hx, hy])
    (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hs, ht])
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using h

name: kl_joint_convex
stmt:
theorem kl_joint_convex (p1 p2 q1 q2 : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp1 : ∀ a, 0 < p1 a) (hp2 : ∀ a, 0 < p2 a)
    (hq1 : ∀ a, 0 < q1 a) (hq2 : ∀ a, 0 < q2 a)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    kl (mixDist lam p1 p2) (mixDist lam q1 q2)
      ≤ lam * kl p1 q1 + (1 - lam) * kl p2 q2
proof:
by
  have hp : ∀ a, 0 < mixDist lam p1 p2 a := mixDist_pos p1 p2 hp1 hp2 hlam0 hlam1
  have hq : ∀ a, 0 < mixDist lam q1 q2 a := mixDist_pos q1 q2 hq1 hq2 hlam0 hlam1
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio (mixDist lam p1 p2) (mixDist lam q1 q2) hp hq,
    kl_as_sum_log_ratio p1 q1 hp1 hq1, kl_as_sum_log_ratio p2 q2 hp2 hq2]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  have h := logsum_two (hp1 a) (hp2 a) (hq1 a) (hq2 a) hlam0 hlam1
  simpa only [mixDist] using h

name: kl_convex_in_p_strict_positive
stmt:
theorem kl_convex_in_p_strict_positive (p1 p2 q : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hp1 : ∀ a, 0 < p1 a) (hp2 : ∀ a, 0 < p2 a) (hq : ∀ a, 0 < q a)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam1 : lam ≤ 1) :
    kl (mixDist lam p1 p2) q ≤ lam * kl p1 q + (1 - lam) * kl p2 q
proof:
by
  have h := kl_joint_convex p1 p2 q q hp1 hp2 hq hq hlam0 hlam1
  have hmix : mixDist lam q q = q := by
    funext a
    unfold mixDist
    ring
  rwa [hmix] at h

name: kl_joint_convex_sum
stmt:
theorem kl_joint_convex_sum {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℝ) (P Q : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hws : ∑ i, w i = 1)
    (hP : ∀ i a, 0 < P i a) (hQ : ∀ i a, 0 < Q i a) :
    kl (fun a => ∑ i, w i * P i a) (fun a => ∑ i, w i * Q i a)
      ≤ ∑ i, w i * kl (P i) (Q i)
proof:
by
  have hex : ∃ i, w i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : ∑ i, w i = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => h i)
    rw [hws] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  obtain ⟨i0, hi0⟩ := hex
  have hwi0 : 0 < w i0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (hw0 i0) (Ne.symm hi0)
  have hmixP : ∀ a, 0 < ∑ i, w i * P i a := by
    intro a
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hwi0 (hP i0 a))
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (le_of_lt (hP i a)))
        (Finset.mem_univ i0))
  have hmixQ : ∀ a, 0 < ∑ i, w i * Q i a := by
    intro a
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos hwi0 (hQ i0 a))
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw0 i) (le_of_lt (hQ i a)))
        (Finset.mem_univ i0))
  rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio _ _ hmixP hmixQ]
  have hR : ∑ i, w i * kl (P i) (Q i)
      = ∑ i, w i * ∑ a, P i a * Real.log (P i a / Q i a) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [kl_as_sum_log_ratio (P i) (Q i) (fun a => hP i a) (fun a => hQ i a)]
  rw [hR]
  calc ∑ a, (∑ i, w i * P i a) * Real.log ((∑ i, w i * P i a) / (∑ i, w i * Q i a))
      ≤ ∑ a, ∑ i, w i * (P i a * Real.log (P i a / Q i a)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ =>
          logsum_finset w (fun i => P i a) (fun i => Q i a) hw0 hws
            (fun i => hP i a) (fun i => hQ i a))
    _ = ∑ i, w i * ∑ a, P i a * Real.log (P i a / Q i a) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: pt2
doc: one-hot 向量 eᵢ（k = 2）：eᵢ i = 1，否则 0。
stmt: def pt2 (i : Fin 2) : Fin 2 → ℝ
proof: fun a => if a = i then 1 else 0

name: ce_not_joint_convex
doc: 形式化反例：CE 不是联合凸的（k = 2、lam = 1/2、两个 one-hot 分布的混合）。
stmt:
theorem ce_not_joint_convex :
    ¬ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 * crossEntropy (pt2 0) (pt2 0)
        + (1 : ℝ) / 2 * crossEntropy (pt2 1) (pt2 1)
        ≥ crossEntropy (mixDist ((1 : ℝ) / 2) (pt2 0) (pt2 1))
            (mixDist ((1 : ℝ) / 2) (pt2 0) (pt2 1)))
proof:
by
  intro h
  have h00 : crossEntropy (pt2 0) (pt2 0) = 0 := by
    simp [crossEntropy, pt2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have h11 : crossEntropy (pt2 1) (pt2 1) = 0 := by
    simp [crossEntropy, pt2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hmix : mixDist ((1 : ℝ) / 2) (pt2 0) (pt2 1) = fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
    funext a
    fin_cases a <;> simp [mixDist, pt2] <;> norm_num
  have hm : crossEntropy (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ) / 2) (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℝ) / 2)
      = Real.log 2 := by
    unfold crossEntropy
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hlog : Real.log ((1 : ℝ) / 2) = -Real.log 2 := by
      rw [show (1 : ℝ) / 2 = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num, Real.log_inv]
    rw [hlog]
    ring
  rw [h00, h11, hmix, hm] at h
  have hpos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  linarith

end Lattice

name: kleeneChain
doc:
**Kleene 链**：从底 `⊥` 出发的迭代 `Fⁿ⊥`。
`kleeneChain f 0 = ⊥`，`kleeneChain f (n+1) = f (kleeneChain f n)`。
stmt:
def kleeneChain [Bot α] (f : α → α) : ℕ → α
  | 0 => ⊥
  | n + 1 => f (kleeneChain f n)

variable [PartialOrder α] [OrderBot α]

name: kleeneChain_zero
stmt: @[simp] theorem kleeneChain_zero (f : α → α) : kleeneChain f 0 = ⊥
proof: rfl

name: kleeneChain_succ
stmt:
@[simp] theorem kleeneChain_succ (f : α → α) (n : ℕ) :
    kleeneChain f (n + 1) = f (kleeneChain f n)
proof: rfl

name: kleeneChain_le_succ
doc:
**相邻步递增**：单调算子的 Kleene 链 `Fⁿ⊥ ≤ F^{n+1}⊥`。
归纳：`n = 0` 用 `bot_le`，后继步用 `hf` 保持。
stmt:
theorem kleeneChain_le_succ (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, kleeneChain f n ≤ kleeneChain f (n + 1)
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact bot_le
  | succ n ih =>
      change f (kleeneChain f n) ≤ f (kleeneChain f (n + 1))
      exact hf ih

name: kleeneChain_monotone
doc: **Kleene 链关于步数单调**：`n ≤ m ⟹ Fⁿ⊥ ≤ Fᵐ⊥`。
stmt:
theorem kleeneChain_monotone (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    Monotone (kleeneChain f)
proof:
by
  intro n m hnm
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm
  clear hnm
  induction d with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ d ih => exact ih.trans (kleeneChain_le_succ f hf (n + d))

name: kleeneChain_le_of_le
doc: 链的每一层都不超过其任意后继：`Fⁿ⊥ ≤ Fᵐ⊥`（`n ≤ m`）的另一种写法。
stmt:
theorem kleeneChain_le_of_le (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    kleeneChain f n ≤ kleeneChain f m
proof:
kleeneChain_monotone f hf h

                                     

variable [Fintype α]

name: kleeneChain_stabilizes
doc:
**稳定性的存在性（鸽笼原理）**：有限偏序上单调算子的 Kleene 链必在
某步出现重复 `Fⁿ⊥ = F^{n+1}⊥`。
反证：若前 `card α` 步都严格增，则 `Fin (card α + 1) → α` 的单射给出
`card α + 1 ≤ card α` 的矛盾。
stmt:
theorem kleeneChain_stabilizes (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, kleeneChain f N = kleeneChain f (N + 1)
proof:
by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, kleeneChain f n ≤ kleeneChain f (n + 1) := kleeneChain_le_succ f hf
  have hlt : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ Fintype.card α → kleeneChain f n < kleeneChain f (n + 1) :=
    fun n hn => lt_of_le_of_ne (hle n) (h n)
  have hmono : Monotone (kleeneChain f) := kleeneChain_monotone f hf
                         
  have hltj : ∀ i j : ℕ, i ≤ Fintype.card α → i < j →
      kleeneChain f i < kleeneChain f j := by
    intro i j hi hij
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hij
    have h1 : kleeneChain f i < kleeneChain f (i + 1) := hlt i hi
    have h2 : kleeneChain f (i + 1) ≤ kleeneChain f (i + d + 1) := hmono (by omega)
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
                                
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α + 1) => kleeneChain f (i : ℕ)) := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Fin.ext
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hltij | hgtij
    · exact (ne_of_lt (hltj (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) (by have := i.isLt; omega) hltij)) hij
    · exact (ne_of_lt (hltj (j : ℕ) (i : ℕ) (by have := j.isLt; omega) hgtij)) hij.symm
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α + 1) => kleeneChain f (i : ℕ)) hinj
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
  omega

name: kleeneStabIndex
doc:
**最小稳定步**（`Nat.find`）：第一个使 `Fⁿ⊥ = F^{n+1}⊥` 的步数。
用 `Nat.find` 从 `kleeneChain_stabilizes` 的可判定性中取出。
stmt: def kleeneStabIndex (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) : ℕ
proof: Nat.find (kleeneChain_stabilizes f hf)

name: kleeneStabIndex_spec
doc: **`Nat.find` 的刻画（spec）**：`kleeneStabIndex f` 处链确实稳定。
stmt:
theorem kleeneStabIndex_spec (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf) = kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + 1)
proof: Nat.find_spec (kleeneChain_stabilizes f hf)

name: kleeneStabIndex_minimal
doc: **`Nat.find` 的极小性**：任何使链稳定的步数都不小于 `kleeneStabIndex f`。
proof: Nat.find_min' (kleeneChain_stabilizes f hf) hn

name: kleeneStabIndex_le_card
doc:
**最小稳定步的上界 `≤ card α`**：这是「有限步稳定」的定量形式
（步数不超过有限格的基数）。
stmt:
theorem kleeneStabIndex_le_card (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    kleeneStabIndex f hf ≤ Fintype.card α
proof:
by
                                          
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hspec := kleeneStabIndex_spec f hf
  have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, kleeneChain f n ≤ kleeneChain f (n + 1) := kleeneChain_le_succ f hf
  have hmono : Monotone (kleeneChain f) := kleeneChain_monotone f hf
                                       
  have hlt : ∀ n : ℕ, n < kleeneStabIndex f hf →
      kleeneChain f n < kleeneChain f (n + 1) := by
    intro n hn
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (hle n) (fun heq => ?_)
    have hmin := kleeneStabIndex_minimal f hf heq
    omega
                                                  
  have hltj : ∀ i j : ℕ, i < kleeneStabIndex f hf → i < j →
      kleeneChain f i < kleeneChain f j := by
    intro i j hi hij
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hij
    have h1 : kleeneChain f i < kleeneChain f (i + 1) := hlt i hi
    have h2 : kleeneChain f (i + 1) ≤ kleeneChain f (i + d + 1) := hmono (by omega)
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α + 1) => kleeneChain f (i : ℕ)) := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Fin.ext
    by_contra hne
    have hi : (i : ℕ) < kleeneStabIndex f hf := by have := i.isLt; omega
    have hj : (j : ℕ) < kleeneStabIndex f hf := by have := j.isLt; omega
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hltij | hgtij
    · exact (ne_of_lt (hltj (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ) hi hltij)) hij
    · exact (ne_of_lt (hltj (j : ℕ) (i : ℕ) hj hgtij)) hij.symm
  have hcard := Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype

name: kleeneLimit
doc:
**Kleene 极限**：链在最小稳定步处的值，即 `F^{kleeneStabIndex}⊥`。
本文件将证明它恰是 `f` 的**最小不动点**。
stmt: def kleeneLimit (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) : α
proof: kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf)

name: kleeneLimit_fixed
doc:
**稳定值是不动点**：`f (kleeneLimit f) = kleeneLimit f`。
由 `kleeneStabIndex_spec`（稳定）与 `kleeneChain_succ`（一步展开）直接得到。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_fixed (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    f (kleeneLimit f hf) = kleeneLimit f hf
proof:
by
  have hspec := kleeneStabIndex_spec f hf
  have h1 : kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + 1) = f (kleeneLimit f hf) := rfl
  rw [← h1]
  exact hspec.symm

name: kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed
doc:
**最小性**：`kleeneLimit f` 不超过任意不动点 `y`（`f y = y`）。
归纳：`Fⁿ⊥ ≤ y` 对一切 `n`（`n = 0` 用 `bot_le`，后继用 `hf`），再取 `n = 稳定步`。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) {y : α} (hy : f y = y) :
    kleeneLimit f hf ≤ y
proof:
by
  have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, kleeneChain f n ≤ y := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact bot_le
    | succ n ih =>
        change f (kleeneChain f n) ≤ y
        rw [← hy]
        exact hf ih
  exact hbound (kleeneStabIndex f hf)

name: kleeneChain_eq_limit_of_le
doc:
**稳定后恒定**：若 `kleeneStabIndex f ≤ n`，则 `Fⁿ⊥ = kleeneLimit f`。
即链在最小稳定步之后不再变化。
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  clear hn
  have hfix := kleeneLimit_fixed f hf
  induction d with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ d ih =>
      have hstep : kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + (d + 1))
          = f (kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + d)) := rfl
      rw [hstep, ih, hfix]

name: kleene_fixed_point_finite
doc:
**Kleene 不动点定理（有限格版本，打包）**：有限偏序 + 有底 + 单调算子 ⟹
存在唯一的最小稳定步 `N ≤ card α`，链在 `N` 处稳定、稳定值是不动点且最小。
这是 Knaster–Tarski / Kleene 的**有限步稳定**形态，四条件一并给出。
stmt:
theorem kleene_fixed_point_finite (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) :
    kleeneStabIndex f hf ≤ Fintype.card α ∧
      kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf) = kleeneChain f (kleeneStabIndex f hf + 1) ∧
      f (kleeneLimit f hf) = kleeneLimit f hf ∧
      (∀ y : α, f y = y → kleeneLimit f hf ≤ y)
proof:
⟨kleeneStabIndex_le_card f hf, kleeneStabIndex_spec f hf,
   kleeneLimit_fixed f hf, fun _ hy => kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed f hf hy⟩

name: kleeneLimit_unique_minimal
doc:
**最小不动点的唯一性**：任意使 `f y = y` 且被 `kleeneLimit f` 支配的 `y`
必与之相等（最小性是「≤」，配合 `kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed` 得双向）。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_unique_minimal (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) {y : α} (hy : f y = y)
    (hle : y ≤ kleeneLimit f hf) :
    y = kleeneLimit f hf
proof:
le_antisymm hle (kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed f hf hy)

                                   

section Powerset

variable {β : Type*} [Fintype β]

name: powChain
doc:
**`kleeneChain` 在 `Set β` 上的同义别名**：`powChain F` 的定义体只是把
参数原样转发给 `kleeneChain`（`Set β` 已由 `Set.instBot` 提供 `⊥ = ∅`）。
命名用意是让幂集语境下的链读作「幂集链」，而非声明 `F` 单调——`F` 的单调性
不是本定义的参数，单调性由下游定理以 `hF : Monotone F` 单独假设。
**说明**：本别名在文件内（含第五节、第六节的全部定理与清单）**无任何引用**，
保留仅为可读性；`F` 若记为 `F`，其语义与 `kleeneChain F` 完全一致。
stmt: def powChain (F : Set β → Set β) : ℕ → Set β
proof: kleeneChain F

name: kleeneLimit_eq_iUnion
doc:
**幂集格上最小不动点 = Kleene 链的并 `⋃ₙ Fⁿ ∅`**（「最小结 = ⋃ₙ Fⁿ ∅」）：
单调 `F` 的最小不动点恰等于链的并。因为链在 `≤ card (Set β)` 步稳定，
并就是稳定项本身。
（本文件只声称**并 = 最小不动点**；`Set β` 的有限性由 `Fintype β` 保证，
故 `Fintype (Set β)` 由 `Set.fintype` 提供。）
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_eq_iUnion (F : Set β → Set β) (hF : Monotone F) :
    (kleeneLimit F hF : Set β) = ⋃ n : ℕ, kleeneChain F n
proof:
by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨kleeneStabIndex F hF, hx⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
                             
    by_cases hle : n ≤ kleeneStabIndex F hF
    · exact kleeneChain_monotone F hF hle hn
    · have hge : kleeneStabIndex F hF ≤ n := by omega
      rw [kleeneChain_eq_limit_of_le F hF hge] at hn
      exact hn

name: kleeneLimit_mem_iff
doc:
**并的成员刻画**：`x` 属于最小不动点 ⟺ `x` 属于某个 `Fⁿ ∅`。
先用 `kleeneLimit_eq_iUnion` 把最小不动点换写成链的并，再用 `Set.mem_iUnion`。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_mem_iff (F : Set β → Set β) (hF : Monotone F) (x : β) :
    x ∈ (kleeneLimit F hF : Set β) ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ∈ kleeneChain F n
proof:
by
  rw [kleeneLimit_eq_iUnion F hF]
  exact Set.mem_iUnion

name: kleeneLimit_subset_of_fixed
doc:
**「最小结」的 `⊆`-刻画**：最小不动点包含于任意不动点（即任意「结」）。
这是幂集格上的最小性重述（「最小结」= 包含于所有结）。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_subset_of_fixed (F : Set β → Set β) (hF : Monotone F)
    {Y : Set β} (hY : F Y = Y) :
    (kleeneLimit F hF : Set β) ⊆ Y
proof: fun _ hx => kleeneLimit_le_of_fixed F hF hY hx

name: kleeneLimit_card_le_of_fixed
doc:
**不动点的基数上界**：任何不动点都至少与最小不动点一样大
（基数形式：`|最小结| ≤ |任意结|`，由 `⊆` 推出）。
stmt:
theorem kleeneLimit_card_le_of_fixed (F : Set β → Set β) (hF : Monotone F)
    {Y : Set β} (hY : F Y = Y) :
    (kleeneLimit F hF).ncard ≤ Y.ncard
proof:
Set.ncard_le_ncard (kleeneLimit_subset_of_fixed F hF hY)

end Powerset
