name: MomentumUpdate
stmt: def MomentumUpdate (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v x : E) : E
proof: x - (μ • v + (2 * η : 𝕜) • A.adjoint (A x - b))

name: MomentumState
doc: 状态对 (v, x) 的一步转移：(v', x')，v' = μ·v + (2η)·A†(Ax-b)，x' = x - v'。
stmt: def MomentumState (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (p : E × E) : E × E
proof:
(μ • p.1 + (2 * η : 𝕜) • A.adjoint (A p.2 - b),
   p.2 - (μ • p.1 + (2 * η : 𝕜) • A.adjoint (A p.2 - b)))

name: MomentumIterate
doc: 状态对迭代：pair (n+1) = MomentumState (pair n)。
stmt:
def MomentumIterate (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) : ℕ → E × E → E × E
  | 0, p => p
  | n + 1, p => MomentumState A b η μ (MomentumIterate A b η μ n p)

name: MomentumV
doc: 第 n 步的速度 v_n（初始 v₀ 与 x₀）。
stmt: def MomentumV (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : E) (n : ℕ) : E
proof: (MomentumIterate A b η μ n (v0, x0)).1

name: MomentumX
doc: 第 n 步的位置 x_n。
stmt: def MomentumX (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : E) (n : ℕ) : E
proof:
(MomentumIterate A b η μ n (v0, x0)).2

omit [IsScalarTower ℝ 𝕜 E] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [IsScalarTower ℝ 𝕜 F] in

name: MomentumError
doc: 动量版的平方误差（对应 GDError）：‖A·x_n - b‖²。
stmt: def MomentumError (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : E) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: ‖A (MomentumX A b η μ v0 x0 n) - b‖ ^ 2

name: momentum_gd_recovery
stmt:
lemma momentum_gd_recovery (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η : ℝ) (v x : E) :
    MomentumUpdate A b η 0 v x = GDUpdate A b η x
proof:
by
  simp [MomentumUpdate, GDUpdate]

name: momentum_error_recurrence_step
stmt:
lemma momentum_error_recurrence_step (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v x : E) :
    A (MomentumUpdate A b η μ v x) - b =
      ((1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)) (A x - b)
      + μ • ((A x - b) - (A (x + v) - b))
proof:
by
  unfold MomentumUpdate
                                        
  have hav : A v = A (x + v) - A x := by
    calc
      A v = A v + A x - A x := by abel
      _ = A (x + v) - A x := by
        rw [← A.map_add]
        abel
                                     
  have hsmul : A (μ • v) = μ • A v := by
    calc
      A (μ • v) = A ((μ : 𝕜) • v) := by rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜)]
      _ = (μ : 𝕜) • A v := A.map_smul (μ : 𝕜) v
      _ = μ • A v := by rw [← RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜)]
                                       
  have hneg : μ • (A (x + v) - A x) = -(μ • (A x - A (x + v))) := by
    rw [← neg_sub (A x) (A (x + v)), smul_neg]
  calc
    A (x - (μ • v + (2 * η : 𝕜) • A.adjoint (A x - b))) - b
        = (A x - A (μ • v + (2 * η : 𝕜) • A.adjoint (A x - b))) - b := by
          rw [A.map_sub]
    _ = (A x - (μ • A v + (2 * η : 𝕜) • A (A.adjoint (A x - b)))) - b := by
          rw [A.map_add, hsmul, A.map_smul]
    _ = (A x - (μ • A v + (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint) (A x - b))) - b := by
          rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    _ = (A x - b) - (μ • A v + (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint) (A x - b)) := by
          abel
    _ = (A x - b) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint) (A x - b) + μ • (A x - A (x + v)) := by
          rw [hav, hneg]
          abel
    _ = ((1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)) (A x - b)
          + μ • ((A x - b) - (A (x + v) - b)) := by
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMa

name: momentum_step_contraction
stmt:
theorem momentum_step_contraction (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v x : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ) (hspec : ‖(1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖A (MomentumUpdate A b η μ v x) - b‖ ≤ (c + μ) * ‖A x - b‖ + μ * ‖A (x + v) - b‖
proof:
by
  rw [momentum_error_recurrence_step A b η μ v x]
  calc
    ‖((1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)) (A x - b)
        + μ • ((A x - b) - (A (x + v) - b))‖
        ≤ ‖((1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)) (A x - b)‖
          + ‖μ • ((A x - b) - (A (x + v) - b))‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ c * ‖A x - b‖ + μ * ‖(A x - b) - (A (x + v) - b)‖ := by
          exact add_le_add
            (le_trans (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ (A x - b))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hspec (norm_nonneg (A x - b))))
            (by simpa [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hμ0])
    _ ≤ c * ‖A x - b‖ + μ * (‖A x - b‖ + ‖A (x + v) - b‖) := by
          exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sub_le _ _) hμ0) _
    _ = (c + μ) * ‖A x - b‖ + μ * ‖A (x + v) - b‖ := by ring

name: momentum_step_contraction_max
stmt:
theorem momentum_step_contraction_max (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v x : E) (c : ℝ)
    (hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ) (hspec : ‖(1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c) :
    ‖A (MomentumUpdate A b η μ v x) - b‖ ≤ (c + 2 * μ) * max (‖A x - b‖) (‖A (x + v) - b‖)
proof:
by
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hspec
  have hcm0 : 0 ≤ c + μ := add_nonneg hc0 hμ0
  calc
    ‖A (MomentumUpdate A b η μ v x) - b‖ ≤ (c + μ) * ‖A x - b‖ + μ * ‖A (x + v) - b‖ :=
      momentum_step_contraction A b η μ v x c hμ0 hspec
    _ ≤ (c + μ) * max (‖A x - b‖) (‖A (x + v) - b‖)
        + μ * max (‖A x - b‖) (‖A (x + v) - b‖) := by
          exact add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left (‖A x - b‖) (‖A (x + v) - b‖)) hcm0)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right (‖A x - b‖) (‖A (x + v) - b‖)) hμ0)
    _ = (c + 2 * μ) * max (‖A x - b‖) (‖A (x + v) - b‖) := by ring

name: MomentumErrPair
stmt: def MomentumErrPair (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : E) (n : ℕ) : F × F
proof:
(A (MomentumX A b η μ v0 x0 n) - b,
   A (MomentumX A b η μ v0 x0 n + MomentumV A b η μ v0 x0 n) - b)

name: momentum_err_pair_recurrence
stmt:
lemma momentum_err_pair_recurrence (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : E) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      MomentumErrPair A b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1) =
        (((1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint))
            (A (MomentumX A b η μ v0 x0 n) - b)
          + μ • ((A (MomentumX A b η μ v0 x0 n) - b)
              - (A (MomentumX A b η μ v0 x0 n + MomentumV A b η μ v0 x0 n) - b)),
         A (MomentumX A b η μ v0 x0 n) - b)
proof:
by
  intro n
  unfold MomentumErrPair MomentumX MomentumV
  set X : E × E := MomentumIterate A b η μ n (v0, x0) with hX
  have hstep' : MomentumIterate A b η μ (n + 1) (v0, x0) = MomentumState A b η μ X := by
    rw [hX]
    rfl
  rw [hstep']
  apply Prod.ext
  ·                                                                            
    simpa [MomentumState, MomentumUpdate] using momentum_error_recurrence_step A b η μ X.1 X.2
  ·                                
    have hv : (MomentumState A b η μ X).2 + (MomentumState A b η μ X).1 = X.2 := by
      simp [MomentumState]
    rw [hv]

name: momentum_iterate_converges
stmt:
theorem momentum_iterate_converges (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : E) (c0 : ℝ)
    (hc0n : 0 ≤ c0) (hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ) (hs : c0 + 2 * μ < 1)
    (hspec : ‖(1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c0) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, ‖A (MomentumX A b η μ v0 x0 n) - b‖ < ε
proof:
by
  let γ : ℝ := (1 - c0) / 2
  let c : ℝ := c0 + μ + γ
  let W : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    ‖(MomentumErrPair A b η μ v0 x0 n).1‖ + γ * ‖(MomentumErrPair A b η μ v0 x0 n).2‖
  have hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ := by
    dsimp [γ]
    nlinarith [hs, hμ0]
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by
    dsimp [c]
    nlinarith [hc0n, hμ0, hγ0]
  have hc1 : c < 1 := by
    dsimp [c, γ]
    nlinarith [hs]
  have hμcγ : μ ≤ c * γ := by
    have hdiff : 0 ≤ c * γ - μ := by
      dsimp [c, γ]
      have hcalc : (c0 + μ + (1 - c0) / 2) * ((1 - c0) / 2) - μ =
          (1 + c0) * (1 - c0 - 2 * μ) / 4 := by ring
      rw [hcalc]
      have h1 : 0 ≤ 1 + c0 := by nlinarith [hc0n]
      have h2 : 0 ≤ 1 - c0 - 2 * μ := by nlinarith [hs]
      have hprod : 0 ≤ (1 + c0) * (1 - c0 - 2 * μ) := mul_nonneg h1 h2
      nlinarith [hprod]
    nlinarith
  have hWstep : ∀ n : ℕ, W (n + 1) ≤ c * W n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [W]
    rw [momentum_err_pair_recurrence A b η μ v0 x0 n]
    set e : F := (MomentumErrPair A b η μ v0 x0 n).1 with he
    set eprev : F := (MomentumErrPair A b η μ v0 x0 n).2 with heprev
    have htri : ‖((1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)) e + μ • (e - eprev)‖
        ≤ (c0 + μ) * ‖e‖ + μ * ‖eprev‖ := by
      calc
        ‖((1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)) e + μ • (e - eprev)‖
            ≤ ‖((1 : F →L[𝕜] F) - (2 * η : 𝕜) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)) e‖
              + ‖μ • (e - eprev)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ c0 * ‖e‖ + μ * ‖e - eprev‖ := by
              exact add_le_add

name: ScalarMomStep
stmt: def ScalarMomStep (a b η μ : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ × ℝ

name: ScalarMomIterate
stmt:
def ScalarMomIterate (a b η μ : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ
  | 0, p => p
  | n + 1, p => ScalarMomStep a b η μ (ScalarMomIterate a b η μ n p)

name: ScalarMomV
stmt: def ScalarMomV (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: (ScalarMomIterate a b η μ n (v0, x0)).1

name: ScalarMomX
stmt: def ScalarMomX (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: (ScalarMomIterate a b η μ n (v0, x0)).2

name: ScalarMomErr
stmt: def ScalarMomErr (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
proof: a * ScalarMomX a b η μ v0 x0 n - b

name: ScalarMomErrPair
stmt: def ScalarMomErrPair (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ × ℝ
proof: (ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n, a * (ScalarMomX a b η μ v0 x0 n + ScalarMomV a b η μ v0 x0 n) - b)

name: scalar_mom_step_fst
stmt:
lemma scalar_mom_step_fst (a b η μ : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (ScalarMomStep a b η μ p).1 = μ * p.1 + 2 * η * a * (a * p.2 - b)
proof: rfl

name: scalar_mom_step_snd
stmt:
lemma scalar_mom_step_snd (a b η μ : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (ScalarMomStep a b η μ p).2 = p.2 - (μ * p.1 + 2 * η * a * (a * p.2 - b))
proof: rfl

name: scalar_mom_v_prev
stmt:
lemma scalar_mom_v_prev (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ScalarMomV a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1) = ScalarMomX a b η μ v0 x0 n - ScalarMomX a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)
proof:
by
  intro n
  set X : ℝ × ℝ := ScalarMomIterate a b η μ n (v0, x0) with hX
  have hstep' : ScalarMomIterate a b η μ (n + 1) (v0, x0) = ScalarMomStep a b η μ X := by
    rw [hX]
    rfl
  unfold ScalarMomV ScalarMomX
  rw [hstep', scalar_mom_step_fst, scalar_mom_step_snd]
  ring

name: scalar_mom_err_pair_snd
stmt:
lemma scalar_mom_err_pair_snd (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)).2 = ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n
proof:
by
  intro n
  set X : ℝ × ℝ := ScalarMomIterate a b η μ n (v0, x0) with hX
  have hstep' : ScalarMomIterate a b η μ (n + 1) (v0, x0) = ScalarMomStep a b η μ X := by
    rw [hX]
    rfl
  unfold ScalarMomErrPair ScalarMomErr ScalarMomX ScalarMomV
  rw [hstep', scalar_mom_step_fst, scalar_mom_step_snd]
  ring

name: scalar_mom_err_pair_recurrence
stmt:
lemma scalar_mom_err_pair_recurrence (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1) =
      ((1 - 2 * η * a ^ 2 + μ) * (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 n).1
        - μ * (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 n).2, (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 n).1)
proof:
by
  intro n
  set X : ℝ × ℝ := ScalarMomIterate a b η μ n (v0, x0) with hX
  have hstep' : ScalarMomIterate a b η μ (n + 1) (v0, x0) = ScalarMomStep a b η μ X := by
    rw [hX]
    rfl
  unfold ScalarMomErrPair ScalarMomErr ScalarMomX ScalarMomV
  rw [hstep', scalar_mom_step_fst, scalar_mom_step_snd]
  ext <;> ring

name: momentum_error_recurrence
stmt:
lemma momentum_error_recurrence (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 2) =
        (1 - 2 * η * a ^ 2) * ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)
          + μ * (ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1) - ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n)
proof:
by
  intro n
  have hpr := scalar_mom_err_pair_recurrence a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)
  have h1 : (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 2)).1 =
      (1 - 2 * η * a ^ 2 + μ) * (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)).1
        - μ * (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)).2 := by
    simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hpr
  have he2 : (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)).2 = ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n :=
    scalar_mom_err_pair_snd a b η μ v0 x0 n
  calc
    ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 2)
        = (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 2)).1 := rfl
    _ = (1 - 2 * η * a ^ 2 + μ) * (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)).1
          - μ * (ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)).2 := h1
    _ = (1 - 2 * η * a ^ 2 + μ) * ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)
          - μ * ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n := by
          rw [he2]
          rfl
    _ = (1 - 2 * η * a ^ 2) * ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1)
          + μ * (ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 (n + 1) - ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n) := by ring

name: scalar_second_order_converges
stmt:
theorem scalar_second_order_converges {p : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ} (α μ : ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ n : ℕ, p (n + 1) = ((α + μ) * (p n).1 - μ * (p n).2, (p n).1))
    (hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ) (hs : |α + μ| + μ < 1) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, |(p n).1| < ε
proof:
by
  let γ : ℝ := (μ + 1 - |α + μ|) / 2
  let c : ℝ := |α + μ| + γ
  let W : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => |(p n).1| + γ * |(p n).2|
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ |α + μ| := abs_nonneg _
  have hslt : |α + μ| < 1 - μ := by nlinarith [hs]
  have h1m : 0 ≤ 1 - μ := by nlinarith [hs, hs0]
  have hs2 : |α + μ| ^ 2 ≤ (1 - μ) ^ 2 := by
    exact sq_le_sq' (by nlinarith [hs0, h1m]) (le_of_lt hslt)
  have hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ := by
    dsimp [γ]
    have hnum : 0 ≤ μ + 1 - |α + μ| := by nlinarith [hslt, hμ0]
    nlinarith
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by
    dsimp [c]
    nlinarith [hs0, hγ0]
  have hc1 : c < 1 := by
    dsimp [c, γ]
    nlinarith [hs]
  have hμcγ : μ ≤ c * γ := by
    have hdiff : 0 ≤ c * γ - μ := by
      dsimp [c, γ]
      have hcalc : (|α + μ| + (μ + 1 - |α + μ|) / 2) * ((μ + 1 - |α + μ|) / 2) - μ =
          ((1 - μ) ^ 2 - |α + μ| ^ 2) / 4 := by ring
      rw [hcalc]
      nlinarith [hs2]
    nlinarith
  have hWstep : ∀ n : ℕ, W (n + 1) ≤ c * W n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [W]
    rw [hstep n]
    have htri : |(α + μ) * (p n).1 - μ * (p n).2| ≤ |α + μ| * |(p n).1| + μ * |(p n).2| := by
      calc
        |(α + μ) * (p n).1 - μ * (p n).2|
            = |(α + μ) * (p n).1 + -(μ * (p n).2)| := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
        _ ≤ |(α + μ) * (p n).1| + |-(μ * (p n).2)| := abs_add _ _
        _ = |(α + μ) * (p n).1| + |μ * (p n).2| := by rw [abs_neg]
        _ = |α + μ| * |(p n).1| + |μ| * |(p n).2| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ = |α + μ| * |(p n).1| + μ * |(p n).2| := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hμ0]
    ca

name: scalar_momentum_converges
stmt:
theorem scalar_momentum_converges (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ)
    (hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ) (hs : |1 - 2 * η * a ^ 2 + μ| + μ < 1) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, |ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n| < ε
proof:
by
  have hconv := scalar_second_order_converges (α := 1 - 2 * η * a ^ 2) (μ := μ)
    (p := ScalarMomErrPair a b η μ v0 x0)
    (scalar_mom_err_pair_recurrence a b η μ v0 x0) hμ0 hs
  intro ε hε
  rcases hconv ε hε with ⟨n, hn⟩
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  simpa [ScalarMomErrPair] using hn

name: scalar_momentum_converges_sq
stmt:
theorem scalar_momentum_converges_sq (a b η μ : ℝ) (v0 x0 : ℝ)
    (hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ) (hs : |1 - 2 * η * a ^ 2 + μ| + μ < 1) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, |ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n| ^ 2 < ε
proof:
by
  intro ε hε
  let m : ℝ := min ε 1
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by
    dsimp [m]
    exact lt_min hε zero_lt_one
  rcases (scalar_momentum_converges a b η μ v0 x0 hμ0 hs m hm0) with ⟨n, hn⟩
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  have hm1 : m ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [m]
    exact min_le_right ε 1
  have hmε : m ≤ ε := by
    dsimp [m]
    exact min_le_left ε 1
  have hsq : |ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n| ^ 2 < m ^ 2 := by
    simpa [pow_two] using mul_self_lt_mul_self (abs_nonneg _) hn
  calc
    |ScalarMomErr a b η μ v0 x0 n| ^ 2 < m ^ 2 := hsq
    _ ≤ ε := by
                                                    
      have hm0' : 0 ≤ m := le_of_lt hm0
      have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := le_of_lt hε
      have hmul : m * m ≤ ε * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg' hmε hm1 hm0' hε0
      nlinarith

             
                                                              
                                    
                                    
                                                 
                                            
                                

end Lattice

name: projSgdUpdate
doc: **投影 SGD 步**：`x⁺ = Π_C(x − η ĝ)`（`Π_C` 是 `RealConvexProjection.projOn`）。
stmt:
def projSgdUpdate (C : Set ℝ) (hne : C.Nonempty) (hcomp : IsComplete C) (hconv : Convex ℝ C)
    (eta x ghat : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: projOn C hne hcomp hconv (sgd_update eta x ghat)

name: projOn_point_le
doc:
**投影非扩张（到固定点）**：`x* ∈ C` ⟹ `‖Π_C(u) − x*‖ ≤ ‖u − x*‖`。
由 `RealConvexProjection.proj_nonexpansive_of_variational`（`x*` 自身的变分不等式平凡）。
stmt:
theorem projOn_point_le (C : Set ℝ) (hne : C.Nonempty) (hcomp : IsComplete C)
    (hconv : Convex ℝ C) {xstar u : ℝ} (hxC : xstar ∈ C) :
    ‖projOn C hne hcomp hconv u - xstar‖ ≤ ‖u - xstar‖
proof:
proj_nonexpansive_of_variational (projOn_mem C hne hcomp hconv u) hxC
    (projOn_variational C hne hcomp hconv u)
    (fun z _ => by simp)

name: proj_sgd_expectation_contraction
doc:
**投影 SGD 单步期望收缩**：`E[ĝ]` 是 `f` 在 `x` 处的（次）梯度、`E[ĝ²] ≤ G²`、
`x* ∈ C` ⟹
`E‖Π_C(x − ηĝ) − x*‖² ≤ ‖x − x*‖² − 2η(f x − f x*) + η²G²`。
stmt:
theorem proj_sgd_expectation_contraction {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : Ω → ℝ} (g : Ω → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (hpsum : (∑ ω, p ω) = 1)
    (C : Set ℝ) (hne : C.Nonempty) (hcomp : IsComplete C) (hconv : Convex ℝ C)
    {xstar : ℝ} (hxC : xstar ∈ C)
    (x eta G : ℝ) (heta : 0 ≤ eta)
    (hsub : Subgradient f x (Expect p g))
    (hG : Expect p (fun ω => g ω ^ 2) ≤ G ^ 2) :
    Expect p (fun ω => ‖projSgdUpdate C hne hcomp hconv eta x (g ω) - xstar‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ‖x - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * eta * (f x - f xstar) + eta ^ 2 * G ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hbase := sgd_expectation_contraction (p := p) g hpsum x xstar eta G heta hsub hG
  have hsq : ∀ ω, ‖projSgdUpdate C hne hcomp hconv eta x (g ω) - xstar‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ‖sgd_update eta x (g ω) - xstar‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro ω
    have h1 : ‖projOn C hne hcomp hconv (sgd_update eta x (g ω)) - xstar‖
        ≤ ‖sgd_update eta x (g ω) - xstar‖ :=
      projOn_point_le C hne hcomp hconv hxC (u := sgd_update eta x (g ω))
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖projOn C hne hcomp hconv (sgd_update eta x (g ω)) - xstar‖ :=
      norm_nonneg _
    have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖sgd_update eta x (g ω) - xstar‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have h4 : projSgdUpdate C hne hcomp hconv eta x (g ω)
        = projOn C hne hcomp hconv (sgd_update eta x (g ω)) := rfl
    rw [h4]
    nlinarith [h1, h2, h3]
  have hmono : Expect p (fun ω => ‖projSgdUpdate C hne hcomp hconv eta x (g ω) - xstar‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ Expect p (fun ω => ‖sgd_update eta x (g ω) - xstar‖ ^ 2) := by
    simp only [Expect]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsq ω) (hp0 ω))
  linarith [hmono, hbase]

name: unbounded_variance_weaker_than_uniform
doc:
**二阶矩界不蕴含逐样本有界（机器验证反例）**：在两点均匀概率空间 `Fin 2` 上取
`G = 1`、`g 0 = √2`、`g 1 = 0`，则 `E[g²] = 1 ≤ G²` 但 `|g 0| = √2 > G`。
这说明 `E‖g‖² ≤ G²`（无界方差假设）**比**「`∀ω, ‖g ω‖ ≤ G`」**更弱**。
stmt:
theorem unbounded_variance_weaker_than_uniform :
    ∃ (G : ℝ) (g : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      Expect (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (fun ω => g ω ^ 2) ≤ G ^ 2 ∧ ∃ ω, G < |g ω|
proof:
by
  have hsqrt : (1 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [show (1 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 by simp]
    exact Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨1, fun ω : Fin 2 => if ω = 0 then Real.sqrt 2 else 0, ?_, ⟨0, ?_⟩⟩
  · simp only [Expect, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [show ((0 : Fin 2) = 0) = True from by simp, if_true]
    rw [if_neg (by decide : ¬ ((1 : Fin 2) = 0))]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    norm_num
  · simp only [show ((0 : Fin 2) = 0) = True from by simp, if_true]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2)]
    exact hsqrt

name: Expect_finset_sum
doc: **期望与有限和交换**：`E[∑_i F_i] = ∑_i E[F_i]`。
stmt:
lemma Expect_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (p : Ω → ℝ) (F : ι → Ω → ℝ) (t : Finset ι) :
    Expect p (fun ω => ∑ i in t, F i ω) = ∑ i in t, Expect p (F i)
proof:
by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [Expect]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have hfun : (fun ω => ∑ j in insert a s, F j ω)
          = (fun ω => F a ω + ∑ j in s, F j ω) := by
        funext ω
        rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      rw [hfun, Expect_add, ih, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: sgd_average_jensen
doc:
**Jensen 不等式（等权）**：`f` 凸、`T > 0` ⟹
`f((∑_{t<T} x_t)/T) ≤ (∑_{t<T} f(x_t))/T`。
由 mathlib `ConvexOn.map_sum_le` 取权重 `1/T`。
stmt:
theorem sgd_average_jensen {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) {T : ℕ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    f ((∑ t in Finset.range T, x t) / (T : ℝ))
      ≤ (∑ t in Finset.range T, f (x t)) / (T : ℝ)
proof:
by
  have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) < (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hw : (∑ _t in Finset.range T, (1 / (T : ℝ))) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have h := ConvexOn.map_sum_le (t := Finset.range T) (w := fun _ : ℕ => 1 / (T : ℝ))
    (p := x) (s := Set.univ) hf (fun i _ => by positivity) hw (fun i _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
  have hl : (∑ t in Finset.range T, (1 / (T : ℝ)) * x t)
      = (∑ t in Finset.range T, x t) / (T : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    ring_nf
  have hr : (∑ t in Finset.range T, (1 / (T : ℝ)) * f (x t))
      = (∑ t in Finset.range T, f (x t)) / (T : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    ring_nf
  rwa [hl, hr] at h

name: sgd_avg_gap_bound
doc:
**平均期望差距界**：由 `RealSGDStochastic.sgd_expected_avg_gap` 除以 `T`：
`(1/T)∑_{t<T} E[f(x_t)−f*] ≤ E₀/(2ηT) + ηG²/2`。
stmt:
theorem sgd_avg_gap_bound {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (x : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (xstar G eta : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (heta : 0 < eta)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar ≤
      ExpDist p (x t) xstar - 2 * eta * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar + eta ^ 2 * G ^ 2) :
    (∑ t in Finset.range T, ExpGap p f (x t) xstar) / (T : ℝ)
      ≤ ExpDist p (x 0) xstar / (2 * eta * (T : ℝ)) + eta * G ^ 2 / 2
proof:
by
  have havg := sgd_expected_avg_gap p hp0 f x xstar G eta T heta hstep
  have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) < (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hTpos]
  have heq : (ExpDist p (x 0) xstar / (2 * eta * (T : ℝ)) + eta * G ^ 2 / 2) * (T : ℝ)
      = (ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + eta ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) / (2 * eta) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [heq]
  linarith [havg]

name: sgd_average_iterate_gap
doc:
**平均迭代的函数值界（Jensen）**：`f` 凸、`∑p = 1`、`p ≥ 0`、逐步期望收缩 ⟹
`E[f(x̄_T) − f*] ≤ E₀/(2ηT) + ηG²/2`，其中 `x̄_T = (1/T)∑_{t<T} x_t`。

证明：逐点 Jensen 给 `f(x̄_T) ≤ (1/T)∑ f(x_t)`，取期望后化为
`(1/T)∑ ExpGap`，再用 `sgd_avg_gap_bound`。
stmt:
theorem sgd_average_iterate_gap {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω)
    (hpsum : (∑ ω, p ω) = 1) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f)
    (x : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (xstar G eta : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (heta : 0 < eta)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar ≤
      ExpDist p (x t) xstar - 2 * eta * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar + eta ^ 2 * G ^ 2) :
    ExpGap p f (fun ω => (∑ t in Finset.range T, x t ω) / (T : ℝ)) xstar
      ≤ ExpDist p (x 0) xstar / (2 * eta * (T : ℝ)) + eta * G ^ 2 / 2
proof:
by
  have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) < (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hjensen : ∀ ω, f ((∑ t in Finset.range T, x t ω) / (T : ℝ))
      ≤ (∑ t in Finset.range T, f (x t ω)) / (T : ℝ) :=
    fun ω => sgd_average_jensen hf hT (fun t => x t ω)
  have hmono : Expect p (fun ω => f ((∑ t in Finset.range T, x t ω) / (T : ℝ)) - f xstar)
      ≤ Expect p (fun ω => (∑ t in Finset.range T, f (x t ω)) / (T : ℝ) - f xstar) := by
    simp only [Expect]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ω _ =>

name: sgd_projected_rate_bound
doc:
**投影 SGD 的 O(GD/√T)**：与 `RealSGDStochastic.sgd_rate_bound` 相同的率，
只是单步假设由**投影**单步收缩（定理 2）提供：
`D² = E‖x_0 − x*‖²`、`η = D/(G√T)` ⟹ `∃ t < T, E[f(x_t) − f*] ≤ D·G/√T`。
stmt:
theorem sgd_projected_rate_bound {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (x : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (xstar G D eta : ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hG : 0 < G) (hT : 0 < T) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hD2 : ExpDist p (x 0) xstar = D ^ 2)
    (heta : eta = D / (G * Real.sqrt (T : ℝ)))
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar ≤
      ExpDist p (x t) xstar - 2 * eta * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar + eta ^ 2 * G ^ 2) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, t < T ∧ ExpGap p f (x t) xstar ≤ D * G / Real.sqrt (T : ℝ)
proof:
sgd_rate_bound p hp0 f x xstar G D eta T hG hT hD hD2 heta hstep

name: Expect
doc: 有限概率空间上的期望：E[X] = Σ_ω p(ω)·X(ω)。
stmt: def Expect (p : Ω → ℝ) (X : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ ω, p ω * X ω

name: Expect_const
doc: 期望对常数函数：E[c] = (Σ p)·c。
stmt:
lemma Expect_const (p : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    Expect p (fun _ : Ω => c) = (∑ ω, p ω) * c
proof:
by
  simp only [Expect]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]

name: Expect_const_mul
doc: 期望对常系数乘法：E[c·X] = c·E[X]。
stmt:
lemma Expect_const_mul (p : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (X : Ω → ℝ) :
    Expect p (fun ω => c * X ω) = c * Expect p X
proof:
by
  simp only [Expect]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)

name: Expect_add
doc: 期望可加。
stmt:
lemma Expect_add (p : Ω → ℝ) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) :
    Expect p (fun ω => X ω + Y ω) = Expect p X + Expect p Y
proof:
by
  simp only [Expect]
  rw [show (∑ ω, p ω * (X ω + Y ω)) = ∑ ω, (p ω * X ω + p ω * Y ω) from
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Expect_sub
doc: 期望可减。
stmt:
lemma Expect_sub (p : Ω → ℝ) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) :
    Expect p (fun ω => X ω - Y ω) = Expect p X - Expect p Y
proof:
by
  simp only [Expect]
  rw [show (∑ ω, p ω * (X ω - Y ω)) = ∑ ω, (p ω * X ω - p ω * Y ω) from
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ω _ => by ring)]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: Expect_nonneg
doc: 期望的单调性（用 p ≥ 0）。
stmt:
lemma Expect_nonneg {p : Ω → ℝ} (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) {X : Ω → ℝ}
    (hX : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω) : 0 ≤ Expect p X
proof:
by
  simp only [Expect]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ω _ => mul_nonneg (hp0 ω) (hX ω))

name: sgd_update
doc: SGD 单步：x' = x − η·ghat。
stmt: def sgd_update (η x ghat : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: x - η * ghat

name: sgd_deterministic_recovery
doc: 确定性次梯度步是 SGD 步的特例（对照 RealSubgradientDescent）。
stmt:
theorem sgd_deterministic_recovery (η x grad : ℝ) :
    sgd_update η x grad = subgradient_descent_step η x grad
proof: rfl

name: Expect_norm_sq_sgd_update
doc:
期望平方距离的展开（核心代数恒等式）：
E‖x − η·ĝ − x*‖² = (Σp)(x−x*)² − 2η(x−x*)·E[ĝ] + η²·E[ĝ²]。
stmt:
lemma Expect_norm_sq_sgd_update (p : Ω → ℝ) (x xstar η : ℝ) (g : Ω → ℝ) :
    Expect p (fun ω => ‖sgd_update η x (g ω) - xstar‖ ^ 2)
      = (∑ ω, p ω) * (x - xstar) ^ 2
        - 2 * η * (x - xstar) * Expect p g
        + η ^ 2 * Expect p (fun ω => g ω ^ 2)
proof:
by
  unfold sgd_update
  have hfun : (fun ω : Ω => ‖x - η * g ω - xstar‖ ^ 2)
      = (fun ω : Ω => ((x - xstar) ^ 2 - 2 * η * (x - xstar) * g ω) + η ^ 2 * (g ω) ^ 2) := by
    funext ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  rw [Expect_add, Expect_sub, Expect_const, Expect_const_mul, Expect_const_mul]

name: ExpDist_nonneg
doc: 期望平方距离非负。
stmt:
lemma ExpDist_nonneg (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (x : Ω → ℝ) (xstar : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ Expect p (fun ω => ‖x ω - xstar‖ ^ 2)
proof: Expect_nonneg hp0 (fun ω => sq_nonneg (‖x ω - xstar‖))

name: sgd_expectation_contraction
doc:
**SGD 单步期望收缩**。设 ĝ 是 ∇f(x) 的无偏估计（以 `Subgradient f x (Expect p g)`
刻画：E[ĝ] 是 f 在 x 处的梯度/次梯度），且二阶矩 E[‖ĝ‖²] ≤ G²。则
E‖x' − x*‖² ≤ ‖x − x*‖² − 2η(f x − f x*) + η²G²。
stmt:
theorem sgd_expectation_contraction {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : Ω → ℝ} (g : Ω → ℝ)
    (hpsum : (∑ ω, p ω) = 1)
    (x xstar η G : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hsub : Subgradient f x (Expect p g))
    (hG : Expect p (fun ω => g ω ^ 2) ≤ G ^ 2) :
    Expect p (fun ω => ‖sgd_update η x (g ω) - xstar‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ‖x - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * (f x - f xstar) + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hexp := Expect_norm_sq_sgd_update (p := p) x xstar η g
  have hdec := subgradient_step_decrease hsub xstar
  have hnorm : ‖x - xstar‖ ^ 2 = (x - xstar) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hcross : 2 * η * (f x - f xstar) ≤ 2 * η * (x - xstar) * Expect p g := by
    nlinarith [hdec, hη]
  have hG' : η ^ 2 * Expect p (fun ω => g ω ^ 2) ≤ η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hG (sq_nonneg η)
  rw [hexp, hpsum, one_mul, hnorm]
  nlinarith [hcross, hG']

name: sgd_variance_identity
doc: **方差恒等式**：Var[ĝ] = E[ĝ²] − (E[ĝ])²。
stmt:
theorem sgd_variance_identity (p : Ω → ℝ) (g : Ω → ℝ) (hpsum : (∑ ω, p ω) = 1) :
    Expect p (fun ω => (g ω - Expect p g) ^ 2)
      = Expect p (fun ω => g ω ^ 2) - (Expect p g) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hfun : (fun ω : Ω => (g ω - Expect p g) ^ 2)
      = (fun ω : Ω => (g ω ^ 2 - 2 * (Expect p g) * g ω) + (Expect p g) ^ 2) := by
    funext ω
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  rw [Expect_add, Expect_sub, Expect_const_mul, Expect_const, hpsum, one_mul]
  ring

name: sgd_variance_nonneg
doc: 方差非负：E[(ĝ − E[ĝ])²] ≥ 0（用 p ≥ 0）。
stmt:
theorem sgd_variance_nonneg (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (g : Ω → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ Expect p (fun ω => (g ω - Expect p g) ^ 2)
proof: Expect_nonneg hp0 (fun ω => sq_nonneg (g ω - Expect p g))

name: sgd_expectation_contraction_variance
doc:
**方差形式的期望收缩**：η²E[ĝ²] = η²((E[ĝ])² + Var[ĝ]），
即噪声方差以 η²·Var 的代价抬高单步界。
stmt:
theorem sgd_expectation_contraction_variance {f : ℝ → ℝ} {p : Ω → ℝ} (g : Ω → ℝ)
    (hpsum : (∑ ω, p ω) = 1)
    (x xstar η : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hsub : Subgradient f x (Expect p g)) :
    Expect p (fun ω => ‖sgd_update η x (g ω) - xstar‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ‖x - xstar‖ ^ 2 - 2 * η * (f x - f xstar)
        + η ^ 2 * ((Expect p g) ^ 2 + Expect p (fun ω => (g ω - Expect p g) ^ 2))
proof:
by
  have hexp := Expect_norm_sq_sgd_update (p := p) x xstar η g
  have hvar := sgd_variance_identity (p := p) g hpsum
  have hdec := subgradient_step_decrease hsub xstar
  have hnorm : ‖x - xstar‖ ^ 2 = (x - xstar) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hcross : 2 * η * (f x - f xstar) ≤ 2 * η * (x - xstar) * Expect p g := by
    nlinarith [hdec, hη]
  rw [hexp, hpsum, one_mul, hnorm]
  nlinarith [hcross, hvar]

name: ExpDist
doc: 期望平方距离：E‖x − x*‖²。
stmt: def ExpDist (p : Ω → ℝ) (x : Ω → ℝ) (xstar : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: Expect p (fun ω => ‖x ω - xstar‖ ^ 2)

name: ExpGap
doc: 期望次优差距：E[f(x) − f(x*)]。
stmt: def ExpGap (p : Ω → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : Ω → ℝ) (xstar : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: Expect p (fun ω => f (x ω) - f xstar)

name: sgd_expected_gap_sum_seq
doc:
**期望收缩的望远镜求和**：若每一步的期望平方距离按
E_{t+1} ≤ E_t − 2η·Gap_t + η²G² 收缩，则
2η·Σ_{t<T} Gap_t ≤ E_0 + η²TG²。
stmt:
theorem sgd_expected_gap_sum_seq (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (x : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (xstar η G : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (_hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar ≤
      ExpDist p (x t) xstar - 2 * η * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2) :
    2 * η * (∑ t in Finset.range T, ExpGap p f (x t) xstar) ≤
      ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hstep_le : ∀ t : ℕ, 2 * η * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar ≤
      ExpDist p (x t) xstar - ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2 := by
    intro t
    have h := hstep t
    nlinarith [h]
  have hsum : (∑ t in Finset.range T, 2 * η * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar) ≤
      ∑ t in Finset.range T,
        (ExpDist p (x t) xstar - ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t _ => hstep_le t)
  have hsplit :
      (∑ t in Finset.range T,
          (ExpDist p (x t) xstar - ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2))
        = (∑ t in Finset.range T,
            (ExpDist p (x t) xstar - ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar))
          + η ^ 2 * (∑ t in Finset.range T, G ^ 2) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hconst : (∑ t in Finset.range T, G ^ 2) = (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have htel : (∑ t in Finset.range T,
        (ExpDist p (x t) xstar - ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar))
      = ExpDist p (x 0) xstar - ExpDist p (x T) xstar :=
    sum_range_sub_telescoping T
  have hET : 0 ≤ ExpDist p (x T) xstar :=
    ExpDist_nonneg p hp0 (x T) xstar
  have htel_le : (∑ t in Finset.range T,
        (ExpDist p (x t) xstar - ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar))
      ≤ ExpDist p (x 0) xstar := by
    rw [htel]
    linarith
  calc
    2 * η * (∑ t in Finset.range T, ExpGap p f (x t) xstar)
        = ∑ t in Finset.range T, 2 * η * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: sgd_expected_avg_gap
doc: 平均期望差距界：Σ_{t<T} E[f(x_t) − f x*] ≤ (E_0 + η²TG²)/(2η)。
stmt:
theorem sgd_expected_avg_gap (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (x : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (xstar G η : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar ≤
      ExpDist p (x t) xstar - 2 * η * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2) :
    (∑ t in Finset.range T, ExpGap p f (x t) xstar) ≤
      (ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) / (2 * η)
proof:
by
  have h := sgd_expected_gap_sum_seq p hp0 f x xstar η G T (le_of_lt hη) hstep
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * η)]
  nlinarith [h]

name: sgd_expected_min_gap
doc:
**存在一步的期望差距界**：∃ t < T，
E[f(x_t) − f x*] ≤ (E_0 + η²TG²)/(2ηT)（min ≤ 平均）。
stmt:
theorem sgd_expected_min_gap (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (x : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (xstar G η : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hη : 0 < η) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar ≤
      ExpDist p (x t) xstar - 2 * η * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, t < T ∧
      ExpGap p f (x t) xstar ≤
        (ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) / (2 * η * (T : ℝ))
proof:
by
  have havg := sgd_expected_avg_gap p hp0 f x xstar G η T hη hstep
  let B : ℝ := (ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) / (2 * η)
  have hTne : (T : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hT)
  have hB : B = (T : ℝ) *
      ((ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) / (2 * η * (T : ℝ))) := by
    dsimp [B]
    field_simp [mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (ne_of_gt hη), hTne]
    ring
  have hcalc : (∑ t in Finset.range T, ExpGap p f (x t) xstar) ≤
      (T : ℝ) * ((ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) / (2 * η * (T : ℝ))) := by
    calc
      (∑ t in Finset.range T, ExpGap p f (x t) xstar) ≤ B := havg
      _ = (T : ℝ) * ((ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2)
            / (2 * η * (T : ℝ))) := hB
  rcases exists_le_sum_mul (a := fun t : ℕ => ExpGap p f (x t) xstar) hT hcalc with
    ⟨t, ht, hgap⟩
  exact ⟨t, ht, hgap⟩

name: sgd_rate_bound_aux
doc:
**一般半径形式的 O(1/T) 率**（s > 0、s² = T、η = D/(G·s)）：
∃ t < T, E[f(x_t) − f x*] ≤ D·G/s。
stmt:
theorem sgd_rate_bound_aux (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (x : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (xstar G D s η : ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hG : 0 < G) (hT : 0 < T) (hD : 0 < D) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hssq : s ^ 2 = (T : ℝ))
    (hD2 : ExpDist p (x 0) xstar = D ^ 2)
    (hη : η = D / (G * s))
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar ≤
      ExpDist p (x t) xstar - 2 * η * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, t < T ∧ ExpGap p f (x t) xstar ≤ D * G / s
proof:
by
  have hTne : (T : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt hT)
  have hDne : D ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hD
  have hGne : G ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hG
  have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs
  have hηpos : 0 < η := by
    rw [hη]
    exact div_pos hD (mul_pos hG hs)
  rcases sgd_expected_min_gap p hp0 f x xstar G η T hηpos hT hstep with ⟨t, ht, hgap⟩
  have hbnd : (ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) / (2 * η * (T : ℝ))
      = D * G / s := by
    have hs4 : s ^ 4 = (T : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      calc
        s ^ 4 = (s ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = (T : ℝ) ^ 2 := by rw [hssq]
    rw [hD2, hη]
    have hden_ne : 2 * η * (T : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) (ne_of_gt hηpos)) hTne
    have hmul_ne : G * s ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hGne hs_ne
    field_simp [hDne, hGne, hs_ne, hden_ne, hmul_ne]
    ring_nf
    rw [hssq, hs4]
    ring
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  calc
    ExpGap p f (x t) xstar
        ≤ (ExpDist p (x 0) xstar + η ^ 2 * (T : ℝ) * G ^ 2) / (2 * η * (T : ℝ)) := hgap
    _ = D * G / s := hbnd

name: sgd_rate_bound
doc:
**SGD 的 O(GD/√T) 期望率**：D² = E‖x_0 − x*‖²、η = D/(G√T) ⟹
∃ t < T, E[f(x_t) − f x*] ≤ D·G/√T。D>0、G>0、T>0 防退化。
stmt:
theorem sgd_rate_bound (p : Ω → ℝ) (hp0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ p ω) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (x : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (xstar G D η : ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hG : 0 < G) (hT : 0 < T) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hD2 : ExpDist p (x 0) xstar = D ^ 2)
    (hη : η = D / (G * Real.sqrt (T : ℝ)))
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, ExpDist p (x (t + 1)) xstar ≤
      ExpDist p (x t) xstar - 2 * η * ExpGap p f (x t) xstar + η ^ 2 * G ^ 2) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, t < T ∧ ExpGap p f (x t) xstar ≤ D * G / Real.sqrt (T : ℝ)
proof:
by
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hT
  have hs_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (T : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by exact_mod_cast hT)
  have hs_sq : Real.sqrt (T : ℝ) ^ 2 = (T : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hT0
  exact sgd_rate_bound_aux p hp0 f x xstar G D (Real.sqrt (T : ℝ)) η T hG hT hD
    hs_pos hs_sq hD2 hη hstep

name: IsSaddle
doc:
**一维鞍点**：驻点，但既不是局部极小也不是局部极大
（「二阶信息不足」的驻点；一维情形下等价于 `f''(x) = 0` 且信息不足）。
stmt: def IsSaddle (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : Prop
proof: deriv f x = 0 ∧ ¬ IsLocalMin f x ∧ ¬ IsLocalMax f x

name: IsStrictLocalMax
doc: **严格局部极大**：存在 δ > 0，使 x 的 δ-邻域内所有 y ≠ x 满足 f(y) < f(x)。
stmt: def IsStrictLocalMax (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y, y ≠ x → |y - x| < δ → f y < f x

name: isStrictLocalMax_iff_neg
doc: **对偶**：f 在 x 严格局部极大 ⟺ `−f` 在 x 严格局部极小。
stmt:
theorem isStrictLocalMax_iff_neg (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    IsStrictLocalMax f x ↔ IsStrictLocalMin (fun y : ℝ => -f y) x
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy hlt => ?_⟩
    have := h y hy hlt
    simp only []
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy hlt => ?_⟩
    have := h y hy hlt
    simp only [] at this
    linarith

name: IsStrictLocalMax.toIsLocalMax
doc: 严格局部极大 ⟹ 局部极大。
stmt:
theorem IsStrictLocalMax.toIsLocalMax {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ} (h : IsStrictLocalMax f x) :
    IsLocalMax f x
proof:
by
  have hmin := (isStrictLocalMax_iff_neg f x).mp h
  have hmax := hmin.toIsLocalMin.neg
  simpa using hmax

name: strict_local_max_of_deriv_sign
doc:
**MVT 引擎（极大版）**：f 在 (x−η, x+η) 上连续可微，且 ∀z ≠ x，
`(z−x)·f'(z) < 0`（左正右负），则 x 是严格局部极大。

证明：`−f` 的导数满足极小引擎的异号条件（`deriv.neg`），
故 `−f` 在 x 严格局部极小，即 f 在 x 严格局部极大。
stmt:
theorem strict_local_max_of_deriv_sign (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hf_cont : ContinuousOn f (Ioo (x - η) (x + η)))
    (hf_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo (x - η) (x + η)))
    (hsign : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (x - η) (x + η), z ≠ x → (z - x) * deriv f z < 0) :
    ∀ y, y ≠ x → |y - x| < η → f y < f x
proof:
by
  have hmin := strict_local_min_of_deriv_sign (fun y : ℝ => -f y) x η hη
    hf_cont.neg hf_diff.neg (by
      intro z hz hzx
      have hz' := hsign z hz hzx
      rw [deriv.neg]
      nlinarith)
  intro y hy hlt
  have := hmin y hy hlt
  simpa using this

name: second_order_sufficient_max
doc:
**二阶充分条件（极大）**：f 在 (x−δ, x+δ) 上连续、可微、f' 连续、f'' 处处为负，
且 f'(x) = 0，则 x 是**严格局部极大**。
stmt:
theorem second_order_sufficient_max (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hf_cont : ContinuousOn f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf'_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf''_neg : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ), deriv (deriv f) z < 0)
    (hstat : deriv f x = 0) : IsStrictLocalMax f x
proof:
by
  have hf'neg : ContinuousOn (deriv (fun y : ℝ => -f y)) (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)) := by
    have h : deriv (fun y : ℝ => -f y) = fun y : ℝ => -deriv f y := by
      funext y
      exact deriv.neg
    rw [h]
    exact hf'_cont.neg
  have hf''pos : ∀ z ∈ Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ), 0 < deriv (deriv (fun y : ℝ => -f y)) z := by
    intro z hz
    have h : deriv (fun y : ℝ => -f y) = fun y : ℝ => -deriv f y := by
      funext y
      exact deriv.neg
    have h2 : deriv (deriv (fun y : ℝ => -f y)) z = -deriv (deriv f) z := by
      rw [h]
      exact deriv.neg
    rw [h2]
    have := hf''_neg z hz
    linarith
  have hstat' : deriv (fun y : ℝ => -f y) x = 0 := by
    rw [deriv.neg, hstat]
    ring
  exact (isStrictLocalMax_iff_neg f x).mpr
    (second_order_sufficient (fun y : ℝ => -f y) x δ hδ hf_cont.neg hf_diff.neg
      hf'neg hf''pos hstat')

name: saddle_classification
doc:
**鞍点分类（一维）**：在 (x−δ, x+δ) 上 f 连续可微、f' 连续、且 f'(x) = 0 时，
f'' 在该邻域上**恒正** ⟹ 严格局部极小；f'' **恒负** ⟹ 严格局部极大。
即二阶导数的符号决定极值类型。
stmt:
theorem saddle_classification (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hf_cont : ContinuousOn f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf'_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hstat : deriv f x = 0) :
    ((∀ z ∈ Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ), 0 < deriv (deriv f) z) → IsStrictLocalMin f x) ∧
    ((∀ z ∈ Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ), deriv (deriv f) z < 0) → IsStrictLocalMax f x)
proof:
⟨fun h => second_order_sufficient f x δ hδ hf_cont hf_diff hf'_cont h hstat,
   fun h => second_order_sufficient_max f x δ hδ hf_cont hf_diff hf'_cont h hstat⟩

name: exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos
doc:
g 在 x 处连续且 `g x > 0` ⟹ 存在充分小的盒子使 g 在盒内严格为正
（`RealKKTSecondOrder.exists_box_of_continuousAt_neg` 的对偶）。
stmt:
theorem exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos (g : ℝ → ℝ) {x δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hg : ContinuousAt g x) (hpos : 0 < g x) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η ≤ δ ∧ ∀ z, |z - x| < η → 0 < g z
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηδ, hbox⟩ :=
    exists_box_of_continuousAt_neg (fun z : ℝ => -g z) hδ hg.neg (by change -g x < 0; linarith)
  refine ⟨η, hη, hηδ, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have h' : -g z < 0 := hbox z hz
  linarith

name: saddle_second_deriv_zero
doc:
**鞍点的二阶必要条件**：f'' 在 x 处连续、x 是鞍点（驻点但既非局部极小也非局部极大）
⟹ `f''(x) = 0`；否则由分类定理落入极小或极大分支。

证明（反证）：若 f''(x) > 0，由 `exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos` 取 η ≤ δ 使 f'' > 0 于
(x−η, x+η)，由 `saddle_classification` 得严格局部极小，从而局部极小，与鞍点的
`¬IsLocalMin` 矛盾；f''(x) < 0 对称（用 `exists_box_of_continuousAt_neg`）。
stmt:
theorem saddle_second_deriv_zero (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hf_cont : ContinuousOn f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf'_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv f) (Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ)))
    (hf''_cont : ContinuousAt (deriv (deriv f)) x)
    (hsaddle : IsSaddle f x) : deriv (deriv f) x = 0
proof:
by
  have hstat : deriv f x = 0 := hsaddle.1
  rcases lt_trichotomy (deriv (deriv f) x) 0 with hlt | heq | hgt
  · obtain ⟨η, hη, hηδ, hbox⟩ :=
      exists_box_of_continuousAt_neg (deriv (deriv f)) hδ hf''_cont hlt
    have hsub : Ioo (x - η) (x + η) ⊆ Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ) := by
      intro t ht
      rw [mem_Ioo] at ht ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2, hηδ]
    have hmax : IsStrictLocalMax f x :=
      second_order_sufficient_max f x η hη (hf_cont.mono hsub) (hf_diff.mono hsub)
        (hf'_cont.mono hsub) (fun z hz => hbox z (by
          rw [abs_lt]
          constructor <;> linarith [hz.1, hz.2])) hstat
    exact absurd hmax.toIsLocalMax hsaddle.2.2
  · exact heq
  · obtain ⟨η, hη, hηδ, hbox⟩ :=
      exists_box_of_continuousAt_pos (deriv (deriv f)) hδ hf''_cont hgt
    have hsub : Ioo (x - η) (x + η) ⊆ Ioo (x - δ) (x + δ) := by
      intro t ht
      rw [mem_Ioo] at ht ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2, hηδ]
    have hmin : IsStrictLocalMin f x :=
      second_order_sufficient f x η hη (hf_cont.mono hsub) (hf_diff.mono hsub)
        (hf'_cont.mono hsub) (fun z hz => hbox z (by
          rw [abs_lt]
          constructor <;> linarith [hz.1, hz.2])) hstat
    exact absurd hmin.toIsLocalMin hsaddle.2.1

name: deriv_pow4
doc: `deriv (·⁴) x = 4x³`。
stmt: lemma deriv_pow4 (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 4) x = 4 * x ^ 3
proof:
by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 4) (4 * x ^ 3) x := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).pow 4
  exact h.deriv

name: deriv_four_pow3
doc: `deriv (4·(·)³) x = 12x²`。
stmt: lemma deriv_four_pow3 (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun y : ℝ => 4 * y ^ 3) x = 12 * x ^ 2
proof:
by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 3) (3 * x ^ 2) x := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).pow 3
  have h2 := h1.const_mul (4 : ℝ)
  have := h2.deriv
  rw [this]
  ring

name: isStrictLocalMin_pow4
doc: x⁴ 在 0 处是严格局部极小。
stmt: lemma isStrictLocalMin_pow4 : IsStrictLocalMin (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4) 0
proof:
by
  refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun y hy _ => ?_⟩
  have h2 : 0 < y ^ 2 := by
    have : y ≠ 0 := hy
    positivity
  have h4 : (0 : ℝ) < y ^ 4 := by
    have := sq_pos_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt h2)
    nlinarith [this]
  simpa using h4

name: isStrictLocalMax_neg_pow4
doc: −x⁴ 在 0 处是严格局部极大。
stmt: lemma isStrictLocalMax_neg_pow4 : IsStrictLocalMax (fun x : ℝ => -(x ^ 4)) 0
proof:
by
  refine (isStrictLocalMax_iff_neg (fun x : ℝ => -(x ^ 4)) 0).mpr ?_
  have h : (fun y : ℝ => -(fun x : ℝ => -(x ^ 4)) y) = fun y : ℝ => y ^ 4 := by
    funext y
    ring
  rw [h]
  exact isStrictLocalMin_pow4

name: second_deriv_zero_undetermined
doc:
**f'' = 0 时二阶条件不足**：存在 f 使 f'(0) = f''(0) = 0 且 0 是严格局部极小
（f = x⁴），也存在这样的 f 使 0 是严格局部极大（f = −x⁴）。
stmt:
theorem second_deriv_zero_undetermined :
    (∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, deriv f 0 = 0 ∧ deriv (deriv f) 0 = 0 ∧ IsStrictLocalMin f 0) ∧
    (∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, deriv f 0 = 0 ∧ deriv (deriv f) 0 = 0 ∧ IsStrictLocalMax f 0)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4, ?_, ?_, isStrictLocalMin_pow4⟩
    · rw [deriv_pow4]; ring
    · have h : deriv (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 4) = fun y : ℝ => 4 * y ^ 3 := by
        funext y
        exact deriv_pow4 y
      rw [h, deriv_four_pow3]
      ring
  · refine ⟨fun x : ℝ => -(x ^ 4), ?_, ?_, isStrictLocalMax_neg_pow4⟩
    · have h : deriv (fun y : ℝ => -(y ^ 4)) 0 = -deriv (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 4) 0 := deriv.neg
      rw [h, deriv_pow4]
      ring
    · have h1 : deriv (fun y : ℝ => -(y ^ 4)) = fun y : ℝ => -(4 * y ^ 3) := by
        funext y
        have := deriv.neg (f := fun y : ℝ => y ^ 4) (x := y)
        rw [this, deriv_pow4]
      rw [h1]
      have h2 : deriv (fun y : ℝ => -(4 * y ^ 3)) 0 = -deriv (fun y : ℝ => 4 * y ^ 3) 0 :=
        deriv.neg
      rw [h2, deriv_four_pow3]
      ring

name: deriv_pow3
doc: `deriv (·³) x = 3x²`。
stmt: lemma deriv_pow3 (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 3) x = 3 * x ^ 2
proof:
by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 3) (3 * x ^ 2) x := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).pow 3
  exact h.deriv

name: isSaddle_cube
doc:
**x³ 在 0 处是真鞍点**：`deriv = 0`，但 y < 0 时 y³ < 0（非极小）、
y > 0 时 y³ > 0（非极大）。
stmt: theorem isSaddle_cube : IsSaddle (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3) 0
proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [deriv_pow3]
    ring
  · intro hmin
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hmin
    set y : ℝ := -ε / 2 with hy
    have hyball : y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) ε := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
      have h1 : y - 0 = -ε / 2 := by rw [hy]; ring
      rw [h1, abs_of_neg (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have hy3 : y ^ 3 < 0 := by
      have hneg : y < 0 := by rw [hy]; linarith
      have hy2 : 0 < y ^ 2 := by
        have : y ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hneg
        positivity
      nlinarith [mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg hy2]
    have hle := hsub hyball
    have hle' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ 3 := by simpa using hle
    linarith
  · intro hmax
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hmax
    set y : ℝ := ε / 2 with hy
    have hyball : y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) ε := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
      have h1 : y - 0 = ε / 2 := by rw [hy]; ring
      rw [h1, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have hy3 : 0 < y ^ 3 := by
      have hpos : 0 < y := by rw [hy]; linarith
      have hy2 : 0 < y ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_pos hpos hy2]
    have hle := hsub hyball
    have hle' : y ^ 3 ≤ (0 : ℝ) := by simpa using hle
    linarith

name: convex_stationary_is_global_min
doc:
**凸函数的驻点是全局最小点**：`ConvexOn ℝ univ f`、f 在 x 处可导、`f'(x) = 0`
⟹ `∀ y, f x ≤ f y`。

证明：由凸性，割线斜率在 x 两侧夹住导数（`slope_le_deriv` / `deriv_le_slope`），
导数 = 0 即得两侧的差商都非负。
stmt:
theorem convex_stationary_is_global_min {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f)
    {x : ℝ} (hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hstat : deriv f x = 0) :
    ∀ y : ℝ, f x ≤ f y
proof:
by
  intro y
  rcases lt_trichotomy y x with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have hslope := ConvexOn.slope_le_deriv hconv (Set.mem_univ y) (Set.mem_univ x) hlt hdiff
    rw [slope_def_field] at hslope
    rw [hstat] at hslope
    have hpos : 0 < x - y := by linarith
    have : f x - f y ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have := div_pos h hpos
      linarith
    linarith
  · rw [heq]
  · have hslope := ConvexOn.deriv_le_slope hconv (Set.mem_univ x) (Set.mem_univ y) hgt hdiff
    rw [slope_def_field] at hslope
    rw [hstat] at hslope
    have hpos : 0 < y - x := by linarith
    have : 0 ≤ f y - f x := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos h hpos
      linarith
    linarith

name: no_saddle_in_convex
doc:
**凸函数没有鞍点**：凸函数的驻点（f 在 x 处可导）是全局最小点，
从而不可能是鞍点。
stmt:
theorem no_saddle_in_convex {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hconv : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f) {x : ℝ}
    (hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hstat : deriv f x = 0) : ¬ IsSaddle f x
proof:
by
  intro hs
  have hminOn : IsMinOn f Set.univ x :=
    fun y _ => convex_stationary_is_global_min hconv hdiff hstat y
  exact hs.2.1 (IsMinOn.isLocalMin hminOn Filter.univ_mem)

name: gradient_avoidance
doc:
**逃逸方向（代数形式）**：`g ≠ 0` 时存在方向 v 使 `g·v < 0`
（取 `v = −g`，则 `g·(−g) = −g² < 0`）。
stmt: theorem gradient_avoidance (g : ℝ) (h : g ≠ 0) : ∃ v : ℝ, g * v < 0
proof:
by
  refine ⟨-g, ?_⟩
  nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h]

name: descent_direction_exists
doc:
**梯度下降方向的存在性**：f 在 x 处可导、`∇f(x) ≠ 0` ⟹ 存在方向 v 与 t > 0 使
`f (x + t·v) < f x`（沿 `v = −∇f(x)` 的局部下降）。
这是 RealGradDescent 中梯度下降步「确实下降」的一阶依据。
stmt:
theorem descent_direction_exists {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x gx : ℝ} (hd : HasDerivAt f gx x)
    (hne : gx ≠ 0) : ∃ v t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ f (x + t * v) < f x
proof:
by
  have hneg : gx * (-gx) < 0 := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hne]
                                                     
  have hpath : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t * (-gx))) (gx * (-gx)) 0 := by
    have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * (-gx)) (-gx) 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).mul_const (-gx)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t * (-gx)) (-gx) 0 := hinner.const_add x
    have hd' : HasDerivAt f gx ((fun t : ℝ => x + t * (-gx)) 0) := by
      have h0 : (fun t : ℝ => x + t * (-gx)) 0 = x := by simp
      rw [h0]
      exact hd
    simpa [Function.comp] using hd'.comp 0 h2
  have hslope : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (f (x + t * (-gx)) - f x)) (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 (gx * (-gx))) := by
    have h := hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp hpath
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h
  have hle : 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ) :=
    nhdsWithin_mono 0 (fun t ht => ne_of_gt ht)
  have hslope' : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * (f (x + t * (-gx)) - f x)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 (gx * (-gx))) := hslope.mono_left hle
  have hev : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), t⁻¹ * (f (x + t * (-gx)) - f x) < 0 :=
    hslope'.eventually_lt tendsto_const_nhds hneg
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hev
  refine ⟨-gx, ε / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
  have ht : ε / 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) ε ∩ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    refine ⟨?_, by show (0 : ℝ) < ε / 2; linarith⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
    rw [show ε / 2 - 0 = ε / 2 by ring, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    lin

name: isStrictLocalMax_eq_neg_isStrictLocalMin
doc:
BRIDGE: the two modules' STRICT local extremum bodies are verbatim the same
    shape (only the inequality is swapped). This is a genuine seam: the two ends
    were zero-import before (RealKKTSecondOrder -> RealSaddlePoint = false,
    RealSaddlePoint -> RealKKTSecondOrder = true).
stmt:
theorem isStrictLocalMax_eq_neg_isStrictLocalMin (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    IsStrictLocalMax f x =

name: p35
doc: The point (3, 5) in Real^2.
stmt: def p35 : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)
proof: fun i => if i = 0 then 3 else 5

name: pNeg
doc: The centered direction `(-1, 1)`, used as the second half of the decisive witness.
stmt: def pNeg : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)
proof: fun i => if i = 0 then (-1 : Real) else 1

name: ctr_p35
doc: Centering (3, 5) gives (-1, 1): the coordinate form of ctr.
stmt: theorem ctr_p35 : ctr p35 = fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then (-1 : Real) else 1
proof:
by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [ctr, p35, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> norm_num

name: lnE_p35_eq_ne_rmsNormE
doc:
DECISIVE WITNESS: rmsNormE pins the DIRECTION of (3, 5), so it is a POSITIVE
    multiple of (3, 5), whereas lnE centers first and is a multiple of (-1, 1).
    The two therefore cannot be equal: their coordinates have opposite signs.
stmt: theorem lnE_p35_eq_ne_rmsNormE : lnE p35 ≠ rmsNormE p35
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hctr : ctr p35 = fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then (-1 : Real) else 1 := ctr_p35
  rw [lnE, hctr] at h
  have h1 := congrFun h 0
  have h2 := congrFun h 1
  simp only [rmsNormE, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, p35,
    Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.isValue] at h1 h2
                                                                
  have hnorm : ‖(p35 : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2))‖ = Real.sqrt (9 + 25) := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    simp [p35, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:Real) <= 9 + 25)]
    norm_num
  simp only [hnorm] at h1 h2
                                                             
  have h34 : Real.sqrt (9 + 25) = Real.sqrt 34 := by norm_num
  rw [h34] at h1 h2
  have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt 34 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hsne : Real.sqrt 34 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hspos
                                                             
                                                
                                                                 
                                                                  
                                                       
  have hn2 : ‖(pNeg : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2))‖ = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    simp [pNeg, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:Real) <= 2)]
  have hpNeg : pNeg = (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then (-1 : Real) else 1) := rfl
  rw [← hpNeg] at h1 h2
  simp only [hn2] at h1 h2

name: varNormalize_eq_rmsNorm

name: varNormalize_x35_ne_normalize_x35
doc:
THE DECISIVE NON-SEAM (group 4): EXEC-V2 group 4 lumps varNormalize with
    RealLayerNorm.normalize under one signature.  The bodies REFUTE that:
    normalize CENTERS first (fun i => center x i / sqrt (centerSq x)) while
    varNormalize does NOT (fun i => x i / sqrt (varOf x)).  These are the
    LayerNorm vs RMSNorm distinction -- the two codomains agree but the
    operations differ.

    Witness: varNormalize (3,5) is a POSITIVE multiple of (3,5), while
    normalize (3,5) is a multiple of the CENTERED vector (-1,1); their first
    coordinates therefore have opposite signs, so the two maps cannot agree.

by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrFun h 0
  have h1 := congrFun h 1
  simp only [Lattice.varNormalize, Lattice.normalize, Lattice.center, Lattice.mean,
    Lattice.varOf, Lattice.centerSq, x35, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h0 h1
                                                 
                                                           
                   
                                                                
                                        
  norm_num at h0
                                                             
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < 3 / Real.sqrt 17 := by positivity
  have hneg : -1 / Real.sqrt 2 < (0:ℝ) := by
    have h2pos : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
    exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by norm_num) h2pos
  linarith

doc:

name: normSq_eq_norm_sq
doc:
**`normSq` 就是范数平方**：`normSq v = ‖v‖²`。

证明：`‖v‖² = re ⟪v, v⟫`（`InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_inner`），
在 `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)` 上内积按坐标展开为 `∑ᵢ vᵢ·vᵢ`（`PiLp.inner_apply`），
与 `∑ᵢ vᵢ²` 逐项一致。
stmt:
lemma normSq_eq_norm_sq {n : ℕ} (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    normSq v = ‖v‖ ^ 2
proof:
by
  rw [InnerProductSpace.norm_sq_eq_inner (𝕜 := ℝ)]
  simp only [normSq, PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial, Finset.sum_apply,
    Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  ring

name: exists_modulus_of_posDef
doc:
**主定理（补 RealHessian 的缺口）**：设 `M` 点式正定（`PosDefQ M`），`n > 0`，
则**存在显式模数** `μ > 0` 使
    `∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), μ · normSq v ≤ quadForm M v`。

模数取为单位球面上的最小值 `μ = quadForm M x`（`x` 由极值定理给出）。

证明（有限维紧性）：
  1. `Metric.sphere 0 1` 紧（`isCompact_sphere`）且非空（`sphere_one_nonempty`）；
  2. `quadForm M` 连续（`continuous_quadForm`），由 `IsCompact.exists_isMinOn` 得极小点 `x`；
  3. `x ∈ sphere` ⟹ `‖x‖ = 1` ⟹ `normSq x = 1` ⟹ `x ≠ 0` ⟹ `quadForm M x > 0`（点式正定）；
  4. 对 `v ≠ 0`：`u := ‖v‖⁻¹ • v` 满足 `normSq u = 1`（在球面上），故
     `μ ≤ quadForm M u = ‖v‖⁻² · quadForm M v`，两边乘 `‖v‖² > 0` 即得结论；
  5. `v = 0`：`normSq 0 = 0 ≤ quadForm M 0 = 0`。
stmt:
theorem exists_modulus_of_posDef {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hpd : PosDefQ M) :
    ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), μ * normSq v ≤ quadForm M v
proof:
by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hn
                   
  have hK : IsCompact (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) := isCompact_sphere 0 1
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => quadForm M v)
      (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) := (continuous_quadForm M).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxmin⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn (sphere_one_nonempty hn) hcont
                                  
  have hxnorm : ‖x‖ = 1 := by
    rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] at hx
    exact hx
  have hx1 : normSq x = 1 := by rw [normSq_eq_norm_sq, hxnorm, one_pow]
  have hxne : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, normSq] at hx1
    simp at hx1
  refine ⟨quadForm M x, hpd x hxne, ?_⟩
  intro v
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  ·               
    rw [hv]
    simp [normSq, quadForm]
  ·                
    have hvpos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
    have hne' : ‖v‖ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hvpos
                          
    have hu_sphere : (‖v‖⁻¹ • v) ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hvpos), inv_mul_cancel₀ hne']
    have hmin_u := hxmin hu_sphere
                                              
                                           
    have hsmul : quadForm M (‖v‖⁻¹ • v) = ‖v‖⁻¹ * ‖v‖⁻¹ * quadForm M v := by
      unfold quadForm
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl f

name: modulus_of_posDef_bound
doc:
**模数界（RealHessian 假设形式的无条件版）**：点式正定 `H` 直接给出
`RealHessian.quadratic_lower_bound_of_posdef` 所需的假设
`∀v, μ * normSq v ≤ quadForm H v`（不再需要外部提供 μ）。
