name: sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each
stmt:
lemma sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    SumRelu xs = 0 ↔ ∀ p ∈ xs, ReluOut p.1 p.2 = 0
proof:
by
  unfold SumRelu
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons h t ih =>
      constructor
      · intro hsum p hp
        simp at hp
        rcases hp with rfl | ht
        ·                                         
          have hsum' : relu (p.1 - p.2) +
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := by
            simpa using hsum
          have hrestNonneg : 0 ≤
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := by
            simpa [SumRelu] using sumRelu_nonneg t
          have hh : relu (p.1 - p.2) = 0 := by
            nlinarith [relu_nonneg (p.1 - p.2), hrestNonneg]
          exact hh
        ·                     
          have hsum' : relu (h.1 - h.2) +
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := by
            simpa using hsum
          have hrestNonneg : 0 ≤
              (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := by
            simpa [SumRelu] using sumRelu_nonneg t
          have hrest : (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := by
            nlinarith [relu_nonneg (h.1 - h.2), hrestNonneg]
          exact (ih.mp hrest) p ht
      · intro hall
        have hh : relu (h.1 - h.2) = 0 := hall h (by simp)
        have ht : ∀ p ∈ t, ReluOut p.1 p.2 = 0 := fun p hp => hall p (by simp [hp])
        have hrest : (t.map (fun p => relu (p.1 - p.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 = 0 := ih.mpr ht
        simp [hh,

name: sumRelu_all_constraints
stmt:
theorem sumRelu_all_constraints (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (∀ p ∈ xs, LeConstrR p.1 p.2) ↔ SumRelu xs = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hout : ∀ p ∈ xs, ReluOut p.1 p.2 = 0 := fun p hp => (relu_preserves p.1 p.2).mp (h p hp)
    exact (sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each xs).mpr hout
  · intro h p hp
    exact (relu_preserves p.1 p.2).mpr ((sumRelu_eq_zero_iff_each xs).mp h p hp)

name: sumRelu_pos_of_unsatisfied
stmt:
theorem sumRelu_pos_of_unsatisfied (xs : List (ℝ × ℝ)) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ xs)
    (h : ¬ LeConstrR p.1 p.2) : 0 < SumRelu xs
proof:
by
  have hout : ReluOut p.1 p.2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact h ((relu_preserves p.1 p.2).mpr hz)
                      
  have hpos : 0 < relu (p.1 - p.2) := lt_of_le_of_ne (relu_nonneg (p.1 - p.2)) (by intro hz; exact hout (by simpa [ReluOut, hz]))
            
  have hle : relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤ SumRelu xs := by
    unfold SumRelu
                             
    induction xs with
    | nil => simp at hp
    | cons h2 t ih =>
        simp at hp
        rcases hp with rfl | ht
        ·                                             
          have hrest : 0 ≤ (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := by
            exact sumRelu_nonneg t
          change relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤
            relu (p.1 - p.2) + (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0
          nlinarith
        ·                     
          have : relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤ (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0 := ih ht
          have h2nonneg : 0 ≤ relu (h2.1 - h2.2) := relu_nonneg _
          change relu (p.1 - p.2) ≤
            relu (h2.1 - h2.2) + (t.map (fun q => relu (q.1 - q.2))).foldr (fun a b => a + b) 0
          nlinarith
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle

end Lattice

name: markov_bound
proof:
by
                         
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg hf_nonneg hf_int ε
                                   
  have hm' : (μ { x | ε ≤ f x }).toReal ≤ (∫ x, f x ∂μ) / ε :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hε).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hm)
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, mul_comm] using hm'

name: chebyshev_bound
proof:
by
                                                    
  have hset : { x | δ ≤ |X x - c| } = { x | δ ^ 2 ≤ (X x - c) ^ 2 } := by
    apply Set.ext
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro h
                                        
      have habs : |δ| ≤ |X x - c| := by simpa [abs_of_pos hδ] using h
      have hsq : δ ^ 2 ≤ |X x - c| ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq_abs]
        exact sq_le_sq.mpr habs
      simpa [sq_abs] using hsq
    · intro h
                                                      
      have habs : |δ| ≤ |X x - c| := (sq_le_sq.mp (by simpa [sq_abs] using h))
      simpa [abs_of_pos hδ, abs_of_nonneg (abs_nonneg _)] using habs
  rw [hset]
                             
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] fun x => (X x - c) ^ 2 := by
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hm := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg hg_nonneg hX_sq (δ ^ 2)
  have hδ2 : 0 < δ ^ 2 := pow_pos hδ 2
  have hm' : (μ { x | δ ^ 2 ≤ (X x - c) ^ 2 }).toReal ≤ (∫ x, (X x - c) ^ 2 ∂μ) / (δ ^ 2) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hδ2).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hm)
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, mul_comm] using hm'

name: verify_probability_guarantee
stmt:
theorem verify_probability_guarantee {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} {f : α → ℝ}
    (hf_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f) (hf_int : Integrable f μ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hE : ∫ x, f x ∂μ ≤ ε ^ 2) :
    (μ { x | ε ≤ f x }).toReal ≤ ε
proof:
by
                                    
  calc
    (μ { x | ε ≤ f x }).toReal ≤ (1 / ε) * ∫ x, f x ∂μ := markov_bound hf_nonneg hf_int hε
    _ ≤ (1 / ε) * ε ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr hε))
    _ = ε := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
      ring

                    
                                   
                                 
                                                     
                                       
                        

end Lattice

name: SymToken
doc:
**L1 token 字母表（符号层）**：`sym z` 携带一个整数（系数向量的某一项，或常数项），
`sep` 是约束分界 token。

⚠⚠ **改名登记（原名 `Token` → 现名 `SymToken`）**：本仓库曾有两个**同名不同型**的
`Lattice.Token` —— 本文件的**符号层**字母表，与 `RealTokenization.lean:165` 的
**字符层**字母表（`single`/`word`）。二者**同名不同型**且**不能同时 `import`**，实测报
'Lattice.instReprToken._cstage1' from RealTokenization`。
⭐⭐ **该冲突直接阻断「数据→token→符号→权重」的端到端组合**
（`RealQuotientReversibility` / `RealClosureReversibility` 两处**已登记**被迫拆文件）。
现按 STYLE「跨文件同名是潜伏断裂」的修法**改名消歧**：本文件用 `SymToken`。
⚠ 改名**不改变任何证明**（纯重命名），既有定理**一条未删**。

**诚实标注**：这不是真实分词器的词表，也不含任何文本/字符层。
stmt:
inductive SymToken where
                                 
  | sym (z : Int)
                    
  | sep
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: splitLast
doc: 把列表拆成「除末项外的前缀」与「末项」；空列表返回 `([], 0)`。
stmt:
def splitLast : List Int → List Int × Int
  | [] => ([], 0)
  | [x] => ([], x)
  | x :: y :: rest => (x :: (splitLast (y :: rest)).1, (splitLast (y :: rest)).2)

name: splitLast_append_singleton
doc:
**`splitLast` 规范形**：`splitLast (a ++ [b]) = (a, b)`。

这是往返恒等的关键引理：由它立即得到「编码段能原样恢复 `(a, b)`」。
stmt:
theorem splitLast_append_singleton (a : List Int) (b : Int) :
    splitLast (a ++ [b]) = (a, b)
proof:
by
  induction a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih =>
      cases t with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons h2 t2 =>
                                                     
          show (h :: (splitLast ((h2 :: t2) ++ [b])).1,
                (splitLast ((h2 :: t2) ++ [b])).2) = (h :: h2 :: t2, b)
          rw [ih]

name: mkConstraint
doc: 由段内整数表重建约束：末项为常数项 `b`，其余为系数向量 `a`。
stmt: def mkConstraint (l : List Int) : VectorConstraint
proof:
let p := splitLast l
  { a := p.1, b := p.2 }

name: mkConstraint_append_singleton
doc: `mkConstraint` 在 `a ++ [b]` 上的取值（即编码段的解码结果）。
stmt:
theorem mkConstraint_append_singleton (a : List Int) (b : Int) :
    mkConstraint (a ++ [b]) = { a := a, b := b }
proof:
by
  unfold mkConstraint
  rw [splitLast_append_singleton]

name: encodeConstraint
doc:
**单约束编码**：系数向量逐项 `sym`，随后常数项一个 `sym`，最后 `sep`。

`b` **必须**被编码（它不参与 `dot`，省略即丢失，见 §六 反例）；
`sep` **必须**存在（否则段歧义，见 §六 反例）。
stmt: def encodeConstraint (c : VectorConstraint) : List SymToken
proof: c.a.map SymToken.sym ++ [SymToken.sym c.b, SymToken.sep]

name: encode
doc:
**约束集编码**：逐约束编码后拼接。

约束集的语义 `AllSatisfied` 是合取、与顺序无关，但编码仍保序，
使往返恒等成为**结构**恒等而非仅语义等价。
stmt: def encode (cs : ConstraintSet) : List SymToken
proof: (cs.map encodeConstraint).flatten

name: toSegs
doc:
**切段**：把 token 流按 `sep` 切成整数表列表。

`sep` 结束当前段；遇到 `sym` 时把它压到后续段的头部。
**末段若无 `sep` 收尾则整段丢弃**——这是有意的严格失败，不是静默降级。
stmt:
def toSegs : List SymToken → List (List Int)
  | [] => []
  | SymToken.sep :: rest => [] :: toSegs rest
  | SymToken.sym z :: rest =>
      match toSegs rest with
      | [] => []
      | seg :: segs => (z :: seg) :: segs

name: decode
doc:
**约束集解码**：切段后逐段还原为约束。

**诚实标注**：解码结果构造性地总是 `some`——「失败」体现在**段被丢弃**
（不完整的尾段不产出约束），而不是返回 `none`。这是本设计的选择：
它保证 `decode` 不拒绝合法编码，同时不编造不存在的约束。
stmt: def decode (ts : List SymToken) : Option ConstraintSet
proof: some ((toSegs ts).map mkConstraint)

name: toSegs_map_sym_append_sep
doc:
**`toSegs` 对编码段的规范行为**：一个完整的约束段（`l.map sym ++ sep`）
恰好切出一段 `l`，其余交给 `rest`。
stmt:
theorem toSegs_map_sym_append_sep (l : List Int) (rest : List SymToken) :
    toSegs (l.map SymToken.sym ++ SymToken.sep :: rest) = l :: toSegs rest
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons h t ih =>
      show (match toSegs (t.map SymToken.sym ++ SymToken.sep :: rest) with
            | [] => []
            | seg :: segs => (h :: seg) :: segs) = (h :: t) :: toSegs rest
      rw [ih]

name: encode_cons_eq
doc:
**编码的 `cons` 分解**：`encode (c :: cs)` 等于「一个完整约束段」后接
`encode cs`——正是 `toSegs_map_sym_append_sep` 所需的形状。

注意段体是 `c.a ++ [c.b]`（末项为常数项），故左式写成 `(c.a ++ [c.b]).map sym`，
`sep` 单独作分界——这正是 §二 段内约定（末项为 `b`）在编码侧的体现。
stmt:
theorem encode_cons_eq (c : VectorConstraint) (cs : ConstraintSet) :
    encode (c :: cs) = (c.a ++ [c.b]).map SymToken.sym ++ SymToken.sep :: encode cs
proof:
by
  unfold encode encodeConstraint
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.flatten_cons, List.map_append, List.singleton_append,
             List.map_nil, List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]

name: decode_encode
doc:
**集级往返恒等（核心定理）**：`decode (encode cs) = some cs`。

即：有限约束集经「符号 → token → 符号」往返后**原样恢复**，
包括约束的**顺序**与每个约束的 `(a, b)`。这是本项目「可逆链路」口号中
L1⇄L2 这一跳此前缺失的证明层对应物。
stmt: theorem decode_encode (cs : ConstraintSet) : decode (encode cs) = some cs
proof:
by
  unfold decode
  induction cs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      rw [encode_cons_eq]
      rw [toSegs_map_sym_append_sep]
      rw [List.map_cons]
      rw [mkConstraint_append_singleton]
                                                                         
      have hc : ({ a := c.a, b := c.b } : VectorConstraint) = c := by cases c; rfl
      rw [hc]
                                                                            
                                                               
      have ih' : List.map mkConstraint (toSegs (encode cs)) = cs :=
        (Option.some.injEq _ _).mp ih
      rw [ih']

name: encode_injective
doc:
**往返恒等的单射推论**：`encode` 是单射。

由 `decode_encode` 与 `Option.some.injEq` 直接得到——若两约束集编码相同，
则解码结果相同，从而 `cs₁ = cs₂`。这给出「符号信息在 token 序列中无损」的
精确表述（也是「可逆链路」在 L1⇄L2 上的形式化含义）。
stmt: theorem encode_injective : Function.Injective (encode : ConstraintSet → List SymToken)
proof:
by
  intro cs₁ cs₂ h
  have h₁ : decode (encode cs₁) = some cs₁ := decode_encode cs₁
  have h₂ : decode (encode cs₂) = some cs₂ := decode_encode cs₂
  rw [h] at h₁
                                                                              
  rw [h₁] at h₂
  exact (Option.some.injEq _ _).mp h₂

name: decode_encode_sat_iff
doc:
**语义保真**：解码 `encode cs` 得到的约束集与原集**满足性完全一致**。

由结构恒等 `decode_encode` 直接得到：解码出的集就是 `cs` 本身
（`Option.getD` 取出后即 `cs`），故二者的合取语义在任何输入处一致。
这把 L1⇄L2 的往返接回了 L2 的符号语义，是通往 L3 的接口。
stmt:
theorem decode_encode_sat_iff (cs : ConstraintSet) (x : List Int) :
    AllSatisfied ((decode (encode cs)).getD []) x ↔ AllSatisfied cs x
proof:
by
  rw [decode_encode]
  simp only [Option.getD_some]

name: encode_drop_b_roundtrip_fails
doc:
**反例一（省略 `b` 必失败）**：若编码不携带常数项（只编码系数向量），
则两个 `a` 相同而 `b` 不同的约束会**编码相同**，往返不可能恒等。

见证：`(a = [], b = 0)` 与 `(a = [], b = 1)`，二者的「只编码 `a`」形式都是 `[sep]`。
这机器验证了 §三 设计点 1：**`b` 是不可省略的信息**。
stmt:
theorem encode_drop_b_roundtrip_fails :
    ∃ c₁ c₂ : VectorConstraint, c₁ ≠ c₂ ∧
      c₁.a.map SymToken.sym ++ [SymToken.sep] = c₂.a.map SymToken.sym ++ [SymToken.sep]
proof:
by
  refine ⟨{ a := [], b := 0 }, { a := [], b := 1 }, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hb : (0 : Int) = 1 := congrArg VectorConstraint.b h
    exact Int.zero_ne_one hb
  · rfl

name: drop_b_changes_semantics
doc:
**反例二（丢 `b` 会改变符号语义）**：上例中 `b = 1` 的约束在 `x = []` 处**不满足**，
故「丢失 `b`」不是无害的表示简化，而是会产出**错误符号对象**的真实缺陷。
stmt:
theorem drop_b_changes_semantics :
    ¬ VectorConstraintSat ({ a := [], b := 1 } : VectorConstraint) []
proof:
by
  unfold VectorConstraintSat
  simp only [dot, List.zip_nil_left, List.foldl_nil]
  norm_num

name: encode_no_sep_roundtrip_fails
doc:
**反例三（省略 `sep` 必失败）**：若编码不设约束分界符（只把各约束的系数
前后拼接、并用约束个数定界），则「一个系数为 `[1, 2]` 的约束」与
「两个系数为 `[1]`、`[2]` 的约束」会产生**相同的 token 序列** `[sym 1, sym 2]`，
解码无法恢复约束**个数**与**切分位置**，往返恒等不可能成立。

两个见证集本身不等（长度 1 vs 2），而它们的「无 `sep` 编码」相同。
这机器验证了 §三 设计点 2：**`sep` 不是装饰，而是段边界信息的唯一载体**。

（注：本反例不带 `b` 编码——`b` 的必要性已由反例一/二单独给出；
这里隔离的是「段边界」这一个设计点。）
stmt:
theorem encode_no_sep_roundtrip_fails :
    ∃ cs₁ cs₂ : ConstraintSet, cs₁ ≠ cs₂ ∧
      (cs₁.map (fun c => c.a.map SymToken.sym)).flatten =
      (cs₂.map (fun c => c.a.map SymToken.sym)).flatten
proof:
by
  refine ⟨[{ a := [1, 2], b := 0 }], [{ a := [1], b := 0 }, { a := [2], b := 0 }], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hlen : (1 : ℕ) = 2 := by
      have hh := congrArg List.length h
      simp at hh
    exact absurd hlen (by decide)
  · decide

name: decode_drops_trailing_partial
doc:
**严格失败语义**：没有 `sep` 收尾的 token 流，其尾段被**丢弃**——
不会静默编造出一个约束。

见证：`[sym 1, sym 2]`（无 `sep`）切段得到 `[]`，
故 `decode [sym 1, sym 2] = some []`——没有凭空产生「系数 `[1]`、常数 `2`」的约束。
这界定了 `decode` 的诚实边界：它**不**声称能解任意 token 流。
stmt:
theorem decode_drops_trailing_partial :
    decode [SymToken.sym 1, SymToken.sym 2] = some []
proof:
by
  show some (List.map mkConstraint (toSegs [SymToken.sym 1, SymToken.sym 2])) = some []
  simp only [toSegs, List.map_nil]

end Lattice

name: isBlank
doc:
折叠意义上的空白：空格与换行。用**显式字符比较**而非 Unicode 表，
使可判定性与证明都不依赖外部数据。
stmt: def isBlank (c : Char) : Bool

name: foldGo
doc: 空白折叠状态机：`prevBlank` = 「上一个**输出**的字符是否为空白」。
stmt:
def foldGo (prevBlank : Bool) : List Char → List Char
  | [] => []
  | c :: rest =>
      if isBlank c = true then
        if prevBlank = true then foldGo true rest else ' ' :: foldGo true rest
      else c :: foldGo false rest

name: foldBlanks
doc: **L0 归一化（空白折叠）**：每个极长空白段 → 一个空格。
stmt: def foldBlanks (l : List Char) : List Char
proof: foldGo false l

name: foldGo_idem
doc: **状态机幂等**：对自身输出再跑一次是恒等。
stmt: theorem foldGo_idem (b : Bool) (l : List Char) : foldGo b (foldGo b l) = foldGo b l
proof:
by
  induction l generalizing b with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c rest ih =>
    cases b with
    | false =>
      cases hc : isBlank c with
      | true =>
        simp only [foldGo, hc, if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        have hblank : isBlank ' ' = true := by decide
        simp only [foldGo, hblank, if_true]
        rw [ih true]
      | false =>
        simp only [foldGo, hc, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        rw [ih false]
    | true =>
      cases hc : isBlank c with
      | true =>
        simp only [foldGo, hc, if_true]
        rw [ih true]
      | false =>
        simp only [foldGo, hc, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        rw [ih false]

name: foldBlanks_idem
doc: ⭐ **`foldBlanks` 是幂等投影**（归一化的定义性质）。
stmt: theorem foldBlanks_idem (l : List Char) : foldBlanks (foldBlanks l) = foldBlanks l
proof: foldGo_idem false l

name: CharToken
doc:
**L1 token 字母表（字符层）**：单字符 token 与多字符（≥2）token。

⚠⚠ **改名登记（原名 `Token` → 现名 `CharToken`）**：本仓库曾有两个**同名不同型**的
`Lattice.Token` —— 本文件的**字符层**字母表，与 `RealTokenSymbolLink.lean:69` 的
**符号层**字母表（`sym`/`sep`）。二者**同名不同型**且**不能同时 `import`**，实测报
'Lattice.instReprToken._cstage1' from RealTokenization`。
⭐⭐ **该冲突直接阻断「数据→token→符号→权重」的端到端组合**
（`RealQuotientReversibility` / `RealClosureReversibility` 两处**已登记**被迫拆文件）。
现按 STYLE「跨文件同名是潜伏断裂」的修法**改名消歧**：本文件用 `CharToken`。
⚠ 改名**不改变任何证明**（纯重命名），既有定理**一条未删**。

**诚实标注**：这不是真实 BPE 词表（真实词表是**学出来的**、与语料相关），
而是「词表结构」的最小抽象。
stmt:
inductive CharToken where
  | single (c : Char)
  | word (c1 : Char) (c2 : Char) (rest : List Char)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: pieceOf
doc: 词条映射：token → 它的字符序列。
stmt:
def pieceOf : CharToken → List Char
  | .single c => [c]
  | .word c1 c2 rest => c1 :: c2 :: rest

name: lookupTok
doc:
词表查询：字符序列 → token（贪心匹配的**单步**）。

`lookupTok_eq_some` 证明它是 `pieceOf` 的**真逆**，这是全文件的地基。
stmt:
def lookupTok : List Char → Option CharToken
  | [] => none
  | [c] => some (.single c)
  | c :: c2 :: rest => some (.word c c2 rest)

name: pieceOf_ne_nil
doc: **词条非空**（词表的结构性质）。
stmt: theorem pieceOf_ne_nil (t : CharToken) : pieceOf t ≠ []
proof:
by
  cases t <;> simp [pieceOf]

name: lookupTok_eq_some
doc: ⭐ **`lookupTok` 是 `pieceOf` 的真逆**——这是词表良性的精确刻画。
stmt:
theorem lookupTok_eq_some {a : List Char} {t : CharToken} :
    lookupTok a = some t ↔ pieceOf t = a
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases a with
    | nil => simp [lookupTok] at h
    | cons c rest =>
        cases rest with
        | nil =>
            simp only [lookupTok, Option.some.injEq] at h
            rw [← h]; rfl
        | cons c2 rest2 =>
            simp only [lookupTok, Option.some.injEq] at h
            rw [← h]; rfl
  · intro h
    subst h
    cases t with
    | single c => rfl
    | word c1 c2 rest => rfl

name: detokenize
doc:
**反分词（L1 → L0）**：逐 token 换成词条后拼接。

**诚实标注**：这里的 `detokenize` 是**拼写层**的（无损）。
真实 `detokenize` 还承担「还原空白」等启发式——那与 `foldBlanks` 同为归一化的反面，
本文件只建模归一化方向。
stmt:
def detokenize : List CharToken → List Char
  | [] => []
  | t :: ts => pieceOf t ++ detokenize ts

name: detokenize_append
stmt:
theorem detokenize_append (a b : List CharToken) :
    detokenize (a ++ b) = detokenize a ++ detokenize b
proof:
by
  induction a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons t ts ih => rw [List.cons_append, detokenize, ih, detokenize, List.append_assoc]

name: detokenize_singleton
stmt: theorem detokenize_singleton (t : CharToken) : detokenize [t] = pieceOf t
proof:
by
  simp [detokenize]

name: bestPrefix
doc:
⭐ **最长前缀匹配**：在 `rest` 的**前缀**中取最长的、可查到的那个。

`rest.inits` 按**由短到长**列出前缀，故 `.reverse` 后 `findSome?` 从左往右
= 前缀**由长到短**，这正是**贪心最长匹配**（BPE/WordPiece 的核心动作）。
stmt: def bestPrefix (rest : List Char) : Option CharToken
proof: rest.inits.reverse.findSome? fun u => if u.isEmpty then none else lookupTok u

name: bestPrefix_spec
doc: ⭐ **最长匹配的规范形**：命中的 token 的词条是 `rest` 的**前缀**。
stmt:
theorem bestPrefix_spec {rest : List Char} {t : CharToken} (h : bestPrefix rest = some t) :
    ∃ u : List Char, pieceOf t ++ u = rest
proof:
by
  unfold bestPrefix at h
  rw [List.findSome?_eq_some_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨l₁, a, l₂, hpref, hfa, hnone⟩ := h
  have ha : a ∈ rest.inits := by
    have : a ∈ rest.inits.reverse := by
      rw [hpref]; exact List.mem_append_right l₁ (List.mem_cons_self a l₂)
    simpa using this
  have hpa : lookupTok a = some t := by
    have hna : a.isEmpty = false := by
      by_contra hc
      have h1 : a.isEmpty = true := by simpa using hc
      rw [h1] at hfa
      simp at hfa
    rw [hna] at hfa
    simpa using hfa
  have hpt : pieceOf t = a := lookupTok_eq_some.mp hpa
  rw [hpt]
  exact (List.mem_inits a rest).mp ha

name: tokAux
doc:
分词主循环：`done` 是**已固定的输出**（尾部追加），`rest` 是**未消耗的字符**。

不变式（`tokAux_detok`）：`detokenize done ++ rest = 原串`。
stmt: def tokAux (fuel : Nat) (done : List CharToken) (rest : List Char) : Option (List CharToken)
proof:
match fuel with
  | 0 => none
  | n + 1 =>
      match rest with
      | [] => some done
      | _ =>
          match bestPrefix rest with
          | none => none
          | some t => tokAux n (done ++ [t]) (rest.drop (pieceOf t).length)
termination_by fuel

name: tokAux_detok
doc:
⭐ **`tokAux` 的不变式**：返回 `some ts` ⟹ `detokenize ts = detokenize done ++ rest`。

即「输出重新拼出输入」——**拼写无损**，这是本层能有的最强陈述。
stmt:
theorem tokAux_detok (fuel : Nat) (done : List CharToken) (rest : List Char)
    {ts : List CharToken} (h : tokAux fuel done rest = some ts) :
    detokenize ts = detokenize done ++ rest
proof:
by
  induction fuel generalizing done rest with
  | zero => simp [tokAux] at h
  | succ n ih =>
      cases rest with
      | nil =>
          simp only [tokAux, Option.some.injEq] at h
          subst h
          simp
      | cons c tl =>
          simp only [tokAux] at h
          split at h
          · exact absurd h (by simp)
          · rename_i t ht
            obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := bestPrefix_spec ht
            have hdrop : (c :: tl).drop (pieceOf t).length = u := by
              rw [← hu]; exact List.drop_left (pieceOf t) u
            have hih := ih (done ++ [t]) ((c :: tl).drop (pieceOf t).length) h
            rw [hdrop] at hih
            rw [hih, detokenize_append, detokenize_singleton]
            rw [← hu]
            simp [List.append_assoc]

name: tokenizeRaw
doc: ⭐ **拼写层分词（L0 → L1）**：贪心最长匹配，不做任何归一化。
stmt: def tokenizeRaw (s : List Char) : Option (List CharToken)
proof: tokAux (s.length + 1) [] s

name: tokenizeRaw_detok
doc: ⭐ **拼写层无损**：`tokenizeRaw` 的输出必定重新拼出输入。
stmt:
theorem tokenizeRaw_detok {s : List Char} {ts : List CharToken} (h : tokenizeRaw s = some ts) :
    detokenize ts = s
proof:
by
  unfold tokenizeRaw at h
  have := tokAux_detok (s.length + 1) [] s h
  simpa using this

name: tokenizeRaw_injective
doc:
⭐⭐ **拼写层是单射**（**本文件的关键发现之一**）。

由 `tokenizeRaw_detok` 立得：输出决定 `s = detokenize ts`。
⇒ **贪心/BPE 本身不产生非单射**；非单射只能来自归一化（见 §五）。
这是任务书未预期、但机器检查过的**区分性结论**。
stmt:
theorem tokenizeRaw_injective :
    ∀ {s t : List Char} {ts : List CharToken},
      tokenizeRaw s = some ts → tokenizeRaw t = some ts → s = t
proof:
by
  intro s t ts hs ht
  rw [← tokenizeRaw_detok hs, ← tokenizeRaw_detok ht]

name: tokenize
doc: ⭐ **分词（L0 → L1，真实模型）**：`tokenize := tokenizeRaw ∘ foldBlanks`。
stmt: def tokenize (s : List Char) : Option (List CharToken)
proof: tokenizeRaw (foldBlanks s)

name: tokenize_not_injective
doc:
⭐⭐ **分词非单射**（任务书要求的核心否定性结论）。

见证：`"a␣␣b"` 与 `"a␣b"`。二者**不等**，而折叠到同一处 ⟹
分词结果**恒等**（无论 `tokenizeRaw` 取值如何——故这是**结构性**反例，
不依赖词表的具体行为）。
stmt: theorem tokenize_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective tokenize
proof:
by
  intro h
  have heq : tokenize (['a', ' ', ' ', 'b'] : List Char)
           = tokenize (['a', ' ', 'b'] : List Char) := rfl
  have hne : (['a', ' ', ' ', 'b'] : List Char) ≠ ['a', ' ', 'b'] := by decide
  exact hne (h heq)

name: tokenize_collision
doc: 同上的**存在量化**形式（供不依赖定义展开的复核）。
stmt:
theorem tokenize_collision :
    ∃ s t : List Char, s ≠ t ∧ tokenize s = tokenize t

name: tokenize_detok
doc: ⭐ **真实分词器的无损刻画**（削弱到归一化后）：`detokenize ts = foldBlanks s`。
stmt:
theorem tokenize_detok {s : List Char} {ts : List CharToken} (h : tokenize s = some ts) :
    detokenize ts = foldBlanks s
proof: tokenizeRaw_detok h

name: lookupTok_ne_none
doc: 非空列表必可查到（最长前缀即为它自己或它的短前缀）。
stmt: theorem lookupTok_ne_none (l : List Char) (hl : l ≠ []) : lookupTok l ≠ none
proof:
by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hl
  | cons c rest =>
    cases rest with
    | nil => simp [lookupTok]
    | cons c2 r2 => simp [lookupTok]

name: bestPrefix_ne_none
doc: 非空输入上 `bestPrefix` 必命中（因为输入自身就是自己的最长前缀）。
stmt:
theorem bestPrefix_ne_none (rest : List Char) (hrest : rest ≠ []) :
    bestPrefix rest ≠ none
proof:
by
  intro h
  unfold bestPrefix at h
  rw [List.findSome?_eq_none_iff] at h
  have hmem : rest ∈ rest.inits.reverse := by
    apply List.mem_reverse.mpr
    exact (List.mem_inits rest rest).mpr (⟨[], by simp⟩ : rest <+: rest)
  have := h rest hmem
  have hne : rest.isEmpty = false := by
    cases rest with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hrest
    | cons c r => rfl
  rw [hne] at this
  simp at this
  exact lookupTok_ne_none rest hrest this

name: tokAux_ne_none
doc:
⭐ **`tokAux` 从不返回 `none`**（燃料充足时）。关键：每步至少消耗 1 字符，
故 `rest.length` 严格递减，燃料 `length + 1` 恒够。
stmt:
theorem tokAux_ne_none (fuel : Nat) (done : List CharToken) (rest : List Char)
    (hf : rest.length < fuel) : tokAux fuel done rest ≠ none
proof:
by
  induction fuel generalizing done rest with
  | zero => simp at hf
  | succ n ih =>
      cases rest with
      | nil => simp [tokAux]
      | cons c tl =>
          have hne : bestPrefix (c :: tl) ≠ none := bestPrefix_ne_none _ (by simp)
          unfold tokAux
          cases hbf : bestPrefix (c :: tl) with
          | none => exact absurd hbf hne
          | some t =>
            intro h
            have hlen : 0 < (pieceOf t).length :=
              List.length_pos_of_ne_nil (pieceOf_ne_nil t)
            have hdrop : ((c :: tl).drop (pieceOf t).length).length < n := by
              rw [List.length_drop, List.length_cons]
              simp only [List.length_cons] at hf
              omega
            exact ih (done ++ [t]) _ hdrop h

name: foldGo_length_le
doc: **`foldBlanks` 不增加长度**（每个空白段至少缩到 1 个字符）。
stmt: theorem foldGo_length_le (b : Bool) (l : List Char) : (foldGo b l).length ≤ l.length
proof:
by
  induction l generalizing b with
  | nil => simp [foldGo]
  | cons c rest ih =>
    have h1 : (foldGo true rest).length ≤ rest.length := ih true
    have h0 : (foldGo false rest).length ≤ rest.length := ih false
    cases b with
    | false =>
      cases hc : isBlank c with
      | true =>
        rw [foldGo]
        rw [hc]; simp only [if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        simp only [List.length_cons]
        omega
      | false =>
        rw [foldGo]
        rw [hc]; simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, List.length_cons]
        omega
    | true =>
      cases hc : isBlank c with
      | true =>
        rw [foldGo]
        rw [hc]; simp only [if_true, List.length_cons]
        omega
      | false =>
        rw [foldGo]
        rw [hc]; simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, List.length_cons]
        omega

name: foldBlanks_length_le
stmt: theorem foldBlanks_length_le (l : List Char) : (foldBlanks l).length ≤ l.length
proof: foldGo_length_le false l

name: tokenize_never_none
doc:
⭐ **分词永不失败**（`tokenize` 无 `none` 分支）。

燃料 `s.length + 1` 恒够：折叠不增长度（`foldBlanks_length_le`），
故 `(foldBlanks s).length < s.length + 1`，由 `tokAux_ne_none` 即得。
stmt: theorem tokenize_never_none (s : List Char) : ∃ ts : List CharToken, tokenize s = some ts
proof:
by
  show ∃ ts : List CharToken, tokAux ((foldBlanks s).length + 1) [] (foldBlanks s) = some ts
  have hle : (foldBlanks s).length < (foldBlanks s).length + 1 := by omega
  have h := tokAux_ne_none ((foldBlanks s).length + 1) [] (foldBlanks s) hle
  cases hts : tokAux ((foldBlanks s).length + 1) [] (foldBlanks s) with
  | none => exact absurd hts h
  | some ts => exact ⟨ts, rfl⟩

name: SameTokens
doc:
**σ（同一分词结果）**：`s` 与 `t` 等价 ⟺ 它们分词结果相同。

这是「分词非单射」的**精确残差**。
stmt: def SameTokens (s t : List Char) : Prop
proof: tokenize s = tokenize t

name: sameTokens_equivalence
doc: **σ 是等价关系**。
stmt: theorem sameTokens_equivalence : Equivalence SameTokens
proof: ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun h => h.symm, fun h1 h2 => h1.trans h2⟩

name: detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient
doc:
⭐ **σ-截面**：对已成功分词的结果 `ts`，重分词 `detokenize ts` 得到**同一** `ts`。

这是 `detokenize ∘ tokenize = id` 在**像上**的精确形式（比商等式更锐）。
stmt:
theorem detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient {s : List Char} {ts : List CharToken}
    (h : tokenize s = some ts) : tokenize (detokenize ts) = some ts
proof:
by
  unfold tokenize at h ⊢
  rw [tokenizeRaw_detok h, foldBlanks_idem]
  exact h

name: detokenize_tokenize_on_quotient
doc:
⭐⭐ **商可逆（核心定理）**：`detokenize ∘ tokenize` 把 `s` 送回**它自己的 σ-类**。

即：`SameTokens (detokenize (tokenize s)) s`。
这是 L0⇄L1 上唯一可能的可逆性形式（严格左逆因非单射而不存在）。
stmt:
theorem detokenize_tokenize_on_quotient (s : List Char) :
    SameTokens (detokenize ((tokenize s).getD [])) s
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ts0, hts0⟩ := tokenize_never_none s
  cases h : tokenize s with
  | none => exact absurd h (by rw [hts0]; simp)
  | some ts =>
      show tokenize (detokenize (Option.getD (some ts) [])) = tokenize s
      rw [h]
      simp only [Option.getD_some]
      exact detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient h

name: tokenize_detokenize_galois
doc:
⭐ **Galois 连接（精确刻画）**：`tokenize s = some ts` ⟺
`s` 与 `detokenize ts` 同类**且** `ts` 本身是规范的（重分词回到自身）。

⚠ **诚实标注**：合取项 `tokenize (detokenize ts) = some ts` **不可省**——无条件版为假
（反例 `ts := [single 'a', single 'a']`：`detokenize ts = "aa"`，同类成立但
`tokenize "aa" = some [word 'a' 'a' []] ≠ some ts`）。见文件头「诚实边界」。
stmt:
theorem tokenize_detokenize_galois (s : List Char) (ts : List CharToken) :
    tokenize s = some ts ↔
      (SameTokens s (detokenize ts) ∧ tokenize (detokenize ts) = some ts)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by
      show tokenize s = tokenize (detokenize ts)
      rw [h]
      exact (detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient h).symm,
      detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient h⟩
  · intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    show tokenize s = some ts
    rw [show tokenize s = tokenize (detokenize ts) from h1]
    exact h2

end Lattice

name: Text.encode
doc:
⭐⭐ **L0 入边桥**：外部世界（`String`）→ 证明层（`List Char`）。

⚠ 这是全库**第一条** `String → List Char` 的命名函数（W28 实测：全库 0 条）。
定义取 Lean 核心的 `String.toList`，**不引入任何新公理**。
stmt: def Text.encode (s : String) : List Char
proof: s.toList

name: Text.encode_eq_toList
stmt: @[simp] theorem Text.encode_eq_toList (s : String) : Text.encode s = s.toList
proof: rfl

name: Text.encode_length
doc:
⭐ **入口桥保长度**：`encode` 与 `String.length` 对齐。

⚠ **诚实标注**：`String.length` 在 Lean 里是 **UTF-8 字节数**，而 `List.length` 是**字符数**；
本定理成立的**原因**是 Lean 的 `String.length` 与 `String.toList` 共享同一套
`utf8ByteSize`/`Iterator` 结构（`String.length_eq_toList_length`）。
**它因此不是 UTF-8 解码的定理** —— 见文件头诚实边界。
stmt: theorem Text.encode_length (s : String) : (Text.encode s).length = s.length
proof: rfl

name: Text.encode_injective
doc:
⭐⭐ **入口桥是单射**（**L0 入边不丢字符**）。

这是入口桥**最重要的正性质**，且**与本仓库另一座桥形成一个尖锐对照**：
`RealEndToEnd.charCode` **不是**单射（`word 'a' 'b' []` 与 `word 'a' 'c' []` 碰撞，
`RealEndToEnd.lean:440` 已登记）。⇒ ⭐ **"桥必然丢信息"不是本仓库的普遍规律**：
`encode` 无损，`charCode` 有损。**两个结论都是机器检查过的。**
stmt: theorem Text.encode_injective : Function.Injective Text.encode
proof:
by
  intro a b h
  have h2 : a.toList = b.toList := h
  exact String.toList_inj.mp h2

name: Text.ofList_encode
doc:
逆方向的**部分**刻画：`encode` 拼回 `String.mk` 后**逐字还原**原串。

⚠ **诚实标注**：这**不是** `encode` 有左逆的断言（左逆要 `List Char → String`，
本文件**不建** —— 见 §四 的不声称清单）。它说的是 `String.mk ∘ encode = id`。
stmt: theorem Text.ofList_encode (s : String) : String.mk (Text.encode s) = s
proof:
by
  simp only [Text.encode]
  exact String.toList_inj.mp rfl

name: tokenizeStr
doc:
⭐ **入口分词**：`String → L1`，即 `tokenize ∘ encode`。

⚠ 这是 `tokenize` 的 **`String` 版**；W28 实测全库此前**没有**这样的函数。
stmt: def tokenizeStr (s : String) : Option (List CharToken)
proof: tokenize (Text.encode s)

name: tokenizeStr_eq_tokenize
doc:
⭐ **组合律（入口桥穿过 L0 不改变语义）**：`tokenizeStr` 就是 `tokenize ∘ encode`。

这是本桥与 L0 的**接口契约**：任何关于 `tokenize` 的既有定理
（`tokenize_detok` / `detokenize_left_inverse_on_quotient` / `tokenize_detokenize_galois` …）
都可以经 `rw [tokenizeStr_eq_tokenize]` **原样**用在 `String` 输入上。
stmt:
theorem tokenizeStr_eq_tokenize (s : String) :
    tokenizeStr s = tokenize (Text.encode s)
proof: rfl

name: tokenizeStr_never_none
doc:
⭐ **入口分词永不失败**（由 `tokenize_never_none` 经组合律继承）。

⚠ **诚实标注**：它继承的正是 `RealTokenization` 的**退化词表**性质
（文件头 :65-70 已登记：真实词表有 OOV）。⇒ 本定理**不**读作
「任意 `String` 都能被真实分词器切开」。**OOV 面的最小可证模型见 §三。**
stmt:
theorem tokenizeStr_never_none (s : String) :
    ∃ ts : List CharToken, tokenizeStr s = some ts
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ts, hts⟩ := tokenize_never_none (Text.encode s)
  exact ⟨ts, by rw [tokenizeStr_eq_tokenize]; exact hts⟩

name: tokenizeStr_detok
doc:
⭐ **入口无损（削弱到归一化后）**：`String` 版的无损刻画，
由 `tokenize_detok` 经组合律继承。
proof:
by
  rw [tokenizeStr_eq_tokenize] at h
  exact tokenize_detok h

name: OOVVocab
doc: **词表**：对字符块的可判定谓词。`Bool` 而非 `Prop` —— 贪心选择须**可计算**。
stmt: def OOVVocab
proof: List Char → Bool

name: bestPrefixV
doc:
**带 OOV 分支的贪心最长匹配**：在 `rest` 的**前缀**中取最长的、**在词表内**的那个。

⚠⚠ **实测过的坑（W28 §三 登记）**：`findSome?` 沿 `inits.reverse` 扫描，
取的是**最长的 V-命中前缀** ——
所以 `bestPrefixV Vzz ['z','z','a']` 的结果是 `word 'z' 'z' []`，
尾字符 `'a'` **留给下一轮**（这正是「最长**匹配**」而非「整串吞掉」）。
**第一版把它写成 `word 'z' 'z' ['a']`，内核当场证伪。**
stmt: def bestPrefixV (V : OOVVocab) (rest : List Char) : Option CharToken
proof:
rest.inits.reverse.findSome? fun u =>
    if u.isEmpty then none else if V u then lookupTok u else none

name: Vzz
doc: **见证词表**：只认 `['z','z']` 这一个词条。
stmt: def Vzz : OOVVocab
proof: fun u => decide (u = ['z', 'z'])

name: bestPrefixV_Vzz_in
doc:
⭐ **正例（词表内成功）**：`"zza"` 在 `Vzz` 下切出 `word 'z' 'z' []`。

⚠ 尾字符 `'a'` **不**在本 token 里 —— 见 `bestPrefixV` 的坑注。
stmt:
theorem bestPrefixV_Vzz_in :
    bestPrefixV Vzz ['z', 'z', 'a'] = some (.word 'z' 'z' [])
proof: by decide

name: bestPrefixV_Vzz_oov
doc:
⭐⭐ **OOV 阻塞（`none` 分支【可达】）**：`['q']` 在 `Vzz` 下**不可切**。

这是本节存在的**唯一理由** —— 没有它，`none` 分支仍是死代码。
stmt: theorem bestPrefixV_Vzz_oov : bestPrefixV Vzz ['q'] = none
proof: by decide

name: bestPrefix_degenerate_succeeds
doc:
⭐ **对照（退化词表不阻塞）**：同一输入 `['q']` 在**旧** `bestPrefix` 下**成功**。

⇒ 两条合起来把"阻塞"钉成**词表的性质**，而不是输入的偶然性。
stmt: theorem bestPrefix_degenerate_succeeds : bestPrefix ['q'] ≠ none
proof: by decide

name: bestPrefixV_empty
doc: **边界**：空输入上 `bestPrefixV` 恒 `none`（`inits` 只有 `[]`，被 `isEmpty` 挡掉）。
stmt: theorem bestPrefixV_empty (V : OOVVocab) : bestPrefixV V [] = none
proof:
by
  simp [bestPrefixV, List.inits]

name: tokenize_never_none_fails_for_Vzz
doc:
⭐⭐ **旧的全称定理在 `Vzz` 上【不成立】** ——
`tokenize_never_none` 式的陈述 `∀ s, ∃ ts, bestPrefixV Vzz s = some ts` 为**假**。

⚠⚠ 本定理**断言的是"旧定理的陈述本身"**（判据 13）：它的**取反**正是
`tokenize_never_none` 的形状，故**若有人把词表改回退化版，红的会是这里**。
stmt:
theorem tokenize_never_none_fails_for_Vzz :
    ¬ (∀ s : List Char, ∃ ts : CharToken, bestPrefixV Vzz s = some ts)
proof:
by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨ts, hts⟩ := h ['q']
  rw [bestPrefixV_Vzz_oov] at hts
  exact absurd hts (by simp)

                    

                                                        
                                                                     
                                              
                                        
                                                     
                                             
                                                  
                                            
  

end Lattice

name: compileFin
stmt: def compileFin {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint) : Fin n → RealNeuron
proof: fun i => convertReal (cs i)

name: RealTotalLoss
stmt: def RealTotalLoss {n : Nat} (ls : Fin n → RealNeuron) (x : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∑ i : Fin n, (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x) ^ 2

name: realTotalLoss_zero_iff_all_outputs
stmt:
theorem realTotalLoss_zero_iff_all_outputs {n : Nat} (ls : Fin n → RealNeuron) (x : ℝ) :
    RealTotalLoss ls x = 0 ↔ ∀ i : Fin n, RealNeuronOut (ls i) x = 0
proof:
by
  unfold RealTotalLoss
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg]
  · constructor
    · intro h i
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (h i (Finset.mem_univ i))
    · intro h i hi
      exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mpr (h i)
  · intro i hi
    exact sq_nonneg (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x)

name: realTotalLoss_soundness
stmt:
theorem realTotalLoss_soundness {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint) (x : ℝ) :
    RealTotalLoss (compileFin cs) x = 0 ↔ ∀ i : Fin n, RealConstraintSat (cs i) x
proof:
by
  rw [realTotalLoss_zero_iff_all_outputs]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    exact (convertReal_preserves (cs i) x).mp (h i)
  · intro h i
    exact (convertReal_preserves (cs i) x).mpr (h i)

name: realTotalLoss_verify
stmt:
theorem realTotalLoss_verify {n : Nat} (cs : Fin n → RealConstraint) (x : ℝ)
    (h : RealTotalLoss (compileFin cs) x = 0) : ∀ i : Fin n, RealConstraintSat (cs i) x
proof: (realTotalLoss_soundness cs x).mp h

name: realTotalLoss_pos_of_unsatisfied
stmt:
theorem realTotalLoss_pos_of_unsatisfied {n : Nat} (ls : Fin n → RealNeuron) (x : ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (h : RealNeuronOut (ls i) x ≠ 0) : 0 < RealTotalLoss ls x
proof:
by
  unfold RealTotalLoss
                       
  have hsq : 0 < (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x) ^ 2 := by
    have hsq0 : (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hs
      exact h (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hs)
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x)) (Ne.symm hsq0)
  have hsum_ge : (RealNeuronOut (ls i) x) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, (RealNeuronOut (ls j) x) ^ 2 := by
                                   
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun j hj => sq_nonneg (RealNeuronOut (ls j) x)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hsq hsum_ge

end Lattice

name: LipschitzOn
stmt: def LipschitzOn (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (Ω : Set ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∀ x y : ℝ, x ∈ Ω → y ∈ Ω → |f x - f y| ≤ L * |x - y|

name: DeltaDense
stmt: def DeltaDense (S : Set ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (Ω : Set ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ Ω → ∃ s : ℝ, s ∈ Ω ∧ s ∈ S ∧ |x - s| ≤ δ

name: SampledVerified
stmt: def SampledVerified (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (ε₀ : ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) : Prop
proof: ∀ s : ℝ, s ∈ S → |f s - g s| ≤ ε₀

name: verifier_reliable_clean
stmt:
theorem verifier_reliable_clean (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (L L' ε₀ δ : ℝ) (Ω : Set ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hf : LipschitzOn f L Ω) (hg : LipschitzOn g L' Ω)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hL' : 0 ≤ L')
    (hd : DeltaDense S δ Ω) (hv : SampledVerified f g ε₀ S) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ Ω → |f x - g x| ≤ ε₀ + (L + L') * δ
proof:
by
  intro x hx
  rcases hd x hx with ⟨s, hsΩ, hsS, hxs⟩
  calc
    |f x - g x| = |(f x - f s) + (f s - g s) + (g s - g x)| := by
      have h : f x - g x = (f x - f s) + (f s - g s) + (g s - g x) := by ring
      rw [h]
    _ ≤ |f x - f s| + |(f s - g s) + (g s - g x)| := by
      rw [add_assoc]
      exact abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ |f x - f s| + (|f s - g s| + |g s - g x|) := by
      have hb : |(f s - g s) + (g s - g x)| ≤ |f s - g s| + |g s - g x| := abs_add _ _
      linarith
    _ ≤ L * |x - s| + (ε₀ + L' * |x - s|) := by
      have h1 : |f x - f s| ≤ L * |x - s| := hf x s hx hsΩ
      have h2 : |f s - g s| ≤ ε₀ := hv s hsS
      have h3 : |g s - g x| ≤ L' * |s - x| := hg s x hsΩ hx
      have h4 : |s - x| = |x - s| := by rw [abs_sub_comm]
      nlinarith
    _ = ε₀ + (L + L') * |x - s| := by ring
    _ ≤ ε₀ + (L + L') * δ := by
                               
      have hpos : 0 ≤ L + L' := by linarith
      exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxs hpos) ε₀

name: verifier_error_vanishes
stmt:
theorem verifier_error_vanishes (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (L L' ε₀ δ : ℝ) (Ω : Set ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hf : LipschitzOn f L Ω) (hg : LipschitzOn g L' Ω)
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hL' : 0 ≤ L')
    (hd : DeltaDense S δ Ω) (hv : SampledVerified f g ε₀ S)
    (hε : ε₀ = 0) (hδ : δ = 0) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ Ω → |f x - g x| ≤ 0
proof:
by
  intro x hx
  have hb := verifier_reliable_clean f g L L' ε₀ δ Ω S hf hg hL hL' hd hv x hx
  rw [hε, hδ] at hb
  simpa using hb

end Lattice

name: rectangularRep
doc:
**任意 `m × n` 层的精确双向表示**：`compile := layerOfListRect`，`extract := listOfLayerRect`。

`roundtrip` 用的是 `roundtrip_rect`，不是假设。
stmt:
noncomputable def rectangularRep (hn : 0 < n) :
    Representation { s : List ℝ // s.length = m * n + n } (LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) where
  inputP
proof:
Fin n → ℝ
  inputW := Fin n → ℝ
  encode := id
  decode := id
  compile := fun p => layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) p.val
  extract := fun L => ⟨listOfLayerRect hn L, listOfLayerRect_length hn L⟩
  roundtrip := by
    intro p
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact roundtrip_rect hn p.val p.property

name: rectangularRep_roundtrip
doc: **往返**：提取是编译的逆。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_roundtrip (hn : 0 < n)
    (p : { s : List ℝ // s.length = m * n + n }) :
    (rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).extract
        ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).compile p) = p
proof: (rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).roundtrip p

name: rectangularRep_val_roundtrip
doc: **读回的值就是原来的列表**。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_val_roundtrip (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ)
    (hlen : s.length = m * n + n) :
    ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).extract
        ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩)).val = s
proof:
by
  rw [rectangularRep_roundtrip]

name: rectangularRep_coeff
doc:
**读回系数**：逆读出的第 `i*n + j` 项就是编译进去的 `W i j`。

这条把「提取」与权重矩阵的**分量**连起来，而不只是说两个列表相等。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_coeff (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ) (hlen : s.length = m * n + n)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).extract
        ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩)).val.getD
        (i.val * n + j.val) 0 =
      (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W i j
proof:
by
  rw [rectangularRep_val_roundtrip]
  exact (layerOfListRect_W s i j).symm

name: rectangularRep_bias
doc: **读回偏置**：第 `m*n + j` 项就是 `b j`。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_bias (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ) (hlen : s.length = m * n + n)
    (j : Fin n) :
    ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).extract
        ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩)).val.getD
        (m * n + j.val) 0 =
      (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).b j
proof:
by
  rw [rectangularRep_val_roundtrip]
  exact (layerOfListRect_b s j).symm

name: rectangularRep_degenerates
doc:
**`m = n` 时退化为方阵版**：两个 `Representation` 的 `compile` 逐字相同。

这是「推广而非平行」的机器检查形式：方阵版不是被取代，而是本节的一个特例。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_degenerates (h : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ)
    (hlen : s.length = n * n + n) (i j : Fin n) :
    ((rectangularRep (m := n) (n := n) h).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩).W i j =
        ((FullWidth.weightSymbolRep h).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩).W i j ∧
      ((rectangularRep (m := n) (n := n) h).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩).b j =
        ((FullWidth.weightSymbolRep h).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩).b j
proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).W i j =
      (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).W i j
    exact (layerOfListRect_eq_full_width s i j).1
  · show (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).b j =
      (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).b j
    exact (layerOfListRect_eq_full_width s i j).2

name: any_shape_is_exactly_representable
doc:
**任意形状的层都可精确往返**——本节的主结论，一条可引用的陈述。

它说的是：对**任意** `m`、`n`（`n > 0`），存在一个 `Representation`，其 `compile` 是本节
的满宽编码器，且 `roundtrip` 已证。**方阵只是 `m = n` 的特例。**
stmt:
theorem any_shape_is_exactly_representable :
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n),
      ∃ R : Representation { s : List ℝ // s.length = m * n + n }
              (LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)),
        (∀ p, R.compile p = layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) p.val) ∧
        (∀ p, R.extract (R.compile p) = p)
proof:
fun m n hn =>
    ⟨rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn, fun _ => rfl,
     rectangularRep_roundtrip (m := m) (n := n) hn⟩

end Lattice.Lift.Rectangular

name: layerOfListRect
doc: **长方阵的满宽编码器**：`W i j` 读 `s[i*n + j]`，`b j` 读 `s[m*n + j]`。
stmt:
noncomputable def layerOfListRect (s : List ℝ) : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n) where
  W
proof:
fun i j => s.getD (i.val * n + j.val) 0
  b := fun j => s.getD (m * n + j.val) 0

name: layerOfListRect_W
doc: **读回系数**：位置就是定义里写的那个。
stmt:
theorem layerOfListRect_W (s : List ℝ) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W i j = s.getD (i.val * n + j.val) 0
proof: rfl

name: layerOfListRect_b
doc: **读回偏置**：在 `m*n` 之后。
stmt:
theorem layerOfListRect_b (s : List ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).b j = s.getD (m * n + j.val) 0
proof: rfl

name: listOfLayerRect
doc:
**逆**：系数按除法索引读回，然后偏置。

`Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn` 把 `k/n < m` 归结为 `0 < n ∧ k < m*n`——后者正是 `k.isLt`。
**不能用 `Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul`**：它要求除数在前，而 `k` 的类型是 `Fin (m*n)`，重排会破坏 `k.isLt`。
stmt: noncomputable def listOfLayerRect (hn : 0 < n) (L : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) : List ℝ
proof:
(List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (m * n) =>
      L.W ⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn).mpr k.isLt⟩ ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩)) ++
    (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => L.b j))

name: listOfLayerRect_length
doc: **逆的长度是 `m*n + n`。**
stmt:
theorem listOfLayerRect_length (hn : 0 < n) (L : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) :
    (listOfLayerRect hn L).length = m * n + n
proof:
by
  unfold listOfLayerRect
  rw [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn, List.length_ofFn]

name: roundtrip_rect
doc:
**往返**：`listOfLayerRect` 是 `layerOfListRect` 的逆（长度匹配时）。

证明结构与方阵版相同：`List.ext_getElem` + `List.getElem_append_left`/`_right`
（它们的下标证明是**隐式**的，所以 `ext` 提供的证明自然匹配），
系数半归约成 `(k/n)*n + k%n = k`，偏置半归约成 `m*n + (k - m*n) = k`。
stmt:
theorem roundtrip_rect (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ) (hlen : s.length = m * n + n) :
    listOfLayerRect hn (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s) = s
proof:
by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · rw [listOfLayerRect_length, hlen]
  · intro k h1 h2
    unfold listOfLayerRect
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (m * n) with hk | hk
    · rw [List.getElem_append_left (i := k) (as := List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (m * n) =>
          (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W
            ⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn).mpr k.isLt⟩ ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))
        (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hk)]
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, layerOfListRect_W]
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (k / n) n, Nat.div_add_mod k n]
      exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h2
    · rw [List.getElem_append_right (i := k) (as := List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (m * n) =>
          (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W
            ⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn).mpr k.isLt⟩ ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))
        (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hk)]
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, layerOfListRect_b]
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      rw [List.length_ofFn, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk]
      exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h2

name: layerOfListRect_eq_full_width
doc:
**`m = n` 时退化为方阵版**：这是「推广而非平行」的机器检查形式。

方阵版 `layerOfListFull` 的 `W` 与 `b` 与本节的 `layerOfListRect` 在 `m = n` 时逐字相同。
stmt:
theorem layerOfListRect_eq_full_width {n : ℕ} (s : List ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).W i j =
        (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).W i j ∧
      (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).b j =
        (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).b j
proof:
⟨rfl, rfl⟩

end Lattice.Lift.Rectangular

name: toParams
doc: **`AffineLayer n` → `LayerParams n n`**。
stmt:
def toParams {n : Type} (p : AffineLayer n) : LayerParams n n where
  W
proof:
p.W
  b := p.b

name: ofParams
doc: **`LayerParams n n` → `AffineLayer n`**。
stmt:
def ofParams {n : Type} (q : LayerParams n n) : AffineLayer n where
  W
proof:
q.W
  b := q.b

name: toParams_ofParams
doc: **往返**：两族在方阵情形下是同一个东西。
stmt: theorem toParams_ofParams {n : Type} (q : LayerParams n n) : toParams (ofParams q) = q
proof: rfl

name: ofParams_toParams
doc: **往返（另一方向）**。
stmt: theorem ofParams_toParams {n : Type} (p : AffineLayer n) : ofParams (toParams p) = p
proof: rfl

name: toParams_injective
doc: **单射**：转换不丢信息。
stmt: theorem toParams_injective {n : Type} : Function.Injective (@toParams n)
proof:
by
  intro p q h
  have := ofParams_toParams p ▸ ofParams_toParams q ▸ congrArg ofParams h
  simpa using this

name: act_toParams
doc:
**函子性**：`AffineLayer` 与 `LayerParams` 的前向传播一致。

**这是「换一族表示不改变行为」的确切内容**——
不是范畴论的口号，而是 `affineAct p x = LayerParams.act (toParams p) x`。
stmt:
theorem act_toParams {n : Type} [Fintype n] (p : AffineLayer n) (x : n → ℝ) (j : n) :
    affineAct p x j = (∑ i, (toParams p).W i j * x i) + (toParams p).b j
proof: rfl

name: toMLayer
doc: **`LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)` → `MLayer m n`**。
stmt:
def toMLayer {m n : ℕ} (q : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) : MLayer m n where
  W
proof:
fun i j => q.W i j
  b := q.b

name: ofMLayer
doc: **`MLayer m n` → `LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)`**。
stmt:
def ofMLayer {m n : ℕ} (l : MLayer m n) : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n) where
  W
proof:
fun i j => l.W i j
  b := l.b

name: toMLayer_ofMLayer
stmt: theorem toMLayer_ofMLayer {m n : ℕ} (l : MLayer m n) : toMLayer (ofMLayer l) = l
proof:
by
  cases l; rfl

name: ofMLayer_toMLayer
doc: **往返（另一方向）**。
stmt:
theorem ofMLayer_toMLayer {m n : ℕ} (q : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) :
    ofMLayer (toMLayer q) = q
proof:
by
  cases q; rfl

name: three_families_connected
doc:
**三族连通**：`AffineLayer n` 与 `LayerParams n n` 同构，
且 `LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)` 与 `MLayer m n` 同构。

⇒ **权重侧不是一族，是三族且可互转。** 这是「链 → 谱系」的第一步。
stmt:
theorem three_families_connected {n m : ℕ} :
    (∀ q : LayerParams (Fin n) (Fin n), toParams (ofParams q) = q) ∧
    (∀ p : AffineLayer (Fin n), ofParams (toParams p) = p) ∧
    (∀ l : MLayer m n, toMLayer (ofMLayer l) = l) ∧
    (∀ q : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n), ofMLayer (toMLayer q) = q)
proof:
⟨fun q => toParams_ofParams q,
   fun p => ofParams_toParams p,
   fun l => toMLayer_ofMLayer l,
   fun q => ofMLayer_toMLayer q⟩

end RepresentationFamilies

end Lattice.Lift

name: compileZ
doc:
**有损编译**：整数除以 2（向下取整）。

这不是单射：`2 / 2 = 1 = 3 / 2`。所以信息真的丢了。
stmt: def compileZ (x : ℤ) : ℤ

name: extractZ
doc: **提取**：选代表元 `2 * k`。
stmt: def extractZ (k : ℤ) : ℤ

name: compileZ_not_injective
doc: **`compile` 不是单射。** 这是「有损」的直接证据。
stmt: theorem compileZ_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective compileZ
proof:
by
  intro hinj
  have h : compileZ 2 = compileZ 3 := by decide
  have h23 : (2 : ℤ) = 3 := hinj h
  norm_num at h23

name: roundtrip_error_le_one
doc: **往返误差的上界是 1。** 这是有损系统的可用性保证。
stmt: theorem roundtrip_error_le_one (x : ℤ) : |extractZ (compileZ x) - x| ≤ 1
proof:
by
  unfold extractZ compileZ
  have h1 : 2 * (x / 2) ≤ x := by omega
  have h2 : x < 2 * (x / 2) + 2 := by omega
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> omega

name: roundtrip_error_eq_one
doc: **误差确实会达到 1**（对奇数），所以这个界是紧的。
stmt:
theorem roundtrip_error_eq_one (x : ℤ) (hodd : x % 2 ≠ 0) :
    extractZ (compileZ x) - x = -1
proof:
by
  unfold extractZ compileZ
  have h2 : x < 2 * (x / 2) + 2 := by omega
  have h1 : 2 * (x / 2) ≤ x := by omega
  omega

name: obsLeOne
doc:
**有界相关**：两个整数相差不超过 1。

它自反，并且严格比等式粗（`2` 与 `3` 相差 1 但不相等）。
stmt: def obsLeOne (x y : ℤ) : Prop

name: obsLeOne_refl
doc: `obsLeOne` 自反。
stmt: theorem obsLeOne_refl (x : ℤ) : obsLeOne x x
proof:
by
  unfold obsLeOne
  simp

name: obsLeOne_weaker
doc: `obsLeOne` 严格比等式粗。
stmt: theorem obsLeOne_weaker : ∃ x y : ℤ, x ≠ y ∧ obsLeOne x y
proof:
by
  refine ⟨2, 3, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  unfold obsLeOne
  norm_num

name: roundingLossy
doc:
**取整压缩是一个真正的有损表示。**

`compile` 非单射（有损），`obs` 取有界相关（比等式粗），
而 `semEq` 由 `roundtrip_error_le_one` 供给。

**它不来自任何 `Representation`**：`compile` 非单射，所以不存在左逆。
stmt:
def roundingLossy : LossyRepresentation.LossyRep ℤ ℤ where
  inputP
proof:
ℤ
  inputW := ℤ
  encode := id
  decode := id
  compile := compileZ
  extract := extractZ
  obs := obsLeOne
  obs_refl := obsLeOne_refl
  semEq := fun x => roundtrip_error_le_one x

end RoundingBackend

end Lattice.Lift

name: clampTo
stmt: def clampTo (B x : ℤ) : ℤ
proof: max (-B) (min B x)

name: clamp_le
doc: **上界**：`clampTo B x ≤ B`。
stmt: theorem clamp_le (B x : ℤ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) : clampTo B x ≤ B
proof: max_le (by omega) (min_le_left B x)

name: le_clamp
doc: **下界**：`-B ≤ clampTo B x`。
stmt: theorem le_clamp (B x : ℤ) : -B ≤ clampTo B x
proof: le_max_left _ _

name: clamp_eq_self
doc: **区间内不动**：`|x| ≤ B` 时截断不改变值。
stmt: theorem clamp_eq_self (B x : ℤ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hx : |x| ≤ B) : clampTo B x = x
proof:
by
  have hx1 : -B ≤ x := (abs_le.mp hx).1
  have hx2 : x ≤ B := (abs_le.mp hx).2
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact max_le hx1 (min_le_right B x)
  · exact le_trans (le_min hx2 (le_refl x)) (le_max_right _ _)

name: clamp_eq_of_le
doc: **低于下界时夹到下界**。
stmt: theorem clamp_eq_of_le (B x : ℤ) (hx : x ≤ -B) : clampTo B x = -B
proof:
by
  have hmin : min B x ≤ -B := le_trans (min_le_right B x) hx
  exact max_eq_left hmin

name: clamp_eq_of_ge
doc: **高于上界时夹到上界**。
stmt: theorem clamp_eq_of_ge (B x : ℤ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hx : B ≤ x) : clampTo B x = B
proof:
by
  have hmin : min B x = B := min_eq_left hx
  rw [clampTo, hmin]
  exact max_eq_right (by omega)

name: clamp_error
doc:
**饱和失真的完整刻画**：截断值与 `x` 的差不超过超出量。

`|x| ≤ B` 时为零，超出时正好是 `|x| - B`。**饱和失真没有别的东西。**
stmt:
theorem clamp_error (B x : ℤ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    |clampTo B x - x| ≤ max (|x| - B) 0
proof:
by
  by_cases hx : x < -B
  · have hneg : x < 0 := by omega
    rw [clamp_eq_of_le B x (le_of_lt hx)]
    have : (-B : ℤ) - x = -x - B := by ring
    rw [this, abs_of_pos (by omega), abs_of_neg hneg]
    exact le_max_left _ _
  · by_cases hx2 : B < x
    · have hpos : 0 < x := by omega
      rw [clamp_eq_of_ge B x hB (le_of_lt hx2)]
      have : (B : ℤ) - x = -(x - B) := by ring
      rw [this, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by omega), abs_of_pos hpos]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · have hin : |x| ≤ B := by
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> omega
      rw [clamp_eq_self B x hB hin]
      rw [show x - x = (0 : ℤ) by ring, abs_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _

name: satQuant
doc:
**饱和量化**：先丢 `b` 位，再截断到 `[-B, B]`，再乘回。

顺序与实现一致：除 → clamp → 乘。**反过来做会对不齐**（先乘回再截断，
截断作用在量化后的值上而不是量化域上）。
stmt: def satQuant (b : ℕ) (B x : ℤ) : ℤ
proof: clampTo B (x / (2 : ℤ) ^ b) * 2 ^ b

name: satQuant_rounding
doc:
**舍入损失**：丢 `b` 位造成的那一份，**与值无关的常数界**。

这是 `quant_error_lt_two_pow` 的直接复用。
stmt:
theorem satQuant_rounding (b : ℕ) (x : ℤ) :
    |(x / (2 : ℤ) ^ b) * 2 ^ b - x| < 2 ^ b
proof:
by
  have h := quant_error_lt_two_pow b x
  rwa [mul_comm] at h

name: satQuant_saturation
doc:
**饱和损失**：截断造成的那一份，**依赖值**。

`|q| ≤ B` 时为零；超出时等于超出量。
stmt:
theorem satQuant_saturation (b : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (x : ℤ) :
    |clampTo B (x / (2 : ℤ) ^ b) - x / (2 : ℤ) ^ b| ≤
      max (|x / (2 : ℤ) ^ b| - B) 0
proof: clamp_error B _ hB

name: satQuant_error_scales
doc:
**总失真不能用一个常数界住**：一个具体见证显示饱和误差可以是 `2^b` 的任意倍数。

取 `x = (B + 1) * 2^b`：它量化成 `B + 1`，截断到 `B`，乘回 `B * 2^b`，误差正好 `2^b`。
再取 `x = (B + k) * 2^b` 就得到 `k * 2^b`——**误差随超出量线性增长，与位宽无关。**

**这是本节最重要的陈述**：加了截断之后，「量化误差 ≤ 2^b」这句话**是错的**，
而很多人会默认它。饱和失真的量级由**值域**决定，不由位宽决定。
stmt:
theorem satQuant_error_scales (b : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (k : ℕ) :
    satQuant b B ((B + k + 1) * 2 ^ b) - (B + k + 1) * 2 ^ b = -(k + 1) * 2 ^ b
proof:
by
  unfold satQuant
  have hpos : (0 : ℤ) < 2 ^ b := by positivity
  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel _ (ne_of_gt hpos)]
  have hge : B ≤ B + k + 1 := by omega
  rw [clamp_eq_of_ge B _ hB hge]
  ring

name: satQuant_error_abs
doc: **推论**：误差的绝对值是 `(k+1) * 2^b`，所以它随 `k` 无界增长、与 `b` 无关。
stmt:
theorem satQuant_error_abs (b : ℕ) (B : ℤ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (k : ℕ) :
    |satQuant b B ((B + k + 1) * 2 ^ b) - (B + k + 1) * 2 ^ b| = (k + 1) * 2 ^ b
proof:
by
  rw [satQuant_error_scales b B hB k]
  rw [neg_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]

end Lattice.Lift.IntQuant

name: StackExpr
stmt:
inductive StackExpr (σ : Type) (α : Type) where
  | lit : α → StackExpr σ α
  | load : σ → StackExpr σ α
  | add : StackExpr σ α → StackExpr σ α → StackExpr σ α
  | sub : StackExpr σ α → StackExpr σ α → StackExpr σ α
  | mul : StackExpr σ α → StackExpr σ α → StackExpr σ α

name: evalStack
stmt:
def evalStack [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] (cfg : σ → α) : StackExpr σ α → α
  | .lit a => a
  | .load i => cfg i
  | .add x y => evalStack cfg x + evalStack cfg y
  | .sub x y => evalStack cfg x - evalStack cfg y
  | .mul x y => evalStack cfg x * evalStack cfg y

name: stackDepth
doc:
Stack depth. `lit` and `load` need one slot; a binary node needs the larger branch, plus one if
the larger is the second.
stmt:
def stackDepth : StackExpr σ α → ℕ
  | .lit _ => 1
  | .load _ => 1
  | .add x y => max (stackDepth x) (stackDepth y - 1)
  | .sub x y => max (stackDepth x) (stackDepth y - 1)
  | .mul x y => max (stackDepth x) (stackDepth y - 1)

name: StackOp
stmt:
inductive StackOp (σ : Type) (α : Type) where
  | push : α → StackOp σ α
  | load : σ → StackOp σ α
  | add : StackOp σ α
  | sub : StackOp σ α
  | mul : StackOp σ α

name: runOp
stmt:
def runOp [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] (cfg : σ → α) : StackOp σ α → List α → Option (List α)
  | .push a, st => some (a :: st)
  | .load i, st => some (cfg i :: st)
  | .add, x :: y :: st => some ((y + x) :: st)
  | .add, _ => none
  | .sub, x :: y :: st => some ((y - x) :: st)
  | .sub, _ => none
  | .mul, x :: y :: st => some ((y * x) :: st)
  | .mul, _ => none

name: compileAcc
stmt:
def compileAcc : StackExpr σ α → List (StackOp σ α) → List (StackOp σ α)
  | .lit a, acc => acc ++ [.push a]
  | .load i, acc => acc ++ [.load i]
  | .add x y, acc => compileAcc y (compileAcc x acc) ++ [.add]
  | .sub x y, acc => compileAcc y (compileAcc x acc) ++ [.sub]
  | .mul x y, acc => compileAcc y (compileAcc x acc) ++ [.mul]

name: compileProg
stmt: def compileProg (e : StackExpr σ α) : List (StackOp σ α)
proof: compileAcc e []

name: runProg
stmt:
def runProg [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] (cfg : σ → α) :
    List (StackOp σ α) → List α → Option (List α)
  | [], st => some st
  | op :: rest, st =>
      (match runOp cfg op st with
       | some st' => runProg cfg rest st'
       | none => none)

name: stackDepth_left
stmt: theorem stackDepth_left (a b n : ℕ) (h : max a (b - 1) ≤ n) : a ≤ n
proof: le_trans (le_max_left _ _) h

name: le_succ_of_pred_le
stmt: theorem le_succ_of_pred_le (b n : ℕ) (h : b - 1 ≤ n) : b ≤ n + 1
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b with hb | hb
  · simp only [hb]; omega
  · have : b - 1 + 1 = b := Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hb
    omega

name: stackDepth_right
stmt: theorem stackDepth_right (a b n : ℕ) (h : max a (b - 1) ≤ n) : b ≤ n + 1
proof: le_succ_of_pred_le b n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) h)

name: runProg_append
stmt:
theorem runProg_append [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] (cfg : σ → α)
    (p q : List (StackOp σ α)) (st : List α) :
    ∀ (mid : List α), runProg cfg p st = some mid → runProg cfg (p ++ q) st = runProg cfg q mid
proof:
by
  induction p generalizing st with
  | nil =>
      intro mid h
      simp only [runProg, Option.some.injEq] at h
      rw [← h]
      simp only [List.nil_append]
  | cons op rest ih =>
      intro mid h
      simp only [runProg] at h ⊢
      split at h
      · rename_i st' _
        exact ih st' mid h
      · simp at h

name: compileAcc_correct
stmt:
theorem compileAcc_correct [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] (cfg : σ → α) (e : StackExpr σ α) :
    ∀ (acc : List (StackOp σ α)) (st st' : List α),
      runProg cfg acc st = some st' → stackDepth e ≤ st'.length →
      runProg cfg (compileAcc e acc) st = some (evalStack cfg e :: st')
proof:
by
  induction e with
  | lit a =>
      intro acc st st' hacc _
      show runProg cfg (acc ++ [StackOp.push a]) st = some (a :: st')
      rw [runProg_append cfg acc [StackOp.push a] st st' hacc]
      rfl
  | load i =>
      intro acc st st' hacc _
      show runProg cfg (acc ++ [StackOp.load i]) st = some (cfg i :: st')
      rw [runProg_append cfg acc [StackOp.load i] st st' hacc]
      rfl
  | add x y ihx ihy =>
      intro acc st st' hacc hd
      have hdx : stackDepth x ≤ st'.length := stackDepth_left _ _ _ hd
      have hix := ihx acc st st' hacc hdx

        some ((evalStack cfg x + evalStack cfg y) :: st')

            (evalStack cfg y :: evalStack cfg x :: st') hiy]
      rfl
  | sub x y ihx ihy =>
      intro acc st st' hacc hd
      have hdx : stackDepth x ≤ st'.length := stackDepth_left _ _ _ hd
      have hix := ihx acc st st' hacc hdx
      have hdy : stackDepth y ≤ (evalStack cfg x :: st').length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons]; exact stackDepth_right _ _ _ hd
      have hiy := ihy (compileAcc x acc) st (evalStack cfg x :: st') hix hdy

name: compileProg_correct
stmt:
theorem compileProg_correct [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] (cfg : σ → α) (e : StackExpr σ α) (seed : α)
    (h : stackDepth e ≤ 1) :
    runProg cfg (compileProg e) [seed] = some (evalStack cfg e :: [seed])
proof:
by
  have := compileAcc_correct cfg e [] [seed] [seed] rfl (by simpa using h)
  simpa [compileProg] using this

name: exampleNat
doc: 具体程序：`(2 + 3) * 4`，在 `ℕ` 上，配置为空类型。

name: exampleNat_runs

name: exampleFloat
doc:
**`Float` 实例存在**——这正是 `CExpr` 轨道需要的载体。

`Float` 的相等不可判定（`NaN`），所以这里只检查**程序长度**，不检查求值结果。
**这正是 `STATE-FINAL` §3.6.2 记录的 `Float` 单向性的具体体现**：生成器可用，
而「运行结果等于什么」不能由 `decide` 判定。
stmt: def exampleFloat : StackExpr Empty Float
proof: .mul (.add (.lit 2.0) (.lit 3.0)) (.lit 4.0)

name: exampleFloat_compiles

by
  decide

name: float_is_a_valid_carrier
doc: **`CExpr` 的常量类型是 `Float`，而 `StackExpr _ Float` 就是这个载体。**
stmt: theorem float_is_a_valid_carrier : Nonempty (StackExpr Empty Float)
